spro/ / shes rig gi si rnam tshangs pa'i drang thig /ri 'pha drabye/lcang zhabs 'gyur med tshe dbang gi rtsomayig phyogasabasgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

she ngajo 1 tadzhai— tāk+ṣi5 ṭā ༵ sgyu ༅rnya/spyospyo/sna /lho rdzosnyi4 phonya1nyed+nghasto rdo rdo d+nghaḥmik+ko shā trephrodz+ra— zhe—tsāste / zhu 4t+t+waṃbheblad+dhadūstse+o // m+muzhed+ngha rke

da༅/ /da lta 'dzom gling na 'ongs su smyod du yod pa'i shes rig gsar rnying gangat+yān rung 'bro ba mi'i rigs kyis shes bya'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i brgyud rim jes can zhig brgyud nas byuja ba'i shes rig gi nying bcud lta but+yān/ bgrang bya stong phrag ru ma brgyud pa'i bod kyi srol rgyun rigaganas la ma na'ang byung rim rija mo'i khrod nas rang re'i pha mes kyiphre srog gi snying porawāzhag pa'i shes rab kyi yang bcud dam par bsnyon du.ed/ sngon rabs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi gtan nas med par gsar dar rig gnas skye khungs med la 'anem gling gsar dar rig gnas kyi 'phyung khungs su grags pa yo rob rig rtsal blar gso'i bya 'gul yangaskral rgyun rig gnas la gzhi bcol ba'i zlo sgo phyes pa tsam min nam/gnas dus ga ge mo zhig tu srol rig ga ge mo zhig dar bar grags pa tsam gyisaspags 'brang 'cholaglub dag ni dngosayod bden pa'i gnas lugs lawārtsi 'azhog med pa'i bsam blo sger gcod mtshan nyid par bes/ srol rgyuna'ag gnas dang dus rabs gsar pa gnyis nang 'gal mtha' gcig tuwābyung ba'i bes pa ci yang med la 'dzom gling 'dir brol rig la tsham tshom med par 'dor nyag cig btang ba'i mi rigs dang mkhas par grags pa ji snyed cig gis phyis 'dir 'gyod bshags zhu bzhin pa mi mthong ngam/ bod kyi brol rig gis 'phel rgyas kyi gom kha la 'gal rkyen gangalhung mi byed pa tsam du ma zad gsar rig gis bsgrun du mi nus pa'i 1

stongaṣ+ṭha skong ba la byas zhes 'azhog pa'i rin thaja gzhal thabs bral bas bod kyi'ag gnas ni 'dzom gling spyi nor zhig tu grub zin pas dus rabs gsarawā'i 'od rigs rnams kyis gal te mig rgyang thung ba'i col rdzung smyodawās de nyid brlag thabs byas na ngo tsha de las che ba med khar 'dzom gling spyi dgrar yang 'gyur srid/ gsar dar rig gnas dgos med smra thabs med cing rig gnas rnam gnyis muja du sbrel na gangs ri'i mu khyud lasawārgal ba dang ma brgarme me'i skye pho yongs la 'phral phugs kyi phan bde chen po bskrun pa gdon mi za/gna' deng gnyis ka'i shes rig la sbyong bamyon gyi 'jug pa yangs shing mun po grags rjes 'braja ba'i gshis smyod las ring du 'das pa raja gi dpyad stobs kyi rtsal kha rgyas pa'i grogs po 'gyur med che dbang lags ni phran sger 'os 'brel 'dris kyi rgyu mtshan tsam pas min par mkhas tshul rnam dpyod la ring mo nyid nas yi rang gus brtse ldan/ da lan yang rang mi'ags dang de'i rig gnas gtso bor 'brel ba'i brjod bya rnam dpyod kyis gzhal ba'i dpyad rtsom ci rigs phyogs cig dril ba'i deb gsar zhigadapar du bskrun par yid spro bla lhag brtas khar bod kyi rig gnas darazhang rgyas pa'i skul 'ded dang ris med 'gro rigs spyi la phan bde rgya chen bsgrub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i legs smon bkra shisargu'o// //rdzogs mchogagling sprul ming gur dga' des/spyi lo 2006lo'i zla ba 1tshes 30la phul/2

'go brjod/si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i dge rgan 'gyur med tshe dbang lags la dus ring po zhig gi spyi tshogs dang rig gnas/ dpal 'byor dang khor yug sogs kyis mngar skyur lan tshwa sogs kyi bro ba sna tshogs shig ster bas blo yi sa bon la 'du shes sna tshogs kyi lo 'dab rgyas pas thun min rang nyid kyi rtsom rig gi 'jig rten gong bu chung ngu'i 'bras bu smin pa 'di la yang bro ba 'dra min zhig myong rgyu yod par gdon mi za/dge rgan 'gyur med tshe dbang ni/ go la zlum po 'dir gnas kyi grags pa mi dman pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang po zhig zhabs kyis bcags pa'i yul rdzogs chen shrī seng du tshe sngon las kyis nga'i slob mar gyur/ de nas bzung dge 'gyur med tshe dbang gis 'jig rten gyi gar stegs thog tu gar ji ltar 'khrab ba nga dang 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig yin stabs/ ngas kyang nyams myong rgan po'i 'bel gtam gyi tshul du dngos sam brgyud nas mdzub ston dang slob gso gang mang byas pas gsal rig sems kyi ras gzhi la shugs rkyen gang mang zhig bzhag yod shag yin/ rgan 'gyur med tshe dbang ni nga'i slob ma yin pas rta bdag la rta rgyus zer ba bzhin/ nga la cha rgyus yod pas khong la pha ma dang yul mi nye ring bcas pas re ba zab mo bcangs pa nang bzhin gyis dpe cha la slob gnyer dga' rab byed mkhan zhig yin pas nga yang kho la dga' bo yod pas/ rtag par ngas kho la dpe cha'i skor la kha ta lab cing / rang shes kyi yon tan de dag rgyud la ci 'byor byas pa yin/ da lam yang shes rig gi spyi 1

rnam tshangs pa'i drang thig ces pa'i dpyad rtsom gyi deb cig phud pa 'di'i nang don gyi cha nas bshad na tshad ma rig pa dang / nang don rig pa/ bris gzugs kyi gal chen rang bzhin/ skabs bab bod mi'i shes rig las don sogs mang tsam zhig bris 'dug pas/ 'di'i 'bri stangs kyi thad nas gnas lugs drang por bshad pa dang / kha gsal la go bde ba/ blo mtho dman sus kyang rtogs sla ba/ mngon brjod sogs kyis ma bcings pa/ sgrub byed kyi thad nas rigs lam rgyu mtshan gyis phyug pa/ lta ba'i thad nas phyogs su ma lhung ba'i yon tan gyis brgyan pa/ nang don gyi cha nas dpe bshus rang bzhin dang / phyogs bsgrigs rang bzhin ma yin zhing / rang nyid blo gros kyi rtsal de brdab gsig btang nas bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyis bsam blo btang ba'i dpyad gsum gyi lam nas drang pa'i gtam du snang bas rin thang mi dman pa zhig yod snyam/spyir ngas rgyun par su la yang kha ta byed skabs su/ rtsom gang zhig yin rung drang po zhig 'bri dgos pa las 'khyogs po zhig 'bri mi rung ma gtogs/mi rabs nas mi rabs rnams su rtsom rig 'di dag shul du lus rgyu yin stabs/gnas tshul ngan pa ste/ ma dag rgyun 'byams dang / shugs rkyen ngan pa chags pa dang / lo rgyus kyi nyes can mi snar 'gyur gyi red ces bshad kyi yod/khyad par du nga tsho dpe gzigs byed mkhan zhig la bshad na/ blta klog bya rgyu'i dpe cha ni ri las mtho tsam pa/ rgyu skar las grangs mang ba zhig sngon byon dam pa dag gis brtsams zin pas/ blta klog byed mi thub pa las blta klog bya rgyu'i dpe cha med pa ga na yin/ der brten nga rang gi lta tshul dngos ma ltar na rtsom rig la dga' bo de tsam med de/ gang yin zer na 'khyogs bshad kyi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyur nas ma dag rgyun 'byams kyis go la 'di btsog dri bro bar byas pa la skrag gi yod/ 'on kyang sems can mos pa sna tshogs yin pas/2

gsar rtsom la 'dod blo yod pa'i mi sna yang gang mang yod nges pas de dag gi thugs dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhig tu 'gyur rgyu dang / gal te gsar rtsom la dga' zhen yod mkhan gyi mi dag mchis tshe de dag gis kyang 'khyogs bshad mi byed cing gnas lugs drang por brjod thub pa'i smon 'dun gyis brgyan te/hor brag 'go dgon gyi dge ming 'dzin pa blo bzang don 'grub kyis/spyi lo 2006lo'i zla ba10tshes 22nyin la/
dhemi snabhenya 4khu ji ( ( — zhed+nghazhe

dkar chagatshad ma byung 'phel skor cung zad gleng ba/ ( 1 )dang po/ tshad ma spyi bshad pa las dang po tshad ma'i dgag sgrub kyi skor bshad pa/ ( 1 )gnyis pa/ rgya gar dang bod du tshad ma'i rig gzhung dar tshul skor/ ( 8 )gsum pa/ tshad ma'i nus pa logs su bshad pa/ (11)bzhi pa/ nga tsho'i bod kyi tshad ma 'di phyi rol yul du spyod dgos pa'i skor/ (15)lnga pa/ nang don rig pa ni tshad ma rig pa yin zhing de'i gtan tshigs rnams yang dag yin tshul bshad pa/ (17)drug pa/ chos las kyang 'jig rten sgrub mkhan mang tshul bshad pa/ (20)bdun pa/ tshad ma rig pa dang gtan tshigs rig pa'i don bshad pa/ (23)bla ma'i rnam thar drang por bshadapa/ (33)bod skad spyi skad skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/ (43)bod kyi srol rgyun tshad ma dang spyi tshogs lam lugs zung 'brel byedapa'i skor/ (47)1

dang po/ tshad ma'i gzhung dngos bshad pa/ (47)gnyis pa/ gsal bshad kyi skor/ (49)gsum pa/ slar yang gzugs sgra gnyis kyi don gsal bor bshad pa/ (51)bzhi pa/ sgra rlung dang 'od rlabs kyi myur tshad bshad pa/ (55)lnga pa/ slar yang dri ro reg bya gsum gyi don gsal por bshad pa/ (57)drug pa/ tshad ma rig pa las rtags gsal dang mtshan gzhi sbyar nas bshad pa/ (60)dam chos kyi che ba 'ga' bshad pa kun dga'i gtam gyi rol mo/ (94)dang po/ mthun sgril gyi rtsa ba dam chos/ (94)gnyis pa/ sdug bsngal can la dam chos/ (96)gsum pa/ dam chos ngo ma (98)bzhi pa/ 'tshe med zhi ba'i chos (99)lnga pa/ blo bde gu yangs kyi chos/ (100)drug pa/ bsam blo gcig tu zlum pa'i chos (101)bdun pa/ sems khams la zhib 'jug byed pa'i chos/ (103)brgyad pa/ kun la snyoms pa'i chos (104)yun ring zhig nas bshad bsam pa (107)bris kyi slob gso'i nyams myong cung tsam gleng ba/ (113)dang po/ bris gzugs kyi gal che'i rang bzhin bshad pa/ (113)gnyis pa/ bris gzugs khyab spel gtong thabs skor bshad pa/ (115)gsum pa/ bris gzugs dar spel gtong bar 'gal rkyen la dogs zon dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/ (116)2

bzhi pa/ yig gzugs ni mi rigs kyi srog rtsa yin tshul bshad pa/ (118)lnga pa/ bod kyi yig gzugs kyi 'byung khungs bshad pa/ (120)drug pa/ yi ge byed thabs sna tshogs bshad pa/ (122)mthar phyin tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam bshad/ (124)mkhas pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/ (129)dang po/ gnad bsdus te bshad pa/ (130)gnyis pa/ mkhas pa'i tshul bshad pa/ (133)hor rong pa tsha'i gling gi mdzad rjes skor gleng ba/ (136)dang po/ ge sar gyi sgrung ni bod shes rig gi ma lag gtso bo zhig yin/ (136)gnyis pa/ khyad par hor rong pa tsha dang 'brel ba'i ge sar gyi rig gnas/ (141)khri'i lo la btsan po skyi'i ra sa thang gi phyag sbal na bzhugs dus bka' bstsal ba'i gcigs kyi yi ge'i 'grel bshad mthong ba don ldan bzhugs/ (146)si bod slob grwa'i dge rgan rnam par bsam chul 'ga' zhu ba/ (157)shing rta 'khor lo/ (165)lha ldan du song ba'i myong tsho/ (170)phyi gling du song ba'i mthong thos/ (183)dang po/ khor yug gi skor/ (183)gnyis pa/ 'tsho ba'i skor/ (184)gsum pa/ 'dod brtse'i skor/ (187)bzhi pa/ slob gso'i skor/ (188)3

lnga pa/ chos lugs kyi skor/ (191)drug pa/ chab srid lam lugs kyi skor/ (193)bdun pa/ mngon gsal dod po'i dge mtshan gyi skor/ (195)brgyad pa/ lam gyi mthong thos skor/ (197)skabs babs bod mi'i shes rig las don mdor brjod dang po/ (199)dang po/ rig gnas spyi yi rnam gzhag cung bshad pa/ (199)gnyis pa/ slob grwa'i slob gso skor bye brag tu bshad pa/ (203)gsum pa/ bod kyi shes rig dar spel gtong tshul cung zad bshad pa/ (206)bzhi pa/ gal che ba'i bya ba 'ga' bshad pa/ (223)skabs babs bod mi'i shes rig las don mdor brjod gnyis pa/(233)dang po/ bod kyi rig gnas che chung lnga yi dgos mkho brjod pa/ (233)gnyis pa/ rang rigs kyi chos pa'i 'gro lugs brjod pa/ (245)gsum pa/ rang rigs kyi re sgug gi 'bras bu brjod pa/ (249)bzhi pa/ si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i shugs rkyen brjod pa/ (253)lnga pa/ chos srid kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin brjod pa/ (258)drug pa/ la rgya'i dgos pa dang dge mtshan brjod pa/ (265)bdun pa/ 'tsho sdod kyi don du thon las lag rtsal la 'bad dgos tshul brjod pa/ (271)brgyad pa/ rang rigs kyi rgyu nor thad kar brjod pa/ (277)dgu pa/ rang rigs kyi mo dang ju thig skor bshad pa/ (282)bcu pa/ rang rigs kyi tshong las kyi skor la cung zad dpyad pa/ (288)4

bcu gcig pa/ 'phel rgyas de phyogs re'i 'phel rgyas la go mi rung ba'i tshul bshad pa/ (299)bcu gnyis pa/ 'brug dang gnam yig la dpyad pa cung byed pa/ (303)bcu gsum pa/ ngal rtsol gyi dge mtshan bshad pa/ (306)bcu bzhi pa/ deng gi bla slob kyi tshul cung zad bshad pa/ (310)bco lnga pa/ khog yangs dang thabs mkhas kyi stobs shugs bshad pa/ (316)bcu drug pa/ sangs rgyas dang sems can la bya ba byed pa'i tshul cung zad bshad pa/ (321)bcu bdun pa/ gtso bo dang rgyal po'i rnam gzhag cung bshad pa/ (325)bco brgyad pa/ gtsang sbra'i 'phrod bsten skor bshad pa/ (331)bcu dgu pa/ ma rtsa bed spyod thabs bshad pa/ (342)nyi shu pa/ dang len gyi nus pa bshad pa/ (344)nyer gcig pa/ phyug 'gyur gyi thabs bshad pa/ (346)nyer gnyis pa/ mi'i srog mi gcod pa'i khas len byed dgos pa'i skor/ (348)mjug byang / (352)5
7bhecici— rjotsho r+sā pa'iṭā sngulha ༷'i sta 7(jistelho 0 rdzornyari kho)ji rdzocho zhu )ge lko tusdi 4

tshad ma'i byung 'phel skor cung zad gleng ba/dang po/ tshad ma spyi bshad pa las dang po tshad ma'i dgag sgrub kyi skor bshad pa/spyir tshad ma rig pa ni 'dzam gling na khyab che ba dang rnam grangs shin tu mang ba shugs rkyen ha cang che ba'i rig gzhung zhig red/ 'di la mtshan nyid rig pa dang shes rtogs rig pa rtsod sgrub rig pa sogs ming gi rnam grangs mang po zhig btags 'dug gang ltar don du tshad ma ni gcig pa red/ de yang rgya bod gang gi tshad ma yin rung / ji skad du/ brtag cing dpyad pa'i rtog ge ba zhes gsungs pa ltar rtog dpyod kyi blo shes rab zhig go/ de ltar rtsa ba'i tshad ma gcig de mi so sos dus rabs dang spyi tshogs mi 'dra ba'i dgos mkho la bsam gzhigs byas nas 'gyur ldog dang dar rgyas yong ba zhig yin/ der brten tshad ma ni mi yi rigs byung ba nas bzung rang chas kyi tshul du byung ba dang mi so sor tshad ma so so yod/ dper na phyugs rdzi la yang gnag phyugs 'tsho skyong bya tshul dang mtha' na ja skol lugs tshun chad shes pa'i tshad ma yod pa dang / skyes ma thag pa'i byis pa la yang nu 'o 'thung shes pa'i tshad ma yod pa zhig red/ tshad ma de bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ha cang gting zab pa mi phal ba'i blo dang rgyang thag ring ba mkhas pas spyod bya las phal pas spyod 'os min pa'i lta tshul de ni ches nor ba zhig go/ yin na yang chos dang 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs phal che zhig 'dem sgrig byas nas kha mig rig pa gsal ba'i gang 1

zag 'gas rig gzhung gi deb cig bsgrigs pas de nas bzung tshad ma rig pa de tshad mthon po yin pas phal pas mi shes zhes khas blangs dgos byung / de yang tshad ma zhes pa de rgya gar gyi skad pra ma ṇa las drangs na rab dang dang po gnyis la 'jug pas grub mtha' 'og mas dang po la 'grel nas yul gsar rtogs kyi shes pa yang dag la sbyar/ grub mtha' gong mas rab la 'grel nas mi bslu ba la sbyar/ de la dbye na mngon rjes tshad ma gnyis 'jog gong 'og gang gi lugs la yang tshad ma yin na shes pa yin pas khyab/ de las gzhan 'gal 'brel dang dgag sgrub/ rgyu 'bras dang mtshan mtshon sogs ni tshad ma dar rgyas song nas bzos pa yin/ de bzhin du mtshan nyid rig pa la yang thog ma zhi la'i skad las drangs na shes rab dang dga' zhen la 'jug pas gnad bsdus te bshad na shes rab la dga' zhen yod ces pa zhig go gzhan rtsod sgrub rig pa dang gzugs 'das rig pa/ 'gal 'brel dang dgag sgrub sogs ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i nang don dar rgyas song nas byung ba zhig yin gyi dang po nas 'thus sgo tshang ba dag cing gsal ba zhig mi srid de/ dngos po gang zhig yin rung 'phel rim nges can zhig dgos kyi yod pa ni chos nyid red/ma zad bod kyi tshad ma'i tha snyad 'di don dang mthun pa'i brda zhig yin pa go ste/ 'gal 'brel dang dgag sgrub/ rgyu 'bras dang mtshan mtshon sogs mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma gang rung gis thag gcod dgos pas tshad ma'i ra ba las 'da' mi thub pa zhig go mtshan nyid rig pa zhes pa'i go don ni bsgrub bya'i chos gang yin pa de sgrub byed mtshan nyid bkod pa'i cha nas btags pa red/ rtsod sgrub rig pa sogs la yang de bzhin du 'grel tshul yod/ der brten rgya bod gang gi lugs la yang thog mar tshad ma zer ba de mi bslu ba dang yang dag gi blo dang shes rab bcas bye brag gi chos gcig la 'jug pa las rim bzhin 'gal 'brel dgag sgrub sogs spyi la 'jug pa zhig 2

red/ gnad bsdus te bshad na chos dang 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs dngos shes pa'i blo yang dag la go chog tshad mas chos dang 'jig rten dar rgyas gtong ba dang / chos dang 'jig rten gyis tshad ma dar rgyas gtong ba bcas phan tshun gcig grogs gcig tu gyur yod/ dus rabs re la tshad ma re/ mi rigs re la tshad ma re/ rtsa ba'i tshad ma gcig de yan lag gi tshad ma grangs med du gyur song / deng sang nub phyogs kyi tshad ma rig pa rnams la blta na skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho la gzhigs nas tshad ma mi 'dra ba sum brgya lhag cig 'brong bu tshe ring rdo rjes mtshams sbyor byed pa bzhin tshad ma de 'dra grangs mang zhig dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan la bsam blo btang na yul mi 'dra ba dang lo rgyus mi 'dra ba dang khor yug mi 'dra ba bcas la tshad ma mi 'dra ba mang pos shugs rkyen bzhag yod pa zhig red ma gtogs dus rabs nyi shu ba'i mi dag gis deng gi dus su nub phyogs kyi tshad ma rig pa de rnams la phyi mig bltas tshe 'od mdangs nyams pa'i nyi ma lta bu zhig tu mthong / gtso bo rang gi khe phan nas mi rigs dang rgyal khab sogs kyi khe phan la dmigs nas dgos pa rgya chen por brten nas tshad ma'i gzhung lugs rnams byas pa red/ mar le ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa de yang skabs re lo rgyus dang skabs re gral rim dang skabs re mi rigs bcas dus mi 'dra ba dang yul mi 'dra ba'i gnas tshul dngos dang sbyar nas spyod kyi yod/ mar khe si ni 'byor med gral rim gyi mi sna zhig yin pa ma zad 'byor ldan gral rim gyi srid dbang 'og tu dka' sdug grangs med myong ba'i 'jar man mi sna zhig yin/ dka' ngal mang po zhig gis mnar bas kho rang gis 'byor ldan gral rim la ngo rgol dang de'i lam lugs mang po zhig rtsa med gtong phyir he ker gyi tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung la dpyad gzhi byas nas tshad ma rig pa'am mtshan nyid rig pa zhig gsar sgrig byas pa red/ tshad ma des rgya che ba'i 'byor med gral rim mi dmangs la skul slong 3

dang slob gso thob pas mi ser grangs med cig la zhum med kyi snying stobs rgyas shing ldog med kyis mdun bskyod byas pas 'dzam gling na u ru si dang krung go sogs rgyal khab mang po zhig gis 'byor ldan gral rim dang de'i lam lugs rnams rdog rdzis byas nas lhag med btang myong / de bzhin rgya gar du yang nang pa'i bstan pa ma dar gong bram ze'i chos lugs kyis sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur/ kho tshos kyang bram ze'i chos kyi lugs srol du mi'i khrag gi mchod pa 'bul ba dang / bud med kyis skyes pa'i rkang 'khrus kyi cha btung dgos pa /ste/ /|) shārjeste )rwadro /re/ byebye) ri ba 1sgo|dang / bud da — na ba na nang par d+nghas pa la phyag 'tshal da sa pa/skyes pa'i ro dur du 'jog skabs de dang lhan du bza' zla bud med de yang gson po dur du 'jug dgos pa dang / rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs gdol ba'i rigs bcas bzhi ru dbye nas rgyal rigs ni lha yi dpung g.yas nas skyes pa dang / de bzhin rje rigs ni dpung g.yon dang / bram ze ni zhal nas dang / gdol ba'i rigs ni brla las skyes pa dang / de las bram ze'i rigs ni gtsang ma bzang po lha 'dra ba zhig tu brtsi/ gdol ba'i rigs ni tha chad pa shin tu mi gtsang ba grib ma dang yang 'grogs mi rung zhes bshad/ pha rgyal po yin na bu rgyal po yin pa/ pha gdol ba'i rigs yin na bu yang gdol ba'i rigs yin pa bcas mdor pha'i las ka gang yin pa de bus kyang las dgos pa las 'gyur ldog gtong mi rung ba dang rigs kyang phan tshun bsre bslad shor mi rung zhes bshad pa dang / de lta bu'i sgrig lam grangs med pa zhig mchis kyang 'dir dpe tsam du bkod pa lags/ srol de gsar du btsugs nas goms 'dris song ba'i bar la lung rigs tshad ma mang po'i bsgrub bya sgrub byed kyi tshul du gtan la phab pa zhig yin gyi las sla mos gtan 'jags byung ba ni min/ der brten de 'dra'i goms srol rdo rje lta bu zhig chadīs pa la yang mtshan nyid rig pa'am tshad ma rig pas rgyab skyor tshad med

thebs pa ni bshad ci dgos/ de rjes lo gnyis stong lnga brgya lhag gi sngon na rlabs che la gzi brjid che ba'i rgyal bu don 'grub de yab rgyal bo zas gtsang dang yum sgyu ma lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs nas dang bo gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad tshul yang i gha paṃ gha dhar sgyu rtsal 'gran skabs zhabs kyi mthe bong gis glang po che'i ro dpag tshad gcig gi bar du bskyur ba sogs sku yis stobs che ba'i mdzad pa mang po bstan gsungs/ skabs de tshe lo brgya ba'i dus mtshams yin stabs da lta'i mi las kyang gzugs stobs che zhing rkang bzang ba zhig yin na yang glang chen gyi ro zhabs kyis g.yug thengs gcig gis dpag tshad gcig gi bar du bskyur yod med gang ltar yang / sku stobs che ba zhig yin pa pe cin du yod pa'i ston pa'i tshems la bltas na go de bzhin ston pa'am rgyal bu don 'grub kyi sku bris ma dbyin ji'i 'grem ston khang zhig tu yod pa zhig kho bos mjal bas dngos gnas sku stobs che ba ra 'phrod byung /gnyis pa dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes skabs sngon goms kyi lo rgyus 'gros ltar btsun mo mang po khab tu bzhes/ gsum pa dgung lo sum cu rtsa gsum bzhes skabs mos pas khrid de shar lho nub phyogs kyi sgo rnams su rim bzhin phebs pas na ba dang / rga ba dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag pa rnams gzigs pas nges 'byung tshad med cig skyes/ de yang dngos gnas rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i gtam zhig yin pa go ste/ dper na rgya nag gi rgyal rabs ches mtha' ma(lko4shubh+riṣ+ka)phu'u yi'u zer ba'i rgyal bo de pho brang gi phyir mi btang nas nang du chu'i rdzing bu dang lcang ma'i gling kha dang pho brang gi bkod pa bcas lha yul lta bu'i gnas su mdzes ma stong gis bskor te bsdad pa las phyi rol gyi rnyog 'dzing me ltar 'bar zhing chu ltar 'khol ba'i 'jig rten de shes kyi med/rgyal po rang nyid phyi rol du 'gro 'dod kyang blon po tshos btsan bkag byas pa dang / mthar rgyal po phyi rol du shor nas phyi'i sdug bsngal de mngon sum du 5

mthong ba zhig red/ dngos gnas bshad na deng rabs dang nye ba'i rgyal po'i lo rgyus rnams su de 'dra yod na/ lo gnyis stong sngon gyi rgyal po'i sgrig lam ni de las kyang dam po yin pa go thub/ dngos gnas rgyal bo don 'grub kyang pho brang gi phyi rol du skor gsum du phebs pas rgya gar gyi sems can spyi'i sdug bsngal dang khyad par du rigs bzhi'i mtha' ma gdol ba'i rigs kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho de mkhyen skabs snying rje mi bzod pa zhig skyes te skye 'gro de dag skyob phyir bram ze'i lugs srol lam chos lugs la sun 'byin brjod de/chos kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin gsungs shing rang nyid kyang rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin dor te mchod rten rnam dag drung la rab tu byung ste chos kyi mdzad spyod kyis ris med 'gro ba la brtse bas skyongs te rigs mi gtso rus mi gtso bslab pa gtso zhes pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad pha ma ma byas pa med pa'i gnas lugs tshad ma mang pos mu stegs pa'am bram ze'i chos lugs de rdo rje rnon pos gtor brlag gtong ba zhig red/ de nas rgyal po don 'grub dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga'i steng sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo lan gsum bskor bas dad ldan gyi mi sna je mang dang gdul bya je rgyas kyis bstan pa de khyab rgya che bas mu stegs pa ming gi lhag ma tsam du byas so/ / mu stegs pa'am bram ze'i chos lugs kyi dam tshig rnams rang srog las kyang mthong chen po brtsi thub pa'i shugs rkyen 'jog mkhan gyi tshad ma de yang gtor byed kyi mtshan nyid rig pa zhig ston pas mdzad pa red/ bod du yang lo ngo khri phrag gi sngon nas byung ba'i bon gyi lugs srol lam bon gyi chos de dar ba dang / de yang spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang dgos mkho bcas la stabs bstun nas bsgrub bya sgrub byed tshad ma dang dgag sgrub kyi tshad mas shugs rkyen chen po 'jog yod/ mdor na ngag nas tshad ma ma brjod rung don thog na tshad ma ni bed spyod mi byed mkhan med pa lta bu red/ bon gyi bstan pa de 6

gnod sbyin nag po'i sde nas gnya' khri btsan po'i bar gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs so gsum pa'i bar du dar rgyas che la skabs de'i mtho rgyal bo dang dma' 'bangs mi yan chad la phan pa yod pa'i rig pa zhig yin pa ma zad dga' bde mthong chos su sbyin thub pa zhig red/ 'on kyang deng gi mi rnams kyis de la zhib 'jug byed skabs gnod sbyin nag po'i sde zer ba de phal che nags kyi tshal na gnas pa'i spre'u mi ru 'gyur nas yun ring ma lon pa ha lam gdod ma'i spyi tshogs su ma thon tsam la yin pa 'dra/ skabs de dag tu srog chags mang po'i dmar mchod byed pa de deng gi bod mi rnams kyis shin tu ma rung ba smyon pa'i bya spyod 'dra ba zhig mthong rung skabs de dus ni bzang po'i las su brtsis/ rgyu mtshan ni sgrub byed kyi mtshan nyid kyis bsgrub bya sgrub tshul gyi tshad ma mi 'dra bas lta tshul gnyis chags pa red/ gna' rabs kyi shes rtogs tshad ma dang deng rabs kyi shes rtogs tshad ma gnyis mi 'dra ste khor yug dang spyi tshogs mi 'dra bas blos rtogs rim gyi tshad ma yang mi 'dra/ dngos gnas bshad na bon gyi bstan pa ni bod kyi bstan pa yin pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med/ yin na yang dus rabs bdun par srong bsngon nas bzung rgya chos bod du bsgyur nas nang pa'i bstan pa dar bas sngar yod bon gyi bstan pa la 'gal ba slong bas phan tshun rtsod pa byung / bstan pa gnyis kyi 'gal ba rno ngar can du gyur ba'i rtags su srong btsan bon la sdang bas yun ring ma bzhugs zhes bon gyi lo rgyus rnams las bshad pas go thub/ ma zad khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas gnyis gdan 'dren zhus te bsam yas kyi lha khang bzhengs pa dang bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom rgyun btsugs phyir thog mar sad mi mi bdun rab byung sgrub pa sogs so/ / chos lugs gnyis kyi bar du sngar las kyang 'gal ba je cher song bas ston pa gcig la bstan pa gnyis mi chud ces lhan cig mi gnas 'gal lta bu'i 7

'gal ba byung / 'ju mi pham gyis kyang mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa la bon rnams kyis shin tu sdang po 'dug bsam gsungs pa de yang don la gnas pa'i skad cha zhig red/ skabs de dus da dung ha shang ma hā ya na sogs kyi lta ba dkar po chig thub bod la dar bas de la rgol phyir rgya gar gyi mkhas pa ka ma la shī la gdan 'dren zhus te rtsod pas ha shang pham par byas nas mthar skrod gtong ba red/ rtsod pa de yang tshad ma rig pa'i dgag sgrub kyi gzhung las ma 'das/kha che'i yul na bod du sdom rgyun ma btsugs gong nas dge slong mang po yod pa dang nang bstan dar snga ba ma zad kha che paṇa chen shākya shri sogs mkhas pa ches mang yang dus phyis kla klo'i lte ba lta bu 'gyur ba ma zad 'dzam gling na yang khyab rgya che ba'i chos lugs shig tu gyur/ kla klo rnams la yang rang lugs sgrub cing gzhan lugs dgag pa'i tshad ma rdo rje lta bu zhig yod pa the mi tshom/gnyis pa/ rgya gar dang bod du tshad ma'i rig gzhung dar chul skor/rgya gar du ston pa shākya thub pas chos phung mang po gsungs shing mu stegs tshar gcod pa'i mngon rjes lung rigs tshad ma mang po zhig gsungs kyang skabs der tshad ma'i rig gzhung ched sgrig ni ma mthong / tshad ma'i rig gzhung ni rgya gar du slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phyogs kyi glang pos thog mar tshad ma kun btus sogs byas pa red/ phyogs kyi glang pos mu stegs lta ba la yid ma ches nas nang par zhugs te ston pa la shin tu dad nas ston pa tshad grub sogs brtsams pa dang / tshad ma'i sgo nas dam chos yang dag yin pa dang las 'bras sogs mi bslu ba yin pa bsgrub pas 'jig rten gyi phyogs su bsam blo mi gtong ba'am tshad ma de 'jig rten gyi phyogs su ma spyod pa red/de bzhin chos kyi grags pas kyang 'jig rten sgrub thabs dang spyi tshogs dar 8

rgyas gtong thabs dang tshe 'di'i 'tsho thabs sogs la tshad ma ma spyod par tshe phyi ma phan chad la thugs bsam bzhes pa zhig red/ de bzhin bod du yang ngas sngar zhus ltar mi'i 'gro ba yod pa nas bzung mi'i rigs kyi tshad ma yod ces bshad chog 'on kyang tshad ma'i rig gzhung bod du sgyur ba'i dus ni khri gtsug lde btsan gyi dus su rgya gar mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang dzi na mi tra dang bod kyi lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum bcas gdan 'dzoms te gtan tshigs thigs pa dang rgyud gzhan grub pa sogs bsgyur/ skabs de ni tshad ma'i rig gzhung bod du yod pa'i thog ma red/ de rjes rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu ne'u thog tu 'chad nyan gyi grwa btsugs te 'khor chig stong lnga brgya tsam 'dus pa las lung rigs smra ba la 'gran gyi zla dang bral ba'i cha pa chos kyi seng ge sngon dus rgya gar du med pa'i tshad gzhung gsar pa bsdus grwa dang rtsod pa'i rnam 'gyur bcas srol gtod cing rigs pa'i 'gros mang po gsar gtod byas/khong yang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yin tsang tshad ma de spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong thabs su kha mi phyogs nas 'jig rten na yod pa'i ka bum dang kha dog sogs tha snyad 'ga' la rtsod pa byas ba las ma mchis/ zhus ma thag pa'i rigs pa 'di dag rtsod pa'i rtsal sbyong ba la ni shin tu phan po 'dug pa ma gtogs tha snyad kyi tshig 'phrul la dpyad pa mang stabs/ don gyi gnad go byed zhig tu 'gyur mi 'dug snyam/ de yang ji skad du/ rtog ge'i tshig phreng tsher ma'i mdung / / 'bum gyis bsnun kyang mi phig pa/ / che rnams rmongs pa'i dka' gnad la/ / smra ba'i ljags ring glog bzhin rkyongs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ sngon dus grwa sa rigs pa'i rgya mtsho dbus na 'dzin grwa 'og ma rnams kyis bsdus grwa'i rigs lam bum pa'i steng du nam rgyun rtsod pas gnas skor rgan po zhig bla grwa rnams kyi rtsod sar tshur yong ste bar phye ba'i tshul gyis khyed tshos na ning yang bum par thob shor byed kyi 'dug da lo yang bum pas ma 9

'grig 'dug da de 'dra ma byed dang ngas bum pa gcig sprad chog ces lab pa red/ skad cha des nga tsho tha snyad tshig tsam la zhen nas ka bum la rtsod pa'i rigs lam sbyong nas dus 'da' bzhin yod pa go thub/ ma zad rtsod pa'i rtsal la ches byang ba'i tshe yar skor mar skor gyi rigs lam sna mang gis yod pa med par bsgrub pa sogs kyi khyad chos yod/ der brten yin pa min par bud na bsdus grwa byang ba'i rtags dang / min pa yin par bud na bsdus grwa byang ba'i rtags su brtsi srol yang yod pa bzhin no/ khyad par du yin log min log gi rnam gzhag 'di rnams la lo na chung ba'i byis pa tshos sbyong pa zab mo byas te blo la 'jug rjes don la mkhas pa'i bshes gnyen tshos kyang rgol mi thub pa zhig yin/ kha rgyun du yang / yin log min log bu zhu'i rtags gsal red/ dge bshes rgan pos zhabs 'dren zhu sa red ces pa dang / da dung rigs lam la la ched du gzhan tshar gcod phyir bzos pa yang yod de/ gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos grwar jo mo mang pos sa gzung bar dogs te cha pa chos seng gis rdzas ldog gi rnam gzhag khyad par ba zhig gi rigs lam gsar ba byas te jo mo rnams rtsod pas tshar bcad de phyir phud btang ba dang / de'i rdzas ldog gi rnam gzhag la jo mo mgo skor gyi rigs pa zer srol 'dug nga rang rdzogs chen 〈shri sing du 〉dpe cha slob gnyer byed skabs lan gcig dge bshes blo bzang don 'grub kyis bsdus grwa'i rigs lam 'di byang chub pa zhig shes rjes spyi bye brag bsres te rtsod na yag po yod gsungs pa dang / khong tshos 'bras spungs su grwa pa zhig la rigs lam gyi sgo a ma'i gos gon yod par bsgrub pa dang ma zad a ma'i nyal gzan gon yod par bsgrubs pas gzhan rnams ni mtshar nas gad mo shor ba dang grwa pa ngu dgos pa zhig byung gsungs/ de lta bu'i rigs pa'i 'phrul bzang po de la khyad chos dang yon tan chen po yod pa go thub/ ma zad rigs lam gyis lam la 'jug bzhin pa rnams 'dug par 10

bsgrub pa dang 'dug pa rnams 'jug par sgrub pa sogs rig pa'i 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab/ der brten gsang phu ni'u thog gi lung khug nas lho mtha' u ru si bar du dar ba'i zab gsal myur gsum gyi shes rab skyed byed rigs lam bzang po 'di che sa zhig skor ma thub nas tshig 'phrul dang ka bum kho na dpyad na phongs pa de las che ba ci yod/gsum pa/ tshad ma'i nus pa logs su bshad pa/spyir bsdus grwa'i nus pa la brten nas kyang dge 'dun pa je mang song yod pa ma zad nang bstan la yang dag ther byas pas tshad thub kyi gzhung du ma grub/ de ltar tshad ma'i rig gzhung de la sbyangs pa byed mkhan ches shin tu mang stabs kyis cha ba chos kyi seng ge'i chos khri de yang je mthor song ba dang chabs cig tu tshad gzhung mkhyen pa'i gang zag de la yang spyi tshogs kyis tshad mthon po'i gdeng 'jog byas pa red/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nang bstan gyi tshad ma de stobs shugs che ru song tshe 'jig rten gyi tshad ma de nyams rgud 'gro ba ni bshad ma dgos pa lags/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang /chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ni me chu lta bu yin gsungs pas/ chu stobs che na me bsad pa dang me stobs che na chu skam pa bzhin chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyang ngo / / der brten spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing gangs can kha ba'i yul du dam chos tshad ma rgya che la gting zab pa zhig dar bas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob mkhan sa yi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa ches mang ba zhig byung / spyi tshogs dang chab srid dpal 'byor dang dmag don bcas ni gzhan dang sdur na che zhan po zhig red/ 'on kyang dus rabs bdun pa dang brgyad pa'i bar bon gyi bstan pa la nyams rgud thebs pa dang nang pa'i 11

bstan pa dar rgyas chen po ma song bar 'go btsugs pa'i dus der srong btsan sgam pos rgya ma phyogs kyi pho brang mi 'gyur byams pa gling nas rgyal sa lha sar spos te pho brang gsar bzhengs dang dmag don la zhib 'jug byed pa dang /chabasrid de ang dang bo byas pa'i tshad ma zhig dar ba red/ skabs de dus bsgrub bya chab srid dang dpal 'byor dmag don bcas la sgrub byed mngon rjes lung rigs kyi rgyu mtshan mang po zhig yod pa bshad ci dgos/ bod kyi stobs shugs dang drag po g.yul gyi las la mchog tu bsngags pa zhig yin tsang bal bza' bag mar sprad pa dang / gong ma thang the tsung dang yang dmag 'thab thengs mang byas mthar kong jo yang bag mar blangs pa red/ chab srid kyi stobs shugs rgyas tshul yang / rgya yig gi lo rgyus deb ther nyer bzhi mchis pa'i nang du thang rgyal rabs kyi thang yig gsar ma las/ bhod kyi shar phyogs su krig dang ma'o krig se krig bcas dang 'brel/ lho bal yul la thug nus an zhi sde bzhi/ byang gru gur slebs te rgya khyon le dbar khri lhag yod pas gong ma han dang we rgyal rabs su'ang 'di lta bu'i rgyal khab stobs po che gzhan su la'ang byung ma myong gsungs/ de yang mtha' bzhi rgyal khab dbang du bsdus gsungs pa dang kun nas mthun/ spyir de 'dra stobs can du gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan yang thang yig las/ bhod nas blon chen krung tsung mngags nas gong ma'i pho brang du 'byor/ krung tsung lo gzhon nu nas rgya'i slob grwar 'grims shing shes yon rgya che/ gong mas mjal kha gnang nas khyed tsho'i btsan po dang rje snga ma rnams las su mdzangs zhes bka' dris pa la/ kho na re nged cag gi btsan po ni dpa' mdzangs mkhyen dpyod kyi cha nas rje snga ma rnams la mi do yang /srid la dam che zhing blon rnams kyis mgo skor du mi btub pa'i rje bo dpe mi srid pa zhig yin/ bhod 'bangs rnams yul grang sar sdod cing thon rdzas kyang nyung /mtsho nag gi rgyud du dbyar gzhung yang gangs mi bzhu/ mi rnams dbyar bal 12

phying dang dgun slog pa gyon/ rtswa chu gang bzang bltas nas mtsher sa 'dzin cing sbra nag tu sdod/ nam zla grang tshe gnas rten spyil bor byed/ bkol ba'i dngos zog ni krung go'i khri cha gcig la'ang mi do 'on kyang dbul phyug thams cad sems mthun/ gros mgo 'og nas 'don pa/ thams cad blo dang bstun nas spyod pas yun ring por rgyal khab stobs che ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhus pa bzhin/ de dus chab srid skyong ba de gal che'i gnad don zhig brtsis yod pa go thub ste srid la dam che zhing zhes gsungs pa las chos phyogs kyi skad cha tshig zur tsam yang ma 'dug ma zad thun mong gi lo rgyus ltar na/ srong btsan de chos la thos bsam sgom gsum gyis dus 'da' mi gda'/ thang yig las khri srong btsan nam spur rgyal zhes kyang bya/ de 'bangs la byams shing mdzangs dkyel che/ rtag tu rta la bcibs nas 'brong dang rkyang rngon par 'gro/ zhi yul te nub ljongs kyi rgyal phran rnams 'bangs su mnga' 'o gsung pas kyang go thub/ thun min gyi lo rgyus ltar na srong btsan spyan ras gzigs yin pa dang kong jo sgrol ma yin pa sogs cha tshang po zhig bshad rgyu yod/ spyir ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rgyal khab yin na'ang 'dra spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab so so dang mi rigs so sos dgag sgrub dang 'gal 'brel yod med rgyu 'bras mtshan mtshon bcas tshad ma'i nang don spyod bzhin yod pa red/ tshad ma zer nas kha snon btab ma btab tsam las rigs drug sems can kun gyis gong zhus kyi dgag sgrub dang 'gal 'brel sogs la spyod bzhin pa lags/ khyad par du sngon thon gyi rgyal khab bam mi rigs la dngos po'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba la thabs dang shes rab kyis rgyu mtshan yang dag cig 'tshol nas de la brten nas dar rgyas song yod pa smos med red/ dngos gnas bshad na rgyal khab la lar tshad ma'i rig gzhung phar zhog tshad ma rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa shes rtogs rig pa bcas kyi ming tsam yang mi shes na yang khong tshos rgyu 13

mtshan yang dag la brten nas lag len thog nas tshad ma'i rig gzhung yod pa'i rgyal khab las kyang tshad brgal gyi 'bras bu thob kyi yod pa red/ der brten tshad ma'i rig gzhung du bkod pa'i nang don des da dung 'dangs kyi med pa'am zhib bshad bzo ma thub pa dang rang blos rtogs ma thub pa gang mang yod pa'i rtags red/ ma gzhi tshad ma 'di rig gnas gang la yang spyod chog pa'i lag cha zhig red/ nga tshos tshad ma'i rigs lam bsdus grwa ni kha dog dkar dmar dang ka bum dang rtag mi rtag sogs la gtso bo spyod pa dang / blo rig ni rtsa nyon drug dang nye nyon nyi shu sogs sems byung nga gcig dang mngon sum sogs blo rig bdun la spyod pa dang / rtags rigs ni 'bras rang ma dmigs pa'i rtags gsum gyis rim bzhin du ldan la la me yod med dang /byas mi rtag dang / sha za bskal don song ba'i gang zag gis sha za tshad mas ma dmigs pa bcas sgrub pa zhig red/ 'di rnams gtso bo yin gyi da dung nang don gzhan yod pa bshad ci dgos/ ma zad bod kyi tshad ma'i rigs lam la byang cha song rjes spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor sogs la spyod na go chod nges red/'on kyang nga tshos de sngon 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa dang zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba bcas rgyu mtshan mang pos bsgrubs nas chos pa rab rnams ni tshe 'di blos btang nas blo phugs chos la gtod/ chos phugs sprang la gtod/ / sprang phugs brag phug skam po la gtod/ / brag phug skam po shi ba la gtod pa red/ chos pa 'bring rnams kyis dben par brten nas sgom nyams len byas nas 'jig rten gyi bya ba phal che 'dor zhing rjes 'jug gi bu slob skyong ba dang / mtha' mas kyang kha 'don dge sbyor la 'bad zhor du khyim pa la rogs ci nus dang gshin dkor gson chog byas pa red/ der brten bod du sangs rgyas bstan pa dar rgyas phyin pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde rgyas pa sogs 14

so/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen gnyis pa slong mkhan 'jar man gyi shis the le zer ba des dmag mi rnams la tshad mas slob khrid byas pa ma yin kyang dgra brgyab dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang dgra 'khrugs kyi grub 'bras bcas rtags dang gtan tshigs sgrig nas bshad skabs dmag mi sems khams yang pa rnams smyo ba'i lo rgyus bshad rgyu 'dug ma zad dmag mi de rnams kyis 'gro ba mi'i rigs de 'dra mang po zhig me skyogs kyi kha na bskyon pa dang dme shi khrag gi 'khor lo bskor nas sha yi ri bo dang khrag gi rgya mtsho byas nas gzhan gyi sa la btsan 'dzul byas te snying rje spu tsam med pa de yang rtsa ba shis the le zer ba des gtan tshigs dang rgyu mtshan mang po zhig gis dmag mi rnams blo kha sgyur ba red/bzhi pa/ nga tsho'i bod kyi tshad ma 'di phyi rol yul du spyod dgos pa'i skor/bsam shes kyi rgan po dang rnam dpyod can gyi gzhon nu rnam pa nga tshos bod kyi tshad ma de rig gzhung kho na byas ma dgos pa tshad ma de phyi rol yul nas ra 'phrod pa bya rgyu gal che/ rjes mi la ras pas/ snang srid dpe cha blta blta nas/ yig nag dpe cha brjed nas thal gsungs ba bzhin/ khong gis snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong zhing bdag med bltas te shes nas lag tu blang pa red/ de bzhin du nga tsho'i kha dog yin na ser po yin pas ma khyab pa shes pa bzhin du de spyi tshogs la kha spo nas zhib 'jug byed dgos pa zhig red ma gtogs kha dog dkar dmar la khyab ma khyab kyi dpyod pa mthar phyin pa zhig shes rung 'di 'dra yin na mi rigs sngon thon yin pas khyab/ 'di 'dra zhig yin na rjes lus yin pas khyab 15

ces pa lta bu'i kha tshod gcod mkhan yang dkon/ mtha' na 'di 'dra zhig yin na bod rigs yin pas khyab ces bod kyi mtshan nyid 'jog pa yang ma mthong /der brten nga tshos bod kyi tshad ma de shes bya rgya chen po zhig la kha bskor nas dpyod par zhugs na bod kyi tshad ma de tshe srog je brtan du 'gro rgyu red/ bod kyi tshad ma'i 'gal 'brel dang sgrub sogs kyi mtshan gzhi 'jog skabs ka ba dang bum pa/ bdag 'dzin dang bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs bzhag pa las rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi dar rgud/ chab srid kyi 'phel 'grib/lo rgyus kyi 'gyur ldog bcas 'jog pa ma mthong / dper na dmar chu'i lung kyog 〈0lobi〉ces pa'i glog brnyan las rgya gar la dbang sgyur nas bod dbang sgyur rgyu'i sta gon la yong ba yin pa'i gnas tshul la zhib 'jug ma byed pa ma zad dmag 'thab bya lugs kyi gros mol dang rtogs zhib tsam yang byed mi 'dug skabs de dag tu rjes dpag rig pas kho tsho bod du yong ba de la bzang po'i rtags ci 'dug ngan pa'i rtags ci 'dug bltas nas mi de bzang ngan gang yin dpog thub dgos pa zhig yin gyi rtags rigs kyi rig gzhung ni rig gzhung rang red/ khyad par du du ldan la la me yod med kho na mi brtag par ja phor ba gang blud na yang rgyu mtshan gang yin dpyad nas bzang ngan dpog dgos pa zhig go gzhan yang lhag bsam dung ltar dkar zhing lus ngag yid gsum gangs ljongs la 'bul ba'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel btson du bcug pa'i bka' blon de rnams kyis rtags rigs la dpyad pa zab mo gnang yod med nga tshos bltas na go dngos gnas bshad na nga tshos bka' blon de rnams la khong khro langs rung gi ma red/ gang red zer na rang las gces pa zhig su yod/ rang la gnod pa bskyel 'dod yod mkhan yang gang na yod/ kho rang tshos dbu rul ba shangs kyis ma tshor nas rang mgo rang rdung byas pa red/ de 'dra byas nas bod kyi spyi tshogs de chu 16

bzhin thur du gzhol pa zhig go/lnga pa/ nang don rig pa ni tshad ma rig pa yin zhing de'i gtan chigs rnams yang dag yin chul bshad pa/spyir tshad ma de chos 'jig rten gnyis dang kha bral nas yan ga kher rkyang du gnas pa zhig min/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi dngos po med na tshad ma gang la brten/ der brten nga tshos tshad ma ni chos kyi steng du spyod sgo gtug pa las 'jig rten na spyod pa ches nyung / de 'dra yin tsang bod kyi spyi tshogs ni chos kyis grub pa'i 'jig rten zhig red/ bod mi'i sems kyi bde skyid ni stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i mi rigs las kyang brgya 'gyur gyis che/ chags sdang gi zing 'khrug dang brel zing gi 'du 'god med par sos dal la bag phebs pa zhig kyang red/ta zig pa rnams kyis bris pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus las/ yul gyi ngo mtshar gcig ni/ mi su yin yang der slebs na/ rgyu mtshan med par sems dga' yal le ba dang / gdong 'dzum mol le zhig 'ong sogs bris/ der brten bod de rang bzhin gyis rgyud 'jam pa gshis bzang ba lhod chags pa zhig yin pa go thub/ ma gzhi lha dang mi yi 'gro ba sogs srog chags grog 'bu tshun chad kyis 'tshol rgyu ni bde ba red/ bde ba byung na des 'grig gi red/ ma zad dpal 'byor dang tshan rig gi rjes su lus pa de yang lta lugs gcig byas na yon tan du mthong / tshan rig dang dpal 'byor/ chab srid dang dmag don bcas dar rgyas byung na 'dzam gling zhi bde phar zhog snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gnyis po yang me yi phung po zhig tu 'gyur nges/ de bzhin dper na rta dang 17

rlangs 'khor gnyis sdur na myur mgyogs kyi shugs dang nus stobs rlangs 'khor che rung rkang bzhi'i rta yod do cog gis lo brgya la mi la gnod pa'i chag grum btang ba las kyang grong khyer gcig gi rlangs 'khor gyis nyin zhag gcig la mir chag grum gtang mang ba zhig red/ 'dzam gling na dngos po yag shos gnam gru dang mtsho gru sogs kyi nyen kha dang chag sgo che tshul rnams nyin re bzhin gsar 'gyur las go gru chen re re la yang mi ga tshad cig gis zhabs phyi zhu dgos pa dang sems 'tshe ci tsam che de yang shes/ mkho dgu mtha' dag 'dzoms pa'i 'byor ldan gyi dpon po las kyang za 'thung gang la yang dka' ngal yod pa'i slong mo zhig gi sems kyi bde ba mang / ri mgor gcer rgyug byed pa'i mi la dang / / rdzogs ldan dpal la rol ba'i srong btsan gnyis/ /gnod 'tshe su che 'jigs dngangs su zhig che/ / mngon sum tshad ma'i srang la gzhal na go / ri mgor gcer nyal byed pa'i mi la dang / / dar gyi sbub na gzims pa'i gong ma gnyis/ / gnod 'tshe su che 'jigs dngangs su zhig che/ / mngon sum tshad ma'i srang la gzhal na go / mkho dgu tshang ba'i 'byor ldan pa zhig yin phyin chad re dogs gnyis kyis mi tshe btang ba red/ khyadartepar du rdza dpal sprul rin po ches/ rgya khab cig bor na sdug bsngal de tsam dang / lug cig bor na de tsam gyi sdug bsngal bcas rin gong che chung bzhin sdug bsngal myong dgos gsungs pa 'di don dang mthun pa dang rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa zhig go 'jig rten gyi dper/ so med na srin 'bu med/ / mig med na ling thog med zer ba bzhin/ 'khor ba'i chos dang bral na de'i sdug bsngal med pa yang chos nyid red sogs mang po'i sgrub pa'i dam chos tshad ma ni mtshan nyid rig pa'i gtam yang dag go der brten mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dam chos tshad ma de rgya gar dang rgya nag bod dang sog po/ kha che dang u rgyan yul dang a me ri kha dang 'jar man/ h+pha ren si dang dbyin ji/ sing ga la dang the go 18

sogs mdor na 'dzam gling na ma khyab pa med pa dang rang stobs kyis shugs rkyen zab mo 'jog thub pa'i stobs ldan gyi rig pa zhig tu gyur/ gong zhus kyi rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas 'khor ba'am 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal rnams shes thub pas/ dmyal ba yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal dang lha dang lha min gyi sdug bsngal rnams ma shes pa dang ma bshad na yang chog pa 'dug dam pa'i chos kyi rgyu mtshan ni sra brtan rdo rje lta bu dang snyan zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yin tsang rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi srid dbang bzung skabs grwa pa re re la 'bangs mi bdun re sprad pa dang / grwa pa la mig ngan bltas na mig 'don pa dang /mdzub brda byas na mdzub mo gcod pa/ kha ngan bshad na mchu to bregs pa/lha khang dang grwa pa'i rgyu nor brkus na de'i ldab brgyad bcu tshab 'jal du bcug pa sogs kyis dam chos kyi drin las dge 'dun pa la yang dad gus dang brtsi mthong de 'dra byas pa red/ de bzhin rje mi la ras pa zhes bya ba 'tsho ba bya 'tshol byi'u 'tshol la brten zhing stobs 'byor mnga' thang phar zhog zas gos kyi cha rkyen kyang med pas lus la bltas na yi dwags dang 'dra ba zas la bltas na khyi phag dang 'dra ba zhes gsungs pas dngos nas bshad na/ mi la ras pa thabs rdug nas 'tsho ba ma 'grig pa ma yin na yang chos kyi rgyu mtshan des sems tshim nas tshe 'di blos gtong ba yin/ dam chos kyi bdud rtsi nyams su myong stobs kyis stobs 'byor gang yang mi dgos pa zhig chags pa red ma gtogs byis pa rtsed mo la g.yeng ba bzhin du rdza chu sil ma dang nags kyi tshal dang me tog sil ma bkra ba dang bya rigs sna tshogs kyi skad bcas la chags nas ri'i phug na bzhugs te zas gos sogs blos btang ba zhig yin rgyu ma red/khong gi gdul bya'i slob bu nyi ma lta bu'i mnyam med dwags po'i rin po che dang zla ba lta bu'i gung thang gi ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rgyu skar lta bu'i ngan rdzong ston pa byang chub rgyal po/ rgyal khrom smad kyi ras pa zhi ba 'od/ se ban ras pa 19

sogs thugs kyi sras brgyad dang / gshen sgom ras pa sogs nye ba'i sras bcu gsum dang / sa lam mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo nyer lnga/ gnas lugs rang zhal mthong ba'i rtogs ldan phyir mi ldog pa brgya/ lam la drod thob pa'i skyes chen brgya rtsa brgyad/ chos 'brel thob mkhan grangs med bcas mdor na rjes 'jug 'khor slob mang po zhig skyong tshe rdza ri dang gangs ri/ bya dang bye'u chu dang me tog kha ba dang sbrang char bcas mgur snyan por drangs te mgo skor gyi sgo nas slob ma de tsam mang bo zhig skyong thub kyi ma red/ der brten mi la ras pa'i mgur glu'i nang don ni rgyu mtshan nam tshad ma'i gtan tshig las grub pas 'khor slob mang po sgong thub pa yin gyi rje mi la ras pa la dgon chung zhig gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen kyang med do/ de lta bu'i stobs 'byor mnga' thang dang rgyab brten dpung rogs med pa/ gzugs kyi lang tsho zhan pa zhig gis slob ma mang po de 'dra skyong byed kyi gsungs de don gyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang rtsod sgrub rig pa yin no/ /drug pa/ chos las kyang 'jig rten sgrub mkhan mang tshul bshad pa/ gong zhus kyi tshan rig dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas song ba'i mtha' 'bras ni 'jigs su rung ba dang nyen kha che ba zhig yin na yang gang ltar spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs su blo 'khor zhing de la 'dun pa che ba'i mi grangs ni nyin re bzhin je mang du 'gro bzhin yod pa red/ ma zad ngas gong zhus bzhin gnam gru dang mtsho gru dang sga sgril sogs kyi nyen kha de tsam che rung de la longs spyod snying 'dod pa las sdur na rta glang la spyod 'dod mkhan med/20

dper na/ dar rtse mdo nas gser rtar 'gro skabs rta dang sga sgril gnyis las gang gi thog tu 'gro 'dod che/ de bzhin sga sgril dang gnam gru gnyis gang gdam sogs mngon sum gyis grub/ gna' rabs kyi lugs srol la lha lugs su 'dzin zhing sngon srol la srog ltar gces pa'i gang zag dag gis kyang sgra sdud dang brnyan 'phrin dang glog sgron sogs la dga' bo gnang bzhin pa lags/khyad par du ting zho'i phing gis bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi lugs srol gsar gtod dang dpal 'byor rtsa ba bzung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang bo bshad pas 'gro mang dag gis mthong thos sngar las kyang rgya che zhing grangs mang bas blo la yang bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas yod/ deng sang dgon pa rnams su gna' rabs kyi ko lham gyon mkhan ches nyung / nga tshos kho tsho la gna' rabs kyi ko lham gyon dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ga tshad bshad na yang kho tshos khas len gyi ma red/ kho rang la deng rabs kyi lham de stabs bde la yid 'ong gi dngos po zhig tu mngon sum tshad grub yin pas so/ der brten tshan rig dpal 'byore la longs spyod par 'dod na de'i rgyu la 'bad dgos pa yang chos nyid red/nye ba'i lo shas nang bod kyi sa khul du sger 'dzugs slob grwa mang tsam zhig mchis/ dkar mdzes dar rgyas dgon gyi mchog sprul rgyal bstan blo bzang byams pas slob grwa zhig btsugs pa dang / sbyang bya rgya bod dbyin gsum gyi skad yig dang shing bzo dang / lha bzo drub bzo bcas yin pa red/ de bzhin mchog sprul lam grags kyis kyang thugs rjes gzigs pa dus las mi 'da' ba'i tshul gyis bud med kyi slob grwa zhig btsugs yod/ da dung a dkon sprul skus btsugs pa'i slob grwa ni ches mang ba dang / gzhan yang tshong dpon dag gis btsugs pa'i slob grwa yang yod/ dkar mdzes mchog sprul skyabs mgon gyis kyang dkar mdzes yul dgon rnams su chu khrid rgyu dang zam pa 'dzugs rgyu/ sman khang btsugs pa bcas kyi phyag las gnang / de ltar 'gro rtso 21

mang dag la brtse bas rjes skyong gnang ba'i mchog sprul rnam pa dang lhag bsam rab dkar gyi gangs la 'gran pa'i tshong dpon dag gis mthong chos su bod mi rigs la phan pa'i sbrang char zhig stsol bzhin yod pa red/ de 'dra byas nas shes ldan mi sna mang tsam zhig bskyar gso byas na nga tsho yang gzhan dag mi rigs kyi rjes su lus mi dgos pa zhig yong srid/ khyad par du dus dang mthun pa'i lam la 'jug mkhan yang mang la 'jug dgos pa zhig kyang red/mkhas dbang don grub rgyal gyis/ mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed mi rung / / ba tshwa'i dri dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa ga la sel/ / rnyed par dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi bem po la dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang bo ma zhugs na yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsa lding mi srid la mdun bskyod kyi gom pa ni de bas kyang ngo / zhes gsungs pas nga tsho yang yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsa lding 'dod la/ / mdun skyod kyi gom pa spo snyam na de yi sngon 'gro la dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang po ma zhugs na bshad pa mang yang 'ja' tshon dang mtshungs kyi yod/ skad cha 'di ni 'jig rten srid lugs dang ches mthun pa'i gtan tshigs yang dag cig yin na yang mang che ba zhig mdun du bskyod pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig phyir ldog ste 'gro ba'am 'gro 'dod yod pa red/ mi rigs dar rgyas dang mi rigs stobs ldan zhig tu bsgyur ba la rgyu rkyen gang 'dra zhig dgos mkhyen ldan rnam pas thugs bsam bzhes rogs/ ma gzhi sangs rgyas kyi bde ba dang 'jig rten dar rgyas kyi bde ba gnyis sdur na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na shin tu dga' 'os pa zhig yin na yang / sangs rgyas sgrub mkhan ni 'jig rten sgrub mkhan las kyang nyung / 'jig rten dar rgyas gtong ba ni ma rung ba dang nyen kha che ba zhig lags kyang / sangs rgyas sgrub mkhan las kyang mang / der brten nga tshos bsgrub rung rgyu de ma sgrub nas sgrub mi rung pa de gang ltar sgrub bzhin pra yin 22

tsang spus dag po zhig bsgrub thub na dga' snyam/ dam pa gong ma'i rjes su 'brangs te ri yi bu byas/ na bun gos gyon/ lto gos gtam gsum gyong la bskur te dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub pa nyams len gyis dus 'da' ba'i gang zag ni deng sang ma mthong / mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi ming khur nas 'jig rten tshe 'di'i 'tsho thabs la spyod na ni gang ltar sdig pa'i las sam mi dge ba yin pa dang / de min chags sdang chen po med pa'i sgo nas dge la brtson na de yang dge sbyong pa zhig yin na yang de 'dra ba yang dkon/ gnas tshul 'di rnams la bltas tshe 'jig rten gyi phyogs su 'jug mkhan ches mang bo zhig mthong / der brten 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa de la rgyu mtshan stobs ldan zhig yod pa gdon mi za/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / 'jig rten pas nga dang rtsod kyi ngas 'jig rten pa dang mi rtsod/ 'jig rten na gang yod pa de ngas kyang yod par khas len/ 'jig rten na gang med pa de/ ngas kyang med par khas len gsungs pas kyang 'jig rten kun rdzob de stobs che ba goder brten chu phran thams cad rgya mtsho la 'jug pa bzhin mi rigs kun po yang 'jig rten dar rgyas phyogs su 'gro bzhin pa dang gsar skrun gyi dngos por zhen nas 'bad kyi yod/ dper na mar gyi sgron me las kyang glog sgron la dga' ba dang / lcags thab las kyang glog thab la dga' ba sogs so/ /bdun pa/ tshad ma rig pa dang gtan chigs rig pa'i don bshad pa/tshad ma rig pa dang gtan tshigs rig pa gnyis kyi bzlas phye ba'i tshad ma rig pa bshad pa la thog mar tshad ma'i rnam gzhag bshad par bya ste/ de yang 23

mdo sde rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs kyi lugs ltar na/ gsar du mi slu ba'i rig pa tshad ma'i mtshan nyid du 'jog pa dang / yul gsar rtogs kyi blo de gsar du rtogs pa yang yin mi slu ba yang yin no/ gal te gsar rtogs min na yul gcig de yang yang mthong zhing yul gcig de yang yang shes na shes pa de yang dag tu mi 'gyur/ bum pa skad cig brgyar mthong ba'i tshe skad cig dang po'i mi bslu ba'i shes pa tshad mar 'jog skad cig gnyis pa nas mthong tshul sngar ma las gzhan mthong du med pas 'dra mthong gi blo yin tsang tshad mar mi 'jogabum pa skad cig gis mi rtag cing 'gyur nas 'gro ba la mthong tshul skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba mthong zhing tshad mas nges pa 'dren mi thub pas tshad mar mi 'jog pa yin/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul ba nyid kyis tshad ma grub pa yin gsungs pas/ khong gis mngon sum rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i rtog med kyi yul rang mtshan pa rnams skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba'i tshe de 'dzin gyi mngon sum shes pas kyang skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba mthong bas tshad mar bzhed/ 'on kyang skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur ba rtogs med kyi shes pas mthong rung mthong tshul la gcig las gzhan du 'gyur ba yang ma snang la/ 'gyur ba mthong ba'i tshad mas nges pa yang 'dren mi thub pa zhig red/ dper na nga rang spyi lo1985lor tshad ma la mkhas pa'i dbang bo ye shes dar rgyas mjal ba dang deng gi bar lhan 'grogs byas pa red/ dngos gnas bshad na 1985lo'i dge rgan ye shes dar rgyas dang go bdun lo'i dge rgan ye shes dar rgyas gnyis gang na 'dra/ skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur nas 'gro bzhin yod rung ngas mthong tshul la gcig ltar snang ba zhig 'dug lo de 'dra mang por mi sdod 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can gyi dge rgan ye shes dar rgyas la gcig las 'gyur ba snang ma thub na/ dus thung ngu skad cig brgya'i 'gyur ba mthong rung mthong tshul la gcig las mi 'dra ba'i 24

nges pa 'dren thub kyi ma red/ ma gzhi tshad ma'i yun gyi tshod ni tshad ma'i byed pa nyams ma nyams la byed dgos pa zhig yin/ bye brag smra bas dbang po gzugs can pa tshad mar 'dod pa dang / sems tsam pas bag chags brtan byung rig pa zhes sbyar/ dbu ma bas tshad ma yin na gsar rtogs yin mi dgos pa mi bslu ba zhig yin na chog pa bcas so/ der brten gang ltar bshad kyang tshad ma ni gtso bo shes pa rab dang phul byung zhig la 'jog de la dbye na mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis yod/ yul mngon gyur la mngon sum tshad ma dang / yul lkog gyur la rjes dpag tshad ma dgos pa zhig red/ spyir rjes dpag tshad ma skyes par byed pa la mngon sum tshad ma sngon du 'gro dgos te/ chos kyi grags pas/ rjes dpag mngon sum rtsa ba can gsungs pa dang / de yang yin te du ldan la yi steng du me yod pa rjes su dpog par sngon la du ba mngon sum gyis mthong dgos/ de bzhin ji skad du/gtso bo'i don la mi bslu phyir/ gzhan la'ang rjes su dpag pa yin zhes bdag cag gi ston pas kyang gtso bo chos kyi gnas lugs bden med bstan pa la mi bslu ba mngon sum tshad mas grub pa yin pas de las gzhan tshe snga phyi dang rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag bstan pa rnams mi bslu pa yin par dpog pa'o/ da lta nga tshos khas len rgyu'i yul lha gzhi bdag gi lha 'di rnams kyang gang zag 'ga' la mthong ba mngon sum shes pa yod dgos kyi rgyu mtshan med par lha gang na 'jog lha yod pa'i rgyu mtshan mngon sum gyis ma grub kyang / ma mtha' yang bya ba kun lam du 'gro ba dang na tsha las skyob pa'i rtags gang rung zhig mngon sum gyis grub nas de la brten nas lha yod pa dang lhas mgon skyabs mdzad pa de rjes su dpog dgos/ der brten mngon sum la ma brten nas rjes dpag gang nas skyes/ nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di yang yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin dar rgyas 'gro 'am mar ngo bzhin nyams rgud du 'gro min ni mngon sum gyi rtags la 25

brten nas rjes su dpog dgos pa zhig red/ da lta gal srid sa khul phyogs 'then dang grub mtha'i chags sdang gi gtam bshad gos gyon zas za ba dang /ma zad rtswa sa rtsod gleng gi ral gri'i so khar gzhon nu mang pos sbar 'tham byas te lang tsho rgyas shing 'tshar longs 'byung bzhin pa'i gzugs thang po cha tshang ba de dum bur bgos pa'am rmas rtags su bskur ba rnams dpa' bo dmar yag stag gi gral du 'jog te/ rang rigs shi rmas btang ba ni yon tan du brtsis/chu mig phor kha tsam dang rtswa sa lag mthil tsam gyi steng du sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil du bcug ste byis pa rnams pha med kyi dwa phrug dang tshe grogs rnams khyo pho med pa'i yug sar lus te khyed rang tsho 'gro ba'i shul du ma bu tshos ma ṇi'i glu dbyangs blang bzhin stong sang nge khu sim me'i nang du dmar chung snying ni sdug gi rgya mtsho ru ltung / gzugs kyi stobs shor/ bzhin gyi mdangs nyams/ skyo gdung gi mchi mas mig mthar bskor te mdun lam rlabs chen la bsam blo gtong rgyu phar zhog rang gi zas gos kyang 'grig dka' ba'i gnas su gyur/khyed rang gi srog me lce dmar mo rlung la bskur gnas de na dar lce med pa'i jo dar zhig lhub lhub tu g.yo ba las/ gzi brjid can gyi dngos po ma mthong pa ma zad/ khyed kyis mi rabs nas mi rabs la 'jog rgyu ni mi bde ba'i gzhi ma chen mo de red/ da dung chos khri mthon po'i steng nas snyan po'i tshig gi rang rigs dum bur gtong pa'i lung rigs mang po spyod pa'i gnas tshul de dag mngon sum du grub na ni/ nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di nyams rgud du 'gro ba rjes su dpog thub bo/ de bzhin ji skad du/ sngon ma gang byas da lta'i lus la ltos/phyi ma gar skyes da lta'i las la ltos zhes gsungs pa da lta'i lus rten bzang ngan mngon sum gyi grub pa'i rtags las sngon ma rgyu dge mi dge gang byas rjes su dpog thub/ da lta'i las bsags tshul mngon sum du mthong ba las phyi ma gang du skye rjes su dpog thub pas/ mngon shes can la lung bstan zhu dgos 26

rgyu mi 'dug pa ma zad mngon shes can gyis kyang mkhyen pa gsung skabs thog ma phyi ma'i yul du song zin pa'i mi de'i ming dang nam 'chi sogs zhus te ming —dang dus tshod rnams nges pa'i rjes su de'i legs nyes bzang ngan kun gsungs pa red 'dug ma gzhi mngon shes kyis 'di phyi kun mkhyen pa'i bla ma bzang po dag gis brda sprod kyi gzhung lugs tsam ma mkhyen pa yang 'dug 'di ni gnam gru gtong shes rung mtsho gru gtong mi shes pa dang 'dra ba ha cang ya mtshan pa zhig red/ gzhan yang 'bu phye ma leb mngon sum du mthong bas de la brten nas gnam gru bzo shes pa dang / lcang lo chu'i steng du g.yo ba las mtsho gru bzo shes pa byung zhes pa 'di dag gis kyang rjes dpag gi rtsa ba mngon sum yin pa go thub/ de lta bu'i mngon rjes tshad mas 'gal 'brel dang dgag sgrub/ rgyu 'bras dang mtshan mtshon/ yin log min log dang yod rtogs med rtogs bcas tshad ma'i rig gzhung gi nang don mtha' dag thag gcod pa ma zad/ shes bya'i chos thams cad mngon rjes tshad mas thag gcod pa red/der brten blo rtags bsdus gsum dang mar le ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa dang nub phyogs kyi shes rtogs rig pa bcas de dag kun kyang mngon rjes tshad ma'i ra ba las ma 'das pas de kun la tshad ma rig pa zer chogaganyis pa gtan tshigs rig pa bshad pa la thog mar gtan tshigs kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la/ gtan tshigs dang rtags dang rgyu mtshan rnams don gcig yin/ ldog cha nas bshad na/ gtan tshigs ni 'di yin zhes gtan 'khel byed pa'i tshig gam gtan 'beb byed pa'i tshig la go gal te yod par sgrub la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshigs yin na/ rtsod gzhi chos can gyi steng du bsgrub bya'i chos 'di yod ces gtan 'beb byed pa'i tshig la gtan tshig zer/ de bzhin yin pa sgrub la tshul gsum tshang ba'i gtan tshig la yang rigs sbrel/ rtags zhes pa de rtsod gzhi chos can 'di bsgrub bya'i chos 'di yin zhes 27

khas blangs nas/ yin pa'i rtags 'di red ces pa lta bu dang / rtsod gzhi chos can gyi steng du bsgrub bya'i chos 'di yod de/ yod pa'i rtags 'di red ces pa lta bu red/ de yang go bde ba zhig bshad na/ mi 'di ni 'brog pa yin te/ yin pa'i rtags sha mar za bzhin 'dug ces pa lta bu dang / rgyu mtshan zhes pa de yongs su grags pas bshad pa'i dgos pa ma mthong / de ltar na tshad ma dang gtan tshigs gnyis kyi ldog cha nas go ba ches tha dad pa zhig len rgyu 'dug kyang / spyir tshad ma yin na gtan tshigs yin pas khyab pa yod de/rjes dpag gi gtan tshigs kyis dpyad mi dgos pa'i chos nyid de yang gtan tshigs shig red/ der brten rtags rigs kyi gzhung rnams las/ bdag med yin na spyir rtags su bkod pa dang bye brag tu sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags su bkod pa yin pas khyab ces bshad pa'i gnad kyang 'di la thugabadag med yod do cog rtags su bkod pa yin te/ sems can rnams kyi lus kyi las dang ngag gi las/ yid kyi las bcas gang zhig yin rung rtags sam rgyu mtshan med pa zhig rtsa ba nas med/ gtan tshigs rig pa rnams ni tshad ma'i gzhung las 'das mi thub pa kun gyis shes/ 'o na bzo gso sgra tshad dang /nang rig sogs bod kyi rig gnas dang rdzas 'gyur dngos lugs mtha' dag gtan tshigs rig pa dang tshad ma rig pa yin na tshad ma rig pa dang gtan tshigs rig pa sogs logs su dbye ba'i dgos pa mi 'dug snyam na/ dngos gnas bshad na snyan ngag bzo gso sgra tshad dang / rdzas 'gyur dngos lugs sems khams bcas tshad ma rig pa'am gtan tshigs rig pa bcas dar rgyas song ba zhig red/ nga tshos tshad ma'i rig gzhung du lhan cig mi gnas 'gal gyi rnam gzhag 'chad skabs/ bem por gyur ba'i lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la snang mun gnyis 'jog pa dang / srog chags su gyur ba'i lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la bya rog dang 'ug pa 'jog pa dang / shes par gyur pa'i lhan cig mi 28

gnas 'gal la bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab dang bdag tu 'dzin pa bcas dpyad pa zhib mos mtshan nyid ma nor ba 'jog thub pa bzhin/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa la dpe mtshon na rdzas rigs mi 'dra ba mang bo zhib 'jug byas te rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten nas rdzas sbyor gyi 'gyur ba rnams shes kyi yod/grangs rig pa la bshad na brgya las lnga bcu 'phri na lnga bcu lus pa dang / brgya la brgyad kyis bsgyur na brgyad brgya ru 'gyur ba sogs rgyu mtshan nam gtan tshigs kyi gzhung las ma 'das/ de ltar bod kyi tshad ma rig pas 'gal 'brel la dpyad pa zab mo gnang ba bzhin/ mkhas pa la las rdzas 'gyur dang dngos lugs la dpyad pa mthar phyin pa zhig gnang yod/ der brten mkhas pa'i grags pa bla na 'bar zhing shes yon can phul byung gi gral du 'jog cing rgya bod mkhas pa kun gyis gong du bkur rung khong gis kyang da dung ma mkhyen pa'i shes bya mang po yod pa bshad ci dgos/ gsum pa 'phros don du mtshan nyid rig pa bshad pa la/ thog mar mtshan nyid de ji ltar 'jog shes dgos pas mtshan nyid bshad pa la/ de yang ji skad du/ mtshan nyid go byed don gyi chos/mtshon bya go bya blo yi chos/ / mtshan gzhi gzhi ldog rten gyi chos zhes mtshan nyid ni mtshon bya mtshon byed kyi don gyi chos yin pas/ dper na me'i mtshan nyid la tsha zhing bsreg pa 'jog pa dang / chu'i mtshan nyid la brlan zhing gsher ba 'jog pa bzhin no/ de bzhin du 'di 'dra zhig la bden pa zer/ 'di 'dra zhig la rdzun pa zer/ spyi tshogs ring lugs ni 'di 'dra zhig yin/ ma rtsa ring lugs ni 'di 'dra red ces bshad pa kun mtshan nyid bshad pa red/ si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa ni mi rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa slar gso dang mi nyams gong 'phel gtong phyir spyi lo1981lor rdzogs chen du btsugs/ spyi lo1983dang 1985dang 1994lo bcas la rim bzhin du bar smad dang /rta'u dang / dar mdo bcas la spos/ sbyang bya bod kyi rig gnas bcu dang 29

de'i steng du chab srid dang rgya yig yig sgyur bcas yin pa red ces bshad pa de yang bod yig slob grwa'i mtshan nyid bshad pa red/ mkhas pa la las mtshan nyid rgyas pa bshad pa dang / mkhas pa la las bsdus te bshad pa red/ gang ltar mtshon bya go byar 'jog cing mtshan nyid go byed du 'jog pas mtshan nyid rgyas bsdus gang bshad rung mtshon bya de gsal po mtshon thub dgos pa red/mtshan nyid des mtshon bya de gsal po ga tshad mtshon thub na mtshan nyid kyi rin thang de tsam gyis che ru 'gro ba ni smos ma dgos pa zhig red/ 'on kyang 'dzam gling na bod kyi mtshan nyid rig pa las gzhan pa'i mtshan nyid rig pa mtha' dag la mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya gnyis bar khyab pa sgo brgyad nges kyi mi 'dugabod kyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i bsdus gzhung rnams su yang mtshan mtshon khyab pa sgo brgyad nges pa shin tu dkon/ spyir phar phyin dang mngon pa/ dbu ma dang 'dul ba/ tshad gzhung bcas bka' pod lnga po'i nang don 'chad skabs sgros gtsang la tshig nyung ba don 'dus pa'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshon bya mtshon par byed dgos pa zhig yin/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa dang bod kyi sa dge bka' rnying gi mkhas pa so sos gzhung so sos mtshon bya rnams la mtshan nyid 'jog tshul mi 'dra bas rtsod pa mang ba dang grub mtha' mi 'dra ba byung ba red/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ deng sang mtshon bya re'i mtshan nyid re re de dbugs sna gcig gis 'don mi tshar ba'i tshig tshogs mang rung mtshon bya mtshon thub pa'i phan pa spu tsam med pa 'dug ces ma rangs pa'i tshig gcig gsungs/ de ltar na tshig nyung don 'dus shig gis mtshon bya mtshon thub pa byung na mtshan nyid de ni phul byung zhig tu 'jog spyir nang pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'jog byed kyi mtshan nyid mi 'dra bas rgya bod kun tu grub mtha' mi 'dra ba byung / dper na don dam bden pa dang kun rdzob bden pa gnyis kyi mtshan nyid la yang mi 'dra ba mang 30

bas des shugs rkyen gyis kyang bsam blo tha dad pa 'gyur yod/ bye brag smra bas kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid la/ bcom pa'am blos cha shas bsal ba na rang 'dzin gyi blo 'dor rung ba'i chos su dmigs pa de 'jog mdor na rags pa 'dzin pa'i blo de kun rdzob tu 'jog ste/ rags pa mthong snang la grub kyang gnas tshul la rdul phran cha med kyi tshogs pa zhig tu 'dod/ don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid la/ bcom pa'am blos cha shas so sor bsal ba na rang 'dzin gyi blo 'dor du mi rung ba'i chos su dmigs pa de 'jog phra ba rdul phran cha med bar du bcom nas de'i phan la bcom du med pas de 'dzin gyi blo 'dor du mi rung bas de ni don dam bden pa'am gnas lugs su 'dod/de yang ji skad du/ gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ / bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ / yod de don dam yod gzhan no zhes gsungs pa dang / gnyis pa mdo sde ba la lung gi rjes 'brangs dang rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs gnyis yod pa las/ lung gi rjes 'brangs ni bye brag smra ba dang 'dra/ rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs kyi mdo sde bas don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sgra dang rtog pas btags pa la ma ltos par rang gi sdod lugs kyi ngos nas rdigs pas dpyad bzod du grub pa'i chos de 'jog kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pas btags pa tsam du grub pa'i chos de 'jog sems tsam pas kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ tha snyad dpyod byed kyi rigs shes kyi tshad mas rnyed pa'i don de 'jog don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ don dam dpyod byed kyi rigs shes kyi tshad mas rnyed pa'i don de 'jog dbu ma pa'i bden gnyis kyi mtshan nyid la/ gangs can gyi mkhas pa thams cad dbu ma pa yin pas bden gnyis kyi mtshan nyid 'jog tshul la khyad par yod tsang rtsod pa yang byung myong bas de'i mtshan nyid skabs 'dir mi 'jog rgya gar du bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon yin na'ang 'dra de'i rjes 31

'brangs yin na'ang 'dra de kun gyis rang gi grub mtha' de rmad byung du 'dzin pa las ngan pa brtsi mkhan med/ de bzhin du grub mtha' 'dzin pa gzhan dag kyang 'dra/ bod theg chen gyi zhing khams yin tsang grub mtha' gong ma las kyang gong ma dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs 'dzin pa las ma mchis/ der brten rgya gar ni bod dang mi 'dra bas grub mtha' so so'i lugs srol 'dzin pa rnams rang gzhan kun gyis shes/ bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen dang /mdo sde rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs kyi slob dpon phyogs glang / sems tsam pa'i slob dpon thogs med/ dbu ma pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub sogs so/ de ltar na bden pa gnyis kyi ming 'dra yang mtshan nyid rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba yin/'di ltar bden pa gnyis la yang mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba de tsam zhig yod na gzhung bka' pod lnga'i don gyi mtshan nyid ni ches mang ba bshad ci dgos/ ma gzhi mtshan nyid go byed don gyi chos zhes pas phar phyin lta bu gcig la mtshon na/ phar phyin ni mtshon bya'am go bya gang zer na 'dra mdor na bshad bya red/mtshan nyid ni de nyid go byed dam mtshon byed yin la rgya bod mkhas pas glegs bam ri 'dra ba mang po zhig brtsams yod/ de bzhin dbu ma dang 'dul ba tshad gzhung bcas bka' pod lnga la mtshan nyid kyi gzhung zhes bzhag yod pa ma zad mtshan nyid kyi gzhung ma yin pa med zer chog dngos gnas bshad na snyan ngag gi gzhung gi nang don mtha' dag mtshan nyid red/ des mtshon bya la snyan ngag 'jog na skyon ci yang med/ yin na yang lag pa yod do cog la lag ldan mi zer ba bzhin du gtan tshigs dang mtshan nyid dang / tshad ma rig pa yin no cog la yang mtshan nyid rigs pa'i gzhung ngam tshad ma'i gzhung gi ming ma btags pa red// / /32

bla ma'i rnam mthar drang por bshad pa/da bla ma tshe dbang phrin lasakyi rang rnam zhal gsungasam/rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ / dge sbyor ngur smig gar gyi rnam rol ba/ / 'dzam gling chos kyi rnga gsang ldir mdzad pa/ / rang byung kun khyab zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / khyed ni chos bzhin sgrub pa'i skyes bu lags/ / bstan pa kha la byang ba'i mkhas pa min/ / gzhan yid slu byed gzugs stobs mi ldan yang / / dad pa'i 'dab ma khyed kyi phyogs su g.yo/ /rnyed bkur thob phyir brel zing ma mchis kyang / / nor bu las lhag dgos 'dod khyed la 'jo/ / de ltar 'dren mchog sbas pa'i rnal 'byor che/ / bla ma dam pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho las/ / rang blos dpog tshod tsam zhig 'god pa la/ / lha dang bla mas gnang ba bdag la stsol/ / ces tshigs su bcad pa 'gas mdun bsus te/ skabs kyi don ni sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po/rtogs pa don gyi bla ma tshe dbang 'phrin las dpal bzang po'i rnam thar cung zad gleng pa la/ de yang spyi lo1995lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 12la/ kho bo hor rong pa tsha dol mda' grong gi rang khyim la slebs/ khyim gyi sring mo che ba la nad kyis zin nas nyin kha shas red 'dug mkhar mgo dgon du dam pa de'i drung du sring mo'i nad gzhi'i yang lji la phyag mo gzigs rogs zhu phyir spun chung ba de btang nas/ kho bo yang sku mdun la bcar rtsis yod ces zhus shog zer ba bzhin zhus pa dang / phyag mo gzigs rjes/ khyed kyi phu bo nga'i rtsar yong 33

rtsis yod na de bzhin gyis/ nga la phyi rgyal du 'gro ba'i lag khyer zhig sprad dgos kyi yod gsungs/ nga'i spun chung gis khyed sgo phyi nang gi mtshams su phebs pa la dka' tshegs 'di tsam che na/ phyi rgyal la ga na phebs thub ces ku re'i tshul du tshig kha shas lab 'dug 'on kyang zhing du gshegs rjes ma gtogs/skabs der khong gi gsung rgan mo 'di la ya mtshan de tsam zhig ma skyes/ de rjes dam pa de nga tsho'i grong nang du nad pa zhig la dbang bskur du phebs pa la/zhor du nga'i khyim du phebs pa dang nged dpon g.yog gnyis dus tshod ga sum tsam la spyi bye so so'i don la 'bel gtam byas/ phebs khar nga'i lo rgyus shig 'bri dgos pas khyed la khom po yod dam gsungs/ ngas khom por yod zhus/khong gis thugs dgyes nyams bcas gnam gshis yag skabs yar shog dang nyi ma gnyis la 'bri thub rgyu red gsungs/ 'on kyang lo rgyus ci 'dra zhiga'abri dgos min skor gsal bshad gnang ma byung / spyi zla 2pa'i tshes 25nyin khong gi drung du sku bcar zhu bsam yang de nyin kha ba chen po zhig gis bkag pas 'gro ma thub/ tshes 26nyin dus tshod bcu tsam la rta thog nas dam pa de'i drung du phyin/ khong dgyes bzhin spro nyams bcas kyis khyed slebs par bzang 'dug gsungs/ khong gis ngas dang po bla mar bsten tshul/ bar du nyams su len lugs/ mthar 'bras bu cung zad smin pa'i tshul de rnams khyed kyis bri thub tshe/ phyi rabs kyi skye bo rnams kyang dam pa'i chos la yid ches skyed thub kyi red gsungs/ nyin der kha bas ri lung kun du dngul gyi me tog ltar dkar lam mer gyur pa'i thog nyi ma'i gser 'od chem chem 'phro zhing gang la bltas kyang dpyid dpal kun nas rgyas pa'i nyams dang / lcang ma'i yal ga'i rtse nas bya bye'u mang bo'i skad snyan gyi 'gyur khug byed pa'i gnas de'i bsam gtan gyi khang bu chung ngu'i nang du gzim khri rgyab yol can gyi steng la/ dam pa 'di nyid bde dal du bzhugs pa las khams mi dwangs pa'i cha tsam yang skabs 34

der mi 'dug par ma zad shel gyi skar khung nas nyi 'od lham mer shar zhing /dwangs gtsang chus bkang ba'i bdun tshar dang mu tig maṇ+ḍal rnams kyis shin tu mdzes pa/ sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyang bkod legs pa/ dri bzang ngad kyis phyogs kun tu khyab pa/ rnyog 'dzing med par 'jam ldem me'i ngang nas dam pa des gsungs pa rnams zin thor bkod pa yin/de la bla ma dam pa khong ni 'bri zla zal mo sgang gi char gtogs dkar mdzes rdzong rong pa tsha'i sger thog grong ma phyogs tshang du/ yab karma bkra shis dang yum skal bzang mtsho gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu khyi ste spyi lo 1kha2 2lor 'khrungs/ ming sring lnga yod pa las bu khong gcig pu yin/ khyim gyis 'jig rten gyi lugs ltar pha gzhis bus 'dzin gyi re ba gtso bo byas pas chung dus slob gnyer de tsam ma mdzad/ khong dgung lo bcu gnyis skabs yab yum gnyis kyang rim bzhin tshe yi dus byas/ de nas sngar las lhag pa'i 'gan zhig ma bsam bzhin du khong gi thog tu bab/ khong gis sku nus ci yod kyis khyim gyi las la 'bad pas dka' sdug kyang chen po myong / spyi lo 1947lor dgung lo nyer lnga'i dgung keg yin/ lo der o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan rnams dus su rim bzhin mngon 'gyur byung / rkyen des bskul nas dam pa'i chos la thun min yid ches kyi dad pa rnam dag zhig skyes/ skabs der yid lhung lha ru sgar la/ drung rams rgyal sprul rin po ches sirnyi dung sgrub tshogs pa'i mdun du phyin te der bsnyen par rdzogs/ spyi lo 1kha52lor dgung lo2 2bzhes/ de nas thun min gyi bla ma kar lu rin po che lo gsum la bsten cing sgrub pa la snying rus byas pas lung bstan bzang bo thob/ spyi lo 1955lor sgrub rgan rin po che hor khog tu phebs skabs dbang lung gang gnang ba kun kyang ma lus par mnos/de rjes dus kyi zing 'khrugs sprin nag 'khrigs cing / chos kyi nyi ma nub 35

ri la yib nye ba dang / bstan 'gro'i don du bla ma kar lu rin po che rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du byon/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis slar yang sgrub par brtson pa gzhol bas ri khrod du lo lngar bzhugs/ de mtshams yul dgon so sor bcos sgyur gyi 'tshub cha shin tu che/ sangs rgyas bstan pa la nyams rgud tshabs chen thebs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde bshig pas bla grwa yongs rdzogs 'brog sde dang zhing sde rnams su phebs dgos thug dam pa 'di nyid kyis kyang zhing las lo kha shas tsam mdzad/ de mtshams rong tsha nang dang yid lhung stod smad kyi 'brog sde rnams su phebs nas bstan 'gro'i don du lus dang srog la'ang mi 'dzem par 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ skabs der sger thog grong gis bkod sgrig ltar mgo phag tu lo bcu gnyis tsam la g.yos ra srung phyir bzhugs/ 'go khrid tshos khong la dmigs bsal mdzad de ngal rtsol la do dam byed kyi med pas sgrub pa nyams len gtso bor mdzad pa dang / zhor du grwa pa chos dad can 'ga' la phyag chen nges shes sgron me'i khrid lung gnang / sngon drung rams rgyal sprul gyi mdun nas sirnyi dung gcig khas blangs pa bzhin lo sum cu tsam la sirnyi bzlas pas dung kha long dus/ lha sa'i gling nas gu ru'i sku rten rnying pa shin tu bzang bo zhig kyang phyag tu son/ de mkhan po a chung rin po che la gzigs 'bul bkyag mkhan po 'di ni gnas lugs drang po thad kar gsungs pa las sgro skur byed mi shes pa lta bu zhig yin pa yongs la grags/ khong gis rten 'di 'dzam gling na yang ches dkon po red gsungs nas dgyes dgyes mdzad/bla ma kar lu rin po che rgya gar du byon khar phyin chad gdams ngag gi gnad la thag ma chod pa yod tshe/ bla ma byams pa chos 'phel la bsten dgos gsungs pa bzhin bsten pas/ nyin gcig dge rgan bsod nams rgya mtsho khong gnyis yod skabs khyed rig pa tshad phebs kyi rtogs pa thob 'dug gsungs/ de nas slar yang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i me ro slar gso'i skal bzang shar ba dang /36

dam pa 'dis mkhan po tshe dbang 'gyur med la bsten nas khrid lung mang po zhus so/ /de nas mkhar mgo'i jo dgon gyi dgon sa gsar tu btab/ sa yi dge mtshan ma lus tshang ba'i gnas der bzhugs shag bzhengs skabs/ sa 'og nas bya rung kha shor gyi dbyibs dang mtshungs pa'i mchod rten gcig byung /rten 'brel des thugs kyi yon tan dar bar mtshon no/ / ma tshad bla ma so sos gnas der gzigs snang mi 'dra ba yang mang por byung / da lta mkhar mgo dgon gyi phyi'i gtsug lag khang dang / nang gi rten gsum/ bar gyi dung 'khor sogs legs par bzhengs grub/ spyi lo1rdzo〈5lo nas snga phyir si tu rin po che dang / 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che/ mkhan 'jigs med phun tshogs sogs kyi mdun nas kyang dbang lung mang po gsan/ khro khog bla ma a khyung hor rong pa tshar phebs skabs su rtogs 'bul byas/ dam pa 'di'i yon tan la thugs dgyes te/ bu skyes ba'i go chod 'dug gsungs nas bstod bsngags kyi me tog kun la khyab par byas/ra gan gser du 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs dang / /seng ge khyi ru snang ba'i skur 'debs sogs/ /ma yin dwangs gtsang rnam thar rgya mtshor 'dir/ /blo ldan ngang mo'i tshogs rnams 'acojug cig gu/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma de rnams las/ phyag chen nges shes sgron me'i blo ldog rnam bzhi'i khrid thob pa nas dkyil 'khor bcu gsum gyi dbang dang / ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha so so'i dbang dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i lung bcas mdor na gsar rnying ris med kyi dbang lung khrid gsum gyis thugs rgyud phyug par mdzad/ ji bzhin phab na yig tshogs mang du 'gro bas de 37

tsam las ma bris/tshad ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten byas nas/ / tshad ldan dbang lung khrid kyis rgyud phyug pa/ / tshad ldan gangs can gangs seng dkar mo khyed/ /tshad ldan dben pa'i gnas su bzhugs la spro/ / de ltar smin byed dbang /grol byed khrid/ rgyab rten lung bcas mchog tu thob nas rang sar btang snyoms su ma lus par/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ / de 'dzin byed dang smra byed pa/ / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ / gsungs pa bzhin sgrub pa nyams len byed pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar blo ldog rnam bzhis 'khor bar zhen pa ldog pa nas bzang 'bam la bsog cing / rgyud sde bzhi'i lha so so'i bsnyen mtshams sa ri gi༅ da ring /rdo pa rigi zhubazhugs/ gzhan yang lus dge bar bkol lugs la bsam na phyag 'bum ther bcu bzhi 'tshal ba dang / smyung gnas cha nyis brgya bzhugs/ smyung gnas pa khri gsum gyi bla ma mdzad/ ngag dge bar bkol lugs la bsam na/ ltung bshags 'bum ther gcig sgrol ma 'bum ther bcu gcig sirnyi dung gcigapak+ṣi bla sgrub kyi bsnyen tshad dang sgrol dkar gyi bsnyen tshad 'bum ther bcu gcig bcas bzlas pa dang / rgyud sde lha lnga'i bsnyen pa nyin rer tshar brgya re zhal 'don chag med gnang / khong gi thugs kyi yon tan rnams ni bdag lta bu la bshad pa'i spobs pa ma mchis kyang / ji skad du/don dam lhan gcig skyes pa'i ye shes ni/ / tshogs bsags sgrib pa sbyang ba'i lag rjes dang / / rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las/ /thabs gzhan bsten pa rmongs ba shes par bya/ / gsungs pa bzhin skyes bu dam pa 'di'i sgrub pa nyams len gyi rnam thar 'dis kyang gnas lugs rtogs par don gyis mtshon no/ / gzhan khong 'a 'a ri khrod du bzhugs skabs rje bsdospya sgrol ma thog mar rmi lam du mjal ba dang / mnal sad skabs kyang da

dung sngar ltar dwangs shar re 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang rta mgrin/ gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed rnams kyang gzim lam du mjal ba'i tshul shin tu mang / /de ltar nyin der dam pa gang gi rnam thar gyi zin tho bkod mtshams 'dir slebs dus mtshams 'jog byas/ de'i mtshams khong gis rtsam pa dang sha khu gsol/ ngas kyang rtsam pa dang sha skam zos pas 'grangs par byas/ za ma 'di ni rang ngos nas dam pa de dang mnyam du zos pa'i zas kyi tha ma yin yang / dus der de 'dra yin pa ni sus shes/ de skabs khong gis da nga shi na 'gyod pa ma mchis kyang shul du jo rgan ma kha shas lus pa 'di tshos sems sdug byed rgyu red gsungs/ rang dbang yod pa'i tshig de dag gis kyang sems la skyo ba skyes pa las gzhan ci yang dran ma thub/ yang sngon gyi bla ma rnams la shul bzhag gi rnam thar mi 'dug pas gzhan gyis bskul ba ltar da lan lo rgyus 'di 'dra zhig 'bri thub na bsam byung gsungs la/ ngas phyi rabs kyi gang zag rnams kyang khyed kyi rnam thar 'di lta bu la brten nas blo kha chos la phyogs thub kyi red zhus/rta ljang can gyis lho 'dzam gling la nyin gcig gi las ka rnams phal cher mjug sgril la nye ba dang / lag 'dogs 'khor lo la bltas pas phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhir zin 'dug rta la rtswa chas sogs med stabs kho bo dgong mor phyir rang yul du log dam pa de 'tsho bzhugs skabs kyi zhal mjal ba'i tha ma de'i nyin yin pa yang sus shes/de rjes go thos la dgong mor gsol ba yang sngar bzhin gsol nas rgyun gyi spyod lam ltar gzims pa dang / nangs mor skya rengs shar ba dang / pho ba mi bde ba'i tshul cung zad mdzad nas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing khyi spyi lo 1rdzo95lo'i zla ba 2pa'i tshes 17re gza' zla ba'i chu tshod drug phyed la yar 39
