bzhengs te nye gnas la na bza' rnams khur song gsungs/ de mtshams zhal nub tu byas/ gzim khri'i smad du sku gzugs mda' ltar skyen par mdzad nas sku gshegs so/ /ya mtshan pa'i gnas tshul 'di ni tshes nyer drug dang nyer bdun gnyis kyi nyin zhag gcig la byung ba lags pas khyed tshos bsam blo zhig thongs dang /gal te khong gi rnam thar de sngar tsam la 'bri thub na khong yang de'i snga zhig la zhing du gshegs rgyu yin pa gdon mi za/yongs la grags pa'i bla chen ma yin kyang / /yongs las lhag pa'i mdzad spyod zla med pa/ /skye 'chi rang dbang thob pa'i dam pa de/ /skye 'gro'i sems can kun gyi skyabs su 'os/ /gzhan ngor chos ltar bcos pa'i ngang tshul dang / /gzhan don ched du rang don gtong ba yi/ /gzhan phan kha bshad tshig la re ba bcas/ /gzhan yid bslu ba'i rnam thar khyed la med/ /chos min las la smyon pa ltar spyod cing / /chos kyi 'dra 'bag kun la ngom pa yi/ /chos pa'i ming gi rnyed dang bkur sti yang / /chos mdzad khyed kyis bsdu ba'i thabs ma byas/ /rtogs pa don gyi bla ma rin po che 'di nyid zhing la gshegs rjes nyin nyi shu rtsa gcig bar thugs dam brtan po bzhugs pa dang / de'i ring la bgegs dang bar chad kyi ming tsam yang ma byung / skabs der hor khog stod smad bar gsum gtsos khong gi rnam thar go mkhan rnams la dad pa'i sa bon bla med cig skrun yod pa the mi tshom/ mthar ban rgan dgon nas snga srol ltar bla grwa bcu 40

skor gyis gdung chas spras/ tshang mas gcig mtshungs su gdung gi mdog dkar ba dang tshul khrims kyi dri ngad ldan pa las shi ba'i ro yi rnam pa mi 'dug ces bshad/ spyi lo 1995lo'i zla ba 2tshes 1rdzol gdung bzhus so/ / nyin der nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang bya rgod dkar po gcig gis sna drangs te bya 'gas skor ba byed pa dngos su mthong / gnas tshul 'di rnams mthun snang du byung ba ltar bris pa las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gsang rnam dang 'ol tshod kyis rjes dpag byas pa ma yin no/ / gdung rus kyis mchod rten bzhengs nas jo dgon rang gyi rgyab rtsig tu bzhugs su bcug go/ / smras pa/yar stod gangs la 'gying ba'i seng dkar/ /dag pa mkha' dbyings zhing la gshegs na/ /shul lus kha ba dkar po'i skyid sdug /mkha' ltar yangs pa'i gzigs pa ma chung / /yar gyi khog pa'i dkyil na yod pa'i/ /'bral med snying dang 'grogs pa'i bla ma/ /dag zhing gang du gshegs na rung yang / /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'di na stsol mdzod/ /dgung sngon dbyings su lding ba'i bya rgyal rgod po/ /yangs pa'i gshog rlabs zung gis rgyang du bskyod skabs/ /sdug gi mun pa 'thib pa'i rdza ri dag la/ /thugs rjes nyi gzhon phog pa'i bka' drin ma chung / /khyad par snyigs dus 'gro ba yongs kyi mig /'dzam gling zhi bde'i thabs lam snang ba'i dpal/ /gangs can mgon po thugs rje chen po yi/ / thugs bzhed mtha' dag gegs med 'grub par smon/ /41

'di las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus/ /bla slob mched grogs spyi yi dam tshig dang / /bzang po'i las la sdang ba'i nyams chag gi/ /sgrib pa'i sdig kun rang sar zhi gyur cig /gzhan yang bla ma dam pa'i slob rgyud bcas/ /skye dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dam tshig ma nyams 'brel ba yod do cog /phyam gcig sangs rgyas thob par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus 'di spyi lo 1995lo'i zla ba 2tshes 26nyin mgo brtsams kyang rkyen 'dra min gyis phyir bshol bas lo de'i zla ba 5 par spos ngad ldan pa'i gnas te grong khyer phrin 'du khongs gtogs lho nub mi rigs slob grwa'i nye 'dabs kyi mgron khang zhig tu mjug rdzogs par bris pa'o 42

bod skad spyi skad skor la rags tsam dpyad pa/gsung gcig gis kyang lha klu gnod sbyin dang / /grul bum rigs sogs tha dad 'gro rnams la/ /gang la gang 'os brda sbyor byed pa yi/ /spyi skad smra ba'i dbang po la dad do/ /de yang deng dus bod kyi spyi skad skor gyi bgro gleng ni nyin bzhin yar rgyas song ste/ mkhas brgya'i 'gran gleng / me tog mnyam bzhad zer ba'i dpe de don la 'byor ba byung / de ltar dgos te gnas tshul gang dang gang zhig yin rung las sla mo dang / mi gcig blo gcig kho nas thag gcod pa zhig yin na phugs mi brtan zhing / nor ba 'byung sla ba sogs kyi skyon mang / der brten mkhas brgya'i blo gros 'jug pa zhib la phra ba'i dpyod pa gnad la 'khel ba byung ba'i tha ma'i bden don ni yang dag pa zhig yin nges/spyir rang mos dang / sa phyogs kyi zhen chags/ grub mtha'i la rgya sogs bzung ste dpyod pa gnang khul byed na/ blo gros phul byung gi mkhas dbang sogs gang 'dra zhig yin rung dngos po'i chos nyid dang mi mthun pas pham kha len pa las khe kha thob mi srid/ bden rdzun ni dngos po'i gshis kyis ngo sprod pa las/ kha bshad tsam gyis 'grub pa zhig ga na yin/ de ltar na 'di 'dra'i rigs la dpyad pa gnang skabs gzur gnas bya rgyu ni gnad dam pa zhig red/'di na mkhas pa'i blo gros kyi mkha' dbyings yangs pa las rig pa'i 'phrul gyi chu 'dzin stug po 'khrigs skabs/ mdo dbus khams gsum mam rong 'brog 43

gnyis bcas kyi skad gang la spyi skad kyi gzhir bzhag sogs bshad sgros ches mang / spyi skad 'byung gzhi yang chab srid kyi lte gnas/ tshong 'brel/ dpal 'byor/ lo rgyus/ tshan rtsal gyi lte gnas sogs gang yin skor la yang bshad pa mang / yang 'gas ni spyi skad gcig gyur byed pa la u tshugs bya rgyu med/ mi yi rigs kyi chab srid dpal 'byor rig gnas sogs phyogs gang mang zhig gis phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba dang / gong 'og bar gyi 'brel ba sogs 'brel 'dris dam zab byed pa las shugs kyis spyi skad cig chags thub zer/gang yin zer na/ sngon dus spra dang spre'u nas mi yi 'gro ba byung / skabs de la yang / thog ma nas mi skad smra mi gtub kyang / rim bzhin skyid sdug gi tshor ba rnon pos phan tshun bar gyi 'brel 'dris shugs kyis grub stabs brda sbyor gyi skad cha ngang gis grub pa las u tshugs bya ma dgos pas kyang go thub pa yin sogs bshad sgros mang /mi rigs srog rtsa skad dang yi ge zhes/ /bod mi'i kha na rlung ltar grags gyur kyang / /sha rus gcig pa'i phu nu 'dzoms pa'i tshe/ /gzhan skad spyod de rang skad ma dor cig /phran gyis bltas na/ spyi skad kyi khungs bcol gzhi la dbus pa'i skad/ / khams pa'i skad/ a mdo'i skad sogs kyi dbye ba phye dgos don med par ma zad rong ba'i skad dang 'brog pa'i skad ces dbyer ba yang dgos don mi 'dug snyam/ bod skad la dbye ba phye rigs kyi skad cha 'di dag ni gtam rdzob cig las snying po yod pa ma mthong / bod kyi spyi skad gcig gyur gyi dge mtshan ni/ bod skad kyi nus pa cher song ba dang / khyab rgya cher song ste yongs kyis shes 'di spyi skad thub pa'i brda sbyor de'o/ / gal te don shes thub pa'i brda skad min na spyi skad yin zhes lo brgya la u tshugs byas rung 'bras bu thob 44

rgyu gang na yod/ ji skad du/ ma ning gzugs bzang mi bzang zhes/ de 'dod brtags pas ci zhig bya gsungs pa dang sgo kun nas mtshungs/ der brten spyi skad gcig gyur gyi khungs bcol gzhi 'di'o zhes 'dzub gu ma btsugs rung / dngos po'i gshis kyis brda sprod cing bslu med bsnyon med kyis me rtags chu rtags bstan pa'i gangs can spyi skad cig yod/ gang yin zer na phyi phyogs na yod pa'i bod rigs spun zla de dag gi bod skad ni spyi skad yang dag pa zhig red/ gnas der 'dus sdod byed pa'i bod kyi mi sna yang mdo dbus khams gsum mam/ rong 'brog gnyis sogs phyogs mtshams mang po nas phebs pa zhig red/ de dag 'grogs 'dris dang / skyid sdug gi tshor ba mnyam myong las grub pa'i bod skad de ni spyi skad ang dang bo de red/ skad de ni mdo dbus khams gsum mam rong 'brog gnyis sogs gang 'dra zhig yin rung gsal rgyas tshang gsum 'dzoms pa zhig brda 'phrod kyi yod/ bod skad de ni spyi skad ma btags rung don la spyi skad red/ deng dus mkhas pa mang shos shig gis kyang spyi skad mched gzhi mi sna 'dus sdod ches mang zhing /nges med kyi 'grul bzhud rgyu lam zhig la 'dod kyi yod/ skad de mdo dbus khams gsum mam rong 'brog gnyis sam gang gi skad yin sogs dpyad dgos don mi 'dug ji skad du/ zas kyis lto ba 'grangs rtsa na/ / rtsam pa'i lo rgyus shes mi dgos/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ skad de la go brda 'phrod pa'i nus pa khyad par ba zhig yod na chog snyam/bod kyi spyi skad smra ba'i gang zag la/ /ngo tshar brtsis te yul lung so so'i skad/ /smra ba'i la rgya mtho ru bsgreng gyur na/ /rtsa ba shor te yal ga 'jus dang mtshungs/ /yang mkhas pa 'gas bod kyi skad dang yi ge ni gcig tu 'gyur zin/ da 45

lta spyi skad gcig gyur byung na des chog zer/ skad dang yi ge gcig gyur zhes pa de yang las sla mo zhig ga na yin/ yi ge'i sgra godangs tshad ldan gang yin gtan 'khel med na skad yi ge gang dang gcig gyur byed/ gal te yi ge skad dang mthun na des chog zer na/ de yang dka' ste/ tshad ldan gyi skad de gang /yi ge skad gang dang mthun par byed na chog zer ba'i gtan 'khel byed dka'/der brten 'di la yang bsam gzhigs byed dgos/ de ltar bod kyi spyi skad skor gyi gtam nyung ngu lab pa 'di yang rgan mo bsam bzang gi tshul du mkhyen ldan dag gi dpyad gzhi tsam du yong rer byas te bris pa lags/smras pa/gangs can spyi skad rgya lam yangs po na/ /phugs re ldan pa'i skyes bu 'jug mdzod dang / /gangs can mdzes rgyan gangs lha me tog ces/ /gangs can yul gru kun tu grags nges so/ /46

bod kyi srol rgyun tshad ma dang spyi tshogs lam lugs zung 'brel byed pa'i skor/dang po/ tshad ma'i gzhung dngos bshad pa/gzugs su rung ba gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na skyes bu'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs su rung ba nang gi gzugs dang / skyes bu'i rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i gzugs su rung ba phyi yi gzugs gnyis yod/ nang gi gzugs la dbye na mig gi dbang bo/ de bzhin du rna ba sna lce lus kyi dbang bo'o/dbang bo lnga bo 'di dag rang rang gi shes pa'i bdag rkyen thun mong min pa nang gi gzugs can dwangs ba ste/ mig gi dbang bo zar ma'i me tog lta bu/rna ba'i dbang po gro ga'i 'dzer bu gcus pa lta bu/ sna'i dbang bo zangs kyi mo khab gshibs pa lta bu/ lce'i dbang po zla ba bkas pa lta bu/ lus kyi dbang po bya reg na 'jam gyi pags pa lta bu'o/ phyi'i gzugs la dbye na gzugs kyi skye mched/ sgra'i skye mched/ dri'i skye mched/ ro'i skye mched/ reg bya'i skye mched dang lnga yod/ mig shes kyis bzung bya gzugs kyi skye mched kyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du/ rna shes kyis mnyan bya sgra/ sna shes kyis bsnam bya dri/ lce shes kyis myong bya ro/ lus shes kyis myong bya reg bya'i mtshan nyid ces sbyar bar bya'o/ dang bo gzugs kyi skye mched la dbye na dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis/ dbyibs su bstan du rung ba dbyibs kyi mtshan nyid/ mdog tu bstan du rung ba kha dog gi mtshan nyid/dbyibs la dbye na ring ba/ thung ba/ mtho ba/47

dma' ba/ lham pa ste gru bzhi/ zlum po/ phya le ba/ phya le ba ma yin pa dang brgyad/ kha dog la dbye na gnyis yod de rtsa ba'i kha dog dang yan lag kha dog gnyis/ kha dog gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i mdog tu rung ba rtsa ba'i kha dog gi mtshan nyid/ kha dog gzhan dang 'dres nas mdog tu rung ba yan lag gi kha dog gi mtshan nyid/ rtsa ba'i kha dog sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi/ yan lag gi kha dog la brgyad yod de/ der gyur ba'i sprin dang du ba rdul dang / khug sna dang / snang ba dang / mun pa dang / grib ma dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi kha dog dang brgyad/ sgra'i skye mched la dbye na zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur ba'i sgra sems can du ston pa la snyan pa dang mi snyan pa gnyis/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ nang ba la nang ba'i chos ston pa'i sgra lta bu dang po dang / phyi ba la nang pa'i chos ston pa'i sgra lta bu gnyis pa'o/ zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur ba'i sgra sems can du mi ston pa la'ang snyan pa dang mi snyan pa gnyis/ mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ dgra las rgyal ba'i rigs mthun gyi nang du sgrog pa'i ki sgra lta bu dang / spang ba bsam gtan par 'tshe phyir sgrog pa'i ki sgra lta bu/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur ba'i sgra sems can du ston par snyan dang mi snyan pa gnyis glog klad kyis tshig rtsub kyis lan sprad pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra sems can du mi ston par snyan pa dang mi snyan pa gnyis/ / mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin/ slob sbyong la dga' ba'i slob ma zhig gi rna bar slob grwa 'tshogs pa'i dril brda'i sgra thos pa dang / slob sbyong la mi dga' ba'i slob ma zhig gi rna bar slob grwa 'tshogs pa'i dril brda'i sgra thos pa lta bu dang brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ dri la'ang bzhi yod de/ zhim pa ni rgya'i rigs la deng rabs kyi ngo byug gi dri lta bu/ mi zhim pa ni gna' lugs la lha lugs su 'dzin pa'i bod mi la de'i dri lta bu/ mnyam pa til mar gyi dri lta bu/mi mnyam pa sha rul gyi dri lta bu/ ro la drug yod de/ mngar ba bu ram gyi ro lta 48

bu/ skyur ba skyu ru ra'i ro lta bu/ tsha ba sgog skya'i ro lta bu/ lan tsha ba tsha'i ro lta bu/ kha ba tig ta'i ro lta bu/ bska ba a ru ra'i ro lta bu'o/ reg bya la bcu gcig yod de/ sra zhing 'thas pa sa'i mtshan nyid/ rlan zhing gsher ba chu'i mtshan nyid/ tsha zhing bsreg pa me'i mtshan nyid/ yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi mtshan nyid de rgyu 'byung ba bzhi'i reg bya dang / 'bras bu la 'jam rtsub lci yang bkres skom grang ba bcas rten bcas kyi lus dbang dang 'phrad pa'i reg bya bdun te/ rang rgyud chu dang me shas che bas reg bya 'jam pa dang / sa rlung shas che bas rtsub pa/ sa chu shas che bas lci ba/ me rlung shas che bas yang ba/rlung shas che bas bkres pa/ me shas che bas skom pa/ chu rlung shas che bas grang ba bcas so/ /gnyis pa/ gsal bshad kyi skor/gzugs so so tshul ji ltar 'jog pa'i skor gsal bo bshad pa la/ 'di rnams su spyir sngo ser dkar dmar nag po lnga las yan lag gam cha shas mi 'dra ba 'ong bas rtsa ba'i kha dog ces bshad mkhan 'dug kyang / nang rig gi gzhung rnams las/ kha dog zil gnon dang zad pa zil gnon skabs su sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi las ma 'jog pas rtsa ba'i kha dog la bzhir 'jog pa yin gsungs/ yan lag kha dog brgyad 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / kun btus las/ sprin sogs de dag nye ba na mi snang bas de dag med dam snyam pa'i dogs pa bzlog chen du brgyad phye ba yin gsungs/ sprin dkar po'i kha dog de rtsa ba'i kha dog dang yan lag gi kha dog gang yin gyi dpyad pa mang rung /sprin dkar po yan lag gi kha dog min pa dang / 'dren pa'i tshe yang de 'gyur pa'i sprin gyi kha dog ces 'dren pas don du yan lag gi kha dog tu gyur ba'i 49

sprin gyi kha dog zer ba dang gcig go/ dbyibs rnams ni gtso bo ltos sa ltos 'jog gis bzhag pa red/ sgra la rnam pa brgyad 'jog pas sprul ba'i gang zag gi chos bstan pa gzhung snga ma rnams su ma zin pa'i sgra lung du bstan pa'i snyan par 'jog pa'i tshe/ sems can du ston pa'i sgra dang / ngag gi rnam par rig byed kyi sgra dang / rjod byed kyi sgra gsum don gcig pas/ gang zag ma yin pa'i sprul pas 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces brjod pa'i sgra chos can/rang rgyu skyes bu'i lce rkan las byung ba'i sgra yin par thal/ ngag yin pa'i phyir zhes rtsod pa dang / de la mdzod sdom gyi lung drangs nas/ ston pa rnam rig gsungs gtsor dgongs sogs gsungs kyang / deng sang ni mtshan gzhi 'jog rgyu shin tu mang bar snang / dri'i skye mched skabs su/ zhim pa yid 'ong dang / mi zhim pa yid mi 'ong / mi mnyam pa shas che ba dang / mnyam pa shas mi che bcas 'jog tshul gcig dang / dbang bo la phan 'dogs pa zhim pa dang / phan mi 'dogs pa mi zhim pa/ de la phan gnod gang yang mi byed pa mnyam pa dang / sbyar byung dang / lhan skyes dang / a spo smin pa'i dri lta bu 'gyur ba las byung ba'i dri dang drug bcas 'jog tshul gnyis bcas so/ ro'i skye mched skabs su/ rtsa ba'i ro drug po re re la mngar ba sogs ro drug re phye bas so drug dang / de re re la lce shes la phan pa dang / 'ju bar phyogs tshe lus sems la mi gnod pa dang / zhu tshe lus sems la phan pa'i re re ste gsum gsum phye bas brgya dang brgyad yod pa dang / gzhan yang so drug po la mi phan pa dang / gnod pa dang / phan mi 'dogs pa gsum gyis dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad kyang yod do/ reg bya la mi 'dra ba'i khyad chen po ma mthong bas der 'jog go/50

gsum pa/ slar yang gzugs sgra gnyis kyi don gsal bor bshad pa/spyir mig shes kyi gzung bya la dbyibs dang kha dog gnyis las gzhan med kyang / mig shes kyi gzung bya ji tsam zhig mang na dbyibs dang kha dog kyang de tsam gyis mang / deng sang sngon thon gyi rgyal khab la la zla ba'i go la'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa'i dbyibs dang kha dog mthong bar ma zad/ skar ma mig dmar gyi dngos po rnams kyang mig gi spyod yul du gyur pa red/ nga tsho bod kyi lung pa rnams su bla ma rtogs ldan 'ga' re'i dbu thod la sku gzugs rang byung gis shar nas dri bzang spos kyis bstan pa'i tshe mig shes kyi bzung thub par bshad/ 'on kyang rang byung sku gzugs kyi kha dog bla ma'i dbu thod kyi kha dog yin nam kha dog gzhan zhig yin/ dbyibs kyang sha las grub pa yin nam gzhan zhig gang yin cha ma mtshal/ gzhan yang mi la ras pa dbyibs dang kha dog rtsa ba nas ma 'gyur bzhin du g.yag rwa'i sbug na bzhugs pa ras chung pas mjal ba de yang mi srid pa zhig min te/ 'dzam gling gi ri ra ba brag khang khyim mtha' dag kyang glog gi brnyan 'phrin gyi stobs kyis shel sgo chung ngu de 'dra nang nas kyang blta thub pa byung / 'on kyang rje mi las chos nyid mkhyen te che chung gnyis med du rtogs pas rwa sbug na bzhugs tshul dang glog gi stobs kyis gzugs shar tshul e 'dra ni mi shes kyang / gang ltar gzugs chen po zhig dngos po chung ngu zhig gi nang du yod tshul ni 'dra bo 'dug da dung yang mig shes kyi gzung bya nyin re bzhin je rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa red/ rna shes kyi mnyan bya mtha' dag sgra yi dbye ba brgyad kyi nang du 'du rung / mdun gyi dam 51

bca' bas 'don bzhin pa ma yin pa'i blo la gzung ba'i brgyad stong pa de rna shes kyi mnyan bya yin min gyi dpyad pa mang po 'dug 'brug gi sgra ni sems can rnams kyi rna shes kyis mnyan bya yin pa go yang / sgra de gang nas 'byung ba la dpyad pa de 'dra mi 'dug bdag cag gi ston pas/ kun dga' bo sems can rnams kyi 'brug gi sgra zhes bya ba de ni sprin gyi sgra'o gsungs/ de ni sprin brdar ba'i glog gi sgra zhig tu 'dod/ ma gzhi deng sang rgyal khab mang po go la gzhan dag tu 'phur lding byed pa'i tshe mkha' dbyings na 'brug ces pa'i srog chags 'jigs su rung ba zhig mthong ba'i lo rgyus mi 'dug yang mi kha shas kyis 'brug mthong pa ma zad 'brug rnams mtsho chen po ru chu 'thung bar yong nas/ mkha' dbyings su kham gyis chu 'dren pas chu yi lhag ma rnams 'thor bas 'brog sde mang po 'khyer bar bshad/ 'di ni don du rlung 'khor chen pos chu 'dren pa la 'brug tu 'khrul song ba las gzhan gang yang min/ phyi rol pas sgra ni phyi rol gyi yul na rtag par gnas shing rlung brlan pas g.yog pa la skyes bus byed rtsol gyi stobs shugs kyis rlung kha phye nas sgra byung ba yin zer/nga tsho ni rnam rtog dbang gis rlung g.yos te/ / des gnas dang byed pa dang / / rtsol ba bskyed de dbugs dbyung dang / / lhan cig yi ge'i gdangs rnams skyes gsungs pa dang / khyad par du a yig gdangs skye ba med pa zhig yin pa dang / a ni stong dang mi stong gi dbu ma'am dmigs su yod ma yin zhes dang / dbyings las a byung a las ni/ yi ge sna tshogs rnams su 'phro zhes gsungs pas spyir rgya bod gang gi lugs la yang sgra thams cad kyi rtsa ba a yig de rang gshis kyis 'byung bzhin yod/ der brten nga tsho nang pas kyang dbyings las sgra 'byung ba yin pa khas len zhing / dbyings kyi sgra la dbye ba dang rtsol ba mi 'dra bas sgra gdangs mi 'dra ba 'gyur ba red/ ma zad bdag cag gi ston pas/ stong nyid rten 'brel du gtan la 'bebs skabs/ rnga yi 52

sgra ni skyes bus lag pa las ma byung /rnga dbyug las kyang ma byung / rnga yi ko ba las kyang ma byung / rnga shing las kyang ma byung / 'on kyang tshogs pa las byung bzhin chos thams cad snang stong rang bzhin du gsungs so/ 'di'i dper rnga sgra 'jog tshul la 'di yang go rgyu chen po 'dug snyam/ de bzhin du rnam rtog dbang gis rlung g.yos te gsungs pa 'dis kyang don chen po bstan te/dper na go la 'di'i phyi rol du phyin rjes dbugs kyi rigs gtan nas med pa yin tsang skyes bus lce rkan gyi byed rtsol gyis sgra de phan tshun bskyal thub kyi med cing glog gi kha par bed spyad dgos pa dngos su grub/ der brten sgra 'byung ba la dbugs ni shin tu gal chen zhig tu snang / mu stegs pas sgra rtag pa rlung gi g.yog bya zhig tu 'dod pa las kyang khyad par du 'phags pa'i gsung 'di dag ni tshad thub kyi gtam du snang / bod kyi rigs gzhung rnams su rdul rdzas las grub pa'i rags pa'i rdul kun la rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus kyi gong bu 'jog pa las sgra rdul mi 'jog pa de yang de yin snyam/ de yang mdzod las/ 'dod na sgra med rdul rdzas brgyad gsungs pa dang yang mthun no/ mkhas dbang nam mkha'i nor bus/ bod kyi cho ga thos grol rnams su/ / sgra 'od zer gsum dgra ru mi blta zhing / sangs rgyas dkar po'i zhing khams mthong ba shog gsungs pa 'di la go rgyu chen po 'dug sngon ma'i lus bor nas rnam shes mun nang du zhugs pa lta bur 'gyur tshe/ bar do'i rnam shes skyed byed du thog mar rang byung khams kyi sgra chen po grags pa dang / de nas 'od zer kyi rlabs 'phros pas/ rnam shes je gsal du 'gro ba zhig yin pa 'di ni/ tshan rig pa'i skad cha dang mthun po 'dug gsungs/ rgya'i skad du (rki)zer ba de yang de 'dra zhig 'jog pa yin snyam/ bod kyi bsdus gzhung rnams su/ sa ser 'byung ba yin gyi kha dog min/ rta dkar gang zag yin gyi kha dog min gsungs pas sa dang kha dog gnyis dbye 'byed gsal bo gnang ba 'di ni tshan rig dang mthun 53

pa'i gtam du snang / kha dog ni 'od rlabs yin par mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ kha dog rnams ni phra rab kyi rba klong g.yo tshul tsam ste/dper na/ 'od kyi rlabs mig 'dzum gcig la brgyad brgya g.yo ba dag la dmar po'i snang ba 'char zhing / bzhi brgya g.yo ba la ser po'i snang ba sogs 'char ba las/ kha dog tsam gzhi'i phra rab rnams la kha dog gi khyad ci yang med par mthong / de bzhin bod du gtam smras pa rgya nag tu skad cig gnyis par thos pa'i 'phrul spyad bzos shing / rgya nag tu yod pa bod du gzugs dpar yang 'debs nus pas dngos po thams cad glog gi rba klong nang du rgyug gi yod pa'i 'bras rtags mthar thug mig gis mthong ba de red gsungs pa dang / bden gsungs de dag deng gi dus su ni sngar las kyang mngon du gyur bzhin pa red/ deng sang tshan rig pas 'od rlabs ring thung bdun phyes te de rnams g.yo bar myur shugs che chung gis sngo sesdodakar dmar 'jog pa lags/da dung mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ de bzhin dkar po yod pas nag po mig la snang nus kyi dkar po legs po'i dngos po yan gar ba ci yang 'jig rten na mi srid do bya ba 'di gsar du go nas lo lnga bcu song sogs 'ga' zhig gis smra yang / rang re'i klu sgrub sogs kyis gna' gna' zhig nas go ba de ka rang yin sogs gsungs/ 'di dag la bltas nas gzugs dri ro reg bya bzhi dang sa chu me rlung gi rdul rdul rdzas brgyad po so so yod tshul gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan chen po yod pa go dper na bod kyi bsdus gzhung las me dmar po reg bya 'jog ste/ tsha zhing bsreg pa zhes gsung ba dang / me dmar po'i dri dang ro sogs ches tha dad yin pa go ste/ ro rdul dang dri rdul mi 'dra bas ro rdul dang dri rdul mnyam du yod rung / myong bya dri ni myong byed lce shes kyis rtsa ba nas myong mi thub/ de bzhin gzhan dag kyang 'dra/ de yang ji skad du/ gnyis gzugs 'gyur te rdul la med gsungs pa sogs so/ 'jig 54

rten pa rnams kyis/ kha dog dbyibs la sa zhes brjod pa las ngos 'dzin ji bzhin bya mi thub pa'i tshul mdzod las gsungs pa bzhin no/bzhi pa/ sgra rlung dang 'od rlabs kyi myur tshad bshad pa/sngon dus tshan rig pa mang pos zhib 'jug byas byas pa'i rjes 'bras su thog mar sgra rlabs ni ches myur ba dang por 'jog pa red/ de rjes gom gang mdun spos kyis slar yang zhib 'jug gang mang byas mthar 'od rlabs ni sgra rlabs las kyang myur bar go ste/ de'i brda 'phrod thabs su mkha' la glog 'tshub pa dang sgra byung ba gnyis dus mnyam na yang / mi rnams kyis thog mar 'od 'khyug pa mthong ba dang / de rjes sgra thos pa de red ces bshad/ spyir sgra'i myur tshul ni dro tshad che chung dang dngos po mi 'dra ba'i nang du myur tshad kyang mi 'dra/ dper na rgyang sgrags so so nas grags pa'i sgra la mtshon na de ni mkha' dbugs kyi g.yo 'gul khrod du brgyud de bgrod dgos pas skar cha re la smi sum brgya bzhi bcu re bgrod thub/ der brten glog 'phrin las khungs dang thag ring thung mi 'dra bas rgyang sgrags so so nas grags pa'i tshig gcig pa'i sgra de thos rgyu la yang dus snga phyi'i khyad par yod/ de ltar na mkha' dbugs khrod kyi sgra yi myur tshad ni ches dal ba zhig red/ lcags rdul la brgyud de bgrod pa'i sgra'i myur tshad ni skar cha re la smi lnga stong nyis brgyar bgrod kyin yod/ de las kyang myur ba'i 'od rlabs ni dbyings stong rkyang (zlo0 )du bgrod pa yin/skar cha re la smi dung phyir gsum bgrod thub pa red/ skar ma'i 'od 'di dag kyang de 'dra zhig myur na yang / nga tshos skar 'od mthong dus skar ma kho rang sngar ma zhig nas 'gag tshar ba bshad/ dper na nyi ma las gzhan du sa'i go la dang thag nye shos kyi brtan skar yang 'od lo bzhi dang grangs chung gnyis 55

gnyis ring ba'i sa na yod/ de bas na nga tshos da lta mthong ba'i skar ma'i 'od ni de nyid las lo bzhi sngon la 'phros pa'i 'od rang yin par bshad/ de dag la brten nas skar ma dang nga tsho bar du ches rgyang ring ba go thub/ dngos gnas bshad na sgra rlabs dang 'od rlabs las kyang myur ba de rnam shes gsal rig yin pas skar cha gcig la stong chen po skor thub kyi yod pa de yang ston pa shākya thub pas 'phrul dang rnam rtog mang bo mi dgos nas/ mkhyen pa gcig gis chos kyi sngon du yid 'gro ste/ yid mgyogs yid ni gtso bo yin gsungs pas bden thub kyi gtam du snang / de bzhin du deng sang phra mthong rgyang shel spyod nas srog chags phra ba 'bu phra (mi7 )zhes pa phyi gzugs nang gzugs mtha' dag la khyab 'dug ces thag gcod pa de yang ston pas lo gnyis stong sngon nas glog dang rgyang shel gang yang med bzhin mkhyen zhing gzigs pa'i sgo nas/ shing rta'i 'phang lo'i khyon la yang sa 'di ni nga yi'o snyam pa'i srog chags grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mthong gsung ba dang / ma zad gnya' shing gang tsam blta nas 'gro la sems 'khrul med gsungs pas 'gro ba'i tshe na yang myi rgod spyod pas rkang lag thams cad gang byung du mi g.yug cing 'jam po dgos tshul gsungs pa'i gnad kyang rang byung khams kyi 'bu phra rnams gsad par dgongs pa yin/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsungs su/ rtsam zan phor ba gang ni 'bu phor ba gang yin gsungs pa yang 'bu phra la dgongs pa red/deng gi tshan rig pas rdul rdzas kyi dngos po mtha' dag bar gseng dang bcas pa yin pa ma zad mkha' dbugs dang bcas par rgyang shel nas mthong pa de yang bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon dag gis/ gna' gna' nas rdul rdzas rags pa thams cad ni rdul rdzas cha med kyis brtsams pas bar dang bcas pa rma thong bas rna 'jags khur dgos pa zhig gsungs myong / bsdus gzhung rnams su dbyibs bshad pa 'di la yang dgos pa chen po zhig yod de/ dbyibs 56

gzugs mi 'dra ba mang por bltas nas mkhas dbang mang por gsar gtod kyi 'du shes chags myong / a ri'i tshan rig pa no pir bya dga' thob mkhan ko la zha'o zhes pas/ rtag par gling ka ru 'khyams 'khyams la song nas mtha' khor gyi don dngos la yig 'jog byed 'os/ gal te khyed kyis sngon mar glang po che mthong ma myong ba yin na glang po che'i dbyibs gzugs gang 'dra zhig yin pa ga la shes zhes gsungs so/ / kha dog bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'od rlabs mi 'dra ba'i gnad rnams shes rjes glog gi stobs kyis brnyan 'phrin du kha dog rnams shar thub pa dang dpar chas sogs kyis de rnams ji bzhin bsdu thub pa de yin/ sgra bshad pa'i dgos pa ni/ rjod byed kyi sgra la dgos pa yod pa bshad ci dgos/ rjod byed kyi sgra min pa'i rol mo'i sgra dkrol ba la yang dgos pa chen po yod de/ tshan rig pa phu'u lang kho ni kang chin rol mo ba zhig yin pa zhig yin la e'e dbyin si than ni thi chin chung ba dkrol mkhan phul byung ba zhig yin/ a'e dbyin si than lags kyis tshan rig gi gnad don bsam gzhigs gnang skabs rtag par thi chin chung chung dkrol gnang gi yod pa red/lnga pa/ slar yang dri ro reg bya gsum gyi don gsal por bshad pa/dri ro reg bya gsum gyi bdag nyid de/ sna lce lus kyi khams su byas te lus rgyas par byed pa yin/ bod kyi bsdus gzhung rnams las bshad pa ltar dri ro reg bya gsum po sna shes dang lce shes lus shes bcas la 'phrad mi 'phrad dang yid du 'ong mi 'ong la ma blta nas sna lce lus gsum la phan 'dogs mi 'dogs la bltas nas phan 'dogs pa de zhim 'jam yid 'ong dang phan mi 'dogs pa de zhim 'jam min par 'jog ste spyod dgos pa zhig yin/ phyi gling 57

pa dag gis kyang dri ro reg bya gsum la spyod tshe sna lce lus gsum la phan 'dogs pa de gtso bor spyod kyi yod pa las yid du 'ong mi 'ong la mi lta ba zhig yin/ spyir dri ro reg bya bzang ngan de yang ltos sa ltos 'jog gis bzhag pa las gtan 'khel gyis bzang ngan zhig rnyed thub pa mi 'dug dper na rgya gar tsha ba che stabs kyis lha yi gos rnams kyang srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos zhes srab la 'jam zhing yang ba zhig ni reg bya gtsigs che ba zhig tu 'jogabod kyis kyang dpe cha rnams su srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos zhes 'don na yang / mtho sgang gi steng du sa grang mo 'di 'dra zhig la srab pa dang yang ba zhig tu gos bzang por brtsi mi rung snyam/ 'phros don/ ma gzhi mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsungs pa ltar nga tsho bod kyi mi la rgya gar bas gang thad nas shugs rkyen zab mo zhig thebs yod/ mtha' na gna' rab kyi rtsom rig dag na ri ma la ya dang 'bigs byed sogs rma rgyal spom ra dang gangs ti se'i sum cha gcig las med cing brjid nyams kyi cha nas kyang do mi zla yang madhar dang 'bigs byed sogs ches mang po grags te rlabs chen rtsis/ 'on kyang deng rabs kyi mkhas dbang 'gas rma rgyal spom ra'i gnyer ma dang gangs dkar ti se'i mig chu shor ba rnams gzur gnas kyi mda' mos rtsom rig gi gzhu rgyud la drangs te gangs can gyi gzhon nu la gtod dus 'phag 'tshag byed kyin yod/ dkyus kyi don/ 'jam tsub zer ba de yang / dngos po kho rang 'jam rtsub gang yang min zhing yul dbang shes gsum 'phrad pa'i tshe 'jam tsub byung ba yin/ dper na chu kho rang 'jam tsub gang yang min rung nya'i dbang bo dang 'phrad na ches 'jam pa zhig snang gi 'dug de bzhin nga tsho'i dbang por ches tsub pa'i tsher ma de yang rnga mo la tshwa bzhin snang gi 'dug ma zad 'dul ba rnams su yang dri ro reg gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi zas rnams sman du 'jog ste/ bkres nad sel phyir dus rung gi sman dang / skom nad 58

sel phyir thun tshod kyi sman dang / rlung nad sel phyir zhag bdun pa'i sman dang / 'dus nad sel phyir 'tsho rkyang gi sman bcas ston pas gnang ba dang /de bzhin bshes springs las kyang / kha zas sman dang 'dra ba rig pa yis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang med par bsten bgyi la/ rgyags phyir ma lags snyems pa'i phyir ma lags/ / 'tshag phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig phyir zhes gsungs so/ / reg bya'i bdag nyid can gyi lci yang rnams kyang dngos po rang ngos nas lci yang 'jog tu med cing / rdul rdzas kyi dngos po spus ka ci tsam bzang na go la'i 'then shugs kyang de tsam gyis che bas de la ljid mo zer/dngos po'i spus ka ji tsam zhan na go la'i 'then shugs kyang de tsam gyis chung bas yang par 'jog pa red/ dngos po kho rang la yang lci'i khyad par med pa'i 'bras rtags ni 'di na ljid tshad mi 'dra ba'i dngos po gnyis sa'i go la'i phyi rol tu 'dren rjes khyad par spu tsam med pas so/ skabs 'di'i spus ka zer ba de yongs grags kyi spus ka la go rgyu ma yin pa/ khe stong (r+haṭ+wā)zhes pa'i mang nyung la blta dgos/ dri ro reg gsum bshad dgos pa yang / dri ro reg gsum zhim bzang dang zhim bzang min pa ji bzhin shes rjes phan pa yod pa'i dri ro reg gsum spyod pa las gnod pa yod pa'i dri ro reg bya la zhim bzang yid 'ong mthong rung mi spyod pa yin/ dper na nyal du yi dri zhim rung de la pha bsad pa'i lag dmar bzhin shin tu 'dzem dgos pa las zhim pa zhig tu 'jog mi rung pas gzhan gnyis kyang 'dra/ de ltar dri ro reg bya gsum la blang dor tshul bzhin byed na na tsha nyung zhing las don 'grub cing srog yun ring 'tsho ba la phan pa yod/59

drug pa/ tshad ma rig pa las rtags gsal dang mtshan gzhi sbyar nas bshad pa/thog mar las dang po pas rtsod pa la 'jug sla phyir rtsod tshul cung zad gleng ba la/ snga rgo4 ni dam bca' ba yin zhing / phyi rgol ni rigs lang pa'am rtsod pa byed mkhan yin/ dam bca' bas lan 'debs tshul la lnga yod de/'dod rtags ma grub khyab pa med/ khyab pa 'gal dang the tshom za/ lnga po lan zhes bya ba yin gsungs/ de yang rtsod gzhi dang bsgrub chos gnyis ldan gyi sbyor ngag rnams la/ 'dod lan dang the tshom gyi lan gnyis gang rung las gzhan med/ dper na mi chos can/ smra shes don go yin par thal zhes pa la/'dod ces lan btab chog 'dod lan thob zer na mi smra shes don go yin par 'dod zer dgos/ mi chos can/ smra shes don go ma yin par thal zer ba la/ the tshom gyi lan ci'i phyir zer dgos/ ci'i phyir lan thob zer na/ mi smra shes don go ma yin pa ci'i phyir zhes so/ des gzhan la yang rigs 'gre/gal te mi chos can/ smra shes don go yin par thal/ lha yin pa'i phyir zhes pa la rtags ma grub lan rgyag dgos/ rtags ma grub kyi lan thob zer na/ mi lha yin pa rtags ma grub zer dgos/ mi chos can/ smra shes don go yin par thal/ sems can yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtags chos don gsum tshang ba'i sbyor ngag 'di la mi sems can yin pa rtags ma grub pas/ rtags ma grub lan mi thob pas/ khyab pa ma byung gi lan rgyag dgos/ khyab pa slong dang zhes na/ sems can yin na smra shes don go yin pas ma khyab zer dgos/ des sbyor ngag gzhan la yang rigs 'gre/ mi chos can/ smra shes don go yin par 60

thal rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtags sbyor la/ 'gal khyab lan rgyag dgos te/ rtag pa yin na smra shes don go min pas khyab pas so/ gnyis pa khyab skor 'god pa las las dang po bas kha dog la rtsod tshul gleng ba/ rtag pa yin par thal/ yod pa gang zhig dngos po ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod zer na/rtag pa ma yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub zer na/dngos po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub zer na/ kha dog yin par thal/ ser po yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ma grub zer na/ ser po yin par thal/ kha dog ser po'i khyab pa gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ khyab pa ma byung zer na/ khyab pa slong dang byas pas/ kha dog ser po'i khyab pa gzhi grub na kha dog ser po yin pas ma khyab zer na/ khyab par thal/ ma khyab pa'i skyon bzhag rgyu med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ zhog dang byas pas/ chos dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba'i kha dog chos can/ zer na/ de chos can/ kha dog gang zhig ser bo ma yin par thal/ 'dod zer na/ 'o na kha dog gang zhig ser po ma yin na/ dkar po yin pa'i khyab par thal/ ma khyab zer na/ khyab par thal/ ma khyab pa'i skyon bzhag rgyu med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ zhog byas pas/ pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog chos can/ zer na/ de chos can/ kha dog gang zhig dkar po yin par thal/ 'dod zer na/ 'o na kha dog gang zhig dkar po ma yin na dmar po yin pa'i khyab par thal/ ma khyab zer na/ khyab par thal/ ma khyab pa'i skyon bzhag rgyu med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na zhog dang byas pas/ in dra ni la'i kha dog chos can/ zer na/ de chos can/ kha dog gang zhig dmar po ma yin par thal/ 'dod zer na/ 'o na sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi po gang rung ma yin na kha dog ma yin pa'i khyab par thal/ ma khyab zer na/khyab par thal/ de la ma khyab pa'i skyon med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na zhog dang byas pas/ las gzhi lhun gyis grub par byed pa'i don yon grub pa ljang khu'i 61

kha dog chos can/ zer na/ de chos can/ kha dog gang zhig sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi bo gang rung yin par thal/ sngo ser 'dus pa'i kha dog yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ces bya'o/ de bzhin du dmar ser 'dus pa las li khri'i mdogadamar sngon 'dus pa las nag po rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar te/ de rnams re re nas co ba'i kha dog sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi po gang rung ma yin par thal/ de rnams yan lag gi kha dog yin na yan lag gi kha dog brgyad po gang rung yin pas ma khyab ste/ ljang bu dang dmar ser nag po de rnams re re nas yan lag gi kha dog brgyad po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/gsal bshad dang po/lan lnga 'debs skabs/ 'dod lan dang the tshom gyi lan gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi'i don de bsgrub bya'i chos de yin na 'dod lan dang / min na the tshom gyi lan dang / rtsod gzhi'i don gyi steng du chos de yod na 'dod lan dang med na the tshom gyi lan thob pas don dang mthun pa'i lan 'debs rgyu gal che/ rtags ma grub dang ma khyab pa dang 'gal khyab ni don dang mthun pa'i lan 'debs thub pa byung na de tsam las lan du 'debs tshul ni gong zhus ltar ro/ mi smra shes don go yin par gzhi bzhag byas pa 'di ni/ tshad ma'i mkhan po dge rgan ye shes dar rgyas kyis gsungs pa bzhin/ spra dang spre'u rim bzhin 'gyur nas smra shes don go ba'i dus rim der mi zer ba de 'jog pa red/'on kyang smra shes don go yin na mi yin pas khyab ma khyab dang /ri mi yin na smra shes don go yin pas khyab ma khyab bshad pa mang rung / mtshan nyid la mtshan mtshon khyab pa sgo brgyad nges pa'i mtshon bya rnam 'jog gi mtshan nyid dang / mtshan mtshon khyab pa sgo brgyad ma nges rung ngo bo gtan 'bebs kyi mtshan nyid gnyis yod pa las/ smra shes don go mi yi mtshan nyid 'jog pa ni ngo bo gtan 'bebs kyi 62

mtshan nyid du 'jog rtag pa yin na smra shes don go min pas khyab pa 'jog pa'i skabs 'di sangs rgyas la dmigs bsal phud dgos pa zhig yin pa mkhyen par mdzod/ mi lha yin pa rtags ma grub ces pa 'di don dang mthun pa'i lan zhig yin te/ lha 'dre mi gsum ni ches tha dad pa zhig yin te/bdag cag gi ston pas kyang / dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gsungs pas/ rigs drug gi sems can gyi bde sdug dang snang tshul dang spyod pa bcas ni ches mi 'dra bas so sor rgyang chad du grub pa zhig red/ der brten mi lha ru 'gyur nas lha mi gnyis kyi gzhi mthun dang / mi 'dre ru 'gyur te mi dang 'dre gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod pa ni gtan nas mi srid pa zhig red/ 'dre zhes pa de yi dwags red/ yi dwags kyi snang ba ni zas skom gyis stong pa'i rnag dang khrag kho na yin par ma zad/ dbyar gyi dus su zla ba las kyang tsha zer dang / dgun dus su nyi ma las kyang grang zer phog pas/tsha bas tshig pa dang / grang bas gas pa'i sdug bsngal kho nas mnar ba'i sems can zhig go/ mi zhes pa ni/ bza' btung rigs mi 'dra ba mang zhing dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi'i dro grang yang tshad las brgal ba lta bu ma yin pa/bde sdug kyang spel ma myong mkhan zhig yin/ lha zhes pa de bdud rtsi sogs 'dod yon lnga la longs su spyod cing rang lus 'od gsal te bde ba kho nas dus 'da' pa zhig go 'on kyang mi yi rigs la yang nang gses rigs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig ni los yod/ dmyal ba la yang tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe nyer 'khor bcas bco brgyad yod la/ yi dwags la yang phyi sgrib dang nang sgrib/ me lce 'khor lo sogs ga tshad cig 'dug de bzhin dud 'gro la yang bying na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor gyi rigs gnyis dang bying na gnas pa'i dud 'gro la yang dbye ba grangs bsam gyis mi khyab/ kha 'thor la yang de bzhin no/ der brten mi'i 'gro ba la yang rigs mi 'dra ma mang po 63

yod pa shes thub kyang / gal te sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsungs rnams bden na ni bod mi thams cad ni spre'u dang brag srin mo'am spra las byung ba zhig red/de 'dra'i rigs mthun gyi sems can zhig la lag cha mi 'dra ba mang bo bed spyod de dum bur gtong ba ni/ rang gcad na rang thung / rang gzhog na rang phra zhes ba de yod nges red/ ma gzhi mi rigs gcig la yang 'jon thang che chung dang stobs che chung ni los yod/ 'on kyang stobs dang 'jon thang che la grub 'bras che ba'i mi de mi gral nas phud de lha gral du 'jog pa ni gcig pa red dper na rgya nag gi rgyal rabs rnams kyi lo rgyus las kon dbyig()drum+mu)dang krang h+phe(byeṣ+ṭha༄) li'u pe (smo1ṣ+ṭha)bcas kyis dmag dpon byas te dgra 'dzing gi sgo nas rang sde srung ba'i byas rjes che bas mthar lha gral du 'jog pa red/ de bzhin rgya nag khren tu'u grong khyer nas le dbar sum bcu lhag song na gam zhan(oṃ rku྾)zer ba der slebs kyi yod/ grong der sngon dus chu yis dka' ngal chen po byed kyi yod pa la/ dus mtshams shig na li pin zer ba'i(sto.oṃ)mi rlabs chen zhig byung bas grong de'i chu yi dka' ngal sel thub pa byung bas/ phyis su khong 'das rjes dran gso khong zhig bskrun nas khong lha ru byas te phyag 'tshal yul dang mchod pa'i gnas su bzhag 'dug 'di dag la brten nas mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ u rgyan (atshi ṣ+pe)yul na mkha' 'gro ma kha spu can byung ba'i rgyu mtshan du/ de'i yul gyi bud med rnams la kha spu yod pa gsungs pa'i bden gsungs de la yid ches lhag par byung / ma zad rgya nag gong ma chen mo rnams la bod kyi bla chen 'gas 'jam dbyangs gong ma zhes 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul bar bzhed kyang / rgya nag pa kho rang tshos 'jam dbyangs yin pa tshig zur tsam bshad rgyu mi snang / spyan ras gzigs (rkultostsas+dza) la yang rgya bod gnyis kyi 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis te/ rgya nag pa'i spyan ras gzigs ni mo rgyud dang gangs can pa'i spyan ras 64

gzigs ni pho rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ mig sngar mthong bzhin pa'i sku gzugs dag las kyang mi rigs re la kho rang dang 'tshams pa'i sku gzugs re yod pas gnad mang po zhig shes thub/ 'on kyang mi de rigs drug gi nang gses kyi lha ru 'gyur ba yin na yang 'dra/ spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs sogs su 'gyur na yang 'dra/ gang ltar lha ru 'gyur tshar rjes ni mi ma red/ dper na mi phag tu 'gyur na mi ma yin pa bzhin no/ bye brag smra ba'i slob dpon dag gis/ shākya thub pa sangs rgyas zhes pa de yang sems sangs rgyas pa yin gyi gzugs phung ni mi yi lus rten rgyal bu don 'grub red zer ba 'di la go rgyu chen pe (radug de bzhin mi ni mi rang red/ mi yi lus rten gcig mtshungs yin pa la gnod sems kyis gnod pa 'byung ba dang / phan sems kyis phan pa 'byung du yod pa'i khyab pa ma nges rung / de 'dra 'ga' shas 'byung du yod pa 'di ni 'byung khams sogs kyi 'phrad lugs mi 'dra ba zhig gis yin snyam/der bsten gangs can pa la thal mo snying khar sbyar te zhu rgyu/ nga tsho'i rigs mthun gyi sems can rnams la 'dre btsan sogs kyi ming btags nas btsog par brtsis te de'i khyim nye rgyud dang bcas pa mgo 'phang bteg tu med pa'i sdug de ma bkal rogs/ khyad par snying rje can gyi bla sprul rnam pas gnad 'di la gzab gal che/ /gsal bshad gnyis pa/1 rtsod gzhi med pa'i rtag pa yin par thal zhes pa 'di/ rtag mi rtag gi chos gang yang rtsod gzhir ma 'jog par/ spyir rtag pa yin pas 'dod lan thebs pa yin/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir zhes/rtags dngos po yin pas bsgrub chos mi rtag pa yin pas khyab rung / spyir rtags dngos gnyis las rtag pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ spyir dngos po yin 65

pa rtags ma grub zer ba dang don gcig go/2 kha dog gang zhig sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi bo gang rung gi kha dog yin par thal/ sngo ser 'dus pa'i kha dog yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ces bya'o zhes pa'i don ni/ sngo ser 'dus pa'i kha dog yin na/ sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi bo gang rung yin pas ma khyab zer ba dang don gcig der brten ljang khu'i kha dog ni sngon po min la ser po min/ dkar po min zhing dmar po min pas so/ de gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/2 spyir chos thams cad la rang nyid grub byed cig yod pa zhig yin/der brten chos dang 'jig rten chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs ring lugs dang ma rtsa ring lugs/ 'khor 'das gnyis bcas chos so so la grub cha mi 'dra ba yod tsang grub tshul ches mi 'dra ba re byung / grub tshul de blo'i yul du gyur skabs grub cha yang de'i yul du gyur dgos te/ grub bde dbyer med kyi rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ lhan skyes kyi kha dog 'chad skabs su gur gum dang gur gum gyi kha dog lhan skyes kyi kha dog 'jog ba bzhin du/ 'gal 'brel de yang 'gal bya dang 'gal byed 'brel bya dang 'brel byed bcas rigs 'gre ste chos gzhan lhan skyes su bsdu dgos pa mang tsam zhig mthong ngo /gsum pa khyab skor dngos 'god pa/kha cig na re/ khyod kha dog yin na/ kha dog khyod yin pas khyab zer na/dkar po chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ dbyibs brgyad po gang rung yin na/ gzugs kyi skye mched yin pas khyab ba thal/ de brgyad gzugs kyi skye mched yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'o na khyod rang la bum pa gzugs kyi skye mched ma yin par thal/ de la gzugs kyi skye mched kyis ma khyab pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig kho na re/ mtshan mo'i mun khrod na gnas pa'i bum pa mig shes kyi gzung bya yin par thal/ 'ug pa'i mig shes kyi bzung bya 66

yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de la ltos te mun khrod na gnas pa'i bum pa ma yin pa'i phyir dang / las dbang gi sbrul gyi mig shes kyi bzung bya la mig shes kyi bzung bya mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ rtsom 'phror bshad tshul des ka ba dang /shing dang / rdo dang / gser dngul sogs la yang shes so/ zhes gsungs pas de dag la yang mig shes kyi bzung bya dang lus shes kyi reg bya gnyis re 'jog dgos so/ yang kho na re/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ khyab ste/ tshe dpag med kyi kha dog yin na/ kha dog yin pas khyab pa'i phyir na yang ma khyab/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus/ sangs rgyas rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ sangs rgyas kyi kha dog med par thal/ sangs rgyas rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gsum med par thal lo/ 'o na/ sangs rgyas kyi skye ba snga ma yod par thal/ 'dod na/rtag pa yin na/ khyod kyi skye ba snga ma med pas ma khyab par thal lo/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos mi gsung gzhal bya yod med sogs mang ngo / yang kho na re/ dkar dmar gnyis kyi nang gi gcig dkar po yin par thal/ dkar po dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de ma yin par thal/ de gnyis kyi nang gi gcig dmar po yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig na re/ kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab zer na/ gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/ gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/ mdog tu rung ba kha dog gi mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba 'dod na/ gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po ma yin par thal/ ser po yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/ gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog chos can/ ser po yin par thal/gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na de chos can/ khyod khyod dang gcig yin par thal/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ kha 67

cig na re/ gzugs yin na dbyibs dang kha dog gang rung yin pas khyab zer na/ dung sgra chos can/ dbyibs dang kha dog gang rung yin par thal/gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ dung sgra chos can/dbyibs dang kha dog gang rung ma yin par thal/ mig shes kyis bzung bya ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de rna shes kyis mnyan bya yin pa'i phyir te/ de sgra yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ gzugs yin na dbyibs kyi gzugs yin pas khyab zer na/ dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba'i kha dog chos can/ dbyibs kyi gzugs yin par thal/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/de chos can/ de yin par thal/ de bem po yin pa'i phyir te/ de rdul du grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ dbyibs kyi gzugs ma yin par thal/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog gi gzugs dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyod khyod dang gcig yin par thal/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re gzugs yin na kha dog gi gzugs yin pas khyab zer na/ mtho ba'i gzugs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir sogs sgrub tshul sngar bzhin no/ kha cig na re/ kha dog dkar po khyod yin pa gang zhig kha dog dmar po khyod yin na/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis ka khyod yin pas khyab zer na/ yin par srid pa'i shes bya chos can/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis ka khyod yin par thal/ kha dog dkar po khyod yin pa gang zhig kha dog dmar po khyed yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po ma grub na/ kha dog dkar po chos can/ yin par srid pa'i shes bya yin par thal/ khyod kyi yin pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog de de yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ kha dog dmar po chos can/ yin pa srid pa'i shes bya yin par thal/ khyod kyi yin pa yod pa'i phyir/68

ma grub na/ der thal/ pad+ma ra ga'i kha dog de de yin pa'i phyir/ sogs sgrub sla/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis chos can/ yin pa srid pa'i shes bya ma yin par thal/ khyod kyi yin pa med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ khyed kyi yin pa med par thal/ khyod kyi yin pa yod na gang dran dran yin pa'i khyab pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re dkar po yin na kha dog dkar po yin pas khyab zer na/ rta dkar po chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ dkar po yin par thal/rta dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ khyod khyod dang gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ khyod gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ rta dkar po chos can/ kha dog ma yin par thal/ de bem po ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de gang zag yin pa'i phyir te/ de rta yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du sngo ser dmar ljang kun la rigs 'gre bar bya'o/ de skad byas pa la/ kho na re/ dkar po yin na kha dog dkar po yin dgos par thal/ sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi bo rtsa ba'i kha dog yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab ces dam bca' 'o/ kha cig na re/ kha dog yin na sbyar byung gi kha dog yin pas khyab zer na/ gur gum gsar ba'i kha dog chos can/sbyar byung gi kha dog yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/yan lag gi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na sla/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ sbyar byung gi kha dog ma yin par thal/ lhan skyes kyi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ gur gum dang gur gum gyi kha dog gnyis lhan gcig tu grub pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/de chos can/ der thal/ de gnyis skye 'jig gnas gsum dus gcig yin pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis grub bde rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/kha dog yin na lhan skyes kyi kha dog yin pas khyab zer na/ gzan dmar po'i 69

kha dog chos can/ lhan skyes kyi kha dog yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ rtsa ba'i kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ lhan skyes kyi kha dog ma yin par thal/ de sbyar byung gi kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ de skyes bus byed pas bsgrub pa'i kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ gzan dmar po'i kha dog dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/gsal bshad gsum pa/kha dog dkar po kha dog yin zhing kha dog kha dog dkar po ma yin pa'i rigs 'dis dge rgan kun dga' rgyal mtshan bod yig slob grwa'i mi yin zhing /bod yig slob grwa'i mi dgen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ma yin zer ba dang 'dra/bod yig slob grwa'i mi ni grangs mang la khyab che zhing stobs shugs che ba zhig yin la dgen kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni bod yig slob grwa'i mi yi bye brag gcig yin tsang de 'dra ma yin pa'i phyir/ der brten bod mi gcig gis bya ba ngan pa bsgrub rung / bod mi bya ba ngan pa sgrub mkhan brtsi mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni bod mi bod mi gcig de ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ de bzhin bod mi kha shas glen pa yin rung / bod mi glen par brtsi mi rung ba 'di dag ni mtshan nyid rig pas brda sprad pa zhig red/ des bzang ngan bde sdug kun la rigs 'gre/dbyibs brgyad po gang rung yin na gzugs kyi skye mched kho na yin pas ma khyab pa'i rigs pa 'dis/ chos thams cad la khyad chos mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa go thub/ dngos gnas bshad na mkhas mi mkhas gnyis ni 'gal zla zhig yin rung / bkra shis mkhas pa yang yin la mi mkhas pa yang yin zer chog/ gang red zer na bkra shis ni 'jig rten la mkhas shing chos la mi 70

mkhas pa'i phyir/ der brten mtshan nyid rig pa rnams su/ btsan rgyal ring lugs rnams ni shog bu'i stag yin la stag ngo ma yang yin zhes pa'i gnad kyang 'di red/ dper na mi gcig la sems bzang zhing ngag 'jam pa/ 'jon thang che la 'brel ba bzang rung / gzugs ches btsog pa yang yod/ yang stobs dang 'jon nus med la sems gnag can la la gzugs bzang po lha 'dra ba yang yod do/ krong tsi gnam bskos las dbang zhes pa'i dpe deb nang du bkod pa ltar na/ mdzes ma zhi hri snying na nas lam du 'gro dus smin ma bsdus shing lag pas brang khar bcag bcag byas te 'gro ba'i tshe sgeg nyams che ru phyin pa red/ khyim mtshes bu mo mdog nyes po zhig yod pa des mthong nas ha cang mdzes po zhig red snyam ste mo yi lad zlos byas pas mdog de las kyang nyes bar gyur/ dper 'dis rigs gcig gi bud med gnyis la khyad chos mi 'dra ba yod pa mtshon thub/ der brten dbyibs brgyad po mig shes kyi gzung bya dang lus shes kyi reg bya gnyis yod pa bzhin/ chos gcig la yang khyad chos mang po yod pa red/ mtshan mo mun khrod na gnas pa'i bum pa 'ug pa'i mig shes kyis gzung bya bzhag pa 'dis 'ug pa'i mig shes la ltos te mun khrod na gnas pa'i bum pa ma yin pa zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan 'dis dbang rdul mi 'dra bas yul mthong tshul mi 'dra ba bstan te/ 'di la brten nas rigs drug gi snang tshul mi 'dra ba yang go thub/ de bzhin srog chags kha shas la me yang tsha zhing bsreg par mi snang / bya rma bya lta bu la dug kyang sgro mdangs rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur/ rmad byung gi mdzes ma ma'o chang dang li ci gnyis mi yi mig lam du yid 'ong zhig yin rung / nya yis de gnyis mthong bas skrag nas chu gting la 'dzul/ byi'us de gnyis mthong bas mtho sar lding / shwa bas de gnyis mthong bas mgyogs myur du bros/ 'o na yid 'ong gi dngos po 'dug gam zhes bshad pa 'di dag dbang bo mi 'dra bas snang tshul mi 'dra ba byung ba red/ der 71

brten mun pa zhes pa de yang yul dbang shes gsum tshogs lugs mi 'dra ba zhig las byung ba las/ mun pa ni 'di red ces 'jog rgyu ma rnyed/ de bzhin mdzes ma zhes pa de yang yul gyi steng na gtan gtan med pa'i yul dbang shes gsum tshogs lugs shig yin pa red/ 'di la mar le ring lugs pas bden don ltos bcas zer gyi yod/ 'on kyang bden don ni ltos bcas yin pas mthar thug gi bden don rnyed mkhan ni 'jig rten la yang med/ der brten 'ug pa'i mig gi yul gyi bden don dang / mi'i mig gi yul gyi bden don gnyis kyang mi 'dra ba byung / rigs lam 'dis dus rabs re la bden don re/ gang zag re la bden don re zer ba de la brda gsal po sprod pa ma zad/mar le ring lugs pas rbad de 'dra ba'i shing lo gnyis med zer ba de la yang brdagasal bo zhig sprad yod/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis kyang / phyogs re 'dra ba kun la yod/ thams cad 'dra ba gang na med gsungs pa'i rigs lam la yang nges shes skyes thub/ sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi kha dog la rtsod pa 'di ni grub mtha' gong 'og gi dbye ba phyes te bshad na 'di la rtsod pa mi 'dugaspyir grub mtha' gong ma rnams kyis sku gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'dod pa las grub mtha' 'og mas sku gsum 'jog gi med pas sangs rgyas kyi kha dog la dpyad pa'i dgos pa mi 'dugakha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab zer ba la/ thal 'gyur gyi sgo nas gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal kha dog yin pa'i phyir zhes dgag pa'i sbyor ngag 'di dag gis 'di yin na 'di yin pas khyab/ de yin na de yin pas khyab ces 'grig 'grig pa'i khyab pa 'jog mi rung ba bstan/ de yang yin te ri dwags me yi gtsang sbra can lta bu la me yang tsha zhing bsreg par mi snang ba bzhin/ srog chags 'ga' la chu yang brlan zhing gsher bar snang gi med/ der brten sngon byon mkhas pa'i 72

gsungs rnams su/ me ni grang ba 'gyur yang srid/ rlung ni zhags pas zin yang srid ces gsungs pa la rgyu mtshan chen po yod/ dper na bum pa'i mtshan nyid la lto ldir zhabs zhum chu skyor gyi don byed nus pa 'jog ste/ mtshan nyid de yin na mtshon bya bum pa de yin pas khyab ces da lta'i dus su bshad rung yang / dus nam zhig na bum pa ni de lta bu ma yin pa zhig kyang yong srid/ de bzhin da lta'i mtshan nyid dag gis mtshon bya mtshon stangs dang ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshon bya mtshon stangs gnyis kyang mi 'dra/ ma zad da lta rjes khyab grub pa'i rtags sbyor rnams nam zhig na 'gal khyab tu grub/ da lta'i 'gal khyab rnams phyis su rjes khyab tu grub thub pa zhig yin/ de ni dus rabs mi 'dra ba dang / spyi tshogs mi 'dra ba dang / khor yug mi 'dra ba bcas skad cig re re bzhin 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin can yin tsang khyab mtha' 'jog mi thub pa red/ deng gi dus su lha 'dra bo brtsi rgyu zhig yin rung nam zhig na 'dre 'dra bo zhig mthong srid/ a'e dbyin si than gyis/ nyi'u tun lags/khyod nas gsar gtod byas pa'i lam bu de khyod rang bzhugs pa'i dus skabs der cha bzhag na de ni lam bu nyag cig de red ces gsungs pa de ha cang yag po 'dug/ 'o na a'e dbyin si than gyis ltos bcas smra ba de rtser slebs tshar ba red dam zer na/ slebs yod pa ma red ces bshad pa 'di la de las kyang go rgyu che/ ma gzhi chu de brlan zhing gsher ba yin pa la de 'khol ba'i tshe tsha zhing bsreg par 'gyur ba dang / de rlangs par gyur te mkha' la 'khrigs nas slar yang chu ru 'gyur ba sogs kyi 'gyur ba de tsam zhig mang / ma zad dgun dus lhags pa che sar chu chab rom 'gyur ba dang / rlung lhags par 'gyur bzhin yod/ chu de yang rlung mi 'dra ba gnyis las grub pa tshan rig gis ra sprod byas pa red/ chu brlan zhing gsher ba yin pa chos nyid kyis grub pa'i rigs pa red zer nas bshad rung dngos gzugs la la dang 'phrad skabs chu de yang 73

brlan zhing gsher ba zhig red mi 'dug de bzhin chos gzhan dag yang 'dra/dngos gnas 'jig rten pas bshad tshul zhig la/ yul gzhan zhig na mar las grub pa'i mi yod cing / mar las grub pa'i mi rnams la sha las grub pa'i mi yod pa red zer nas bshad na/ kho tshos ya mtshan gyi gnas su brtsis te/sha rul ba dang 'bu zhugs pa sogs mi yong nas ga re zer gyi yod red/ sha las grub pa'i mis mar las grub pa'i mi de ya mtshan du rtsis te mar nyi mas mi zhu nas gang yin na bsam gyi yod pa red ces bshad pa 'dis mi mar las grub mkhan zhig yod med gang ltar yang / bshad srol 'dis chos 'di ni 'di 'dra red/ chos de ni de 'dra red ces kha tshon gcad mi thub pa zhig yin par bstan/ ma zad ma'o tse tung gis/ brtag dpyad zhib 'jug ma byed na/skad cha bshad pa'i dbang cha med zer ba'i gnad kyang 'di red/ nga tsho'i yul 'di ru bshad na dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi yi dbyar tsha zhing dgun grang ba zhig yin pa la/ rgyu mtshan de tsam zhig gis dbyar tsha zhing dgun grang zhes kha tshon bcad mi thub/ nga tshos mthong gsal rang la yang / lo rabs 'di'i dus rabs lnga bcu dang bdun cu sogs su skyes pho mo tshang mas dmag zhwa ser po dang dmag gos ser po rnams gon nas skyes pa tshos mgo steng gi skra min pa gzhan rnams breg pa sogs yag shos su brtsis/ de'i rjes dus rabs brgyad cur slebs mtshams dor ma'i mtha' kha chen mo(sko//yokhuṣ+ṭha) re dang 'jur rta phyi rting mthon po zhig gon nas skra thams cad gzengs gzengs byas pa de ni cha lugs mdzes por brtsis/ de rjes dus rabs dgu bcu ma slebs tsam la dor ma'i mtha' kha chung chung zhig 'jog dor kha chen po (7 neṣ+ṭha) byas pa dang stod thung yang mjug rug bzhag pa(r+sām)de gyon mkhan mang / deng sang dus rabs dgu bcu ba'i dus su dor ma dang stod thung mdog snum po tshong dpon rnams kyi gon pa 'dra mo de la mthong chen byed kyin yod/ de 'dra ba'i 74

dus thung ngu zhig gi nang du yang cha lugs la 'gyur ba de tsam zhig song yod na/chab srid dang dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang bsam blo bcas phyogs yong la 'gyur ba chen po phyin pa bshad ma dgos/bdag cag gi ston pas/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces pa la nges shes zab mo zhig slar yang skyes so/ nang pa dag gis chos thams cad la khyab mtha' 'jog mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni chos thams cad bden med yin pa ltos bcas kyi rten 'brel yin pas red gsungs/ mar le ring lugs pas kyang khyab mtha' 'jog gi med/ der brten rten 'brel gyi gnad la mkhas na mkhas pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gang gis rten cing 'brel ba shes pa des chos shes so/ gang gis chos shes pa des sangs rgyas shes so zhes gsungs so/kha cig na re kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab ces pa nas khyed gzhi grub pa'i phyir zhes pa'i bar gyi le tshan 'di'i nang / khyab pa khas zer ba 'di'i don ni kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab pa khas len song zhes pa'i don dang / rtsa bar 'dod na zhes pa ni/ rtsa ba'i thal 'gyur gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir zhes pa de yin la/ de la 'dod lan btab nas gser sbyangs btso ma'i kha dog dmar po yin par 'dod ces pa'i don no/ khyed khyed dang gcig yin dgos pa'i don bstan/ des gzhan la yang rigs 'gre yang gzugs yin na dbyibs dang kha dog gang rung yin pas khyab ces pa'i le tshan 'di'i nang / sgra de gzugs yin zhing dbyibs dang kha dog gang rung min pa zhig bstan pa las khyab pa khas zer ba dang rtsa bar 'dod na zer ba rnams sbyar stangs 'dra/ kha dog dkar po khyed yin pa gang zhig kha dog dmar po khyed yin na kha dog dkar dmar gnyis ka khyed yin pas khyab zer na zhes pa'i le tshan 'di'i nang / kha dog dkar po khyed yin par srid pa la/ kha dog de kha 75

dog dkar po yin zhing / chos dung dkar po'i kha dog de kha dog dkar po yin zhing / de bzhin du gzhi pad+ma rā ga'i kha dog de kha dog dmar po yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang kha dog dkar dmar gnyis ka khyed ma yin te/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis ka khyed yin pa med pa'i phyir/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis kyi yin pa yod na/ kha dog dkar po yang yin la dmar po yang yin pa zhig dgos pas de 'ang med pa'i phyir/ 'di las ni dkar po de dmar po ma yin zhing dmar po de dkar po ma yin pa bstan gyi/ gzhi gcig gi steng na dkar dmar gnyis yod chog pa zhig yin te/ gzhi ba glang lta bu gcig gi steng du yang kha dog dkar po'i cha dang kha dog dmar po'i cha gnyis ka yod pa ma zad/ kha dog dkar po de dkar po yin zhing kha dog dmar po de dmar po yin pa'i phyir/ le tshan 'dis bya sgang ni rdo sgang ma yin zhing / rdo sgang ni bya sgang ma yin pa ches 'gal ba yin pa go byed du 'gyur zhing / de bzhin 'byor ldan dang 'byor med bar gyi 'gal ba dang / spyi tshogs ring lugs dang ma rtsa ring lugs bar gyi 'gal ba dang / chos dang 'jig rten bar gyi 'gal ba/'phel rgyas song ba'i bsam blo dang rjes lus kyi bsam blo'i bar gyi 'gal ba bcas gcig yin na gcig ma yin zhing gzhi mthun mi srid pa'i 'gal ba zhig bstan yod la/ spyir tshig snyan snyan po dang don bcud yod yod 'dra bo ga tshad cig bshad rung / 'jig rten ni 'gal ba las grub pa zhig yin zhing /dper na mi yi lus rten la sbyar nas bshad/ mi yi gzugs phung ni sa chu me rlung gi khams bzhi las grub cing / sa khams ni sra ba dang / me khams ni tsha ba dang / chu khams ni brlan zhing / rlung khams ni yang pa bcas yin pas/sa chu me rlung gi khams rnam pa bzhis 'gal ba rgyun mi chad pa slong bzhin yod/khams rnam pa bzhi bo cha snyoms pa'i 'gal ba yod la/ cha mi snyoms pa'i 'gal ba'ang yod/ cha snyoms pa'i dus su khams bde ba zhig yin la/ cha mi 76

snyoms pa'i dus su khams mi bde ba zhig yin pas nad na tsha zer ba de skabs der byung ba zhig yin/ me rlung gi khams kyis sa khams stobs che ru mi gtang zhing / de bzhin gsum po yang 'dra/ dper na sa chu rlung gi khams stobs che zhing me khams nyams nas kho tsho la 'gal zla slong mi nus pa'i dus su me khams gso byed kyi sman gtang dgos pa bzhin no/ de bzhin phra phung dmar po dang (phre1a.oṃ) phra phung dkar po (dze+e.atsho) gnyis kyis mi yi gzugs grub pa red zer chog srog chags dkar dmar gnyis kyi bar du yang de bzhin 'gal ba rgyun mi chad pa zhig skyes nas gson por 'tsho bzhin yod/ gal te de'i 'gal ba rnams rgyun chad tshe shi zhes pa de byung ba red/ en ke sis/ tshe srog kyang dngos gzugs dang go rim de rang gi nang la gnas pa'i 'gal ba rgyun ma chad par rang shugs su skye pa dang / rang shugs kyis thag gcod pa zhig red/'gal ba de mtshams chad ma thag tshe srog kyang mtshams chad pas shi 'gro ba red ces bshad/ dper na glog ces pa de yang glog rdul mi 'dra ba gnyis 'gal ba rgyun ma chad pa skyes pa las byung / gal te glog rdul gnyis kyi 'gal ba mtshams chad skabs glog kyang chad pa red/ der brten phyi snod 'jig rten dang nang bcud 'jig rten gnyis ka 'gal ba las grub cing 'gal ba med na 'jig rten med pa red/ gna' dang deng gi rtsom rig mi 'dra ba glegs bam gyi phung bo byas pa'i rtsom pa po grags can gyi mi sna rnams de 'dra rtsom rig gi blo sgo 'byed byed ni spyi tshogs dang rang byung bcas kyi 'gal ba'i rnyog 'dzing las byung ba red/ rgya nag gi rtsom pa po lu'u zhun (lja 7) dang hung yis ta hri(byeshā—rkisgo/ ) dang bod kyi mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel dang don 'grub rgyal bcas la yang spyi tshogs dang khor yug lo rgyus dang dus rabs kyi 'gal ba des rnon po'i mtshon la ngar blud pa bzhin bsam gzhig sna tshogs shig ster nas/ thol byung bden tshig gi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyur te mdun skyod kyi gom 77

pa ldog med du spos te/ phyir snur rkang mthil gang yang ma shor zhing bden pa'i lam nas gshegs pa zhig red/ dus rabs gsar rnying dang spyi tshogs gsar rnying / lo rgyus gsar rnying dang bya dngos gsar rnying thams cad 'gal bas gtan 'khel byas pa red/ dngos po skad cig dang po de dngos po skad cig gnyis pas rnying bar bsgyur/ skad cig gnyis pa de skad cig ma gsum pas rnying par bsgyur te 'gal ba rgyun chad med pa zhig slong bzhin yod/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang rgyal khab dar rgyas/ mi rigs kyi mdun lam dang /ldog med kyi lo rgyus dang / spyi sger gyi bde sdug dang / mthar go la rdul phra rab tu gyur pa mtha' dag 'gal bas gtan 'khel byed cing 'gal bas thag gcod pa red/ rlabs chen gyi mi dang shes ldan gyi mi sna/ stobs ldan gyi dpa' bo dang / thob can gyi dpon po yid 'ong gi mdzes ldan ma kun kyang 'gal bas grub pa'i rang gzugs shig red zer na yang thal mi che ba yin/der brten bsdus gzhung rnams su/ tha dad gang zhig gzhi mthun mi srid pa de 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid gsungs pas/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis kyang yin pa mi srid pa'i 'gal bar bzhag pa bzhin chos thams cad kyang ra ba de las ma 'das pa zhig yin/ skabs 'dir rnams dpyod can gyi mkhas pa 'gas kha dog dkar dmar gnyis 'gal ba min te phan tshun gnod bya gnod byed min pa gang zhig 'gal ba yin na gnod bya gnod byed yin dgos pa'i phyir zer na/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis kyi bar du yangaganod bya gnod byed grub te/gos dkar can gyi tshong dpon dang / gos dmar can gyi tshong dpon gyi bar du gtam lab lugs dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur bcas gang zag thad nas 'gal ba yod par ma zad/ kha dog mi 'dra ba'i gos gnyis kyis kyang phan tshun 'gran zhing rang tshugs 'dzin zhing rang gi ngo bo mi gtong ba zhig yin/de bzhin kha dog dmar po la kha dog dkar po zil gyis gnon pa'i nus pa 78

yod de/ rgyu dang dbyibs gcig las grub pa'i gos dmar gos dkar gnyis tshong khrom du bshams rjes gos dkar tshong 'a/ 'grim na gos dmar zil gyis mnon pa'i rtags dang / gos dmar tshong 'grim che na gos dkar zil gyis mnan pa'i rtags red/ de bzhin dbyar dus kyi spang ljang gi kha dog des dgun dus yul lung skya bo'i kha dog la mi 'dod pa'i skul slong yang sprad thub kyin yod/ ma zad nang rig gi gzhung rnams su/ kha dog zil gnon zhes rnal 'byor pas nang du sngo ser dkar dmar bzhi bsgoms nas phyi rol gyi kha dog rnams zil gyis gnon pa lta bu red/ yang khos kha dog dkar dmar ni bem po yin phyir 'gal mi shes zer na/ 'o na me chu gnyis kyang 'gal mi shes te/ de gnyis bem po yin phyir ro/ / kha dog dkar dmar gnyis mnyam du bsres na kha dog dkar po shugs che na dkar skya ru'agyur zhing / kha dog dmar po shugs che na dmar skya ru 'gyur bzhin yod pas kyang gcig gis gcig la gnod kyin yod pa go ste/ me chu gnyis lhan cig tu 'phrad na/ me stobs che na chu skam pa dang / chu stobs che na me gsad pa bozhin no/ sngon nga rang lo bco lnga lon skabs bod mi rgan po zhig gis/ ya gi'i gangs ri de zhu ba'i tshe srid pa 'di 'jig nges yin zhes lab byung / ngas bsam par gangs zhu na srid pa 'jig dgos pa'i 'brel ba gang yang med ci 'dra'i glen pa bsam nas snying khog pa'i dkyil nas 'phya dgod shor ba zhig byung rung / kho la snying rje ba ltar ya ya zhes lan sprad bzhin nga ni kho las kyang ldab log gi mkhas snyam yang / rgan po'i skad cha 'di gtan tshigs rigs pa chen po zhig yin par ma zad/ phran ni kho bo las kyang ldab log gis blun po zhig yin pa ngas da lta shes byung / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'di yang sa chu me rlung gis grub cing / gcig gis gcig stobs che ru mi gtong zhing / cha snyoms na srid pa gnas thub/gal te me stobs che nas gangs ri zhu ba'i drod tshad la slebs na srid pa me yis 79

'jig pa'i 'go brtsams pa red/ rgan po'i skad cha'i don snying ni 'di yin 'dug deng gi dus su yang srid pa me yi phung bor 'gyur ba'i sngon brda la chu dkon pa dang shing bskam pa sogs yong pa'i gnas tshul gsar 'gyur las brda 'phrad cing / 'di'i don la tshan rig pa mang pos sems khral yang gnang bzhin yod/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ 'gal ba don gyi steng na ma grub pa'i blo yi chos yin par 'dod de/ rig gter las/ 'brel ba bzhin du 'gal ba yang / dngos po'i don la grub pa med/ rnam par rtog pas sgro btags nas/'gal ba nyid du rnam par gzhag ces gnod bya yod pa na gnod byed med/gnod byed skyes pa'i tshe gnod bya 'gags shing / dus mnyam pa'i tsha reg grang reg ni gnod bya gnod byed ma yin pas 'gal ba ma yin gsungs pa'i rigs pa 'dis yul gyi steng na 'gal 'brel yan ga ba yod pa bkag pa ma zad/gnas lugs steng nas brtag cing dpyod na 'gal ba zhes bya ba zhig ma grub pa bstan pas dam chos dbu mar 'jug pa'i sgo byed pa red/ 'gal ba'i mtshan nyid la gnod bya gnod byed 'jog pa ni gcig mthun yin te/ de yang rig gter las chos gang gang la gnod byed pa/ de ni de la 'gal zla yin gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i rig pa'i dpyod pa ni tha snyad 'jig rten pa'i tshad las brgal ba zhig yin snyam/ 'di ltar byas tshe mthar gzung 'dzin gnyis bral stong nyid kyi gnas su slebs pa 'dra/ der brten khong gis dam chos dbu mar 'jug byed kyi tshad ma gsungs pa yin gyi/ 'jig rten phyogs kyi tshad ma'i 'gro lugs ni kha dog dkar dmar gnyis 'gal ba yin par ma zad 'gal ba grub pa de ni chos de gnyis gzhi grub byed kyi rtsa ba zhig yin/ gal te kha dog dkar po las gzhan pa'i kha dog gang yang med na/ 'gal ba yang grub byed med la kha dog dkar po zhes pa zhig mi srid pa zhig red/ der brten kha dog dkar dmar gnyis kyi yin pa med la/ kha dog dkar dmar gnyis yod dgos pa 80

'di u tshugs dang bcos sgyur byas pa ma yin la byas kyang phan med kyi ngal ba tsam du ma zad/ de bzhin chos dang 'jig rten bzang ngan dang bde sdug kun kyang de dang 'dra ba zhig yin/ deng sang gang zag 'gas nam zhig na 'jig rten dar rgyas song song ba'i mthar chos kyi bstan pa rtsa med 'gro rgyu'i gtan 'beb byed kyin yod pa red/ de ni rten 'brel la rgol phod pa'i dpa' bo g.yag rgod kyi rjes su 'brangs ba zhig yin/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis kyi 'gal ba stobs che ru song na de tsam gyis chos dang 'jig rten mnyam du gnas thub kyi yod pa red/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis mun pa ci tsam gyis gnag na sgron me de tsam gyis gsal gsungs pa dang / de bzhin 'jig rten pas kyang / chos kyang zab na nag pori bdud kyang zab ces tshad ma'i gnad phig pa'i skad cha bshad rgyu snang / yang la las ngan pa mi 'dod cing bzang bo kho na re sgug byed bzhin yod/ don du bzang bo yang rtsa med gtong ba dang sgo kun nas mtshungs/ de gang red zer na ngan pa med na bzang po ga na yod/ bzang ngan gnyis ni ltos grub red/ skye shi gnyis kyang shi ba yod tsang skye ba yod kyi shi ba med na skye ba gang na yod/ dgra gnyen gnyis la cha mtshon nas bshad na dgra ci tsam mang na gnyen de tsam gyis mang / dgra med na gnyen gang na yod/ dgra med na gnyen gyi dgos pa med phyir ro/ rku mi byed mkhan de mi bzang po ru mthong bar byed pa la rku byed mkhan zhig sngon 'gro dgos pa dang rku byed mkhan de ngan par mthong ba la rku mi byed mkhan de sngon du nges dgos/ gang ltar yang 'di dag ni ltos grub yin pas phan tshun mdung khyim ltar brten pa zhig red/ gal te mi'i 'dod pa lta bur grub thub pa zhig yin na 'dod rgyu ni bzang bo dang drang po/ mkhas pa dang ya rabs yin la de'i ldog phyogs rnams mi 'dod pas sa'i khyon la bzang phyogs kyis 'gengs thub pa zhig yin dgos/ de ltar ma yin pa mngon sum gyis grub pa 81

zhig go/ der brten da lta'i 'jig rten 'di ni 'gal bas grub pa'i 'jig rten red/ dam pa gong mas dngos rgyu tshogs pa gcig la rag las kyi 'brel ba grub pa gsungs ba dang / de'i rtags sbyor la kha nang bu ram gong bu'i steng na chos can/ bu ro snga mas bu gzugs da lta bskyed pa'i nus pa yod de/ bu ro da lta ba yod pa'i phyir zhes bu ro dang bu gzugs gnyis kyi dngos rgyu tshogs pa gcig ste/ bu ro'i dngos rgyu bu gzugs yin pa dang / bu gzugs kyi dngos rgyu bu ro yin zhing de gnyis ka tshogs pa gcig dang / bu ro yod med kyi rag las sa ni bu gzugs yin zhing / bu gzugs yod med kyi rag las sa ni bu ro yin/ de ltar rag las kyi 'brel ba grub rung 'gal ba ni yin te/ ro lce shes kyi myong bya yin zhing / gzugs mig shes kyis gzung bya yin pa bzhin chos thams cad kyi 'gal 'brel ni de ltar grub pa red/ bod kyi dper la ri la ri dwags med na/ sgo na g.yung dwags med zer ba 'di yang 'gal 'brel dang mthun pa'i gtam du snang / khyad par du skabs 'dir thon dus/ shes bya'i chos thams cad 'gal 'brel gyis grub pas/ ngas 'od phung 'di la khyad par du 'gal 'brel sna mang yod snyam pa zhig 'dug de gang yin zer na/ 'od kyis snang ba byed pa dang drod ster ba/ skye dngos rnams smin par byed pa dang /nad bcos pa dang brnyan 'phrin gtong ba sogs byed pa shin tu mang / deng sang rgyal phyi nang gang gi lo rgyus dang brnyan 'phrin gang yin rung / de rnams su rtsa rlung gi stobs kyis 'od 'phros nas na tsha sogs bcos pa dang / sman khang chen mo rnams su (lko) 'od mi 'dra bas nad mi 'dra ba bcos pa dang /'od kyis 'dod rgu stsol ba dang / mi 'od phung du 'gyur ba dang / 'od phung lha 'dre mi sogs su 'gyur tshul sogs shin tu mang / 'di la bltas na sngon byon mkhas dbang dam pa'i cho ga rnams su/ dper na bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dkar dmar thing gsum 'phros/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog pas 82

sgrib gsum dag sku gsum mngon du gyur nga/ sgom pa 'di rnams kyi skabs su yang / 'od zer rdul grub sgom mi rung yang / ye shes 'od kyis byed las ni yin no/ de bzhin bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'od du zhu ba dang / 'od de yang rang la 'thim pas rang nyid dang bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbyer med du sgom pa dang /gzhan yang 'od kyis sna drangs nas 'gro ba 'dren pa dang / 'od zer chen mo'i dbang skur ba sogs 'di rnams ches 'dra bo 'dug pas ngas 'od mi 'dra ba mang pos bya byed mi 'dra ba mang bo byed par ma zad/ mi yi srog 'tsho ba dang gsal rig gi shes pa 'di dag la yang 'od gang zhig dang 'brel ba chen po zhig yod snang bag chags shig bcos min gyis 'dug pas/ rnam dpyod can rnams kyis gom gang mdun spos kyi tshul du dpyad par 'tshal/ yang khyod kyi yin pa yod na gang dran dran yin pas khyab pa'i phyir zhes pa ni kha dog dkar dmar gnyis kyi yin pa yod na gang dran de yin pas khyab 'gro ba'i don yin/gal te gang dran na de yin tshe lha 'dre gnyis yin par bsam na lha 'dre gnyis yin pa yod dgos pa dang mkhas pa yin pa dang phyug po yin pa dang / dpa' bo yin pa dang / dpon po yin pa bcas gang bsam na de yin dgos pa zhig yin/ de ltar yin pa med de/ mkhas pa ni/ ji skad du/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byed na/ 'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/ de ltar bas na gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes gzung dang /bdag nyid kun mkhyen bya phyir de la de brtson bya gsungs pa dang / ma bslab pa la kun mkhyen nyid/ 'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden zhes pa sogs kyis mkhas pa yin bsam pa tsam gyis mi chog pa brtson dgos pa bstan/ de bzhin phyug po dang dpa' bo dpon po bcas kyang 'gal ba dang rnyog 'dzing / dka' spyad dang sdug rus mang bo byas pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin pas/ stong bsam gyis nyi ma 'phur ba ni rmi lam rmis pa bzhin no/ lag len thog nas ra sprad med 83

pa'i 'gro sems gtsang mas glog gi zlos gar 'khrab pa ni don la thob tu med pa'i stong bsam gyis 'khor lo skor ba red/ bod kyi dper la yang bsam rgyu sram lpags 'grub rgyu be'u lpags zer ba de dang kun nas mtshungs/ dper na mi gcig gis gad snyigs nas gser gyi gdu bu zhig lan gcig stes dbang gis rnyed nas phyis su las gzhan gang yang mi byed par rtag par gad snyigs slog nas gser rnyed par re sgug byed na mthar mu ge'i lam du zhugs pa las ci yang med/ de bzhin nga ni lha yin la mkhas pa yin/ nga ni grub thob yin la rtogs ldan yin/ nga ni 'dzam gling na rtse mo yin la phul byung yin/ 'jon thang can yin la gtsang ma yin snyam pa tsam gyis de ltar mi 'gyur zhing don du log rtog tu 'gyur bzhin yod pas/ rang mthong mi che zhing rdzig gtam gyi 'khor lo mi bskor nas bya ba la gzob pa lhur len gyi sgo nas 'bad na mdzes so/yang kha dog yin na sbyar byung gi kha dog yin pas khyab zer na zhes pa'i le tshan nang du gur gum dang gur gum gyi kha dog gnyis grub bde rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir zhes gur gum dang gur gum gyi kha dog gnyis skye 'jig gnas gsum dus mnyam par bstan/ bum pa dang bum pa'i byas pa'i byas pa gnyis kyang grub bde rdzas gcig yin no/ grub bde rdzas gcig zhes pa ni skye 'gag gnas gsum dus mnyam yin par ma zad rdzas gcig kyang yin dgos/ de bzhin za ma'i ro dang za ma gnyis kyang grub bde rdzas gcig des ni za ma'i ro myong bar 'dod na za ma dgos kyi yod pa bstan te/ za ma med na za ma'i ro gang na yod/ mi dang mi'i skye gnas rga 'jig bzhi yang de bzhin yin la chos nyid 'di ldog ste skye gnas gnyis las rga 'jig gnyis mi dgos pa'i thabs shig 'dzam gling na rnyed mkhan zhig yod na rin thang de las che dang / rlabs de las che su zhig yod/ 'on kyang dpa' bo'i dpung la 'jigs mi shes shing /84

dpon po'i thob la mi brtsi ba dang / mdzes ma'i gzugs dang zhim pa'i zas sogs gang gis kyang bslu brid bya mi gtub pa gzhung drang ba ngo mnyam pa ni skye gnas rga 'jig bzhi yin/ 'di la thug dus 'khor sgyur gyi rgyal po la yang thabs bkod pa med/ de bzhin phyi snod 'jig rten dang nang bcud sems can mtha' dag kyang skye gnas rga 'jig ba'i'i ra ba las 'da' mi thub pa zhig yin/ da lta mig sngar dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu rmol khab yin na'ang 'dra mi rigs yin na'ang 'dra/ kun kyang de bzhis bsdus te yod/ tshad ma'i mkhan po ye shes dar rgyas kyis/ me tog ga tshod cig bkra na de tsam gyis 'jig la nye gsungs pa 'di yang gnad 'di la dgongs pa yin/ rgyal khab dang rgyal khab kyi lam lugs gnyis kyang grub rdzas gcig yin te/ rgyal khab kyi lam lugs med na rgyal khab gang na yod rgyal khab med na yang rgyal khab kyi lam lugs gang na yod/ spyir rgyal khab ces pa de yang mi yi dgos mkho la gzhigs nas 'dzugs pa yin gyi rgyal khab ngo bos grub nga/ zhig med/ der brten mar le ring lugs pas kyang rgyal khab ni dbang sgyur byed kyi thabs su gyur pa zhig yin par bshad/ de brten tshogs pa zhig gis 'a/ma lugs shig byas pas rgyal khab byung ba red/ khyim tshang dang khyim tshang gi lam lugs/ dgon pa dang dgon pa'i lam lugs/ 'brog pa dang 'brog pa'i lam lugs/ zhing ba dang zhing pa'i lam lugs/ de kun kyang grub bde rdzaru/ gcig yin pas 'brog pa'i lam lugs med na 'brog pa med/ mi dang mi yin pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / 'dre dang 'dre yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bcas kyang grub bde rdzas gcig tu 'jog chog de bzhin chos gzhan la yang rigs 'gre ste sbyar shes par bya/ grub bde gcig ni grub bde rdzas gcig dang mi 'dra zhing skye gnas 'jig gsum dus mnyam gyi 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pa las rdzas gcig yin mi dgos/ dper na/bum pa'i tshogs pa na yod pa'i sa chu me rlung bzhi lta bu/ 'di rnams rdzas 85

gcig ma yin rung skye gnas 'jig gsum dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ de bzhin mtha' med kyi 'jig rten 'di yang stes dbang dang stabs bde'i sgo nas byung ba ma yin pa/ yongs khyab kyi 'brel ba grub pas gong bu zhig chags pa red/sa'i go la dang go la'i nang gi gter rdzas dang phyi yi skye dngos bar la grub bde gcig pa'i 'brel ba chags yod/ de brten nang gi gter dang phyi yi skye dngos mtha' dag longs su spyod de mjug rdzogs dus go la yang mjug rdzogs pa'i dus la slebs tshar/ de dus mi rabs 'dis rang gzhog na rang phra ba dang /rang bcad na rang thung bas rang nyid kyang gtor brlag shor ba zhig yin/'brong bu'i sna tshomos gangs ri'i khrod kyi bsam gzhigs las/ ngas bltas na dpal 'byor gong spel du brtson drag pa'am 'jig rten gyi snang ba la zhib 'jug byed drag pa des rang byung khams kyi dngos rdzas rnams mi yi rigs kyi 'tsho ba je legs su gtong ched bed spyod kyis rdzogs par byas te mi mjed zhing 'di myur bar rdul bzhin brlags pa la sta gon byed kyi yod pa dang / mi rigs 'tsho gnas byed pa'i dus tshod kyang je nyung je nyung du 'phris 'dug la/da ltar sa sgang zlum po'i steng gi ming grags can gyi grong khyer rnams su rang byung bkod pa rnams dpal 'byor gong spel gyis bcom ste ri lung dang chu gtsang mo'i tshab tu mis bzos snang ba tsam gyis blo tshims pa byas/ dbyig 'dzin ma'i bcud rnams rlangs 'khor sogs bkol spyod kyi slad du bton/rkyen des 'byung bo 'dzin ma snum bag dang bral nas rang bzhin gyis bskams/chu'i khams kyang zad tshar nas da lta sdong 'dzugs nags skrun byed pa dang grong khyer kun tu chu dkon 'byung bzhin pa gang 'di'i snga ltas yin par nges mi rnams kyis rang bzos byis pa'i chu bed spyad de lo mang bskyal/ de yang rim bzhin rdzas kyis stong ste 'dzad pa na/ 'jig rten stong pa'i mtha' la slebs pa dang dper na mi'i lus la chu'i 'byung khams rgyugs ma che bas tsha ba rgyas pa 86

bzhin 'jig rten 'di yang rlan gsher gyi 'byung ba dang bral bas me'i khams kun nas 'phel/ nyin byed kyi snang ba 'gog med du 'phros te me'i khams dang bsdebs nas 'khrugs cing 'jig rten thams cad mes bsregs/ de nas rlung khams de nas sa'i khams su byas te rdzas kyi mthar thug rgyud slar yang 'jig rten gsar pa zhig chags 'grub la 'gyur 'go rtsom bar byed do/ zhes pa 'di'i gnad kyang grub bde gcig pa'i gtan tshig gis ra sprad pa yin/ 'o na 'di la bshol du yod dam snyam na/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin rnams la yang bkod pa med la ston pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang thabanu mi rnyed/ grub bde dbyer med rdzas gcig ni/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dus mnyam pa yang yin/ cig shos snang ba mngon gsum la gcig shos kyang snang dgos pa de de'i don yin/dper na ljon shing ljon shing gi dbyibs dang kha dog lta bu/ ljon shing mthong dus cig shos ljon shing gi dbyibs dang kha ngo/ga rnams kyang mthong ba yin/ de bzhin bod mi mthong dus bod mi'i khyad chos rnams kyang mthong ba yin/ phyi rgyal ba mthong dus phyi rgyal ba'i khyad chos mthong gi yod/ de bzhin gzhan la yang rigs 'gre/ spyir chos thams cad la rang nyid grub byed kyi grub cha yod pas rang nyid ji bzhin mthong thos dang blo'i yul du gyur dus de'i grub cha de yang nges kyi yod pa zhig yin/ der brten chos dang 'jig rten chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ spyi tshogs ring lugs dang ma rtsa ring lugs/ 'khor 'das gnyis bcas chos so so la grub cha mi 'dra ba yod tsang grub tshul ches mi 'dra ba re byung / grub tshul de blo'i yul du gyur skabs grub cha yang de'i yul du gyur dgos te/ grub bde dbyer med kyi rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/ lhan skyes kyi kha dog 'chad skabs su gur gum dang gur gum gyi kha dog lhan skyes kyi kha dog tu 'jog pa bzhin du 'gal 'brel de yang 'gal bya dang 'gal byed/ 'brel bya dang 'brel byed bcas rigs 'gre ste chos gzhan lhan skyes su bsdu dgos pa 87
