mang tsam zhig mthong ste/ dper na bya dang sgo nga gang sngar sems can dang sangs rgyas su sngar zhes gna' nas da bar du dus yin ring ba dang / skya ser pho mo kun gyis rtsod kyang gtan 'khel ba'i blo gtod sa ma rnyed/ gal te 'di rnams kyang dge sdig gnyis dang bzang ngan gnyis/ bstod smad gnyis bcas cig shos skyes dus cig shos skyes pa bzhin lhan skyes zhes 'jog na thal mi che ba zhig e yin na/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ kun la phan pa'i ngo mtshar rdzas 'phrul dang / yongs la gnod pa'i ltas ngan cho 'phrul gnyis/ shes rab ral gri'i rno phyogs re re'i sne/ gcig gi zla la gcig kyang slebs par nges zhes pa 'di yang mtshan nyid rig pa'i sdom tshig cig snang /gcig las gnyis su gyes pa'i lta ba zhes pa yang 'di tsam la dgongs pa lags/der brten nang don gyi gzhung rnams las sdug bsngal ni bzang ngan gnyis las ngan par brtsis kyang sdug bsngal la yon tan dang bzang cha ni yod de/zhi ba lhas/ skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed sogs skyo ba'i yon tan mang po gsungs/ bde ba ni bzang bo dang yon tan du brtsis kyang skyon che ste lha mi khom pa'i gnas su 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang lha bde ba la g.yeng ste chos bsgrub pa la khom po byung med pa red/dus rabs kyi dgos mkho la gzhigs pa'i bcos sgyur sgo 'byed byas pas chab srid dang dpal 'byor dmag don rig gnas bcas phyogs yongs nas dar rgyas cher phyin na yang / de dang chabs cig tu g.yo sgyu'i dran 'phrul je mang dang / skrag dgos pa'i bya ba mang po yang lhan cig tu skyes kyi yod/gzan dmar po'i kha dog ni lhan skyes kyi kha dog ma yin zhing bcas ldan dge slong sogs kyi rtags su gzan la tshos dmar po byug pa zhig yin/ 'di lta bu'i sbyar byung gi kha dog rnams spyi tshogs dang chab srid dmag don sogs kyi dgos pa mang po zhig la bsten nas sbyar byung gi kha dog mang po bzos/88

dper na krung go'i dmag gos ser po dang dmag rtags dmar po sogs rgyal khab so so'i rtags mi 'dra ba'i sbyar byung gi kha dog mang bo byas/ de bzhin dus rabs kyi 'gros las gdong la dkar dmar nag gsum sogs kyi kha dog sbyar te mdzes chos su brtsi ba mang / gzhan rnams go sla/ gnyis pa gzhi grub kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa la gnyis/ rnam gzhag bshad pa dang / khyab skor 'god pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ mtshan nyid dang dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/tshad mas grub pa gzhi grub kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi grub/ yod pa/ shes bya/gzhal bya rnams don gcig/ tshad mas dmigs pa yod pa'i mtshan nyid tshad mas rtogs par bya ba gzhal bya'i mtshan nyid/ blo'i yul du bya rung ba shes bya'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa gzhi grub la dbye na rtag pa dang dngos po gnyis/ dang po ni chos dang skad cig ma ma yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa de rtag pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ yin pa srid pa'i rtag pa dang / yin pa mi srid pa'i rtag pa gnyis/ yin pa srid pa'i rtag pa bzhag du yod de/shes bya de de yin pa'i phyir/ yin pa mi srid pa'i rtag pa bzhag tu yod de/rtag dngos gnyis de yin pa'i phyir/ don byed nus pa dngos po'i mtshan nyid/dngos po la dbye na bem shes ldan mi 'du byed gsum/ rdul du grub pa bem po'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na phyi'i bem po dang / nang gi bem po gnyis/skyes bu'i rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i rdul du grub pa de phyi'i bem po'i mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi ni/ bum pa/ ka ba/ sa chu me rlung sogs lta bu/ skyes bu rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i rdul du grub pa de nang gi bem po'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo lta bu/ gsal zhing rig pa shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi mig shes lta bu/ bem shes gang rung ma yin pa'i 'du byed ldan min 'du byed kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ dngos bo dang / mi rtag pa dang / rta dang / ba glang sogs gang zag rnams de yin/ yang gzhi grub la 89

dbye na/ gcig dang tha dad gnyis yod so so ba ma yin pa'i chos de gcig gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni shes bya/ rtag pa/ dngos po rnams re re nas de yin/ so so ba'i chos de tha dad kyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni/ rtag dngos gnyis/ mtshan mtshon gnyis/ ka bum gnyis lta bu rnams de yin/ yang shes bya la dbye na/ rang mtshan spyi mtshan gnyis/ sgra rtog gi btags tsam ma yin par rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i chos de rang mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ sgra rtog gis btags pa tsam yin gyi rang mtshan du ma grub pa de spyi mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du/ don dam par don byed nus pa'i chos de don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ don dam par don byed mi nus pa'i chos de kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rtag pa spyi mtshan kun rdzob bden pa rnams don gcig gzhal bya la dbye na/ mngon gyur dang lkog gyur gnyis/ mngon sum gyi tshad mas dngos su rtogs par bya ba mngon gyur gyi mtshan nyid/gsal bshad bzhi pa/tshad mas grub pa gzhi grub kyi mtshan nyid ces pas gzhi grub dang ma grub ni tshad mas grub ma grub la lta dgos/ tshad ma zhes pa log rtogs kun dang bral ba'i blo yang dag zhig la 'dod/ de lta bu'i blo ngor grub na gzhi grub cing yod par 'jog dgos/ tshad ma de ni phyi rol yul gyi bden don gnas lugs dngos shes mkhan zhig yin/ de'i ngor grub pa'i chos de gzhi grub pa zhig yin phyin chad/ gzhi grub de ni dpa' bo'i dpung gis bshig mi thub la/ btsan po'i dbang gis bzlog mi nus/ mthon po'i thob kyis kyang ci byar med/ gal te phyi rol yul gyi gzhi grub dang mi mthun pa'i blo zhig yin na blo de log rtog gi blo zhig tu 'jog dgos/ log rtog gi blo can la mthar thug ste bshad na khe ka med la pham kha kho na yod par bshad/ der brten gzhi grub zer ba 'di mar 90

le ring lugs ltar na bden don zer ba de dang gcig red/ mar le ring lugs pa'i bden don ni phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos dang de'i chos nyid yang dag pa mtshon pa de la zer/ nga tsho bod kyi tshad ma'i gzhung du yang gzhi grub kyi mtshan nyid la tshad mas grub pa de 'jog spyer gzhi grub kyi rnam gzhag 'di 'jog dka' ba zhig snang ste/ bzang ngan/ yod med/ yin min sogs shes bya mtha' yas pa zhig 'dug pa la/ bzang bo yin na bzang bo gzhi grub dgos/ gzhi ma grub pa'i bzang po zhig med/ de bzhin chos gzhan dag la yang rigs 'gre bzang po dang ngan pa sogs ni spyi tshogs dang 'jig rten gyi 'khor phyogs sam dus kyi 'gros las byung ba zhig red/ dus kyi 'gros dang mi mang gi 'khor phyogs cha rkyen nges can zhig gi 'og nas gang zag 'ga' la bzang po snang ba de/ gang zag 'ga' la ngan par snang / gang zag 'ga' la ngan par snang ba de/ gang zag 'ga' la bzang por snang / dper na mi gtsang ba de phag dang 'phrad na gtsang bar snang / mi dang 'phrad na btsog par snang / chos gcig la snang tshul gnyis byung ba dang / snang tshul gnyis ka bden don nam gzhi grub pa khas len dgos/ de bzhin mi la ras pas ser ba phab pa des a khu dang a ne la mi dga' zhig byas kyang / khong gi ma myong tsha dkar rgyan la dga' bde skye ba bzhin no/ de ni de gnyis la rkyen mi 'dra ba'i stobs kyis tshor ba gnyis su gyur pa red/ nyi ma tsha ba de yang bzang ngan gang yin kha tshon bcad dka' ste/ dro ba 'dod pa'i gang zag la bzang bo zhig tu snang na yang / grang ba 'dod pa'i gang zag la ngan par snang srid do/ cig shos ngor bzang po gzhi grub la/ cig shos ngor ngan pa gzhi grub pa'i phyir/chos nyid dang mi mthun zhes pa la yang sa tshod nges can zhig yod/ dper na bod rigs la cha mtshon nas bshad na rlangs 'khor bzo thub pa byung na gzi brjid yin pa bshad ci dgos/ lcags rta zhig bzo thub pa byung na yang gzi 91

brjid cig red/ 'on kyang phyi gling gi sngon thon mi rigs shig la cha mtshon nas bshad na lcags rta dang rlang 'khor phar zhog gnam gru dang mtsho gru bzo ba sogs kyang rlabs chen gyi las su brtsi mi rung / 'di gnyis kyi spyi tshogs dar rgyas gtong ba'i tshod gzhi mi 'dra bas tshod mi 'dra ba gnyis byung / gnyis ka yang chos nyid kyis grub pa khas len dgos/ der brten chos nyid kyis grub pa'am gzhi grub kun kyang ltos 'jog gam rten 'brel yin pa ni bshad ci dgos/ bden don nam tshad mas grub pa'i chos la 'bad par byas nas 'bras bu thob dgos pa ni shar nub kyi gling dang rgya bod kun kyang 'dod tshul gcig pa red/ 'on kyang tshad grub dang bden don zer ba de las la 'bad tshe 'grub thub pa'i rang bzhin zhig la 'bad pa dang / chos nyid dang mthun pa'i blo zhig yin dgos/ chos nyid dang mthun pa'i blo ni dbang yod la yod pas ma khyab cing / 'byor ldan la yang yod pas ma khyab la/ dpa' bo la yang yod pas ma khyab/ tshad ma su la yod na chos nyid dang mthun pa'i blo de la yod cing / de'i ngor grub pa de yang tshad grub yin par ma zad/ mthar thug mi yi lam phyogs der 'gro rgyu gtan 'khel gyi yod pa red/ spyir 'jig rten gyi chos nyid kun po gzhi grub pa zhig yin te/ tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ 'das pa'i dus dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus dang da lta ba'i dus bcas kyi dngos po rnams ni gzhi grub pa yin te/ rang dus der gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ dper na/ 'das pa'i dus kyi rgyal khab kyi dar rgud dang mi rigs kyi skyid sdug sogs gzhi grub pa yin te dus der grub pa'i phyir/ de bzhin ma 'ongs par 'byung 'gyur gyi bya dngos mtha' dag kyang gzhi grub pa yin te dus der grub pa'i phyir/ ri bong gi rwa dang mo gsham gyi bu la ma 'ongs pa bzhag mi rung ste/ gtan med yin pas gzhi grub pa'i dus med pa'i phyir/ 'byung 'gyur dang ma 'ongs pa rnams ni yong nges kyi rang bzhin zhig yin dgos te/ dper na rtsi shing la me 92

tog bzhad nas 'bras bu smin pa dang / mi la skye rga na 'chi yod pa sogs tshang ma yong nges kyi rang bzhin red/ de bzhin gtan med rnams la 'das pa yang 'jog tu med/ mkhas pa 'gas ri bong rwa shes bya ma yin zhing bdag med yin pas bdag med kyi bye brag shes bya bzhag dgos zhes bshad kyang / ri bong rwa gzhi ma grub pa la de bdag med yin/ min gyi dpyad pa btang ba ni ches ya mtshan pa red/ dbu ma rgyan las/ ma ning gzugs bzang mi bzang zhes/don 'dod brtag pas ci zhig bya gsungs/ pas/ ri bong rwa gtan med de bdag med yin min dpyad pa ni/ 'khrig pa'i bya byed mi nus pa'i ma ning 'di gzugs bzang ngam ngan zhes brtag dpyad bya ba dang gcig tu snang /93

dam chos kyi che ba 'ga' bshad pa kun dga'i gtam gyi rol mo/ mthon po'i thob dang dpa' bo'i dpung shed dang / / btsan pos u tshugs mdzes mos bslu brid bcas/ / gang yang ma ngoms shugs kyis dad pa'i yul/ / ston pa'i chos 'di yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ ris med kun la snyoms pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ / thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas/ / gang 'dod re ba skong ba'i chos kyi char/ / 'bad med lhun 'grub stsol la bdag yid dad/ /dang po/ mthun sgril gyi rtsa ba dam chos/dam pa'i chos la snying thag pa nas mtha' gcig tu mos pa'i gang zag zhig yin phyin chad mi rigs mi 'dra zhing / phyug sprang mi mtshungs pa/ cha lugs mi 'dra ba gang zhig yin rung / dngos gnas chos dad mi sna de dag la sems gting gi mthun lam zhig yong gi yod la de 'dra zhig yong dgos nges kyang yin/ dam pa'i chos kyi ngo bo la gral rim med cing / pho mo'i dbye ba med pa/ rgyu phyug sprang gi khyad par med pa/ thob go sa'i mtho dman med pa/gnya' gnon dang bshu gzhog med par/ btang snyoms chen po zhes bya ba de yin zhing / chos pa rnam dag cig yin zhing / chos sgrub mi sna zhig yin phyin chad phan tshun bar gyi ru nga dang / phrag dog med cing / khyed shi nga sos kyi 94

'gal zla de dag rang sar zhi ste/ phan tshun bar du ma bu dang spun grogs kyi brtse zhen lta bu chags kyi red/ da lta mthong gsal rang la yang / dper na/yul mi 'dra ba dang / skad mi 'dra ba/ cha lugs mi 'dra ba de dag kyang /dam pa'i chos kyi gdugs zhabs nas mthun lam bzang zhing / gcig gis gcig la btsan po u tshugs kyis mi mthun pa de dag mthun thabs byed ma dgos pa/ snying thag pa nas gcig gis gceg la dga' dad dang gus bkur yod pa yin zhing / rang lta mchog 'dzin che/da cing / mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems khams kyis kun la khyab pa'i sems gshis mnga' bas/ chos dad mi sna ni kha bral ring lugs ma yin zhing / ris med mthun lam bzang bas mthun sgril ring lugs zhes bya/ chos pa zer ba de mkha' mnyam sems can spyi'i bde sdug la bsam gzhig byed pa zhig yin dgos pa dang / khyad par du mkhos zhan pa/ sdug bsngal che ba dag la de las kyang snying brtse bas skyong ba zhig yin pas/ de las kyang mthun lam bzang po yong mkhan zhig yin par shes dgos/der brten ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes pa/ bdud kyi mtshon cha tsub mo dag la 'jam mnyen me tog lan du sbyin mkhan/ lhas byin khros pas skyogs rdo 'phang tshe mi smra brtul zhugs dang du len mkhan/ rang gi dgra la sdang mig tsam yang blta ba mi nus pa'i de 'dra'i gnyom chung nang gi gnyom chung zhig gis/bstan pa'i chos de khyab spel byed po dag gis btsan po u tshugs byed ma dgos nas pad nang du bung ba 'khor ba bzhin nang pa'i dam chos kyi phyogs su 'khor thub par byung zhing / yul lung mi gcig pa'i rgyal khams spyi la nang pa'i chos 'di nyin re las nyin re je dar dang je rgyas 'gro bzhin yod cing / mtshon rgya khab tsam zhig bed spyod ma dgos pa/ dam pa'i chos 'di de 'dra khyab spel gtong thub pa byung ba 'di dam chos kyi che ba yin par shes dgos/ mkha' mnyam sems can spyis mthun sgril gyi lag zung dam du sbrel nas/ zhi bde'i 95

dpal la longs su spyod 'dod na dam pa'i chos lugs las lhag pa'i lam lugs shig yod tshod mi gda'/ 'on kyang nang chos la kha g.yar te/ rang gi khe phan gnyer ba dang / nang chos kyi lta grub la kha g.yar te/ mi gzhan mgo gnon pa dag gi las ni chos kyi las ma yin/ bdag cag gi ston pas nang chos la gus ma gus gnyis la dga' sdug gnyis dang lta stangs gnyis mi bya zhing ngo mnyam pa zhig dgos gsungs 'dug pa ma zad/ sdang ba'i dgra bo la de las kyang brtse bas skyongs dgos gsungs/ chos pa tshul bzhin gyur na mi rigs shig dang rgyal khab tsam gyi mthun sgril la mi thug cing / mkha' mnyam sems can spyi la mthun sgril zhig yong nges/gnyis pa/ sdug bsngal can la dam chos/bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa 'di thun mong gi bshad tshul ltar na yang / sems can gyi sdug bsngal sel byed du 'dzam gling 'dir phebs pa yin zhing / de yang ston pa 'dzam gling 'dir phebs te/ rgya gar gyi rigs bzhi'i tha ma gdol ba'i rigs la brtse bas skyongs te/ gdol ba'i rigs la dngos gnas bcings 'grol thob yod pa ni kun gyis khas len zhing / rlung ltar grags pa 'di ga lags/ dper na ston pas/ rigs mi gtso rus mi gtso bslabs pa gtso zhes pas rigs rus de 'dra shugs chen po'i lta stangs yod pa'i rgya gar sa char de 'dra'i 'gyur ldog chen po zhig gtong thub pa 'di ha cang rlabs che la gzi brjid che ba zhig lags/ ston pa rab tu byung ste/ lo drug dka' bar spyad de/ mthar mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i bar tshang ma sems can gyi don yin par shes dgos/ khyad par du sems can thams cad pha mar shes dgos pa'i rigs pa 'dis sdug bsngal can gang na 96

yod na chos pa de ru yod dgos pa zhig yin la/ dper na thogs med kyis khyi mo'i khog smad kyi 'bu la lce ldag byas te blangs pa dang / bdag cag gi ston pas bslab pa lam gyi gnas skabs su dmya‘spa bar gyad kyi shing rta 'dren po la lag rogs byed pa lta bu/ gzhan yang bdag cag gi ston pa 'di nyid bslab pa lam gyi gnas skabs su las dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya dang / ma dag pa'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs nas sems can gyi don bsgrub pa 'di dag gis/ nang chos ni sems can sdug bsngal las 'grol byed yin zhing / khyad par du sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems yin zhing / lus kyi sdug bsngal de yang mthar thug ste bshad na/ sems thog tu bab pa zhig yin pa/ dper na sems thog gi gnas lugs de dag ngo shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa la na dga' shi skyid ces pa zhig yong gi yod pa kun gyis shes/ dper na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar pa dang / mi la ras pa 'di dag lo na tshod de tsam rgas shing / tshe yi phar mthar thug pa'i dus la slebs dus kyang / gsal rig sems kyi bzhag lugs skor lugs shig gis brjod med kyi bde bas chos mgur sna tshogs bzhes te/'jig rten pa'i dngos po la re ltos byed ma dgos pa kun nas thugs spro bo byung ba 'di nang chos kyi drin rang yin zhing / ngas gong zhus kyi sdug bsngal can la chos zhes pa de ha cang mthun po mi 'dug gam/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/gang gi chos kyi ngon bo mchog sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang / de dag don med gyi nar 'khyams gsungs pa bzhin yin pas bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod na sems kyi gsang ba shes dgos pa dang / sems kyi gsang ba shes dgos na dam pa'i chos shes dgos pa zhig yin pas/ sdug bsngal zhi bar 'dod pa rnams kyis nang chos la brten par bya'o/97

gsum pa/ dam chos ngo ma/de yang bdag cag gi ston pas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos zhig kho bos rnyed gsungs pas/ yul dang yul can/ sems dang dngos po'i mtha' thams cad las 'das pa'i spros bral gang yin pa de chos yin zhing / 'jig rten gyi dngos po mtha' dag la zhen med 'dzin med kyis 'jig rten las logs su gyur ba'i phyogs shig nas gtan bde'i go 'phang de btsal dgos kyi/ 'jig rten pa nang bzhin gyis dga' sdug chags sdang gi 'dam du ltung na chos 'grub pa gang na yin/ mdo sde ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min/ lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad ma min/ gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad yin na/'phags pa'i lam gyis su la ci zhig bya gsungs pas/ 'phags pa'i chos zhes pa gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs 'jig rten pa'i chos las 'das pa dang /'jig rten pa'i chos la re ltos byed ma dgos pa/ 'jig rten gyi dngos po la brten nas bde ba thob thabs byed mi dgos pa zhig yin/ gal te 'jig rten pa'i dngos po bzang po la brten nas bde snang 'char na 'phags pa'i chos la mnga' ma brnyes pa'i rtags bstan pa red/ de ltar na 'jig rten tshe 'di'i che thabs la 'bad pa de ni chos ngo ma ma yin zhing / rang gi khe phan don du gnyer ba de ni de las kyang chos ngo ma gang na yin/ de ltar na dam chos ngo ma'am 'phags pa'i chos la mnga' brnyes yod med ni rang blo rang la lkog tu ma gyur pa yin pas rang blos ha go ba las gzhan gyis tshod dpog byed mi thub/ dam chos ngo ma ni thog mar dge ba/ mtha' ma'i dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ don bzang ba/ tshig 'bru bzang ba/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs 98

su byang pa/ legs par gsungs pa zhes bya ba yin rung dam pa'i chos 'di mis lag bstar ram bed spyod byed dus/ mi'i lam lugs shugs che nas dam pa'i chos la mi'i lam lugs kyis shan zhugs pas dam chos rnam dag mi 'gyur ba mang /bzhi pa/ 'che med zhi ba'i chos/de yang nang pa'i skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya las/ chos la skyabs su song na sems can la gnod 'tshe spong gsungs pa nga/nga / gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no zhes pa dang / dge sbyong gi chos bzhi ni/ gshe la slar mi gshe pa dang / khros la slar mi khro ba dang / brdegs kyang slar mi rdeg pa dang /mtshang brus kyang slar mtshang mi 'bru ba bzhir gsungs pas/ sems can la gnod cing 'tshe ba byed pa ni chos ma yin zhing / gnod cing 'tshe ba byed na chos kyi ra ba las 'das pa'o/ de ltar na 'tshe med zhi ba'i chos ni nang chos yin zhing / nang chos la brten nas 'jig rten khams kyi 'thab 'khrug dang /'gal rtsod kun zhi nas phan tshun 'tshe med zhi bde la longs su spyod thub pa zhig yin/ dper na chos pa zhig yin na tha na grog sbud tshun chad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor spong ba yin pas/ chos pa rnam dag de la zhi bde'i ded dpon zhes bya/ de ltar na nga tsho nang pa'i chos kyi nang dkyil khyad chos che ba de ni 'tshe med zhi ba'i chos yin pa red/ nye rabs chos pa yin zhes khas che ba'i grub mtha'i kha 'dzin pa dag gis mda' mdung mtshon cha spyod de rang nyid kyi grub mtha' srung skyob byed ched du tha ma pa nang bzhin gyis rang mtshan gyi khrag gi 'khor lo bskor ba dag ni chos pa'i las ma yin pa shes par bya/dper na rje mi la ras pa'i nye 'gram na sha ba dang shwa khyi dud 'gro bsam med 99

dag kyang phan tshun 'tshe med zhi bar gnas thub par byung ba 'di rje mi la'i thugs rgyud na 'tshe med zhi ba'i chos mnga' ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ bdag cag gi ston pas bdud kyi mtshon cha tsub mo la 'jam mnyen me tog lan du sbyin pa/ lhas sbyin khros pas skyogs rdo 'phangs tshe mi smra brtul zhugs dang du len pa/ rang gi dgra la sdang mig tsam yang blta ba mi nus pa 'di 'tshe med zhi ba'i chos kyi che ba red/lnga pa/ blo bde gu yangs kyi chos/spros med bya btang gi chos ni dam chos yin la/ de yang tshe 'di'i bcas bcos dang spros pa kun zhi nas/ sos dal bag phebs gnas pa dag ni nang chos rnam dag byed po de red/ mkhas dbang dge chos kyis/ yod ces bya ba 'di yang bcos ma ste/ med ces bya ba 'di yang bcos ma nyid/ de 'dra'i bcos ma kun gyis ma bslad pa/ sems kyi rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin zhes pas nang chos byed po de la blo bde gu yangs de 'dra zhig yong gi yod/de bzhin rdza dpal sprul rin po ches/ mal na lus/ lus la sems sems la lhod yod pa zhig dgos gsungs pa 'di gnad dam pa zhig yin/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar/ rje mi la ras pa la thob dang go sa med cing dpal dang 'byor ba mi ldan yang / de 'dra'i blo bde gu yangs su bzhugs shing / spros med rnal 'byor ngang nas rdo rje'i mgur blangs nas bzhugs tshul la ltos dang go rgyu zhig yod/ nga tsho 'jig rten pa rnams nyi ma re re bzhin khom long med par zin med kyi las la 'bad pa chen por byas te/ brel brel 'tshub 'tshub tu ji tsam rgyug rung blo bde gu yangs kyi spro skyid la rol ma thub pa 'di dam chos las ring du song ba'i rtags red/ yang mkhas dbang dge chos kyis/ re 100

dogs 'og 'gyu'i rnam rtog sdug bsngal gyi skyur rtsi/ shugs 'byung dga' bde'i nyams kyis 'o ma dang 'dres pas/ bza' btung longs spyod phyi yi skyid chas tsam 'grig kyang / blo bde gu yangs nang gi skyid nyams de mi 'dug che 'dod re ba'i gzhi ma me nang du bsreganu/ shing / mi 'dod khral gyi btsun gzugs thal dong du bskyur te/ gang dran sems rjes 'brangs ba'i smyon pa yi spyod pas/ ljongs dang ljongs su rgyu ba'i gu yangs shig byung na/ tshul gsum rtags kyi rdzong gog rmeg med du bshig cing / mtha' brgyad dem bca'i mdud pa rang sa ru chad de/ gang shar snang ba gzhi med rtsa bral du go nas/ zhe blo gting nas bde ba'i dga' spro zhig byung na/ stong pa mtha' dbus med pa'i 'od gsal gyi dbyings su/ 'dzin med sems kyi ngo bo ro gcig tu thim ste/rang myong brjod du med pa'i zag med kyi bde ba/ zhes gnas lugs rtogs pas zag med kyi bde ba thob nas blo bde gu yangs shig 'byung rgyu yod pa thag bcad 'dug pa bzhin dngos kyi gnas lugs la yang de 'dra yin pa gdon mi za/ de bzhin du rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sa phyogs bdag gir bzung med pa/rang bzhin gyis ni yangs rnams su/ rang dbang spyod cing chags med pa/nam zhig bdag ni gnas par 'gyur zhes pa dang / yang de nyid las/ lhung bzed la sogs nyi tshe dang / kun la mi mkho'i gos 'chang zhing / lus 'di sba bar ma byas kyang / 'jigs med gnas par nam zhig gyur zhes pa sogs kyis dam pa'i chos la brten pa'i blo bde gu yangs kyi spro nyams la yid smon byed pa lta bu/drug pa/ bsam blo gcig tu zlum pa'i chos/de yang mkhas dbang dge chos kyis/ 'khor ba'i chos dang bstun nas 101

myong ba'i tshe/ mi skyo bya ba gcig kyang yod min te/ skyo ba'i sems gso dam pa'i lha chos te/ nam zhig tshe na gcig kyang 'byung bar nges zhes sems kha chos phyogs su nam zhig na 'khor nges yin pa'i gnad kyi sdom tshig gcig gsungs/ 'dzam gling na sngon thon gyi mi rigs dang / sngon thon gyi rgyal khab ga 'dra zhig yin rung rang nyid kyi blo kha phyogs sa'i chos shig med pa mi srid/chos dam tshig de la brten nas bsam blo 'thor ba rnams phyogs gcig tu zlum pa zhig yin/ dper na/ byi'u phrug 'khor sa'i tsher phung dang / ri dwags 'khor sa'i spang ljongs/ gcan gzan 'khor sa'i nags tshal/ nya mo 'khor sa'i chu mtsho zer ba ltar so so la bsam blo gtod sa zhig dang / blo 'khor sa zhig dgos nges yin pa ni chos nyid kyis grub pa zhig red/ de ltar na chos 'di ni bsam pa'i dpal yon gyi srog shing yin zhing / chos kyi drin la brten nas sems la spro bar 'phel zhing / 'jigs pa'i sa phyogs su blos thub kyi skyel ma dpa' bo la brten pa nang bzhin gyis chos kyis mi 'jigs pa'i dbugs gsar pa re sbyin gyi yod/ spyir rang gi ngo bo 'dzin pa chos kyi mtshan nyid ces gzhung kun las grags pa nang bzhin gyis/ dam pa'i chos la yang rang gi ngo bo yod pa yin zhing / dam chos sgrub po de la yang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i chos kyi ngo bo zhig ldan gyi yod/ ngo bo de ldan gyi mi sna rnams la bsam spyod kun po gcig mthun yong thub pa zhig yin/ de ltar na sa mtshams kyis rgyang thag ji ltar ring / rgyun du thug 'brel ci tsam med rung / sems bsam pa gcig tu zlum zhing mthun sgril gyi srog gi ka ba brtan por chags thub pa 'di chos kyi drin rang red/ chos med kyi mi sna dag ni gang la yang gtad so med par skya ba med pa'i gru rlung gis g.yo ba nang bzhin yong gi red/102

bdun pa/ sems khams la zhib 'jug byed pa'i chos/de yang 'dzam gling 'di na zhib 'jug bya yul grangs med cig dang /zhib 'jug byed po bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod la/ zhib 'jug byed pa'i bya ba yang grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig myotsho/da pa yang kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ tha na sho rgyal 'jog lugs la yang zhib 'jug byed kyi yod pa red/ rgyang ring gi nam mkha'i rgyu skar nas nyi zla go la bcas pa la zhib 'jug byed pa dang / de dag tu dpung 'jug byed dang byed bzhin yod pa red/'on kyang bsam gzhig byed dgos pa zhig la mig shes kyis thag ring gi gzugs mthong rung / thag nye'i rdzi ma mi mthong ba nang bzhin shes bya rgya chen po de tsam la zhib 'jug byed kyi yod rung / nga tsho dang tshe rabs thog med nas mnyam du 'grogs pa'i sems kyi gshis la zhib 'jug byed po ni dam chos las ma mthong la/ nga tshos kha phyir 'khor te/ ji tsam gyis zhib 'jug byed/ ji tsam gyis bya byed mang rung rtsa ba'i sdug bsnga'/ zhi thabs byed thub kyi med/ rgyu mtshan ni sems kyi gsang ba 'di ma shes na bde ba thob 'dod dang sdug bsngal zhi 'dod kyi 'dun pa ji tsam che rung stong bsam kho na las ma 'danu dper na bdag cag gi ston pa 'di thog mar rgyal bu byas/ rgyal srid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la rol ba'i skal ba dang ldan rung / des kyang phugs kyi bde ba mi thob cing / phugs kyi sdug bsngal zhi mi thub par gzigs te/ sems kyi gsang ba shes thabs su lo drug la dka' ba spyad de/ mthar sems kyi gsang ba shes par ma zad mngon du gyur te sangs rgyas pas/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ ces gsungs pas sems kyi gsang ba 'di ha go na gnas lugs mang po zhig go thub kyi yod 103

pas sems kyi gsang ba shes thabs su dam pa'i chos la 'bad par bya/ nga tsho nyi zla skar gsum brgya dang stong la zhib 'jug byas/ rdzas 'gyur khri phrag mang po'i gnas lugs shes rung / sems kyi gnas lugs shes mi thub/ sems kyi gnas lugs ma shes na/ 'dzam gling bskor rung / shes rgya che rung / bde ba thob thabs dang / sdug bsngal zhi thabs mi ldan no/ dper na sangs rgyas ni gtan bde'i go 'phang thob tshar ba zhig yin la/ gtan bde'i go 'phang thob dgos na sems kyi gnas lugs shes dgos/ de yang / lung las/ sems 'di rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol zhig ces pa bzhin no/ ma gzhi nga tsho phal ba'i sems kyis shes bya thams cad 'di yin 'di min gyis thag chod mdog kha bo byed kyi 'dug rung / sems kho rang ji 'dra zhig yin sus kyang zhib 'jug ma byas na/ sems ci 'dra zhig yin ci la go/ dper na nga tshos dngos po'i lji tshad rgya mas tshad 'dzin byas te/ rgya ma la yid ches byas rung / rgya ma tshad ma yin min sus thag gcad thub/ de bzhin du nga tshos sems kyi gnas lugs de ha ma go na sems ci 'dra zhig yin sus kyang mi go/ der brten sems kyi gnas lugs shes phyir dam pa'i chos la slob gnyer ci nus byed na bzang / brgyad pa/ kun la snyoms pa'i chos/sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis/ ma 'dris 'gro ba'i gnyen bshes zhes ston pa la bstod pa dang / mkhas dbang dge chos kyis/ ma 'dris 'gro ba'i rtsa lag zas gtsang gi sras po zhes pa sogs kyis bdag cag gi ston pa ni sems can kun la mnyam pa'i ris med kyi btang snyoms pa chen po yin zhes ston pa'i che ba 'don pa dang don gcig tu snang / gzhan yang thugs rje kun 104

la mnyam pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ zhes ston pas kun la mnyam par gzigs pa'i tshul gsungs pa sogs kyis kun la snyoms par gzigs pa'i ston pa la/kun la snyoms pa'i chos shig yod pa yin zhing / chos de lag bstar byed tshul thad la/ gzhung so so'i lam rim sgrig lugs mi 'dra zhing / chos gzhung so so'i rtsal du bton lugs mi 'dra ba tsam las don gyi gnad 'bab sa gcig yin/ dper na skyes bu gsum zhes pa'i skabs kyi skyes bu chen po'i lam ni sems can thams cad mar shes pa/ drin dran pa/ drin gzo ba byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bskyed pa/ yid 'ong gi lhag bsam/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa bcas lag bstar byed pa/ dper na skyes bu zhes pa rgya gar skad du pu ru ṣa zer bod skad du stobs dang nus pa la 'jug cing / stobs dang nus pa chen po la skyes bu chen po zer ba dang / stobs dang nus pa che dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ ris med sems can spyi'i 'gan de skyes bu chen po'i phrag thog tu bab pa yin zhing / tha na 'bu grog sbud tshun chad de rang gi a ma yin pa'i 'du shes bcos min zhig bskyed dgos/ de ni dam pa'i chos lag bstar byed pa'i tshul red/ de bzhin du rgyal sras zhi ba lhas spyod 'jug tu/ 'gro la phan par ma gtogs pa/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs ma mchis zhes sangs rgyas thugs dgyes par byed dgos na sems can gyi don bsgrub dgos gsungs pa dang /de bzhin du/ re zhig bdag gi rjer gyur nyid kyang ni/ gang phyir rang gi sku la'ang mi gzigs pa/ de la rmongs pa bdag gis ji ltar na/ nga rgyal bya zhing bran gyi dngos mi bya zhes bdag cag gi ston pa chos kyi rje bo de nyid kyis sems can thams cad la bu spus gtsang gis pha ma la zhabs phyi zhu ba lta bu dang /g.yog po bzang pos dpon la g.yog byed pa nang bzhin gyis sems can gyi don bsgrub pa zhig yin na nga tshos sems can la brten nas g.yog byed dgos pa las nga rgyal ci la byed/105

smras pa/dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi bcud/ /rang gzhan bde la bkod pa'i dam chos 'di/ /bde ba thob 'dod rnams kyi grogs kyi mchog /sdug bsngal brlag 'dod rnams kyi dpung gi gnyen/ /lha klu gnyan gsum grogs su ma bkug cing / /dpa' bo ge sar dgra lhar ma bsten rung / /zhe blo gting nas bde ba'i gu yangs 'di/ /ri dam chos yi dam byas pa'i 'bras rtags red/ /106

yun ring zhig nas bshad bsam pa/deng gi dus 'dir chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus bzang ba'i stabs kyisabla grwa je mang du 'gro ba dang / khyad par sprul pa'i sku ni spang las sha mo brdol ba bzhin ga sa ga la khyab bzhin pa red/ der brten sprul sku ni mi dmangs dang 'go gtso sogs rgan dar gzhon gsum gyi gtam gyi gzhi gtso bo zhig tu gyur/ 'gas sprul sku ni pha— mkhas pas bu sprul sku byas pa dang / sprul sku'i bu dang tsha bo sprul sku dang / sprul sku'i tsha mo mkha' 'gro ma dang / gong ma'i ming dang 'dra ba la de'i sprul skur btags pa sogs red 'dug pas yid brton med zer/ 'gas ni sprul sku ni chos longs sprul gsum zhes pa'i sku gsum gyi nang tshan gyi sprul sku ste/ de ni bstan 'gro'i don la bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa yin pas ches khyad par 'phags pa zhig go zhes bshad/ 'gas ni bla ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa de tsho gshegs rjes yang srid len pa de la sprul sku zer ba yin zhes pa sogs chu rlabs 'phyur ba bzhin bshad tshul sna tshogs kyis gang / gang ltar yang spru'/ sku ni rang dbang yod pa gzhan la ltos mi dgos pa ci bsam na ci bshad/ ci mos na ci las chog pa lta bu zhig mthong gi yod/ dper na sprul sku'i grogs mo ni mkha' 'gro ma/ sprul sku'i chang ni gsol chang zhes pa sogs thun mong phal pas spyod na skyon du 'gyur ba thams cad sprul skus spyod na yon tan du 'gyur/ de yang dper na dug gis sems can spyi'i srog la 'tshe rung rma bya la phan pa bzhin no zer ba sogs dpe lung mang po bkod kyin 'dug der brten sprul sku la dmigs bsal gyi 107

gnas tshul ha cang mang bas tha na sprul sku gdug tsub kyi las la dga' na sprul rgod dang / blun po zhig yin rung blun tshul bstan pa yin gyi blun po min zer ba sogs kyis ming gang snyan snyan btags/ gong du bkur rgyu mang ba dang /spyi tshogs kyis dmigs bsal phud rgyu mang drag pa sogs kyis sprul sku 'ga' ni nga rgyal gyis 'ur long / sprul sku 'gas ni sgrig lam thams cad brlag cing gtor/ byis pa gces long gtong ba bzhin sprul sku long shor du gyur na phan gnod gnyis gang gis che bsam dgos pa zhig yin par ma zad sprul sku la gus bkur gang mang thob pa dang / dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo bzang ba sogs kyi shugs rkyen gyis sprul sku byed 'dod ni skam pas chu la don gnyer byed pa bzhin 'gro mang dag gis rgyu ngo thob gsum sogs gang gis kyang sprul sku'i ming e thob lta bzhin 'dug 'di 'dra la dgongs nas kun mkhyen gyis kyang / sprul sku la sprul sku'i cha rkyen nam mtshan nyid tshang dgos kyi sprul sku la sprul sku'i cha rkyen nam mtshan nyid ma tshang na sprul sku min gsungs pa sogs kyis gang byung gis sprul sku byas pa la bkag par mdzad yod/ de bzhin 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po ches ngas ni dam pa gong ma'i ming tsam la skyabs su ma mchi nas grwa pa dkyus ma nang bzhin gyis slob gnyer byas pa yin gsungs pas tshig 'dis bla ma gong ma'i ming tsam la re ltos byed ma dgos par rang stobs kyis slob gnyer byed pa dang rang stobs kyis bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i rgyu sgrub dgos pa bstan/ gzhan yang dpal sprul thams cad mkhyen pas/ deng gi sprul sku 'di dag ni bong ba ste sa sgor ri mgo nas sgril na ri mjug thon dus sa sgong 'thor zhig tu gyur te lhag ma tsam las med pa bzhin sku phreng rim byon thams cad snga ma las kyang phyi ma je ngan du 'gro gda' gsungs/ tshig 'dis kyang sprul sku 'ga' dang 'gas thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bshad sgrub las gsum sogs gang yang byed ma thub pa ma zad bstan pa'i rkang 'dren 108

'gro nyen che bzhin yod par bstan/ da dung gu ru'i sprul sku dang shākya thub pa'i sprul sku yin zer mkhan phar bltas pa tsam gyis spyang ki'i rnam thar 'dzin te za 'dod kyi 'khor lo skor mkhan kha shabasdo mthong bas skyugs bro bo 'duga'adi dag gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan las gnod pa che bas gzab gal che/ mdor na bstan 'gro la phan pa'i skyes bu zhig la sprul pa'i sku zer gyi yod pa ma gtogs 'gro la phan pa'i bya ba sna gcig kyang ma byas par rang 'dod yid byed kho nas rang nyid thob dang grags pa don du gnyer nas ra gan gser du 'dzin pa bzhin rang nyid che rlom byed pa de la gal te sprul sku btags rung ming tsam gyi sprul sku red zer gyi yod/ ngas sprul sku yin zer mkhan grogs bzang zhig la 'di ltar zhu myong / khyed la sprul sku'i ming yod rung sprul sku yin min ngas mi shes/ 'on kyang khyed la chung dus nas bzung bsam blo bzang po bcos min gyi phan sems dang / gshis kyiru/ gzur gnas shig yin par ma zad 'dod chung chog shes can zhig yin 'dug pas de'i ngos nas nga khyed la gus pa yod ces bshad pa yin/ ma gzhi sprul sku'i ming ma btags rung sprul sku zhig yin na gser sa 'og na yod kyang 'od nam mkha' la khyab pa bzhin ldog med kyi 'jon nus te bstan dang 'gro ba'i don sgrub thub pa zhig yong gi red snyam/ de min tha mal pa zhig la ming snyan snyan mo sangs rgyas dang byang sems sprul pa'i sku sogs ga tshod btags rung khyi rgan la seng ge 'dzin pa nang bzhin dgos pa gang yang med pa ma zad/ 'jig rten gyi dpe la myi ngan mying che na 'bod mkhan ngo tsha zer ba de yong gi red/ khyad par du bzlas pa'i grangs/ sgom pa'i nyams sogs gang yang med par ma zad 'gro la phan pa'i bya ba gang yang mi byed cing sprul sku'i ming tsam zhig gis shi dkor gson chog sogs za rgyu yod yod thams cad zos te shi bo 'khyag stong stong / gson po dro seng nge bzo nges kun gyi rgyu nor rnams rang gis tshur blangs te bed spyod na 109

'di phyi gnyis phung gi rgyu bsags pas rang mgo rang gis skor/ rang mgo rang gis brdung ba zhig ma yin nam/ spyir rgyal ba'i bka' rjes 'jug mkhas pa'i bstan bcos sogs gang du yang dkor nag lcags kyi ril bu de/ za byed khro yi 'gram pa zhig dgos gsungs pa ma yin nam/ nyams rtogs kyi rnal 'byor gang yang med pa'i phal ba'i mi sprul sku'i ming can dag gis dkor zos te brjid brjid rngam rngam 'dra chags byed rung / gnyom chung gi las ka byas/gnyom chung gi za ma zos na don gyis brjid che la gtsang seng nge shig yin pas/gnyom chung bdag nyid brnyas pa sogs kyis dpa' zhum mi dgos pa zhig yin/yang deng gi dus 'dir dpal 'byor yod na ci yang sgrub thub pa zhig yin pas/ dpal 'byor gyi 'gro song btang thub na sprul sku byed chog gi red zer ba'i skad cha zhig go rgyu 'dug gal te de bden na mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ rgyu yod de la thar pa yod/ rgyu med de la thar pa med ces sngon dus rgyu yod na bya ba gang yang sgrub thub pa lta bu'i spyi tshogs la ma rangs pa'i tshig cig gsungs pa bzhin nga tshos kyang rgyu yod de la sprul sku yod/rgyu med de la sprul sku med zer dgos pa lta bu red/mkhas pa 'gas ni bsam med kyi byis pa zhig la sprul sku'i ming sprad de khri la phud pa las bla ma mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa de tsho sprul sku byas te khri la phud nas mtshan 'dogs na bstan 'gro la de las phan che ba mi 'dug zer/ gal te mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i bla ma zhig yod na mtshan ma btags kyang rang stobs kyi nus pas bya ba thams cad bde blag gis sgrub thub pa zhig yin pas de la sprul sku'i ming gis dgos pa yod snang mi shar/'ga' zhig gis bla ma lo na lon pa de dag la mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms tshe sprul sku'i ming btags rung sprul sku yin pa'i yid ches med pas/sprul sku zer ba de chung byis pa'i dus nas lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan nam 110

rtags ril sgril ba sogs las ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i skad cha zhig 'dugagang zag de rigs kyis sprul sku zer ba des dpe cha mi shes rung rdzig nyams che la/ bya spyod thams cad mtho la dma' la ste cha mi snyom pa zhig la 'dod kyi yod/sprul sku ngos 'dzin byed lugs sogs ji ltaza ri yin rung nga tsho la do gal mi che/'on kyang sprul skus bstan 'gro'i don rnal ma zhig sgrub rgyu dang / sprul skus che che brjid brjid kyisaci khri gang mtho mtho ru sdod/ za ma ci zhim zhim zos/ gos ci bzang bzang gon te dbul zhing phongs pa'i sems can de dag snang med du bskyur te nyam nga ba'i 'gro ba dag la btsog bltas nas rang nyid ci mos gang mos mi byed rgyu'i re ba de ha cang che/ ma gzhi sngon gyi rnam thar dang lo rgyus dag na bod gangs can pa'i bkres skam gyi sdug bsngal de spyan ras gzigs kyis ma bzod nas spyan chab shor ba zhig yin gsungaru/ na nga tsho'i sprul sku rnam pas kyang sems can gyi sdug bsngal mthong nas mchi ma shor thub pa dang phan pa ci nus sgrub rgyu gal che/ de bzhin rgya chen srol 'byed kyi slob dpon chen mo thogs med kyis khyi mo ro smad rmas ma la sha 'bu zhugs te sha 'bus khyi mo zos pa mthong ste rang gi ljags kyis sha 'bu rnams blangs pa'i rnam thar la bltas na yang sprul sku de 'gro ba dag gi zhabs 'degs pa zhig sku/na dgos kyi/ khengs rlom dang nga rgyal gyis mi phyed la kha mi grag mkhan dang / gral mtho dman tsam dang tshig snyan mi snyan tsam gyis dga' sdug shor mkhan zhig yin mi rung ba zhig dgos pa bstan yod/ de bzhin ston pa'i rnam thar dag na sems can gcig gi don du ston pa dmyal bar bskal pa stong du gnas pa gsungs pa dang / dpal sprul thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / lha sa'i jo bo'i mdun du sems can thams cad kyi don du dmyal ba mnar med du skye dgos zhes smon lam btab pa sogs gang nas bltas kyang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam sprul lam/ bla ma'i rnam sprul gang zhig yin rung mdor na 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon yin pas sems 111
can gyi g.yog dang zhabs 'degs pa zhig yin pa'i kun slong yod dgos pa las sems can la gnya' gnon dang rang nyid mtho sar bsnyegs pa sogs byed mi rung ngo / / 112

bris kyi slob gso'i nyams myong cung tsam gleng ba/dang po/ bris gzugs kyi gal chen rang bzhin bshad pa/rje bstan dar lha rams pa'i zhal nas/ / rtsom pa legs kyang sug bris mi 'byor na/ dpa' rtsal che ba'i dpa' bo lag rdum 'dra/ / zhes sngon nas gdams ngag zab mo zhig gnang ba de ga lags/ de bzhin si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa btsugs nas deng gi bar du bshes gnyen rgan rabs pa rnam pa'i shugs rkyen bzang po'i sku drin las/ sug bris la mthong chen dang do snang byed pa'i goms gshis de ma dor bar gnas/ khyad par du gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma dang dbu khrid chen mo bkra shis tshe ring rnam gnyis kyis nam rgyun si bod slob grwa la gsungs gsal/ khyed tshos bris la nan tan dang do dam byed cing slob gso'i nang don gtso bo'i gral du 'jog dgos/slob ma rnam pa'i rig gnas kyi chu tshad mthon po yin rung / sug bris legs por zhig ma 'byor na spyi tshogs kyis gdenganu/ tshad bzang po zhig 'jog gi ma red/ der brten slob ma rnams spyi tshogs thog tu slebs dus thog mar phyir bstan rgyu de bris gzugs rang yin pas bris gzugs kyis shugs rkyen bzang po zhig 'jog dgos gsungs/ de bzhin slob grwa rang ngos nas kyang bris gzugs la gal chen byed cing bris kyi slob thengs mang por 'jog pa/ bris kyi 'gran sdur byed pa sogs thabs shes sna mang spyod rung / sngon dus kyi slob ma lta bu'i bris kyi chu tshod mthon po yong khag ngo/tsho 'dug rgyu mtshan ni slob chung 113

dang slob 'bring skabs bod yig gi chu tshad zhan pa/ de las kyang bris gzugs la snang med dang mthong chung byas pas lan pa red/ spyir bris gzugs 'di chung byis pa'i dus nas gtso bor bzung dgos rgyu zhig red/ lo na mthon po'am lo na gang 'tshams song ba'i mis sbyong na de tsam gyis yag po zhig yong thub kyi mi 'dug der brten chung nas bris gzugs la bslab rgyu gal shin tu che/ pe cin rig gnas pho brang du bzhugs pa'i mkhas dbang mi nyag mgon pos sug bris 'byor rgyu 'di gal shin tu che/ dper na nga tsho dga' ldan khri la bud pa'i mkhas dbang gser ri 'dra ba brgya kha lhag yod rung de dag la brtsams chos yod mkhan nyung nyung red/ rgyu mtshan ni sug bris legs par ma 'byor ba'i rkyen gyis yin pa las rig gnas zhan pas ga na yin gsungs/der brten khong rnam pa la rig nor phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa dag phyir phud pa'i lag cha ang dang po sug bris legs par 'byor dgos pa de rang red/'dzam gling na yang rig gnas mkhas pa'i gral du yod pa dag gis bris gzugs legs por 'byor dgos pa ni rtsa ba'i cha rkyen du brtsi ba red/ dper na khong mkhas pa red 'on kyang sug bris 'byor gyi med zer na rna lam du mi 'gro ba'i skad cha zhig tu snang gi yod/ de ltar na nga tshos bris gzugs la do snang byed rgyu gal shin tu che/ dper na bris gzugs legs por 'byor ba'i mi sna zhig sa phyogs shig tu slebs tshe sa phyogs der bris gzugs kyis don chen po thon thub kyi 'dug si bod slob grwa nas mthar phyin pa'i slob ma skal bzang rdo rje dar mdor gsar 'gyur khang la las bgo byas rjes/ dar mdor 'grul skyel rlangs 'khor gyi kha byang rnams brje nas khong gis phyag bris mdzad pas sgros gtsang la yid du 'ong ba zhig snang bas rnam pa gsar pa zhig tu bsgyur ba red/ de bzhin nga tsho dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul gyi srid gzhung gi las khungs dang / sger gnyer dang las rigs so so'i sgo byang dag yag po 114

zhig byung na/ phyis dkar mdzes khul ljongs rgyu'i yul du gyur dus ljongs rgyu ba dag la spro ba ster ba dang / spyan 'bul gyi ltad mo bzang po zhig tu 'gyur thub pa red/ de ltar na che ba rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi brtsams chos nas/chung ba sgo byang yan chad kyi las su bgyi ba rnadzo mas la bris gzugs ni med du mi rung ba'i lag cha zhig red/ dper na deng sang gang zag phal mo ches rtsom yig 'bri ba dag rtsom sgrig pas dus deb ri/hūṃ 'god grabs kyis rtsom gsher skabs su bris gzugs bzang ba de tsho la nan por blta ba las bris gzugs zhan na rtsom gyi sdeb sbyor dang nang don ji ltar bzang rung mig lam du mi 'jog pa'i gnas tshul yod/ rgyu mtshan 'dis kyang nga tshos bris gzugs la do snang dang mthong chen byed dgos par go/gnyis pa/ bris gzugs khyab spel gtong thabs skor bshad pa/gong zhus ltar chung byis pa'i dus nas bris gzugs 'bri sbyong gi las la gtso gzung byed rgyu 'di ni bris dar spel gtong thabs sam bris gzugs yag po yong ba'i thabs mchog cig red/ dper na dbus gtsang phal mo che'i yul gru dang a mdo reb kong yul sogs su chung dus nas bris gzugs 'bri sbyong dang rtsom yig 'bri rgyu'i lugs srol dar che bas rtsom yig 'bri ba dang /'khyugs bris kyi cha la byang cha che/ thabs shes gzhan zhig ni bris gzugs 'gran sdur dang bris gzugs 'grem ston byed pa de yin/ spyi lo 19rdo4lor si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwas bris gzugs dang rtsom yig lhan cig tu go gcig chod kyi 'grem ston byas pas des bris gzugs je yag tu phyin pa'i skul lcag rlabs chen thebs pa red/ khyad par du bris zhes pa de lo zla mthud de 115

'bri rgyu ches mang po byed dgos pa las nyin kha shas dang zla ba kha shas la lag rtsed byed pa'i sbyong pas ga yang mi phyin/ de ltar na nga tshos bris gzugs kyi byed las dang bris gzugs kyi gal che'i rang bzhin shes par byas te bris sbyong ba'i goms gshis bzang po zhig kyang chags par byed dgos/ dbu khrid chen mo bkra shis tshe ring mchog gis bkod sgrig ltar bod ljongs kyi slob dpon chen mo zla ba tshe ring mchog nged slob grwar phebs te bris gzugs slob khrid nyin gnyis gnang bas dgen slob kun gyis bris gzugs la mthong chen byed pa'i skul mar gyur/ de ltar na bris gzugs kyi ched khrid gnang ba'i bkod sgrig byed pa 'di yang bris gzugs khyab spel gtong thabs shig lags/ spyir dbus pa'i 'khyugs bris dang 'bri tsha de yag po 'dug pas nga tshos nges par du bslab sbyong dgos pa dang / dbu can skor la khams bris dang a mdo'i bris de 'grig po yod pas 'di'i thad la dgen chen mo mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyis kyang 'di bzhin zhal bzhes gnang / khyad par du khong gis/ / gnod byed nang du yod kyang phyi ru bskrad/ / phan byed phyi ru yod kyang nang du blangs/ /gcig la dam du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig 'dis/ / phyi ma'i 'jig rten 'di na go mi chod/ ces snyigs dor bcud len gyis gang bzang bzang de nang du len rgyu/gang ngan ngan de phyir dor dgos/ ces pa'i lung 'di drangs te bslab bya byed kyi yod/gsum pa/ bris gzugs dar spel gtong bar 'gal rkyen la dogs zon dgos pa'i skor bshad pa/spyir bris gzugs sbyong ba'i mos pa zhan pa dang bris gzugs sbyong ba'i 116

goms gshis med pa sogs ni 'gal rkyen che shos de red/ khyad par du deng dus tshan rig gis sna 'dren byas pa'i bzang po'i yon tan cha dang / ngan pa nyes pa'i cha gnyis yod pa ste/ dper na da lta'i dus su glog klad kyi bstan pa ches dar ba 'dis bris bri ba'i lag so'i 'gul bskyod byed pa'i go skabs nyung ba dang / tha na sug bris dgos med smras ༈) bris kyi bstan pa nyams dmas 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pas ci nas kyang gzab rgyu gal che/ spyir glog klad kyi dge mtshan che ba ni nga tshos mkhyen gsal lta ra lags kyang / deng rabs can gyi spyad chas de dag la gong zhus ltar dge mtshan ldan rung / nyen kha yang che bas nga tshos nges par du gcig las gnyis su gyes pa'i lta ba'i thog nas lag bstar byed dgos pa las/ ri bong cal 'drog nang bzhin byed na gtan nas 'grig gi ma red/ dper na glog klad lta bu'i spyod chas 'di dag dus bde byad 'jags/ glog gi cha rkyen bzang po ldan na/ bed spyod kyi stabs bde ba/myur mgyogs che ba/ sgros gtsang ba zhig yin rung / brgya la dus kyi zing 'khrug lta bu dang / glog gi cha rkyen mi ldan pa'i lung khug 'gol bo dag na glog klad spyod thabs gtan nas med pas de dag tu sug bris ma 'byor na ji ltar bya/ sngon byon mkhas pa de tshos phyag bris mdzad par byang tshad mtho ba ste/dper na bris gdan gyi cog tse dang / thig shing sogs mi dgos par lag pa g.yon pas snag bum bzung ba dang / 'bri gdan byed cing g.yas kyis phyag bris ya yo med cing mda' ltar skyen pa re 'bri thub kyi yod/ nga tshos kyang de 'dra ba zhig sbyong brdar byed rgyu gal che/ spyi tshogs rnyog 'dzing gi rang bzhin/'gyur ldog gi rang bzhin 'di la bris gzugs kyis zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pas/ nga tshos nges par du tha ma'i 'dings brgyab ste cha rkyen mi ldan pa dang brel 'tshub che ba/ zing 'khrugs slong ba'i sdo snyis lta bu zhig la bris kyis zhabs 'degs ji ltar zhu ba'i thabs de 'tshol dgoṭaṭa/ yi ge 'bri stangs skor la yang 117

do snang byed dgos pa ste/ deng sang bod yig dang rgya yig dbyin yig sogs yig rigs mang po zhig 'bri rung tha na smyug gu 'dzin tshul gcig kho na byed kyi 'dug nga tshos bod yig 'bri dus smyug gu 'dzin tshul dang yig rigs gzhan 'bri dus smyug gu 'dzin tshul gnyis gtan nas mi 'dra bas kun gyis mnyam 'jog byed pa gal che/bzhi pa/ yig gzugs ni mi rigs kyi srog rtsa yin chul bshad pa/de yang bdag cag gi ston pas/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ / nga nyid yi ge'i gzugs su snang / nga yin snyam du shes bya'i la/ / de tshe nga la gus par gyis/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yig gzugs la mthong chen dang dad gus dgos tshul gsungs pa 'dis nga tshos yig gzugs la gtsigs su 'dzin pa 'di ma nor ba'i lam yang dag yin tshul bstan/ grong pa'i phal mi dag gis kyang bka' thog tu sku ma 'jog ces po ti'i thog tu sku bzhag mi rung ba'i skad cha bshad kyi yod/ de bzhin du sher phyin gyi gzhung dag las/ gaṅgā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku med par byed pa bas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po a gcig med par byed pa nyes dmigs che tshul dang /sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i bye ma grangs snyed la mchod pa phul ba bas sher phyin gyi gzhung la mchod na phan yon che tshul phyogs mang po nas gsungs/ sher phyin ni rgyal ba'i yum yin pa dang / yum 'di la brten nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed tshul dang / dper na khyim zhig gi a ma gcig la bu mang po yod pa na bu de dag gis a ma la byams skyong dang a ma'i srog 'tsho thabs la 'bad pa 118

dang / a ma'i bka' drin dran nas drin r+ṣa4na 'jal ba ltar/ sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis rgyal ba'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung 'jig rten du yun ring bzhugs thabs dang srung skyob byed dgos pa'i tshul mang du gsungs pas/ sher phyin gyi gzhung ni nang bstan gyi snying po dang rtsa bar snang bas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog ceṭ+wāṃs kyang bya/ de bzhin sngon dus bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mchod rten sogs la skor bar phebs skabs yig 'bru na gcig mthong rung yar blangs te dbu thog tu bzha ga ste/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pa la lam cha tshang la ma nor ba zhig dgos/lam cha tshang la ma nor ba zhig dgos na yig 'bru na 'di yang med du mi rung ba zhig yin gsungs te mtho sar 'jog srol yod/ mi rigs kyi srog rtsa ni skad dang yi ge yin pa yongs la rlung ltar grags/ de las skad de gang ltar bshad kyang rgya bod sogs mi rigs gang zhig yin rung dper na yul skad mang stabs kyis bod dang bod kyi bar la bod skad kyis brda 'phrad dka' ba dang / rgya dang rgya'i bar la yang rgya skad kyis brda 'phrad dka' ba bcas ni mig mthong lag zin red/ de ltar na de thams cad kyi phan tshun bar brda 'phrad thabs kyi rtsa ba yi ge la brten pa las thabs gzhan med/ yi ge skad kyi gdangs su 'dod pa dang yi ge gzugs su 'dod pa gang zhig yin rung yig gzugs la brten nas don go thub pas yig gzugs ni mi rigs brtan por gnas byed kyi srog rtsa ngo ma yin/ yig gzugs kyis mi rigs kyi tshe srog brtan par byed pa la/ yig gzugs kyi sku tshe brtan dgos/ yig gzugs gtor brlag shor na mi rigs de yang brlag tshar ba red/ yig gzugs la brten nas brtse sems dang / thun mong dang thun min gyi bsam spyod sogs bskyed par byas te blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa'i rig gnas ngo bo can gyi mi rigs shig chags 119

thub/ yig gzugs la nus pa nges can zhig ldan pa ni smros ma dgos pa 'di ltar/ yi ge skad gdangs su 'dod pa'i dbang du gtong na skad gdangs des kyang yig gzugs lta bu go chod mi thub/ gang lags zer na yi ge'i sgra gdangs ni gcig gyur ma yin pas/ bod kyi yul gru so so'i yi ge'i sgra gdangs mi 'dra ba'i rtsod pa ni mdun na gnas bzhin pa 'di ga lags/ 'on kyang nga tshos ngoms rin yod pa zhig ni yig gzugs gcig gyur yin pa 'di rang red/ der brten mthar thug ste bshad na yig gzugs kyis don ngo ma bzhin go bar byas te blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa dang / dpal 'byor rig gnas sogs phyogs yongs la zhabs 'degs rlabs chen zhu bzhin yod/mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ dper na chos skad du bris pa'i glegs bam zhig mnga' ris nas a mdo'i bar 'khyer yang / thams cad kyis lhog shing go thub ba yin/ / zhes gsungs pa 'di yang mthar thug ste bshad na yig gzugs kyi drin rang red/ ma zad dper na deng gi dus su a mdo'i mi dang dbus pa'i mi gnyis kyis phal pa kha skad thog nas phan tshun brda 'phrad dka' rung dbus pas bris pa'i rtsom rig dang lo rgyus sogs gang zhig yin rung / a mdo bas klog cing go thub pa dang / de bzhin a mdo bas bris pa dag kyang dbus pas klog shes pa dang go thub pa 'di yang rtsa ba yig gzugs kyi drin rang red/lnga pa/ bod kyi yig gzugs kyi 'byung khungs bshad pa/de yang mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ sngon gyi mi rnams thog mar ri mo bris pa'i las byas te rim gyis yi ge yang byung bar mngon la 120

gsungs pa bzhin/ yig gzugs kyi ma phyi ri mo yin pa yongs grags kyi bshad tshul ltar lags/ khyad par rgya gar gyi yig gzugs 'di yang ri mo las 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/ mkhas dbang dge chos kyis/ rgya gar gyi yul gru phal che la nang gses kyi khyad cung re tsam ma gtogs yig gzugs 'di rang yin la/ o rgyan kyang sngon kha roṣā yi ge bri bas lo paṇa thang yig mjug tu o rgyan gyi yi ge nya yi sgal pa 'dra ba sogs bris pa la/ 'di ltar yod ces dpe ris dang bcas bris yod/ gang ltar nga tsho'i bod yig gi ma/ phyi rgya gar gyi yi ge de yang ri mo las byung ba gsal bshad byed yod/ spyir nga tsho bod kyi yi ge'i khungs bcol sa ni saṃ skyi ta red/ de ni rgya gar yi ge ste bram ze'i yi ger 'bod pa 'di nyid/ro man dang / 'jar man/ u ru su sogs thams cad kyi yi ge'i phyi mo yin tshul mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsungs/ gsungs 'di ni don la gnas pa'i gsungs shig yin/ dper na rgya nag gi yi ge 'di sbyong bde ba'i ched du ro man gyi yi ge las phin dbyin(7sgo)te da lta spyod bzhin pa 'di dag blangs pa red/ bod kyi yig gzugs saṃ skyi ta lha yi yi ge la brten nas bzos pa yin pa yongs la grags/ gong zhus ltar ro man gyi yi ge'i 'byung khungs kyang saṃ skyi ta lha yi yi ge yin pa'i rtags ni/ dper na ka kha dang 'dra ba'i spru6 ca cha dang 'dra ba'i 3 9tsa tsha dang 'dra ba'i snukhu pa pha dang 'dra ba'i 6ji 'di dag yod pas yig gzugs gnyis kyi bar gyi 'brel ba yod tshul phyogs tsam go thub pa 'dug de ltar na lha yi yi ge 'di 'dzam gling gi yig rigs phal che'i ma phyir gyur pa zhig mthong gi 'dug bod kyi yig gzugs dpe gang la blang pa sogs bshad tshul cung mang rung / bden lung pa gnyis de phu thag ring zer ba ltar/ 'dzam gling na nyin re las nyin re je gsal du 'gro ba ni/ bod kyi yi ge 'di dpe blang sa lañja ma yin zhing / gup+ta yi ge de yin tshul shes pa red/ lañja 'di rgya gar gna' rabs nas nye rabs bar gyi 121

yig rigs spyod sgo can gyi gral du yod pa ma mthong / 'di la mkhas dbang dge chos kyis/ / lañja 'di mdzes bris yin pa las bed spyod byed pa'i yi ge min gsungs/ khyad par du gup+ta yi ge dag ni nga tsho bod mi bod yig la byang cha yod cing / shes rig gi chu tshad cung mthon po yod pa dag gis ma bslab kyang phal che 'don thub pa 'dug ces gsungs tshul yod pa 'di dag la bltas nas bod kyi yig gzugs kyi ma phyi ni gup+ta yin par grub/ / dus kyi cha nas kyang gup+ta'i rgyal brgyud kyi skabs su sngon dus thon mi saṃ bho ṭa rgya gar du byon pa yin pas/ rgyu mtshan de dag gis bod yig dper blang sa de gsal por shes thub/drug pa/ yi ge byed thabs sna tshogs bshad pa/de yang gong zhus ltar/ cha rkyen phun sum tshogs pa ste/ glog klad kyis yig gzugs bzos pa dang / tha na glog klad lag pas brgyab ma dgos par sgra dag pos 'don pa tsam gyis yig gzugs bzo thub pa 'di ga lags kyang /de la rin thang med de/ glog klad kyis yig gzugs mdzes mo ga 'dra thon rung bris kyi rig gnas shes pa'i gral du mi 'jog de bzhin glog klad kyi yig gzugs kyis sku dngos kyis bris pa'i yig gzugs la 'gran du med de/ lag bris dngos ma la gdengs 'jog mtho zhing / tshad mthon po'i lta ba 'dzin gyi yod/ yi ge sbas pa blangs ba'i gter yig dang / mkha' 'gro'i brda yig lha bab yi ge sogs ji ltar byung tshul ni dad ldan thun min gyi spyod yul zhig red/de min sngon byon mkhas pa tshos me'i yi ge dang / chu'i yi ge rlung gi yi ge sogs srol gtod yod 'dug pas de dag kyang sbyong gal che/ dper na gal te gsang ba'i las don dang / yang na snag shog mi 'dzoms pa'i dus byung na de dag spyod sgo che ba yin/ gzhan yang bla chen dang dpon chen gyi drung yig byed 122

skabs kyi yig gzugs dang / 'bangs mi la bka' shog 'beb pa'i yig gzugs/ gong rim la zhu yig 'bul ba'i yig gzugs/ gnas tshul zin bris phab pa'i yig gzugs sogs skabs bab gang 'tsham re 'bri shes par byed dgos/smras pa/bris kyi bstan bcos mkha' ltar yangs pa la/ /zhib mo'i dpyod pa sprin ltar 'khrigs dus 'dir/ /bris gzugs bstan pa'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /phan re'i tshig gi dbyar rnga ldir ba'i tshe/ /mthong chung khyad gsad byed pa'i rtsa ldum 'ga'/ /dbyings su gzhil te gangs can yig gzugs kyi/ /lo legs 'bras bu g.yur du za gyur te/ /lha rnams dga' ba'i char chen gnas 'dir phob/ /123

mthar phyin tshogs 'du'i thog gi gtam bshad/da lor mthar phyin pa'i 'dzin grwa khag gis rang rang so so'i ched sbyong gtsor byas pa'i sbyong bya rnams mjug rdzogs pa ste/ si bod slob grwa'i slob khrid 'char 'god de phal cher 'grub pa dang / de bzhin gshis spyod dang byang tshad/spus ka sogs phyogs gang thad nas kyang yar thon yong yod/ slob ma 'di dag si bod slob grwar thog mar thon skabs rgya yig dang grangs dngos rdzas sogs tog tsam las chen po mi shes pa dang / bod yig kyang brda dag tsam las sbyong ma myong mkhan sha stag yin la/ lhag par du phyogs 'dus dge 'os 'dzin grwa'i slob ma rnams dang thog slob grwar 'dir slebs skabs rgya yig rgya skad shes pa las/ bod rigs rang gi spyi'i skad yig mi shes mkhan sha stag yin/ da lta bod skad yig dpyis phyin pa mkhyen la srol rgyun goms gshis kyang rtogs pa dang / rtsom yig 'bri ba sogs la'ang byang cha chen po thob yod/ de min mthar phyin 'dzin grwa 'di dag gis da lta bod kyi rig gzhung chen mo dag la blo yi 'jug pa yangs por chags par ma zad rgya yig kyang rgyun spyod skor rnams phal cher shes tshar/slob ma 'di dag pha ma dang kha bral ba'i thog ma slob grwa 'dir thon skabs drin sbyin pa'i pha ma dang / yid nye ba'i gnyen grogs/ skyed bsrings pa'i pha yul bcas dran thengs re la mchi ma re shor mkhan phal che yin/ rgyu mtshan gang yin zer na/ de ni khor yug dang mi sna/ shes rig sogs gsar ba mang bo dang thug pas/ sa mtha'i mthong goms med pa'i tshor ba rnon pos 'jigs 124

skrag tsha gsum snying la reg stabs dran gdung gi mig chu shor ba red/ pha yul gcig pa'i slob ma la 'brel 'dris byed pa ma gtogs yul lung tha dad kyi slob ma la rgyang chad byas te ma 'dres bar dogs zon 'dra byed kyin 'dug gzhan yang bod gos dang rgya gos/ nub gos gang zhig yin na'ang 'dra chags po zhig gon shes kyi med/ rang gi gtam la zhe tshig med par ma zad gzhan gyis rang la zhe tshig sbyar na'ang ngo tsha mkhan zhig yin/ spyir slob chung dge rgan dang slob 'bring dge rgan rnam pas dka' ba khyad du bsad/ ngal ba dang du blangs/sha snag rus la phab/ nyin mtshan bar ma chad par sha thang thang gis spyod yon gnyis spel gyi slob gso byas rung da dung sa phyogs ring lugs dang / gshis gyong ring lugs kyang yod/ da lta'i dus 'dir slob ma'i spus tshad dang byang tshad bcas tshad mthon por slebs yod stabs/ phyogs dang gshis de dag med par spyi yi mi zhig tu gyur ba dang / spyi yi 'gan khur can du gyur yod/gtam bshad lugs/ gos gon lugs/ za ma bza' lugs sogs gang gi thad nas bshad rung / byang tshad mtho la ji5 rabs spyod bzang gi mi zhig tu mngon/ khyad par du bsam blo'i byang tshad phul du phyin pas sger sems can cung tsam dang spyi sems can mang tsam yod mkhan zhig tu gyur/ ma gzhi slob ma ni bzo grwa nas thon pa'i thon rdzas dang 'dra ba zhig yin/ bzo grwa nas thon pa'i thon rdzas de la spus ka tshad ldan zhig yod na de la rin gong gi tshad chen po byas rung nyo mkhan yod nges/ gal te thon rdzas kyi spus ka ches zhan na btsong na rin mi khug sbyin na ngo med zer ba de yong gi yod/ dpe de'i cha nas nga tsho slob grwa ni bzo grwa dang / slob ma ni thon rdzas a na ma na red/ 'on kyang slob ma bskyar gso byed pa ni spyod yon gnyis ka bskyar gso byed pa yin/ de ni mgar bas mgar rgyu med la blug pas blug rgyu med/ de ni thogs reg med pa'i las don zhig yin pas de'i cha nas mi 'dra/ khyad par du slob ma la shes 125

yon slob rgyu ni sla la/ gshis ngan bcos rgyu ni dka'/ de 'chos pa la zhi rgyas dbang drag gi mdzad pa bzhis lo zla mang po la skyong dgos pa zhig yin/ nga tsho'i slob ma 'di dag spus ka can zhig yin min spyi tshogs dang phrad dus go thub/ si bod slob grwa'i dge rgan 'di 'dra mang bo zhig gis lo zla de 'dra mang bo'i nang du rang rgyud na yod pa'i mthong thos myong gsum gyi shes rig de sprad zin/ de nyid spyi tshogs 'gal 'du'i phung bo'i nang bed spyod dgos/ de la 'gal rkyen gyi dug dang / phan rkyen gyi sman sogs sna tshogs shig dang 'phrad srid pas/ 'gal rkyen dang 'phrad na phyi bshol med pa/ phan rkyen dang 'phrad na nga rgyal med pa zhig yin dgos/ khyad par du bdag cag gi ston pas/'dul ba yul dus dang bstun dgos gsungs pa ltar/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang spyi tshogs dang dus rabs la bstun rgyu ni gal che/ spyir rang tshugs 'dzin los dgos/ rang tshugs med pa'i mi ni khyi 'khyar dang 'dra bas gar yang mi phyin/ 'on kyang rang tshugs 'dzin pa de yang legs nyes zhib 'jug byas mthar chod don thog tu rang tshugs 'dzin dgos pa las/ ci yin 'di yin med cing rgyu mtshan gang yang med par 'di yin zer nas sra mkhregs kyis u tshugs byas na/ de la shes yon pa'i dri tsam yang mi bro bar ma zad rjes lus kyi rtags bstan pa yin/khyed rnam pas ma thon ma 'jon pa byung ba'i tshe slob grwa la sdug yus mi 'bor zhing / ma thon ma 'jon pa de brtson 'grus kyi skul mar sgyur ba dang /ma yum slob grwa la'ang khyim tshang gang gi mi dang / ra ba gang gi nor zer ba ltar/'du shes legs po zhig bzung ste 'dzem med kyis bsam 'char 'don dgos/dge rgan rnam pas rgyun du slob khrid byed skabs rten 'brel de gtso gnad du brtsis nas bshad kyi yod/ de bzhin khyed rnam pas rten 'brel la yid ches gnang dang / rten 'brel gyi 'gro lam du rgyu ba las/ pha 'thug po/126

ma gnyan po/ rgyab ri brag rtse mo mdung 'dra ba sogs yod snyam nas sos dal bag phebs byed mi rung ma gtogs/ 'thug po srab po dang / gnyan po gnyom po gyur/ brag tha skya dang / mdung khab tu gyur dus/ khyed rang mgon med skyabs med du lus nges/yang slob ma la las nga ma gtogs mi med/ 'phongs 'go ma gtogs sha med bsam nas/ rang nyid gcig pus sto/nga gsum kha lo sgyur/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon/ rlabs chen gyi bya ba ngas sgrub zer nas/ mthon po'i ri dang dma' mo'i rong gang la yang mi blta/ rten 'brel gyi lam du mi 'gro bar/'jig rten byed po tshangs pa bzhin/ rang nyid gcig pus bya ba thams cad sgrub 'dod shar ba ni pham kha khur ba las gang yang mi thon/ gong ma bkur zhing / 'og ma skyong ba/ rang 'dra dang 'grogs shes pa'i rten 'brel gal che/rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag 'di yag por shes na/ rang nyid rang gi mgon yin pa'ang shes la/ rang nyid gcig pus don kun sgrub mi thub pa'ang shes thub pas las don thams cad kyang phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'grub thub/ rten 'brel gyi mdun du dpa' bo'i dpung dang / mkhas pa'i kha/ nor gyi bslu brid sogs gang gis kyang btsan shed bskyed sa med/ 'di na tshig thag bcad nas bshad na rten 'brel gyis 'jig rten legs par byed pa yin/bod yig slob grwa btsugs nas bzung deng gi bar du khyad chos dra ma 'di dag yod de/ (gcig) mthun sgril te sa khul phyogs ris dang grub mtha'i chags sdang sogs kyi 'gro lam med/ (gnyis/) goms gshis bzang bo ste mthon po'i dbang dang / nor gyi rngam brjid/ mdzes ma'i gzugs dang /zhim po'i zas sogs gang zhig ldan yang mgo 'phang mtho sa med/ gang yang med pa'i sprang bo zhig yin rung dma' mi dgos/ gang yin zer na spyod yon gnyis ldan gyi slob ma yin na mthong chen dang gus bkur yod/ bod kyi dpe 127

la/ bu rang la yon tan yod na dga' ldan khri la bdag po med zer ba'i dpe de 'di na lag bstar byed kyi yod/ (gsum/) shes rig ste srol rgyun rig gnas kyi gzhi rtsa brtan la/ deng rabs rig gnas kyi lam sna khrid de/ slob grwa'i gzi brjid 'bar bzhin yod/re ba kha shas 'don na/ las khungs gang du bya bas gang zhig sgrub rung /'bur du thon pa'i byas rjes bzhag pa/ shes rig la ngoms med kyis rang sbyong byed pa/ kha bshad don la gnas pa'i bden don gyi bya ba bsgrub rgyu/ phyogs gshis ring lugs dang 'khyog spyod ring lugs la dug ltar 'dzem pa/ spyi don sgrub ci nus byed rgyu/ ya rabs kyi gshis spyod rgyun 'khyongs byed pa/ khyad par du/ 'dzam gling dang / ma 'ongs pa/ deng rabs can bcas la kha phyogs dgos pa las/ blo khab mig ltar dog / rang mthong khron pa'i sbal ba ltar che ba bcas ni mi rung / mjug tu/ mthar phyin slob ma rnams kyi bsam don yid bzhin 'grub cing / phyag las la bar chad med pa/ phyis sdod slob ma yongs rdzogs na nad tsha gsum med pa/ slob sbyong la sngar las kyang brtson par byed pa'i smon 'dun sdon/ /128

mkhas pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/de yang tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ lus kyi phul byung 'grib med pa/ / blo yi byed pa'i khyad par gyis/ / shes rab la sogs phul byung dang / / 'grib pa dag tu gyur pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar shes rab bzang ngan ni blo la rag las pa yin gyi gzugs bzang ngan dang / na tshod che chung / lus stobs rgyas min la mi ltos pa'i tshul shes dgos/ de lta sdithu'i shes rab can gyi mkhas pa de yang ji lta bu zhig dgos zer na/ de yang ba/ skya'i legs bshad las/ yon tan skyon gnyis sus kyang gsal/ / 'dres pa 'byed shes mkhas pa yin/ /chu las 'o ma ngang bas phyed/ / ba las 'o ma kun gyis longs/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan dang skyon/ bzang phyogs dang ngan phyogs sogs 'gal ba'i phung bo 'dres ma rnyog 'dzing can gyi dka' gnad de tshul bzhin dbye 'byed shes pa ni mkhas pa yin gsungs/ de bzhin shes rab kyi go don 'chad skabs/gzhung chen po dag las/ shes rab ni brtags pa'i chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa ste som nyi zlog pa'i las can no zhes gsungs/ de ltar na gzhung chen po de dag tu dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig gis mkhas pa zhes pa de ji 'dra zhig dgos pa'i thad la gsal thag chod kyi gnad la 'khel ba'i mdzub mo btsugs 'dug 129

dang po/ gnad bsdus te bshad pa/ chos rnams la dbye 'byed kyi nus pa rgyun ldan de mkhas pa yin zer chog ste/ shes rab yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang chos kun la mkhas dgos pa'i khyab pa med de/ bye brag gi chos gcig la mkhas rung mkhas pa yin/ de yang sa skya'i legs bshad las/ mkhas gang shes bya'i don kho na/ / ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ / bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes na/ / de yang de la mkhas pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pas shes bya thams cad shes na mkhas pa yin pa bshad ci dgos/ / shes bya phyogs gcig shes na yang mkhas pa yin zhes pa'i don yin no/ / yang deng sang mkhas blun mang po zhig gis mkhas pa'i tshad gzhi mi 'dra ba du ma zhig spang la me tog bkra ba bzhin gang shar shar gyis gleng brjod byed pa'i dus 'dir so so la rgyu mtshan ci rigs shig yod rung /gzhung bka' pod lnga shes mkhan zhig kho na la mkhas par 'dod pa'i tshul gcig snang / de ni ston pa'i bstan pa la dad gus che zhing / ya rabs rkang bzang btsun tshugs can gyi la rgya yin yang / phyogs lhung las brgal mi thub pa'i gang zag gi rigs su snang / gang zag de rigs kyis thun mong rig gnas la mthong chung byed pa dang / thun mong rig gnas shes pa'i gang zag rnams mkhas gral du mi 'jog cing brnyas bcos byed kyi yod/ de dag gis sa skya'i legs bshad las shes bya kun gyi gnas lugs shes pa la mkhas par 'dod pa'i tshul gcig dang / bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa la mkhas par 'dod tshul gnyis ka ring du dor ba'i lugs su snang ste/ legs bshad las 130

shes bya'i gnas lugs shes pa la mkhas pa 'dod pa gang zhig khyed kyis gzhung lnga shes na mkhas pa 'dod pa las/ gzhan mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin legs bshad las/ bye brag sbyangs pa'i don shes pa la mkhas par 'dod pa gang zhig khyed kyis gzhung bka' pod lnga shes mkhan kho na la mkhas pa 'dod pa gang zhig bye brag gzhan shes rung mkhas par mi 'dod pa'i phyir/yang 'gas ni gzhung bka' pod lnga bo la ris mal ris rgyug gi 'grel bshad byed shes pa la mkhas par 'dod/ ma gzhi ris mal ris rgyug gi don de gzhung 'chad po'i slob dpon gyi ngag khrid ltar shes pa tsam la ngos 'dzin na de ni las sla ba ma zad/ ne tsos kha ton bton pa bzhin gzhan zer rjes zlos kyi rnam thar 'chang ba'i lugs su snang / de yang 'ju mi pham pas nges shes sgron mer/ gzhan zer rjes su zlos la mkhas pas ci/ rang gi rnam par dpyod pa bag phob la/ / dris pa'i lan 'di nye bar ldon mdzod dang / / nang gi rnam daphyod mthong ba bzhin du gsal/ / zhes rnam dpyod kyi blo yi 'jug pa zhib cing phra la/ gang dang gang dris pa la spu ris 'byed pa'i nus pa zhig dgos tshul gsungs/ yang ris mal ris rgyug gi go don ni rtsa ba'i gzhung rtsom pa po'i dgongs don ji bzhin shes pa zhig la 'dod na/ de ni shin tu dka' ba'i rigs su snang ste/ rtsa ba'i gzhung rtsom po'i dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs dgos na ston pa shākya thub pa'i dgongs don ji bzhin rtogs par khas len dgos/ de khas len na grub mtha' mi 'dra ba du ma zhig 'gyur don gang na yod/ lo stong phrag du mar zhib 'jug byas rung / dgongs don phyin ci ma log pa zhig shes dka' ste/ sngon byon mkhas pa tshos kyang de yi dgongs don ji bzhin gtan la phab ma thub nas rgya gar du nang pa la grub mtha' chen po bzhi dang bod du yang sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad sogs so sor gyes so/ / de yang 'phags pa'i dgongs pa ni ljoridi yin/ zhes lta bas gtan la 131

'bebs tshul/ sgom pas nyams su len lugs/ mthar thug grub pa'i 'bras bu bcas rang dbang rang tshugs kyi grub mtha' mi 'dra ba re byas te so sor gyur/ der brten/ 'di ltar 'dod tshul 'di yang ches dka' ba'i rigs su snang / gang ltar gzhung bka' pod lnga ma shes rung mkhas pa'i gral du 'dug 'os rigs ni gang mang yod/ deng dus yongs grags kyi mkhas pa'i thob thang sprad lugs la bltas na/ 'gro ba mi yi rigs la phan 'dogs pa'i las rigs gang la 'bur du thon pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin tshe thob de len chog chog tu yod pas/ mkhas pa'i thob dang bstun pa'i 'gan dbang sprad cing / mthong chen dang gus bkur zhu rung ba yin/ 'on te dam chos shes pa kho na la mkhas par 'dzin zhing 'jig rten shes pa la ma rabs dang tha chad la rtsis pa ni rgya gar bas rigs bzhi las gdol ba'i rigs tha chad dang ma rabs su brtsis te gnya' gnon dang bka' bkyon byed cing g.yog la bkol ba dang khyad par ma mthong / dpe cha ni dngos gnas dpe zhig red/ dpe des gang la yang rigs 'gre shes par byas te/ shes bya la 'jug dgos/ dpe cha de nyid kyis gang la yang mdzub ston byed thub pa'i bsam blo ni gtong mi rung / 'on kyang shes bya la shes byed 'jug pa 'tsham min gyi khyad par ni gnam sa ltar mchis/dper na gang zag kha cig ni dpe cha'i khrod du mi tshe gtong rung yar bskyed thon du med par shing skam chu la sbang ba bzhin no/ / yang brda tsam bstan pas tshegs med kyis shes rig mkhyen pa'i gang zag kyang 'dug / sbyangs pa sngon song ngam 'phral sbyong gi 'bras bu gang zhig yin rung rnam dpyod kyi rig pa dang ldan na mkhas pa yin no/ / dpe mtshon zhig bkod na/ nyan shul mkhyen rab 'od gsal ni rnam dpyod kyi rig pa zab gsal myur gsum 'dzoms pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin/ de yang legs bshad las/ mkhas pa yon tan kun bslab pa/ / mthar phyin gcig gis 'jig rten gsal/ / zhes pa dang 132

mtshungs kyi yod/ khong gis shes rig gi bgro gleng byed skabs dpe cha'i khrod du mi tshe gtong ba'i mkhas pa grags can de cho las kyang tshad rgal gyi blo stobs yod pa yin/ de las ldog par/ dgos dus bu med/ sbos dus phyen med zer ba ltar gnas tshul gsar ba zhig dang gdong thug dus/ mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin dgos byung na/ mkhas pa de rigs ni sems pham dgos pa zhig red/gnyis pa/ mkhas pa'i tshul bshad pa/ —'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ni mkhas pa'i tshul yin/ deng dus bod 'dir bshad na 'chad rtsod kyi bya ba spel mkhan grangs ha cang mang rung / tshan rig gi rig gzhung dang dpal 'byor rig pa sogs la 'chad rtsod byed mkhan nyung /de las kyang rtsom pa po ni nyin mo'i skar ma ltar ches dkon po zhig red/mkhas grags can gyi skyes chen 'ga' zhig gis yig skur tsam bris pa la yang blo rig gi bu ga la mun pas 'tshangs pa ltar dog por chags yod/ yongs grags su mkhas pa'i tshul dang ldan pa zhes pa de 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum shes pa zhig la zer/ gal te 'chad rtsod kho na las rtsom pa ma shes na dbang po skyon can bzhin mkhas pa'i tshul ma tshang ba shes dgos/ deng dus rang ming tsam yang 'bri mi shes pa'i gang zag 'ga' mkhas pa'i gral du 'jog tshe gzhan rigs kyi mkhas pa dag ni kha dgod khog nas 'chor bzhin yod/ 'di rigs ni shin tu gzab gal che snyam/ rgyal khams spyi 'gros ltar bshad na mkhas pa'i gral du 'jog mi 'jog mkhas rim gyi go ming tshang ma dpyad rtsom gyi rin thang gis dbye 'byed byed kyin yod/ pe cin du rab 'byams yon sbyong phebs pa'i phyi 133

gling ba zhig gis sa lu ljang pa'i mdo la dpyad rtsom ldeb bzhi bcu tsam yod pa zhig bris pa la mkhas dbang chen po dag gis dpyad gleng byas mthar rab 'byams pa'i dpyad rtsom du brtsis te go ming yang sprad 'dug tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar mthar phyin dpyad rtsom zhes slob grwa che 'bring khag las mthar phyin skabs lag khyer lon min gtso bo dpyad rtsom gyi rin thang la lta ba dang / dpyad rtsom gdeng 'jog gnang lugs la thug yod/ gzhan yang 'bring rim dge rgan dang mtho rim dge rgan/ slob dpon chen po rgan gzhon gyi go rim/ rab 'byams pa'i thob kun kyang dpyad rtsom gyi rin thang gis gtso bo tshad 'dzin byed kyi yod/ po ti brag ri 'dra mang bo sbyong rung po ti dpe khri'i thog tu bzhag rjes blo rig la gnyid 'thibs pa bzhin dran rgyu gang yang med pa'i mkhas pa de yang sems pham dgos pa zhig red/ ma gzhi mkhas pa'i tshul gsum las rtsom pa de dka' tshegs che ba'i ngal rtsol zhig yin/ khyad par du bstan bcos rtsom pa po de rab chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba/ 'bring yi dam lhag pa'i lha yis zhal gzigs pa/ mtha' ma yang rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa zhig yin dgos gsungs pas kyang zhib cha che/ rgya gar du bstan bcos gsar ba re brtsams tshar ba dang mkhas pa'i mdun sar bshams dgos/ gal te bstan bcos yang dag tu 'dug na bsngags brjod kyi me tog 'thor zhing mkhas pa'i gtsug tu bkur/ bstan bcos log par 'dug na dpe cha de mer bsregs pa dang / tshogs pa'i dbus nas rtsom pa po gnas dbyung gtong ba dang / dril bsgrags tshabs chen byed pa sogs zhib cha ha cang che/ ji skad du/ gang phyir mkhas pa'i las gsum las/ 'chad rtsod ngag la ma nges pa/ / srid phyir ma 'khrul rtsom pa ste/ / zhes gsungs pa yang gnad de dag la dgongs pa red/ yang deng sang mkhas pa'i ming grags la re nas u tshugs can de rigs kyis bris pa'i rtsom deb nang na sa bshad rdo bshad kyis sa 134

rdo 'dres pa'i nas bzhin spyod sgo med pa du ma zhig snang / yang gang zag 'ga' zhig gis sngon gyi mkhas pa'i gsung de dag dpe bshu byas te gzhan nor rang gis len gyin yod/ de dag klog bde ba dang dpe rgyun yun ring gnas par byed pa'i dgos pa yod na ma gtogs dge mtshan gzhan yod par ma snang /der brten rtsom pa po la tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen mang stabs/ cha rkyen tshang ni dkon po red/ rtsom pa thams cad rtsom pa ri/na zer ba'i gtam de bden par 'dug go/ sdeb sgrib byas te sngon byon mkhas pa'i rtsom dang deng rabs kyi 'phrul las thon pa'i gsar dar rig pa gnyis mthun sbyor byed shes na ches mdzes par snang / ma zad sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsung gis ma 'ongs gnas tshul ra sprod byed shes na de las kyang mdzes par snang / rgyu mtshan 'di la brten nas ma'o tse tung gis gang zag 'gas dpe deb re bzos pa la ha las las byed mkhan de ni blun po yin pa'i rtags red ces bshad/ der brten dpe deb bzos pa la ha las rgyu ci yod/ sangs rgyas kyis gang zag la mi rton chos la rton/ tshig la mi rton don la rton dgos gsungs pa ltar brjod don gnad du 'dzin te rin thang yod med la ba rtag dgos/ don snying med pa'i rtsom deb de dag ni bla srog med pa'i mdzes ma bzhin du dgos nus med do/ /135

hor rong pa tsha'i gling gi mdzad rjes skor gleng ba/rang sde'i rigs la bu ltar brtse bas dgongs/ /rgol ba 'joms la rdo rje'i thog ltar ngar/ /srid pa gsum na zla med dpa' bo mchog /gling rje mi yi nor bus shis par stsol/ /'di na mi yi nor bu gling rje ge sar skor/ /shes rig bgro gleng mkhas brgyas byed dus 'dir/ /rang skal chad la dogs pa'i skul 'ded kyis/ /zhib mo blo yis 'jug pa'i khur 'di blangs/ /dang po/ ge sar gyi sgrung ni bod shes rig gi ma lag gtso bo zhig yin/de yang spyir gling gi dpal rtul brgyad cu/ phu nu sum cu sogs kyi mdzad rjes de dag dmangs khrod du khyab pa'i gtam rgyud dang / yig thog gi lo rgyus sogs ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs bkra ba ltar phyogs mtshams kun tu khyab nas yod/ de dag las kyang khyad par du ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad rjes ni rlabs che ba gzi brjid ldan pa zhig yin par ma zad sa khul so sor ge sar gyi shes rig 136

gis ma khyab pa med pa dang / ge sar gyi bstan pa dar ba'i rtags khyad par can re med pa'i sa zhig mi rnyed pa lta bu zhig yin/ ge sar gyi 'khrungs yul la bshad na/ khams sde dge'i a phyug gling yin pa ni 'khrungs gling me tog ra ba nas bshad pa dang sbrags tshe ji bzhin don 9pa 'byor ba zhig yin/ (de yang phran gyis bris pa'i 〈ge sar gyi 'khrungs yul je bzhin bshad pa〉zhes par cung gsal bo zhig zhus yod) de yang bdag kyang a phyug gling gi tshar tshar dgon du skor ma gsum bzhi la dpe khrid du song zhing / khrid yun yang ring la khrid rgyu'i dpe cha'i grangs kyang mang / de'i ring la 'khrungs gling nas bshad pa'i sa rtags chu rtags dang don dngos sbyar nas bltas pas ge sar 'khrungs yul 'di min na gang yin snyam pa zhig 'dug khyad par du gna' nas deng gi bar lha sras dgra lha'i rgyud par grags pa'i gling tshang gi rgyal rabs tshang ma yang a phyug gling gi ge sar lha khang nang gser khri mnga' gsol byed srol yod/ 'di ni ge sar 'khrungs yul yin pa'i rtags khyad par can du kun gyis brtsi/ ge sar zhib 'jug gi las don 'di kha sang de ring gzhi nas dar ba zhig min la/zhib 'jug gi dus tshod snga ba/ zhib 'jug gi rin thang ldan pa/ zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu bzang ba zhig yin/ dper na rgyal nang la bshad na krung dbyang nas rdzong rim pa'i bar du ge sar zhib 'jug gzhung las khang btsugs pa dang /slob grwa che khag rnams su yang ge sar zhib 'jug ched 'dzugs byas te ched sbyong gi lha rams pa'ang yod/ deng gi char ge sar skor 'di rgyal nang du shes rig rlabs chen du brtsis pa ma zad 'dzam gling gi shes rig bang mdzod du yang med du mi rung ba zhig chags pa red/ ge sar sgrung 'di 'dzam gling na ches ring ba'i lo rgyus snyan rtsom yin pa ni yongs la rlung ltar grags pa red/ge sar sgrung 'di bshad bde ba/ tshig snyan pa/ sbyor legs pa/ gson nyams ldan pa/ ma nor lam ston gyi bslab bya mang ba/ dngos yod 'tsho ba 137

mtshon thabs bzang ba sogs dge mtshan brgya phrag mang bos phyug pa zhig yin/bltas na mig gi longs spyod/ nyan na rna ba'i longs spyod/ bsam na sems kyi longs spyod du gyur bas bod rigs mi dmangs kyi khrod na khyab rgya che la/chod che ba'i go sa bzung yod/ khyad par du ge sar sgrung 'dis bod mi dmangs kyi bsam blo dang / bya spyod/ las don sogs phyogs yongs nas yar thon yong bar skul 'ded thebs pa dang / bod kyi rig gnas che chung bcu dang mi 'dra zhing ge sar sgrung 'di bod kyi zhing 'brog mi ser dkyus ma ste yig ngo mi shes mkhan tshos kyang ji bzhin nyan bshad shes kyi yod pas ge sar sgrung gi rig gnas ni bod spyi ba'i rig gnas shig yin/ ge sar sgrung las jo ru ste ge sar thog mar ma gcig bu gcig yin pa/ sbra 'thas po zhig dang 'bri gcig sogs 'tsho ba skyo bo yin pa la/ rim bzhin rang gi 'jon nus kyis gling gi bdag por gyur ba ma zad/ phyi dgra mgo 'jom pa'i tho ba dang / nang gnyom chung skyong ba'i pha mar gyur/ skad cha 'dis bu skyes na dga' ldan khri la bdag po med zer ba dang / gri bzang bo ko shubs nang na yod/ mi bzang bo gos hrul nang na yod zer ba'i dpe dang 'byor ba'i don zhig bstan gyi yod/de ltar na don 'dis bod rigs mi dmangs khrod na 'khos ka zhan pa/ mig lam du med pa'i dman pa dag la yang snying stobs kyi slob gso spel te ngar bskyed pa dang / re ba'i kho thag ma chad de spobs pa dgu 'gyur skye bar byas/jo ru lha las chad pa dang / jo ru la lhas rogs gnang tshul bshad pa ni/ phyis su dad pa can 'gas bsres pa'i kha gsab kyi gtam zhig min nam snyam/ ma gzhi gling gi yul na ge sar 'khrungs dus kha drag can dang / 'byor ldan/dpung ldan sogs brjid che ba mang rung / ge sar rang nyid kyi hur thag gis dka' tshegs dang du blangs te dmigs pa chen pos las la sbyar te kun gyi yang rtser 'dzegs pa'o/ /138

'di nas ge sar yod med dang dngos yod kyi mi zhig yin min skor la rags tsam zhig dpyad par 'dod pa la/ de yang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/gangs kyi seng ge gar yang ma mchis shing / ge sar rgyal po gud du mi bzhugs mod/ / sgro btags sems la dngos su snang ba 'di/ / snyan tshig sgra yi brjod bya cis mi rung / / zhes gsungs pa la/ 'grel bshad mkhan po mang shos kyis/dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis ge sar med par 'dod pa dang / de bzhin gangs seng yang med ces bshad 'dug zer/ phran gyis lta tshul lam 'grel tshul ni/gangs seng yod med skor la dge chos nyid kyis gsal bshad gnang ba ni 'di ltar/ gangs dang ldan pa'i nags kyi tshal na gnas pa'i seng ge la gangs seng zer zhes gsal bar gsungs pas gangs seng ngos 'dzin tshul mi 'dra ba tsam las gangs seng med ces ma gsungs/ de bzhin ge sar yang gud du 'am logs shig na sgrung nang bshad pa lta bu'i rlabs chen po brjid che ba lha klu gnyan gsum grogs su sbon mkhan zhig med pa la/ mi dkyus ma zhig yod pa ni shin tu 'dod pa'i gtam zhig snang / 'on kyang sgrung nas bshad pa nang bzhin zhig med tshul ni snyan tshig gis rgyan pa red ces dngos su gsungs pas go thub kyi 'dugage sar sgrung 'dis rig gnas dar rgyas yong ba la skul 'ded chen po byas yod/ bod kyi spyi tshogs khrod na ge sar sgrung nyan bshad byed pa ni bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba dang bo'i gral la yod pa zhig yin/ nam rgyun pha ma dang zhang bo de dag gi bu tsha dag la/ yi ge sbyangs nas sgrung bshad shes pa zhig byung na 'grig gi red zer gyin yod/ de ltar na sgrung bshad pa dang klog thub pa'i ched yi ge sbyong ba dang / yi ge shes nas sgrung klog bshad byas te so so'i rig gnas chu tshad je mthor 'gro yi yod/ khyad par du sgrung gi rig pa la brten nas 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul shes pa ma zad rtsom rig dag kyang shugs la shes pa 139
