dang / dpe gson nyams ldan pa de dag gis kyang gtam la rgyan cha phun sum tshogs pa zhig spras nas/ spro skyid kyi 'tsho ba'i 'od rlabs shig 'khyil gyi yod/ge sar sgrung 'di'i sgyu rtsal la bshad na/ dga' ba bskyed pa'i sgyu rtsal/yid 'phrog pa'i sgyu rtsal/ skyo ba bskyed pa'i sgyu rtsal/ dpa' bskyed pa'i sgyu rtsal/ sems bde ba'i sgyu rtsal/ 'tsho ba shes byed kyi sgyu rtsal sogs sgyu rtsal phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom rig cig yin/ ge sar sgrung phal che ba de rang byung rig pa'i rtsal las brdol ba las nan gyis btsan sbyar byas pa min pas/ snga phyi 'brel chags pa/ tshig sbyor sdeb legs pa/ lhun chags pa/ rang bab kyi nyams dang ldan pa'i dge mtshan yod/dmag don kyi rig pa ni de las kyang shugs che ba zhig bstan yod de/'thab pa'i bkod pa/ 'gro ldog gi tshod 'dzin/ dpa' bor bya dga' ster lugs/ sdar ma la chad pa gcod tshul/ mdor na dmag bkod byed lugs rnams tshig don phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas bstan yod/ ge sar sgrung las dpal 'byor la mthong chen gnang tshul bstan pa ni/ rdzong khag so so phab dus rdzong de'i nor sogs blangs pa yang / dper na gru gu go rdzong / sum pa mdzo rdzong / kha che ra rdzong / mi nub dar rdzong / sog po khyi rdzong / mi nyag g.yu rdzong / stag gzig nor rdzong / rgya nag ja rdzong / rim bzhin go mtshon dang /mdzo/ ra/ dar/ khyi/ g.yu/ nor/ ja sogs kyi rdzong phab ste phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal la rol bar byas/140

gnyis pa/ khrad par hor rong pa tsha dang 'brel ba'i ge sar gyi ri ga gnas/dkar mdzes rdzong nas yar le dbar sum cu dang sde dge a phyug nas mar le dbar brgya dang sum cu tsam gyi mtshams su chags pa'i sa gnas de la hor rong pa tsha zer/ 'di na gnas pa'i mi sde dag gis kyang ge sar gling sgrung la mthong chen gnang ba ma zad sgrung phal che blo la bshad thub mkhan mang /khyad par du sa gnas 'di'i dmangs tshogs dag gis sgrung la ches dga' bo gnang ba dang / sgrung nyan bshad kyi bstan pa rgya che dar gyi yod pa la rgyu mtshan nges can zhig yod pa ste/ nga tshos dpyad pa gsum gyis tshul bzhin gzhal na gling ge sar dang 'brel yod kyi bstan pa mang bo zhig gnas 'di nas spel yod pa mthong gi 'dug de yang spyir gnas 'di la rong pa tsha zhes sngon nas grags/ming 'di la 'grel bshad mi 'dra ba gnyis 'dug bshad tshul gcig ni sde chen po 'di rong pa yin zhing / rtags khyad par can gyi tsha chu zhig kyang yod pas rong pa tsha zer zhes pa dang / yang bshad tshul gcig ni hor rong tsha dmar legs phyogs 'dir byon myong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis hor rong pa tsha zhes bshad/ gang ltar gnas 'di na gling dang hor gyi bstan pa dar ba'i lo rgyus ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mang / dper na hor ser khag lnga ste/ rta'u/brag 'go tre bo/ dkar mdzes/ stong skor lnga la zer gyin yod/ de ltar na gnas 'di la tre hor rong pa tsha zhes sngon nas deng bar grags pas hor gyi bstan pa dar yod kho thag red/ hor la yang hor ser dang hor nag hor dkar gsum du phye ba ni kun gyis shes/ de bas ma zad hor sde yod pa nang 141

bzhin gling sde yang 'di na yod pa ni/ rten 'brel lam ltos grub yin pa red/de yang yin te/ dper na rong pa tsha zhes pa'i skabs su rta chu zhes pa'i gtsang chu zhig yod la de'i yan chad la zer ba dang / rta chu man chad la gling tshang phyogs bzhi zer ba zhig yod/ de yang ma smad phyogs pa/ re mgo phyogs pa/mkhar sgang phyogs pa/ nor 'dzin phyogs pa ste bzhi/ 'di'i gling tshang zhes pa de ge sar gling gi rgyud pa min nam snyam/ gang yin zer na sa gnas 'di na hor zhes pa zhig dang gling zhes pa zhig yod tshul la bltas na hor gling zhes ches 'os shing 'tsham po 'dug gcig byas na gling gis sa gnas 'di bzung nas hor dang 'khrugs pa bkyed ba zhig min nam snyam/ sngon nas deng gi bar g.yul gang du 'gyed na der sa gzung dgos pa ni 'gro lugs shig red/ yang rong pa tsha rang na 'dan ma khag ces pa'i grong sde zhig yod/ deng ming 'di sde shog la btags nas 'dan ma sde shog zer gyin yod/ 'di'i 'dan ma zer ba 'di sngon dud tshang gcig gi dud ming red 'dug dud tshang 'di la 'dan ma dbang chen zer ba gcig dang / de rjes 'dan ma rig 'dzin/ pad rdor zer ba gnyis byung ba dang / de rjes 'dan ma ya lu dang nyi dga'/ rdo gces zer ba gsum byung / 'di'i khyim rgyud du skyes pa'i bu dag ni/ gzugs mtho la pho sgo yag pa/ snying yod la dpa' shed che ba sha stag byung bas kun gyis gzhi bdag gi bu red ces bshad srol 'dug de ltar na gling 'dan ma'i mi rgyud red zer na ngo tsha mi dgos pa zhig red/ 'on kyang phugs kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra yin min dpyad gzhi lags/ yang sus kyang bsnyon du med pa'i lo rgyus shig ni/ 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i tshe rabs las kyi rta pho ste/ 'do rje rkyang rgod de hor gyi gdong chen nya nya na yod tshul 'di ltar gsungs te/ de yang jo rus ma 'gog mo 'brug mo gnyis rta 'dzin du btang ba dang / khong gnyis kyang rta 'dzin du song bas/ sa bzang bo smon lam la kha nas phar bltas tshe/142

bod kyi pan ne ri ngos su/ rkyang la yan la la bkram/ lung yan thang la bkram/ri yan rtswa la g.yengs nas yod par zhib tu bltas pas gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'do rje rkyang rgod de/ sngon po g.yu yi rnga rngog pad+ma ra ga'i spu mdog spu rtse gzi mdangs lam mer/ mdun nas bltas na li ga ma thad du ker langs 'dra/rgyab nas bltas na rgod ngang bas spang zan 'thu 'dra/ zhum zhum wa mo'i khog smad la/ kyur kyur nya mo'i bshul 'dra yod pa/ sha rgyas shis kyi sgyid pa la/shang shang ma yi brang chung yod/ bar lhug bzhi na 'jur bzhi yod/ tshigs bzhi dang cha tshad mnyam pa rta gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i 'do ba'i gsang chen bcu gsum na bya khra khra spungs se yod pa 'brug mos/ mthong ste 'gog mo la glu blangs pa ni 'di ltar/ sa 'di sa ngo ma shes na/ sa bzang bo smon lam la kha red/thad phar la bltas dang ltad mo gda'/ rgyal po gdan la bzhugs 'dra'i ri/rgya yi kha sha smug ri zer/ hor gyi gdong chen nya nya dang / bod kyi pad ne ri yag red/ ri 'gor 'ja' sprin 'khrigs ker yod/ ri sked rtsi shing rgyas nas yod/ ri mtha' me tog bkra nas yod/ rkyang kha dkar ma brgya bu brgya lhan du gnas/ sogs gsungs pa las/ sa bzang po smon lam la kha de da lta rdzogs chen nas mar yong dus smug ri la zer ba de red/ smug ri la nas bltas dus hor gyi gdong chen nya nya 'di mthong gi yod/ de dus 'brug mos kyang smon lam la'am smug ri la nas gdong chen nya nya mthong ste/ 'gog mo la glu blangs pa zhig red/ bod kyi pad ne ri bkra zer don yang yar dbus lha sar 'gro dus kyi lam bar gyi ri mgo zhig nas mar bltas dus kyang ri mgo 'di mthong gi 'dug mthong tshul yang me tog pad+ma bkra ba lta bu'i ri zhig mthong bas red/de bzhin rgya yi kha sha smug ri zer don yang / rgya yul gyi ri mgo zhig nas ri 'di mthong ba dang / mthong tshul yang kha sha'i mdog dbyibs lta bu zhig mthong gi yod/ hor gyi gdong chen nya nya zer don yang / hor rong pa tsha bas ri 'di 143

gdong chen nya nya zer ba dang / ri yi 'gram nas bltas dus nya yi dbyibs lta bu zhig mthong bas red/ spyir 'do rje rkyang rgod thog ma yod sa'i ri 'di na yod dang de na yod ces bshad tshul ches mang / 'on kyang jo ru 'khrungs yul gyi sa gnas dang rong pa tsha'i bar gyi sa thag dang / gna' mi rgan po'i ngag sgros/ sa rtags chu rtags gang nas gzhigs rung ri 'di 'do rje rkyang rgod thog ma yod sa de red/ khyad par du hor rong pa tsha 'di na rta 'gros ma ches mang zhing / chab mdo/ rta'u/ skye rgu/ 'dan khag sogs sa gnas so so nas rta nyo bar ched phebs kyis rta rnams la gong chen po sprad nas nyo ba dang / der brten hor rong pa tsha ba'i gna' mi'i zhal rgyun la/ 'do rje rkyang rgod de gnas 'dir byung ba yin tsang 'di phyogs kyi rta rnams 'gros kha bzang la spus gtsang ba zhig yin zer/ gna' mi rgan po'i zhal rgyun bzhin 'do rje rkyang rgod kyi rgyud pa los yin snyam pa'i rin gong khri can gyi rta ches mang / dper na/ da lta rong pa tsha sger thog grong du rta rma bya zer ba zhig 'dug rta de la sgor mo khri gnyis sprad mkhan yod rung ma btsong ba red/ de ltar na rong pa tsha bas tshong las thams cad kyi nang nas rta yi tshong las de ches 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin yod pa ma zad/ rta la brten nas 'tsho ba skyel gyi yod zer chog pa zhig go/da dung gnas 'di na jo rus 'ur rdo gyis 'phangs pa'i rdo ya mtshan can dang / 'do rje rkyang rgod kyi zhabs rjes/ 'brug mo'i thab ka sogs sa gnas so so na ches mang zhing / de dag la gtam rgyud yag po bshad rgyu yod/ rjes su go skabs byung na dpar re rgyag na ches yag po red snyam/ de ltar ge sar lo rgyus 'di dar nas lo ngo stong phrag gcig 'khor ba'i dga' ston gyi dus 'dir lung pa so so dang yul gru so so nas ge sar skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gang mang zhig byung dus 'dir/ bdag gis kyang go skabs dam 'dzin gyis ge sar gling gi skor gyi gnas tshul rags bsdus 'di byas so/ /144
smras pa/ hor gling 'dres ma grong gi rgya mtsho nas/ /hor gling gnyis kyi mdzad rjes dri med nor/ /hor gling gang gi rigs yin ma nges pa'i/ /hor gling 'dres ma'i bu des 'di byas so/ /

khyi'i lo la btsan po skyi'i ra sa thang gi phyag sbal na bzhugs dus bka' bstsal ba'i gcigs kyi yi ge'i 'grel bshad mthong ba don ldan bzhugs/rtsa tshig 'di na su gang gis myi shes pa'i/ / g.yung drung lha yi rmu thag ring mo 'dis/ / mtha' myed chos dbyings rig pa'i dbyings su btags/ /rig pa'i bu chung lus kyi nang du btags/ lus kyi tho yor zas dang skom la btags/ / zas dang skom ni phyi rol yul la btags/ / de ltar thag pa gcig la gcig mthud pas/ / gcod pa'i sa mtshams gzhan ni yod ma yin/ / sa mtshams gcig ni kun gyis myi 'dod pa/ / lus sems 'brel thag chod pa'i 'chi ba nyid/ / sa mtshams gcig ni kun gyis myi shes pa/ /thag pa rul nas dbyings rig 'dres pa nyid/ / sems 'di mtha' dang bral ba'i lha mo ste/ / lha mo'i pha yul 'jig rten 'di min mod/ / sems kyi lha mo'i zhabs kyi mthe'u chung gcig / skud pas lus po 'di la dam du btags/ /de nas skud pa 'di nyid chad kyi bar/ / lus kyis gang myong sems kyis myong bar snang / / mthe'u chung bsdams pas lha mo 'ching bar snang / / mthe'u chung 'di la phan gnod gang byas kyang / / lha mo de la bde sdug myong bar zad/ /thag pa 'di de chad na legs mod kyang / thag pa chad par 'jig rten thams cad skrag / thag pas 'brel ba'i thabs la' 'bad pa' na'/ / thag pa'i sne kun tsher mas dkris par mthong / / tsher ma'i rtse mo re re 'gog slad du/ /shes rig las kyi rnam grangs re re bslab/ / des na tsher ma 'gog pa'i khral 146

las 'di/ / ma shi'i bar du brel bas byed par zad/ / tshar med spang du med pa'i brel ba 'di/ / kund kyi skye ba blangs pa'i don sgor snang / / mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems kyi cha shas gcig / sha khrag lus kyi 'dam du tshud pa na'/ / tsha grang bkras skom re dogs 'jig skrag gi / sdug bsngal 'di la zad mtha' myed pa snyam/ / 'on kyang 'bad : pa brgya yis bsgrub sgrub pa'i/ /shes rig dpal gyis spras pa'i lus po 'di/ / chos nyid gnam kyi rgyal mo'i bka' lung bzhin/ / sa steng 'di ru lo shas sdod par zad/ / mgur 'di skad ces blangs so/ /'grel bshad kyi thog ma'i mchod brjod ni/ / lhag bsam ke la sha ri'i rtse mo na/ /mkhyen pa chu 'dzin stug pos rab 'khyud de/ /rnam dpyod glog dmar rab tu 'khyug pa dang / /mi 'jigs dbyar rnga ldir ba'i dam pa lags/ /ngur smrig rnam gsum nor dang ma brje ba/ /gong ma'i ming la skyabs su ma mchi ba/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum zhal du ma gsol ba/ /chos pa bzang po khyed 'dra gang nas rnyed/ /ces tshigs su bcad pa 'gas mdun bsus te skabs bab kyi don ni mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis btson nas blangs ba'i mgur 'di la 'grel bshad cig yod na phan pa che tshul hor khang sras bsod nams dpal 'bar lags kyis gsungs 'dug pas des rkyen byas te lhag bsam rnam dag gis 'bri rgyu'i mos pa byung / spyir mkhas dbang 'di la sngar nas yid ches kyi dad pa rnam dag yod thog spyi lo 1991lor khrin tu'u nas hor khang sras la phran gyis dus tshod bzhi tsam gyi ring la dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gi lo rgyus 147

bka' 'dri zhus pas dus de nas bzung khyad par du mi ldog dad pa'i nyi ma zhig khog nas shar ro/ /de yang mgur 'di mkhas pa'i rtsom ltar yig mang gi glegs bam du yang mi 'dug dbu tshad seng ge'i mjings snol lta bu'i bsgrub bya sgrub byed kyi rtsod rigs kyang mi snang / phyag rdzogs dbu ma'i ming la dam 'dzin gnang ba'i grub mtha'i la rgya 'dzin pa dag gi lugs kyang ring du dor/ tshig sgros lhur len pa dang / tshig skyon la do snang ma byas par/ gang shar glo bur btson nas bris pa 'di don gyi go ba gtso bor byas pa zhig 'dug khyad par du deng dus chos lugs la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan rgyal phyi nang kun tu dbu dkar nag ser gsum bgrang yas pa zhig mchis pas nang rig las byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag 'di lta bu ngo sprad tsam zhig byas na yang mnyam med shākya'i ring lugs la yid ches skyed thub kyi red snyam pa'i phan sems kyis bskul nas bshad mos byung / der brten mgrin pa mkha' ltar yangs pa las chos kyi rnga gsang ldir ba'i 'chad la mkhas pa dang / chos grwa gangs dkar rtse nas lung rigs g.yu ral gsig pa'i rtsod la mkhas pa dang / shog dkar yangs pa'i thang la snag gi rta pho rgyu ba'i rtsom la mkhas pa'i dam pa rnam pas 'di nyid rtsom pa po su yin dang / de grub mtha' gang yin sogs rtog 'dod byas te dgag bzhag gi mgo mi 'dren par 'di rtsom pa'i dgos pa dang bstan 'gror sman pa'i rgyu ru 'gro min gzigs rogs zhes gsol ba lan brgyar 'debs pa lags/de la dang po 'di na su dang gang gis myi shes pa'i/ / zhes pa nas de ltar thag pa gcig la gcig mthud pas/ zhes pa'i bar gyi don 'di ltar/snod 'jig pa'i rang bzhin can la rten 'khrul ba can gyi khams gsum sems can gyis brten pa'i thog ma med pa nas ma rig pa'i gdon gyis smyos pa'i gang 148

zag su dang so skye gang gis kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i g.yung drung lha yi rmu thag ring mo 'dis mtha' med de mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos dbyings stong pa chen po 'di nyid gsal rig gi dbyings su btags pa dang /de yang rgya bod mkhas pas sems can spyi'i shes pa'i mtshan nyid la gsal zhing rig pa 'jog pa dang phyogs mthun no/ / de bzhin du gsal rig shes pa'i bu chung ni sgyu lus phung po'i nang du tshud cing btags pa dang / sdug bden lus kyi tho yor de 'tsho bar byed pa dang 'bral thabs med pas de la btags pa yin/ de yang thar ba chen po'i mdo las/ de zas ma mchis na lus kyang ma mchis zhes pa dang mthun no/ / yang zas skom ni phyi rol gyi rgyu rkyen tshang na yod la ma tshang na med pas der rag las shing btags pa'o/ / de yang zas skom chos can/ phyi rol gyi rgyu rkyen 'dzoms na 'byung ste/ res 'ga' ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes rgyu khyad par sgrub kyi 'bras 1ོgas bkod na'ang chog go / de ltar kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni lha yul du 'gro bar byed pa'i gnam gyi rmu thag gam 'ju thag lta bu'i 'khor bar 'khor byed kyi rmu thag yin pas gnas lugs ma shes na bden 'dzin gsal rig gis btags shing sgrog bden rdzun gsal rig gi shes pa 'di thal ba'i rtsed mo 'a/ longs spyod cing dga' sdug shin tu mang ba'i rig pa col chung ba bsam med byis pa bu chung bzhin 'gyur ldog che ba'i mi dran dgu dran gyi kun rtog can yin pa dang / de nyid lus la mthud pa dang lus tho yor lta bu'i ke re can 'di nyid zas dang skom la mthud cing 'brel ba dang / zas skom yang sngar bshad bzhin rkyen la ltos pas snga ma snga ma rnams phyi ma phyi mar mthud cing btags pa'o// / yang / g.yung drung lha yi rmu thag ring mo 'dis/ / mtha' med chos dbyings rig pa'i dbyings su btags/ / lus kyi tho yor zas dang skom la btags/ / zas dang skom ni phyi rol rkyen la btags/ / zhes pa dang mthun par dam chos thar rgyan las/149

'khor bar 'khrul ba 'di yang su 'khrul na khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khrul lo/ / gzhi ci las 'khrul na stong pa nyid las 'khrul/ rgyu ci las 'khrul na ma rig pa chen pos 'khrul lo gsungs/ de bzhin du rig pa'i bu chung lus kyi nang du btags/ / zhes pa dang mthun par/ tshul ji ltar 'khrul na/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi spyod yul du 'khrul lo gsungs/ de ltar thag pa gcig la gcig mthud pas/ / gcod pa'i sa mtshams gzhan ni yod ma yin/ / ces pa dang mthun par/ dus nam 'khrul na/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas 'khrul lo/ 'khrul ba la rang sangs yod dam snyam na/ 'khor ba mtha' med par grags pa de yin no gsungs so/ /yang g.yung drung lha yi rmu thag ring mo 'dis zhes pa nas gcod pa'i sa mtshams gzhan ni yod ma yin zhes pa'i bar gyi go don rten 'brel dang sbyar na/sa lu ljang pa'i mdo las/ dge slong gang zhig sa lu ljang pa 'di shes na rten cing 'brel ba 'byung bar shes so zhes pa dang / dge slong dag 'di yod pas 'di 'byung / 'di skyes pas 'di skye ste/ 'di ltar ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed nas skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi zhes so/ gong gi don rnams go bde bar bshad na/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon chen po dpal ldan zla bas/ sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'jig rten dang / / snod kyi 'jig rten shin tu dpag yas 'god/ / 'gro ba ma lus las las skye bar gsungs/ / sems spang nas ni las kyang yod ma yin/ / gsungs pa bzhin/ / sems ni gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi 'jig rten gnyis ka'i rgyur bstan pas/ yul yul can gnyis su ma mchis pa'i gzhi yi shes pa 'di/ gser bzang po la g.ya' zhugs pa dang chu dwangs ma sa rdos rnyogs pa bzhin/ ma rig pas rgyu byas nas gzhi yi gnas tshul la phyin ci log tu zhugs nas sems rnam rtog gis kun nas bsgrogs pa yin no/ /150

gnyis pa gcod pa'i sa mtshams gzhan ni yod ma yin/ / zhes pa nas/thag pa rul nas dbyings rig 'dres pa nyid/ zhes pa'i bar gyi don 'di ltar/de lta bu'i thag pa 'di gcod pa'i sa mtsham sa gnyis las gzhan med de/ sa mtshams gcig ni 'o cag 'jig rten pa rnams shin tu skrag cing mi 'dod bzhin ldog med thog tu babs pa'i lus sems 'brel thag chad de bem rig kha bral 'gro ba'i 'chi ba yin pa dang / sa mtshams gcig ni khams gsum sems can gyis mi shes shing rtogs dka' ba bden 'dzin gyi thag pa rul nas dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med du 'dres te gnas lugs kyi rang zhal mjal te 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa'o/ / de yang / ji skad du/ gang gis rten cing 'brel bar shes pa des chos shes so/ / gang gis chos shes pa des sangs rgyas shes so/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin rten 'brel stong nyid du shes na thag pa rul nas dbyings rig dbyer med 'dres pa zhig yin/ /gsum pa/ lha mo'i pha yul 'jig rten 'di min mod/ / ces pa nas kun gyi skye ba blangs pa'i don sgor snang zhes pa'i bar gyi don/ de yang ji skad du/ sems la sems ma mchis te sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin dang po'i sems 'di ni mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i nam mkha' la gnas pa'i lha'i gzugs su bkod de/ lha mo'i pha yul bde sdug re dogs spros pa mang ba'i 'jig rten 'di ma yin mod kyang / mtha' dang bral ba'i sems kyi lha mo'i zhabs kyi mthe'u chung gcig la rmongs pa ma rig pa'i skud pas lus po 'di la dam du btags/ gsungs pa de'i don ni sems kyi gnas lugs 'di ma rtogs na 'khor ba yin pa dang rtogs na sangs rgyas yin par bstan/ de nas rmongs pa ma rig pa'i skud pa 'di nyid ma chad kyi bar du lus kyis gang myong sems kyis myong bar snang ste/ 'khrul snang mi zad pas mes 151

tsha ba dang chus gsher ba rlung gis g.yo ba bcas zlog med du 'byung ba'i phyir/'di dang mthun pa'i gtam rgyud go bde ba zhig bkod na/ sngon dus mi nyag phyogs kyi bla ma zhig gis kho bos ngo bo'i thog tu 'jog skabs bde sdug sogs gang yang med gsungs pas/ nyin gcig mes bsreg pas a tsha zhes pa'i skad shor ba gzhan gyis kho la ngo bo'i thog tu zhog cig ces lab pas/ khos ngo bo yang tsha yong gi 'dug ces bshad pas kun dgod shor/ dpe 'dis ngo bo la tsha ba ma grub kyang sdug bden lus kyi phung po 'di nyid ma dor bar sems kyi myong tshor la'ang zad mtha' med par lus kyis myong bar bstan snyam/ klu sgrub dgongs rgyan du yang / ji srid rnam shes kyi rten ma brje ba dang ji srid kun rdzob kyi snang ba ma 'gag ba de srid du stong nyid mngon sum rtogs kyang sngar gang khas blangs pa de dbang med du khas len dgos pa 'di la rigs pas sgrub byed kyi 'bad pa bya ma dgos gsungs/ de bzhin du snang ba'i rnam gzhag 'di kun rig ngor yongs su rdzogs par zhig pa la nyon sgrib spangs pa dang / snang ngor yongs su rdzogs par zhig pa shes sgrib spangs pa yin no gsungs pa bzhin/snang ngor ma zhig na/ zhi ba lhas/ de byed nyid kyang chags skye 'gyur/ /gsungs pa bzhin/ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyu ma'i bud med sprul pa yin par shes bzhin du chags pa skye ba'i rgyu mtshan snang ngor yongs su rdzogs par ma zhig pa'am shes sgrib ma spangs pas so/ / de ltar na sdug bden gyi phung po 'di dag gi snang ba ma zad bar du sems can phal ba dag gi sems rgyud la phan gnod yod pa ma zad/ snang ba ma zad na stong nyid rtogs pa'i gang zag la'ang de bzhin no zhes so/ / spyir sems kyi lha mo 'di la mgo dang rkang pa mthe bong sogs med kyang rgyu ma rig pas mgo rkang mthe'u chung sogs btsan gyis btags nas de nyid skud pas nan gyis bzung bas mthe'u chung 'di la phan gnod gang byas pas lha mo de 152

la yang bde sdug mnyam par myong bar zad gsungs/ 'di yang chu las chu rlabs 'phyur ba bzhin dang / mkha' las sprin 'khrigs pa bzhin no/ / thag pa 'di de nyid du chad na mya ngan las 'das pas shin tu legs te sdug bsngal mtha' dag zad mod kyang / thag pa chad par 'jig rten thams cad skrag gi yod de 'khor ba spang bya dang myang 'das blang bya zhes tshig snyan por thon yang don du kha khog mi mtshungs pas de ltar min te/ thag pas 'brel ci thub kyi thabs shes la 'bad dgos pa'i phyir na/ thag pa srung phyir thag pa'i sne kun tsher mas dkris par mthong ste/ rnam rtog je mang dang 'jig rten phyogs la mngon zhen che ru btang ba'i don no/ / de 5/nga dgongs rgyan du/ phal pa drang po'i rjes su 'brang 'brang nas/ / rgud nga/'i rtsa ba lhan skyes bden 'dzin rnyed/ / mkhas pa drang po'i rjes su 'brang 'brang nas/ / de las sdug pa'i kun brtags bden 'dzin rnyed/ / gsungs pa 'di ltar na o rgyan chen pos/tshe 'dir sangs rgyas pa la shes bya mang po la bslab par mi bya'o/ gsungs pa 'di la yang yid ches skye dgos pa zhig red/ de bzhin jo bo rjes byang chub lam sgron du/ tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / / tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ / ngang pas chu las 'o ma len pa bzhin/ / rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya/ / gsungs pa 'di dag gdams ngag khyad par 'phags pa zhig go / spyir thog med nas gsal rig sems kyi rnam rtog grangs med pa gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du phyi rol gyi bya dngos mtha' dag 'phel rim la ltos pa'i rnam par shes pa yang nyin bzhin je rgyas song yod/ mthong chos tshe 'di la yang tshung byis par za 'thung tshun chad bslab pa nas kun dang mnyam pa'i gtam bshad dang las la spyad pa bsam shes pa bcas la mthong chen po rtsis pas don du 'jig rten la zhen pa che ru btang / 'jig rten sgrub thabs la mkhas pa chags pa las chos kyi gnas 153

lugs phyogs su blo 'khor gyi med/ gnas lugs la dad pa'i gang zag yin phyin 'jig rten la sgrog byed kyi thag pa srung phyir da lta'i blo la gang 'thad kyi grub mtha' mi 'jog nas 'di las 'das pa'i thabs la 'bad cig de lta bu'i bdag 'dzin gyi thag pa srung ba'i rnam rtog brgyad khri bzhi stong 'di dag ni reg na tsub cing mi bde bar skyed pa'i rgyu rkyen tshang nas gsar du skyes pa'i tsher ma bzhin no/ / 'jig rten pa dag gis thog mar nyon mongs pa'i tsher ma rnams skyed bsring byas/ slar yang 'di dag gis sdug bsngal skyed skabs tsher ma'i rtse mo re re bzhin du 'gog pa'i slad du shes bya rig pa'i las kyi rnam grangs re re bslab kyi yod/ dper na thog mar 'ben gsar du btsugs kyang de mdas brgyab nas rtsa med btang ba bzhin/ 'ben btsugs pa'i dka' las la ltos na rtsa med gtang mi nyan pa zhig 'dra yang de 'ang de ltar min pa bzhin no/ / bla ma kar lu rin po ches phyi rgyal pa dag la chos gsungs skabs/khyed tsho la mi'i yul na lha'i dpal 'byor lta bu mnga' yang tsher ma'i steng du nyal na 'gre ldog gang 'dra byas kyang bde ba'i gnas skabs med pa bzhin/nang sems rgyud kyi nyon mongs 'di dag ma zhi bar bde ba mi thob gsungs pa bzhin no/ / des na 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi sdug bsngal gyi tsher ma 'gog pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa rnams kyis mi 'dod bzhin khral ltar bsten pa'i las 'di/ ma shi'i bar du khom po med par brel ba byed par zad/ de nyid rdzogs nas tshar du med pa ma bsten thabs med pa yin pas spang du med pa'i brel ba 'di/ 'jig rten pa kun gyi skye ba blangs pa'i don sgo yin pa 'dra/de yang dpe go bde ba zhig bkod na 'jig rten pa rnams kyi zhe sdang gi sdug bsngal sel phyir gzhan nyams rgud song nas rang nyid rgyal kha thob pa de yin pas de'i las la 'bad pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems kyi cha shas gcig ces pa nas sa 154

steng 'di ru lo shas sdod par zad ces pa'i bar gyi don 'di ltar/ myur mgyogs kyi shugs dang ldan pa ri brag sogs la thogs med du rgyu ba mkha' dang mnyam pa'i gsal rig sems kyi cha shas gcig ste nyon mongs pa rtsa nyon nye nyon sogs kyi ngo bor gyur ba zhig sha dang khrag las grub pa'i lus kyi 'dam du tshud pa na/ da gzod tsha grang bkres skom re dogs 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal 'di la zad mtha' med pa snyam/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal che la 'jigs skrag che ba zhig lags/ 'on kyang 'bad pa brgya phrag mang po yis bsgrubs pa'i shes rig dpal gyis bskrun pa'i lus po lngadi/ chos nyid de gnam gyi rgyal mo'i gzugs su bkod de de'i bka' lung bzhin ldog med kyis sa steng 'dir lo shas sdod pa las thabs med gsungs pa'o/ /slar smras pa/lta ba rnam dag zla gzhon dwangs ma yis/ /zab gsang bdud rtsi'i gru char 'jo mdzad pa/ /re dogs spros dang bral ba pha rgan gyi/ /ngang tshul 'dzin pa khyed la snying nas gus/ /khyed sku zla gzhon dwangs ma dus kyis yol/ /'on tang rnam dpyod nyi ma brgya las ni/ /rtsom rigs zer brgyas gangs can gzhon nu rnams/ /mdun lam snang bar byed pa khyod kho na/ /rig gzhung 'chad la don gyi rab 'byams pa/ /skad rigs smra la lo tsā chen po dang / /dkor dang nor gyis dbul ba'i slong mo ba/ /grub dbang khyed la mi dad rang dbang ci/ /'di ni gzur gnas blo yis nyer drangs pas/ /155

don gyi zla ba mkha' la 'char ba 'dir/ /'khrul ba'i ra ri nag nog mtshan ma dang / /ya yo 'khyog po'i 'phel 'grib med snyam yang / /ma rtogs log rtog phyogs rtogs kyis bsgribs ste/ /rnyog por mthong na blo ldan kun da tshogs/ /khrel ba'i gzhi ru gyur pas bzod gsol phyir/ /lha reg dkar pos zhu sna byed las ci/ /156

si bod slob grwa'i dge rgan rnam par bsam chul 'ga' zhu ba/dge rgan ni mi'i rigs kyi rig gnaru/ brgyud sprod byed mkhan yin zhing /mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs rgyun mthud dang 'phel rgyas byed par zam pa lta bu'i byed nus thon bzhin yod/ mi'i rigs kyis dus ring por bsags pa'i rig gnas dang tshan rig lag rtsal gyi shes bya dang / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ de min spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo dang / mtshan nyid rig pa'i lta tshul sogs 'dus pa'i spyi tshogs kyi bsam pa'i rgyu nor mi rabs nas mi rabs su spel ba dang nyar tshags byed cing gong du spel bar gtso bo dge rgan gyi nus par brten dgos/slob khrid ni slob ma'i shes yon skyed sring byed pa'i thabs mchog yin/slob khrid byed skabs gtso gnad nan gyis bshad pa/ dris lan tshul du rgyugs len pa/ 'os 'tsham gyi 'grel bshad byed pa/ slob khrid de spyi tshogs dang /'dzam gling / ma 'ongs pa/ deng rabs can la kha phyogs pa/ ma zad sgra dag la tshig gsal ba/ dpe bshad nas don go bar byed pa/ don bshad nas rigs 'gre gzhan la sbyar shes pa/ shes rig gi bgro gleng ltar byas te thag gcod pa sogs kyi dge mtshan 'dzoms dgos/ dge rgan rang nyid kyi 'gan babs slob khrid kyi slob deb la byang pa dang rgyus yod pa ma zad/ rig gzhung gzhan dag la yang byang cha yod dgos/ khyad par du spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul dang / rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi gnas tshul bcas la mi rmongs pa zhig kyang dgos/deng dus gnas tshul gsar pa sna tshogs shig dus deb dang brnyan 'phrin 157

sogs las shes thub pas de dag la gzab nan gyis blta rgyu dang / shes yon pas shes rig gi 'bel gtam byed sar zhugs dgos/ tshogs pa de dag dang mnyam du bsam blo brje res dang / the tshom can gyi gros gzhi la thun mong gis dpyad pa gnad phig pa zhig byed pa dang / de dag la brten nas rang nyid kyi blo yar thon yong bar byed dgos/ deng dus shes yon pa yin zer mkhan 'ga' dang 'gas sho rgyan 'dzugs pa'i las la sha sbrang sha la 'khor ba ltar bar med du 'jug pa dang / shes rig dang slob gso skor gyi gtam gleng skabs mkhris nad can la mar khu bstan pa ltar zhen kha log gi yod/ ma gzhi dge rgan rang nyid la shes yon chu tshad nges can zhig gis grub pa'i bsam blo la sdom tshig cig med na/ slob ma la ma nor lam ston ji ltar bya/ dge rgan la 'dzoms dgos pa mang na yang gnad kyi sdong po med du mi rung ba'i zur gnyis te/ brtse mkhas gnyis yin no/ dge rgan kha shas la bshad na slob khrid kyi 'gan lcogs pa ma zad 'gan rnam dag khur ba dang / dngos gzhi'i slob khrid yang dag byed pa ma zad zur khrid byed pa dang da dung rnam kun slob grwa'i spyi chos la bsam gzhig byed kyi yod/ dge rgan 'ga' shas kyis slob grwa'i las don mig sngar yod kyang mi zur du bor/ las ka gang zhig byed rung gla phogs kyi rin tsam dang khral 'jal ba ltar las don u tshugs kyis byed pa las rang mos lhag bsam gyis byed pa min/ spyir 'jig rten gyi gtam dpe la rtsam khug nang du rtsam pa med na/ phor pa nang la 'bab rgyu med zer ba bzhin spyir yag po ma byung na sger yag po byung khungs med pas/ mig rgyang ring ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyis spyi yi don gang nus kyis 'bad brtson byed rogs zhes re ba zhig zhu rgyu yin/ma gzhi 'jig rten gyi gtam dpe la/ dge rgan ci 'dra dge phrug dang pha ma ci 'dra bu phrug zer ba bzhin dge rgan gyi shugs rkyen des slob ma la bag 158

chags zab mo zhig 'jog pa ma zad slob ma de yang dge rgan dang phyogs so so nas 'dra ba zhig yong gi red ces bshad chog/ der brten dge rgan gyi gtam bshad tshul/ gos gyon lugs/ gshis spyod tshul ldan bcas phyogs yongs nas gzob pa lhur len byas te mig dpe 'os pa zhig byed dgos/khyad par du nga tsho dge rgan rnams ni dpon po ma yin la/ 'byor ldan pa yang ma yin/ tshong dpon yang min la dmag dpon yang min/ der brten dpon po dang 'byor ldan/ dmag dpon dang tshong dpon sogs kyi gshis dri ngan pa med pa zhig yin par ma zad de lta bu'i nyams yod 'os pa zhig kyang min/ nga tshos skyed sring byed pa'i slob ma la yang dpon nyams sogs btsog dri ngan pa de dag ma gos pa zhig yin pa ma zad / mi yi rigs la zhabs 'degs byed pa'i g.yog po bzang po lta bu'i sems shig yod par byed dgos/ khyad par du nga tshos skyed sring byed pa'i slob ma de spyi tshogs la spyod sgo yod pa/ spyi tshogs dang ya ma bral ba zhig dgos/ skyed bsring pa'i slob ma de kha yod lag yod kyis 'gro la phan 'dogs pa'i las byed pa zhig yin pa las stong bshad dang stong nyams bstan mkhan zhig yin mi rung / zhi ba lhas kyang / 'gro la phan pa ma gtogs pa/ / rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs ma mchis/ / zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis su 'gro la phan ma gtogs rgyal ba dgyes thabs med ces gnad sdom zhig bstan yod/ khyad par du dus dang mthun pa'i slob gso ste/ rtsom rig pa dang spyi 'brel rig pa/ drung yig rig pa dang gzhung yig rig pa/yig sgyur rig pa dang glog klad bcas la sbyong pa bya rgyu ni gal ha cang che/ bzo gso brda tshad rnams la ched sbyong yang 'dzugs yod pas spyi tshogs 'di la mkho gal yang che la spyi tshogs la kha phyogs te slob khrid kyi rkang yang 'dzugs dgos/dper na/ go gsum 'dzin grwar dge dpal ldan legs bshad kyis dkar nag gi rtsis dang / spyi rtsis bsdoms te slob khrid byas pas de'i rtsis la bod 159

rtsis zer ba dang / dge rgan blo bzang rgya mtshos bod kyi gso rig dang nub sman krung sman gyi shes bya rnams bsdur te bod kyi gso rig khongs su gab yod pa'i shes bya rnams tshur 'byin te nad sogs bcos thabs byed na bod kyi gso rig de yag po zhig yong gi 'dug gsungs/ khyad par du nad ngos 'dzin dang sman ngos 'dzin sogs kyi thad gso rig khag sdur ba byas te thad gtug rgyu yang gal ha cang che/ 1kha9ṭ+wāṃlo'i lo smad du lha sa la lta skor 'gro srabs lho kha'i 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa zhig tu bzhugs mol tshogs 'du chogs dus dge rgan lo na gzhon pa zhig gis gsung don/ bod kyi nang tshad gnyis ni spyi tshogs la dngos su mkho gal mi che zhing / bod kyi nang tshad gnyis kyis spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu thub kyi mi 'dug zer/ de la phran gyis bod kyi spyi tshogs ni chos kyis grub pa'i spyi tshogs shig yin pas/ nang rig la yang de'i spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i nus pa yod pa'i ngos 'dzin yod dgos/tshad ma ni lag cha zhig yin/ de chos 'jig rten gang du yang spyod chog pa zhig yin gyi 'jig rten na spyod mi chog pa zhig ga la yin zhes bshad/ ma gzhi yang spyod dang mi spyod/ spyod shes dang mi shes ni gnad don zhig red ma gtogs nang tshad gnyis spyi tshogs la kha gtod pa yin na stobs che la phan 'bras myur du smin thub pa zhig yin/ der brten bod kyi rig gzhung gang zhig yin rung spyi tshogs sam 'jig rten la kha phyogs te khrid dgos pa las 'jig rten rgyab tu bskyur ba'i slob khrid byas pa yin na mig ldan gad la lhung ba'i lo rgyus de 'byung nges/ /slob ma je mang du song ba dang / ched sbyong sna mang gyur pa/ do dam bdag gnyer cha tshang ba/ slob gso'i cha rkyen bzang ba sogs ni si bod slob grwa'i gzhi rkang brtan por tshugs pa'i cha rkyen yin la/ slob grwa dar rgyas yong ba'i rtags kyang bstan pa yin/ slob ma'i 'byung khungs dkar rnga li'ang ya 160

khag so so las li'ang ya sogs phyogs 'dus 'dzin grwa ni spyi lo 1rdzokha6lo nas bsdu thub pa byung bas slob grwa'i las don je myo/nga song rung / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ mi rigs rig gnas dar spel gtong ba'i khyab khongs cher song bas dge mtshan shin tu che/ der brten 'go khrid dang dge rgan rnam pas phyogs 'dus 'dzin grwa'i slob gso shugs snon dang / mthong chen byed pa/bdag gnyer bzang ba/ slob khrid kyi 'gan spus dag khur ba ma zad/ skabs skabs su slob don khru'u dang slob ma'i kho/ slob dpyod khang bcas kyi 'go khrid rnam pas kyang slob gso'i skad cha dang kho tsho'i bsam 'char bsdu len byed na snyam/ yin na yang / sgrig lam la dam lhod med par mas bu la brtse ba ltar bka' bkyon dgos pa la bka' bkyon dang / slob gso dgos pa la slob gso/chad pa bab pa la chad pa gcod dgos pa las snying rje go log byed mi rung /khyad par du khong tshor bod yongs grags kyi srol rgyun dang gna' bro dang gna' klu sogs kyi thad nas khyad chos thon par zhig sbyong bcug dgos/ched khrid byed pa ni shes rig sna mang bsdu rub byed pa'i thabs mchog yin/ der brten ched khrid kyi lam lugs de rgya che ru gtang dgos/ ched khrid pas gtso gnad gcig dang gnyis gsum las mang mi rung / de bshad rjes slob mas gtso gnad de dag gzhi bzhag byas te dri ba byed dgos/rang re'i slob grwa'i dge rgan rnam pas ched khrid byed pa ma zad/ phyi yi slob dpon chen mo dang mthong thos ha cang rgya che ba'i mi sna dag gdan zhu byas te ched khrid byed du 'jug pa/ de 'dra byed pa yin na chab srid dpal 'byor rigaganas dmag don sogs kyi shes rig yod dgu de phyir phud nas ltad mo blta rgyu'i go skabs thob pas bden rdzun gyi dbye ba gsal po 'byed chogagaser dngul zangs lcags gang zhig yin rdo la brdar na shes pa bzhin/mngon rjes lung gsum gyis de dag la dpyod pa'i dus bden rdzun de mngon 161

gsal dod po zhig yong gi red snyam/ ma zad nga tsho'i shes rig gis 'dzam gling gi shes rig la kha gtad bkyag dgos/ 'gran sdur gyi dus rabs 'di la shes rig gi 'gran sdur yang dgos/ gal te nga tsho'i shes rig gis gzhan gyi shes rig la sdur ba ma byed na/ nga tsho'i shes rig la bang rtsal ga 'dra yod sus shes/ phran gyi lta stangs ltar na shes rig mi 'dra ba so so 'gran sdur ram phog thug bya dgos/ si bod slob grwa rta'u nas dar mdor spos pa yin na bod kyi rig gnas slob khrid nyams rgud 'gro rgyu red ces mang po zhig gis sngon de 'dra bshad skabs/ dge mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyis/ dpa' bo 'dzing sa nas mi shi/ sdar ma bros sa nas shi zer ba de yong gi red/ nang du sdod pa las phyir bud na dga' gsungs pa bzhin bod kyi shes rig kyang phyir bud nas gzhan gyi kha gtad du langs dgos pa zhig yin snyam/nga tsho slob grwa'i dge rgan rnams kyis ched khrid byed pa'i lam lugs bkod nas bzung 'dzin grwa so sos kyang rtsa 'dzugs byas te re mos kyis bshad du bcug pas go brgyad lo la gtam bshad 'gran sdur byed skabs sngar las kyang je bzang song yod pa ni mngon sum du dmigs/ da phyin chad kyang 'dzin grwa so sos gtam bshad sbyong brdar thebs phyir bshad pa re mos byed bcug dgos/ 'on kyang rtsa 'dzugs yod pa sgrig lam yod pa bcas shes yon pa'i bro ba yod pa'i skad cha bshad dgos pa las stong bshad dang 'khyog bshad/ sa bshad rdo bshad sogs bya mi rung /slob grwa'i las don gang zhig 'go btsugs nas bzung spyi yi don du 'gyur dang mi 'gyur/ spyi la phan thogs dang mi thogs bsam gzhig byas te las don bsgrub rgyu gal che/ khyad par ma 'ongs pa'i don te mig rgyang ring por gzigs dgos pa las gnas skabs kyi 'ur 'ur zing zing zhig gis don thon gyi ma red snyam/ spyi yi don du sha snag rus la phab ste las don sgrub ma thub 162

rung / spyi yi bsam blo dang spyi la phan pa'i tshig gcig gsungs na yang dga' 'os pa zhig yin/las don 'grub dang mi 'grub ni mthun sgril la thug/ mthun sgril gyi dpung sde zhig chags na gang la yang phyir bshol mi dgos pa zhig yin snyam/mthun sgril med na bde 'jags med/ bde 'jags med na slob gso dar rgyas gtong rgyu phar zhog/ mtha' ma rang nyid rang gis brlag pa las gzhan rlog byed gang yang mi dgos/ khyad par dge rgan rnams la mthun sgril yod dgos/ slob grwa 'di la sa lag mthil tsam zhig bdag gir bzung rgyu med pa nas da lta sa rgya chen po 'di 'dra zhig bed spyod rgyu byung ba'i bar gyi 'phel rgyas 'di yang mthun sgril gyi 'bras bu yin/ dgra byung na gri kha mnyam len/grogs byung na phor ba mnyam 'dzugs byed dgos pa las/ dgra rang khyim nas langs/ nad sman khug nas thon pa yin na shin tu bcos mi rung ba'i bya ngan zhig yin/ spyir dge rgan dang las byed pa gang yin rung so so'i lta tshul dang bsam blo bcas tshig gi lam nas ra sprod chog pa las/ dgra 'dzin mkhan yang med la 'dzin yang mi rung / tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan snyun mnar skabs zhal chems su/ nga'i tshig la dpang po gyis/ bar du mi ma zhugs pa dang /spun phu bo nu bo 'dra gyis/ khyed rnams nang mthun na/ phyi'i dgra la skrag mi dgos/ sus kyang glags mi che/ nang zhig byas na/ phyi'i dgra mi dgos/khyed rang tshos rang tshod mi thub pas/ der ma song zhig rem gsungs pa bzhin nang mthun po bya rgyu gal che/ gnas tshul yod na gdong gtug nas sgrog bkrol thag chod sla ba ma zad/ khyim tshang gang gi mi bzhin 'dzem med kyi skad cha bshad na ches legs pa zhig yin/nga tsho'i slob mas nga tsho slob grwa'i rgyugs ra nang rgyugs sprod dgos pa ma zad/ spyi tshogs la rgyugs sprod dgos/ gal te spyi tshogs la rgyugs ma sprod na 163

slob grwa'i tshe srog yun ring brtan mi thub thag chod/ der brten nga tsho'i slob mas spyi tshogs la rgyugs sprod pa'i cha rkyen nam gra sgrig byed rgyu gal che/ nga tsho la spyi tshogs kyi skar ma mthon po zhig sprod byung na/ bu phas mi bstod dgras bstod/ bu mo mas mi bstod gnas kyis bstod zer ba'i dpe de 'gyur gyi red/nga tsho'i slob ma la spyi tshogs kyis gshis spyod kyi thad la skar ma mthon po zhig sprod kyi yod/ da dung dbu khrid dang dge rgan rnam pas slob mas skar ma mi lon pa'i cha de gang yin zhib phra byas te shes dgos pa ma zad/ de'i cha la shugs snon bya dgos/ mchog sprul gzan dkar rin po ches nga tsho slob mas bod kyi rig gzhung shes pa'i cha nas skar ma mthon po zhig sprad yod/ slob dpon chen mo mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyis nga tsho slob grwas srol rgyun rig gnas shes pa'i cha nas skar ma mthon po zhig sprad yod/ slob dpon chen mo dmu dge bsam gtan gyis nga tsho slob grwas srol rgyun rig gnas shes pa'i cha nas skar ma mthon po zhig sprad yod/ phran gyi lta stangs ni slob grwa 'di'i khyad chos mi shor ba sra brtan gyi sdong po'i rtser spyi tshogs la phan 'bras yod pa'i 'bras bu zhig smin thabs de gang gi bzang thabs shes byed dgos/gong gi zhu ba 'di dag ni rang rgyud la med pa'i kha chos tsam zhig yin rung 'di 'dra zhig 'grub thub na snyam pa'i rgan mo bsam bzang gi kha ta bzhin bshad pa yin pas/ 'grig min rnam pa tshos gzigs te legs cha dang blang dang skyon cha ring du dor ba mdzod na ches mdzes par snang / de bzhin bshes gnyen rnam pas so so'i lta ba de shes rig gi bgro gleng byed phyir yig cha re byas te gros gzhi bzo na de las kyang mdzes par snang ngo / /164

shing rta 'khor lo/ spyi lo1978la nged dol mda' grong du shing rta 'khor lo zhig rdzong srid gzhung gis mkho btsong byas/ skabs der grong pa'i rgan gzhon pho mo kun gyis ngo mtshar 'bum ldan gyi ltad mo la g.yeng pa bzhin shing rta 'khor lo de'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab mgo mjug bar gsum kun la lta bzhin 'di'i phan 'bras ni bshad mi shes pa zhig red zer nas gcig gis gcig la mgo g.yug bzhin lag pa'i brda dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur bcas lo yag snye ma rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin tsha tsha 'ur 'ur byed kyin 'dug rang nyid kyis kyang 'phrul cha'i rigs mthong ba mngon sum gyur pa thengs dang po yin pas ltad mo yun ring bltas/de nas shes can gyi rgad po dang bsam bzang gi rgan mo rnams kyis lo na gzhon pa'i pho mo dag la 'phrul cha bed spyod byed skabs shin tu sems chung byed dgos ma gtogs gyong kha chen po yong gi red ces bshad/ sde ba'i 'go khrid zla bas 'phrul cha bed spyod byed skabs bdag gnyer byed pa'i dgos pa dang bdag gnyer bya lugs bcas dril bsgrags dang slob gso'i ched du tshogs 'du bsdus/ khos thog mar 'phrul cha 'di'i don du sgor mo bsog lugs/gong rim gyi 'go khrid la yar zhu bya lugs/ 'brel ba ci 'dra byed pa sogs mdor na ngas byas ngas thon gyi skad cha mang po zhig bshad/ de mtshams a zhang skal dgas da 'phrul cha 'di 'dra thob pa 'di ni tang dang rgyal khab kyi bka' drin dang rgyaci che'i mang tshogs kyi 'jon thang yin lugs bcas mang po zhig bshad/ stag rgod tshang gi bu rdo rje stobs rgyal gyis mdor na 'phrul cha 165

'di 'dra zhig nga tsho'i grong la thob pa 'di gnas tshul bzang po yin/ da phyin chad bdag gnyer byed rgyu gal che zhes bshad/ tshogs 'du ring drag nas mtshan mor gyur pa dang / smag sgra be sgri be'i skabs mi mang tshogs pa'i dbus nas a ne chos mtshos phyen chen po zhig shor nas kun gyis lag pas lag par brdeg bzhin ha rgod dus gcig la byed kyin tshogs 'dur grol brda gtong ba bzhin tshogs 'du yang grol/ phyen skyogs des phyogs lhung can gyi nga rgyal dang khong khro rnams kyang meg med du brlag /skabs der grong brdal du shing rta 'khor lo ni gtam gsar pa zhig tu gyur bas khyim tshang re re bzhin bshad rten byas/ de nas shing rta 'khor lo gtong mkhan mi gnyis bsko bzhag byas shing thengs dang por shing rta rta pho lnga la drud du bcug te sman nag rgyab tu shing 'thu 'gro ba'i sta gon byas/ skabs der shing rta de la ltad mo ba sngar las kyang je mang du song / de dus mi tshogs dbus nas a mye bkra shis kyis sna dud ser po gang bgrang bzhin rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi gzhung na gnam gru dang rdzas ngan sogs tha na rdza ma bzo lugs tshun chad gsungs yod pas skyabs su mchi zer/ de dus lo na nyi shu lon pa'i pho gsar rdo rgod kyis 'o na khong rnam pas gsar bskrun mi bya ba'i rgyu mtshan ci red zer nas ha rgod chen po zhig byas/ mkhan po chos bzang gi rtsa nas dpe cha cung sbyong myong ba'i grwa ba blo bzang gis de dag 'khor bar 'phen byed kyi rgyu nyon mongs yin pas bzo skrun ma byas pa red ma gtogs sangs rgyas kun mkhyen yin pas chos thams cad mkhyen gyi yod pa red zer/gtam de la a mye bkra shis kyis mgo bo gug gug byed bzhin rnam 'gyur bzang po bstan/ rdzong slob gso cus kyi las byed pa 'gyur rdo khos dgongs pa zhus te pha yul la yod par khel bas kho yang der slebs song / deng sang tshan rig dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab la las khyim du glog brnyan blta ba dang zla skar 166

gyi go la'i thog tu 'phur bskyod byed bzhin yod ces bshad/ de dus a khu dam pas rgya che rgyang ring gi skad cha phan thogs mi 'dug/ phan pa yod nges shing rta sga sgril 'di red/ da mang po mi bshad grong pa'i bkod sgrig ltar rang rang so sos shing 'thu 'gro ba'i gra sgrig gyis zer/ phyi nyin snga mor skyes pa stobs can kha shas dang 'go khrid bcas kyis shing rta 'khor lo 'gro chas kyi gra sgrig byed skabs so so'i bza' zla rnams kyis khyed tshos gzob rang srog ni shin tu gal che ba zhig yin ces bshad bzhin pa'i sgang der bu mo me los chu zom stong pa zhig rgyab tu khur nas byung bas de la kun gyis sdang mig gis bltas nas rtags ngan par rtsis/ de nas shing rta de rta rgod rnams kyis drud de grong pa dang kha gyes te lam chung brgal nas gzhung lam thog slebs grabs yod skabs/ mi thams cad kyis da rlangs 'khor dang thug phrad yong skabs rta 'drog ste chag sgo zhig nyo thag chod red bsam ste 'jigs skrag gis rngul chu shor/sems 'tshab 'tshub ngang nas gcig gis gcig la gzob gzob zer bzhin 'ga' shas kyis bla ma mkhyen zer/ 'ga' shas kyis rje btsun sgrol ma mkhyen zer nas so sos ci dga'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs bzhin gzhung lam thog tu mu mthud de bskyod/ yud tsam song rjes rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig mar 'ong ba mthong bas ches cher skrag 'jigs skyes pa'i mod la rta rgod rnams kyi kha dang rna ba la hub ru phags rub kyis 'jus te shing rta 'gro mtshams bzhag pa dang rlangs 'khor shing rta'i zur nas mar song rjes da gzod shing rta 'khor lo ded nas song / de'i rjes su rta rnams mi 'drog pa'i gdengs tshod thob pas rlangs 'khor che chung gang la 'phrad kyang mtshams 'jog ma byas par lam zur nas song bas bde bar gnas su phyin/ de'i tshe shul gyi khyim mi rnams kyis da ga 'dra bzo 'ong zer nas sems mi bde ba'i gtam mang po lab/ de nas skyes pa de dag gis stobs shugs ci yod kyis/ shing bcad de shing rta la ri spung 167

snapa ltar brtsegs te thag pas dam ngo ra bsdams nas sngar ltar yul phyogs su 'ong ba dang / khyim du slebs nyin rgan skra dkar dang chung byis pa yan gyis bsu bar byas/ da res las don de bkra shis bde legs kyi mjug rdzogs pas grong ba gcig po blo bde ba dang / shing rtas 'bud shing lcogs pa'i tshad mtho ba la brten nas sems la dga' ba thob nyi ma 'ga' song rjes ston gyi lo tog bsdu ran pas shing rtas 'drud dgos pa'i 'char gzhi bzhag song / shing rtas tshur lo tog drud de phar stong bar 'gro skabs shing rta'i thog nga rang 'dug rgyu byung / spyir lam thams cad la sgang 'bur mang stabs shing rta'i thog sdod skabs ya sos ma sor brdab/ong mgo pang leb la brdeg/ lus po thams cad dkrugs bzhin du yang skyid snang gis khengs/ 'di ni gsar du 'phrul cha'i rigs dang por spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin tshod red/ ston las mjug rdzogs rjes lo tog brdung ste rgyal khab gzhung la 'bru khral bkyag dgos skabs yang shing rta 'khor lo'i thog 'bru sgyel thams cad brtsig ste 'gro grabs byed kyin 'dug/nga yang de'i gral du 'gro rgyu'i bkod pa byas/ dol mda' grong gi lho yi thad du phar tsam song na thur du 'bab dgos pas thur shin tu gzar po zhig yod/de nas shing rta'i kha lo ba gnyis g.yas g.yon du bsdad nas shing rta cung zad cig gtong dus 'khor lo sdom byed de shugs kyis gnon tshe 'khor lo sdom mi thub pa shes bzhin skyon med 'gro zer nas nga la g.yon phyogs kyi rta kha khrid du bcug ste mar tsam song dus shing rta shugs kyis shor bas sngon gyi rta bzhi bo 'drog nas do bo thams cad thag ring du 'phang / kha lo ba shing rta'i zhabs la 'gril/ shing rta'i yu ba bzung mkhan gyi mi rnams ni thag pas sgrog ste shing rta dang mnyam du drud/ skabs der phar bltas dus thal skya gnam la 'phyur ba dang dkyil gyi rta de sa la 'gyel dus gzhan rnams 'drog ma thub pas shing rta 168

'dug thub pa byung /grong mi thams cad 'ur zing zing byas/ lha dkon mchog gis tshe srog la gnod mi 'dug zer bzhin do bo rnams phyir bskyal/ rmas ma thams cad sman khang du khrid song / skabs der nga'i dwangs gsal sems kyi me long ngos su shar ba ni 'phrul cha che chung gang yin yang (sprugril rgyu de las sla bo red snyam/gnas tshul 'di dus nam yang mi brjed pa'iri sems gting gi rdo ring zhig tu gyur/ de ltar dus thung ngu de tsam gyi nang du shing rta 'khor lo zhig gis blo dang bya ba dgag bzhag gi spros pa bde sdug gi snang ba sogs de tsam zhig je mang gtong thub tshe rigs 'dis yan tsi me mda' la longs spyod pa'i skal ba ldan na skabs der 'jig rten ni ches gsar pa zhig yin par mo rtsis gang yang bya mi dgos/ / 1bye9

lha ldan du song ba'i myong tsho/de yang dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs dgu bcu bar si bod slob grwa khams dar mdo'i g.yag rwa sbug na yod dus/ sngon dus si khron zhing chen mi rigs don gcod khang gi kru'u rin/ si bod slob grwa 'di btsugs pa'i gtso gnyer gnang mkhan/ bkra shis tshe ring mchog gis nga tsho’slob grwa'i blo mthun kha shas shig lha sa la lta skor 'gro rgyu'i gros 'go bton/ gtso bo lha sa'i slob gso'i gnas bab ste/ slob grwa'i slob gso la lta sbyong byed dgos gsungs/ rgyu mtshan des bkra shis nor bu dang / bu legs/ phran rang bcas 'gro rgyu'i gros thag bcad pas spyi lo 19khardolo'i zla 1skyutshes 12nyin la 'di nas khren tur song / zla de'i tshes 15la khren tu'u hra'ang lu'u (lko tshe/ )gnam gru sa tshigs nas gnam gru la bsdad de lha sa'i phyogs su bskyod/ gnam gru nas bltas pa'i tshe/ bod mi chags sa'i phyogs rnams gsal bo mthong skabs/gangs ri'i khrod ces pa'i ming de don la 'byor ba mthong bas tshig de la nges shes lhag par ba zhig skyes song / / ri 'go de dag na mtsho ha cang mang rung /mtsho shin tu chen po mthong ma byung / ri la brag ri/ gangs ri/ nags ri/spang ri/ bye ma'i ri sogs shin tu mang bo 'dug phran la bshad na/ gangs can yul du gnam grur 'phur lding byed pa thengs dang po yin pa dang / nam rgyun ltad mo sogs la lta 'dod che ba'i mi yin gshis/ de'i nyin yang gnam gru nas byis pa rtsed mo la g.yeng ba bzhin/ dus skad cig kyang chud zos su ma btang nas/ bltas bltas pas bshad mi shes pa'i skyo snang / bcos min gyi 170

dga' snang / bde ba'i nyams bcas 'gal 'du'i tshor bas drangs te yud tsam zhig gis lha sa'i gangs dkar gnam gru'i sa tshigs su slebs/ de nas gangs dkar gnam gru'i sa tshigs nas rlangs 'khor chung chung zhig tu bsdad de song bas/ pho brang po ta la thog mar mjal byung / de ni mjal ba tsam gyis ngo sprod mi dgos shing 'jig rten gyi dpe la/ rna thos brgya las/ mig mthong gcig gis dga' zer ba ltar/ mngon sum du gyur stabs spro snang dang dad snang gis yud tsam zhig la rnam rtog gzhan skye ba'i go skabs 'phrog go / ma zad de ni lo rgyus kyi bden dpang dang / mes po'i blo stobs/ ma 'ongs mdun lam gyi dran skul sogs gang byed kyang chog pa zhig snang / de nas rim bzhin lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi jo bo shākya mu ne dang ra mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje bcas mchod mjal byas pas/ dngos gnas bshad na bod kyi sa cha na/phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas phebs pa'i chos dad mi sna dag dang lhan cig tu mchod mjal byed pa las gzhan gang yang mi rung / nga ni 'jig rten gzhan zhig la slebs pa'i nyams snang zhig byung / gang yin zer na ma gzhi phran ni bod yin pas bod mis chos dad kyi sa chod ci tsam bzung yod pa snga nas shes bab yod rung / de'i nyin sngon blo la 'char ma thub pa'i bod mi rigs dang chos lugs gnyis gzhi gcig tu 'dres yod pa'i don de gsal por shes byung / dper na nam gsal nas nyi rtse ma phog pa'i gong la jo bo skor mkhan gyi mis skor lam kun gang 'dug jo mjal 'gro mkhan gyi mi rnams phreng ba bsgrigs pas gtsug lag khang gi phyi nang thams cad du lcags thag sbrel ba ltar mu 'brel gyis khyab 'dug de dus nang chos kyis bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi go gnas gang 'dra zhig bzung yod gsal po shes thub par ma zad/ bod mi'i mi tshe'i rin thang che shos de jo mjal zhu ba yin pa dang / bod mi'i las don ang dang bo de lha gdan skor ba la brtsis pa bcas kyi ra sprod gsal bo yong gi 171

'dug de nas nyin 'ga'i rjes la gtsang bkra shis lhun por mjal skor song ba dang / lam bar nas mnyes thang bde ba can te rwa stod dgon du rtsa chen jo bo'i yi dam sgrol ma mjal rgyu byung / de nas lam du zhugs te gzhis rtser slebs/ bkras lhun dgon de ni dwangs gsal yid du 'ong ba/ mjal tsam gyis rten bzhengs kyi spus ka gzhan dgon las kyang bzang shos yin pa'i tshor snang zhig ster song / gtsang gi 'bring rim dgen 'os slob grwa dang / mtho 'bring slob grwa khag bcas la lta bar phyin pas/ dge rgan de tshos dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa ma zad/ gtam thams cad lhug por mol byung / slob gso'i nyams myong brje res byas pas srol lugs phal cher nged bod yig slob grwa dang 'dra bo 'dug dge rgan de rnams la mig dpe byed rin yod pa gnyis mthong ste/ gcig skyid sdug mang bo rig pas byang tshad mtho ba dang /gnyis/ rtsom rig de gal che'i rang bzhin du 'dzin pa de yin/ spyi'i slob khrid ni rgyal khab gcig gyur gyi 'char gzhi ltar ro / /phyi nyin rgyal rtse la phyin/ rgyal rtse'i dpal 'khor mchod rten du mchod mjal byas pa dang / de 'dra'i mchod rten chen po mthong ba thengs dang bo yin pas dga' snang dang / khyad par du de'i sa khod dang lcags ris skor stangs ni bshad mi shes pa'i nyams mtshar ba zhig dang / rang byung gis rlabs che ba'i rnam pa shugs kyis dod pa zhig 'dug gna' rdzong zhig ri 'go ru mthong / spus mi bzang rung po ta la'i chags tshul a na ma na ru snang / gna' sa cha 'di dag paṇa chen rin po che'i mnga' khongs yin zer/ kho tshos bshad lugs la bltas na/ bod kyi g.yos zas rigs dang bod kyi gdan 'thag bcas kyi lag rtsal yag shos de 'di phyogs na dar ba yin 'dug der zhag gcig bsdad de phyi nyin tshur log gi lam bar nas zha lu dgon mjal du song /zha lu ni bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdan sa yin pa dang / bu ston gdan 172

sa'i lo rgyus mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis rgyal khams rig pas bskor ba'i gtam rgyud gser thang du phra la zhib pa zhig gsungs yod pa sogs kyi shugs rkyen des skom pas chu la don gnyer byed pa bzhin mjal 'dod kyi 'dun pa snying la bkod de song / dgon pa grong dang 'dres ma zhig 'dug /dngos gnas bshad na thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa bu ston rin po che'i gdan sa na/ nyams dma' ba'i rgan pho mo kha shas dang skyabs med long ba thang dkyil du lus pa lta bu'i phru gu 'ga' ma/thong ba dang / de'i nyin rta ljang can gyi tsha drod rgyas la sha sbrang mang pos sdug glu len pa ltar sgra grag bzhin 'phur 'dug lung pa de 'jam chag ger gnas pa sogs kyis rkyen byas nas bu ston rin chen grub shin tu dran pa dang / lhan cig tu khong gi snyan grags sa gsum na khyab rung / khong gshegs shul du lus pa ni 'di tsam mo snyam pas/rang sems 'gal ba'i phung bo la 'dri rtags shig bkod pa dang / lo rgyus la sdug yus bor ba las thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ lha gnyer pa grwa ba 'ga' dang /lha khang so sor bla ma so sos cho ga re gtong bzhin 'dug kun mkhyen bus ldebs bris dngos ma dkyil thang kha shas mjal rgyu 'dug rung nyar tshags bzang bo byed kyi mi 'dug pas/ de dag kyang yun mi ring bar 'jig nges red/ de nas mar tsam song bas gtsug lag khang chung chung zhig gi sgo na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bsnyen pa rdzogs skabs kyi dbu skra'i khrus gzhong mjal rgyu byung / rdo las grub pa'i khrus gzhong de'i nang du chu tog tsam zhig 'dug pas de btung na shes rab 'phel ba'i gtam du snang bas lha gnyer ba la gnang re byas bas 'thung rgyu rnyed/ de nas slar yang lam du zhugs te gzhis ka rtser phyin/phyi nyin sa skya la song bas sa skya'i dgon de mjal skabs/ 'di na mkhas pa gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu mang tsam byon pa ma zad/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes snyan pa'i grags pa sa gsum na khyab pa de bzhugs myong gi yod 173

snyam pas bdag yid dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi rlon gsher des sa skya bo la snum ka ster song / dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang chen de 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas phyag 'debs pa dang / 'di btab nas lo bdun brgya lhag tsam song tshul bcas lha gnyer gyis ngo sprod gnang bas 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i mdzad rjes de ha las dgos pa zhig snang / deng sang bar snang khams na bsnyegs pa'i khang chen dag gi zlar mi 'os kyang / skabs de dus 'di lta bu'i khang chen zhig bzhengs thub pa 'di rmi lam du yang rmis mi shes pa zhig red/ 'on kyang sgo phyi nang de rnams su za lhag 'thung lhag la re zhing nyams dma' ba'i glen lkugs can dang khyi 'khyar gyis gang 'dug pas ches snying rje ba zhig go/ de nas sa skya'i slob 'bring du lta skor phyin dus slob grwa'i ra ba nang du slob ma tsho sdod 'dug / kho tshor skad cha kha shas dris pas/ lan rgyag stangs la bltas na dngos gnas gnyom chung gshis 'jam du snang bas brtse sems bcos min zhig skyes song / skabs der kho tsho'i dge rgan phebs byung / slob ma tsho dge rgan la skrag pa ltar mgyogs por log song / nga tshos dge rgan de la si bod slob grwa'i ngo sprod kyi yig cha dang dus deb rnams sprad zhor skad cha kha shas shig lab pa yin/ nang du yong dgos pa'i skad cha mi 'dug pas phyi log gi lam du zhugs pa yin/ lam nas snar thang dgon du mjal kha byas pas/ sngon nga rang byis pa'i dus su gzungs 'dus dang 'bum sogs tshar mang bo klog myong stabs dpe cha de dag gi mjug byang du snar thang du dpar du btab pa lags zer ba'i tshig de skor ma mang bo 'don myong bas/snar thang de ga 'dra zhig yod na snyam gyi yod/ da res snar thang mig gis mngon sum du gyur ba'i skal bzang 'dir/ skyo dgos pa zhig la gna' shul gyi gyang ral de mthong dus/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi che ba shugs la rtogs thub pa dang / chabs cig tu da lta'i nyams rgud mngon sum du gyur/ skabs der rta 174

bdun dbang bo yang chu lha'i phang du yib la nye bas zer drod kyis nga tsho la smre ngag 'don pa'am skul ma gnang ba ltar/ skyo ba'i steng du skyo ba zhig sprad pas sa de la dbugs ring gi lan zhig sprad pa las thabs gzhan gang yang ma ragagatsug lag khang chung chung gnyis dang dpar shing 'thor bo kha shas shig gis nga tsho la dga' bsu zhus pa ltar du snang rung sdug 'don byed pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/ de nas gzhis ka rtse ru log gzhis ka rtse'i grong pa'i 'dabs der 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge'i sku gdung bzhugs yod sa'i sa 'bur chen po zhig yod gsungs 'dug pas/ grogs po rnam pas rtsad gcod gnang bas rgad po zhig gis 'di na red ces bstan pa las 'di yin gyi rtags mi 'dug zer/nga tshos gzhis rtse slob 'bring gi dge rgan bstan nor la rdor lo rgyus brkos te der 'dzugs rgyu'i re ba zhus/gzhis rtse zhag gcig bsdad de phyi nyin lho kha'i phyogs su song / lam bar du rdo rje brag dgon pa mjal rgyu byung la/ spyir snga 'gyur rnying ma'i byang gter gyi bstan pa'i mched gzhi gtso bo zhig yin pa dang / lo rgyus kyi rin thang ha cang che na yang / dgon 'di rig gnas gsar brje skabs rmig med du bshig zin pa la/ phyis gsar bzhengs byas pa red 'dug der brten phyi khang /nang bkod sogs gang nas bshad rung blo tshim po zhig ma byung / skyo snang dang bcas te log dgon 'dir 'gro skabs gru la bsdad de yar klung chu bo brgal nas 'gro dgos pa zhig red/ de nas dra nang 'bring rim slob grwa la lta skor song bas/ de'i nyin ngal gso la 'khel stabs slob gtso ma rnyed nas dus tshod ring tsam sgug dgos byung / de mtshams slob grwa de'i slob gtso dang slob don khang gi mi sna de dag byung / nga tsho la dga' bsu byas te nang du khrid song /slob grwa 'di'i dgen slob las bzo bcas pa mthun sgril bzang la/ mdzub mo lnga bcangs khu tshur byas te khe phan yod pa'i las la hūṃ rub phaṭa rub byed 175

mkhan zhig red/ dper na/ tshod zhing rang gis rmo ba dang / phag pa gso ba sogs slob ma'i 'tsho ba legs po yong thabs byas/ khong tshos gsungs don/nga tsho ni dma' 'bring yin pas 'bring rim ched gnyer slob grwa sogs su rgyugs sprod kyi gra sgrig dgos/ slob ma yongs kyis rgyugs 'phrad pa mi nges pas rgyugs ma 'phrad pa'i slob ma khag gi ma 'ongs pa'i 'tsho ba la phan phyir rlangs 'khor/lcags rta/ chu tshod/ sgra sdud sogs kyi lhu lag gtor sgrig byed du bcug nas lag rtsal slob kyi yod zer/ slob grwa'i khor yug dang phyi khang / nang bkod/sgo che chung dag gi kha byang 'bri tshul dang bcas pa spus gtsang zhig red/ de nas phyir thon te gzhung lam ded de mar tsam song nas lam bkyog ste le dbar bzhi tsam gyi sa nas smin grol gling dgon pa mjal byung / dgon 'di brjid chags che la sku rten rtsa chen shin tu mang bas yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog song /bshad srol la dgon 'dir thun mong gi rig gnas dar rgyas che ba ma zad/rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs sam mched gzhi zhig yin zer rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pas smin grol yab sras zhes lce thog tu len mi bra ba lta bu'i dad gus zhu sa de'i gdan sa red/ gtsug lag khang chung ngu zhig gi sgo 'gram na dgon pa'i sgrig yig cig bris 'dug pas dngos gnas yig gzugs mdzes la sgros gtsang ba/spus bzang ba zhig snang ba las shes rig gi khyad chos gzhan mngon gsal dod po gang yang mi snang / tshur log pa'i lam nas byis pa kha shas shig gis tshig rtsub re smra yi 'dug pas lung ba 'di'i yul dgon kun po la gshis gyong gi nyams rang bzhin gyis dod 'dug sa 'di ma gtogs yul gnas dgon sogs gang du rgan gzhon pho mo su 'dra zhig dang thug rung zhi 'jam bab chags can kho na snang bas/ dngos gnas lha gdan phyogs kyi mi la khyad chos 'dug snyam nas dga' ba yang yang skyes ba dang byang tshad mthon po yin pa'i ngos 'dzin yang byung / de nas phyi dro nyi nub tsam na dra nang du slebs pa dang / ci 176

mgyogs kyis 'brel ba byas te lho kha'i 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwar lta skor song ba yin/ slob grwa 'di'i slob gtso dang sde tshan so so'i gtso bo de dag gzhan gyi slob grwa dang mi 'dra zhing / tshugs yod dang sgrig yod lta bu'i rnam pa zhig bstan pa ma zad/ shes rig gi bgro gleng dang / dgag bzhag gi spros ba bcas la dgyes po gnang mkhan zhig red/ khong rnam pa la lta phyogs mthun pa'i skad cha gcig yod pa de ni/ slob ma la spyi tshogs thog tu spyod sgo yod pa'i shes rig slob dgos zer ba de red/ gzhung las khang gi gtso bo mi sna zhig gis/ nang tshad gnyis kyis spyi tshogs la phan nus gang yang mi thon pas slob grwa bas sbyong na dgos pa chung zer/ de la phran gyis bod kyi spyi tshogs ni chos kyis grub pa'i spyi tshogs shig red/ chos kyi shes bya ci rigs shig slob grwa bas ma shes na bod mi la zhabs 'degs zhu thub dka' lugs dang / tshad ma ni chos dang 'jig rten sogs shes bya mtha' dag la skor(bkol) chog pa'am spyod sgo yod pa zhig yin ces pa sogs kyis lan sprad/ de dus kho tshos tshad ma spyi tshogs la bkol spyod byed tshul ji 'dra zhig yin na zer gyi 'dug ngas tshad ma spyi tshogs la spyod tshul gyi yig cha zhig phran gyis bris yod pas khyed rnam pa la sprad chog zhus/ 'gro khar rtsom yig de tshar kha shas sprad yod rung khas len min mi shes/de'i phyi nyin mkhar la ches snga ba yum bu bla sgang zhes grags pa de mjal bar song / lam bar nas mjal sems kyi skyid bsog pa/ nga tsho sdod pa'i rlangs 'khor chung chung mgyogs pa zhig lags kyang / nga'i sems kyi rta phos sngon nas mkhar der skor nas ji tsam sgug kyang slebs rgyu med pa zhig red/nga'i gzugs kyi lhu lag la nus pa gsar pa zhig thon pa ma zad/ dbang bo kun rno gsal myur gsum 'dzoms pa/ nam rgyun rlangs 'khor du sdod skabs gnyid khug gi yod rung / de'i nyin gnyid ches rgyang ring zhig tu bsrings 177

so/ / gal te lam bar na lha yi bu mo stong gis glu len bro 'khrab kyi rnam 'gyur bstan zhing 'dod yon lnga yi mchod pa phul rung / de dag yid dgu la ma byed nas blos btang ste/ mkhar de la mjal 'dod yod thag chad red/ de nas dngos su mkhar de mjal byung / mkhar de chen po de 'dra min pa chung chung zhig lags kyang / lo rgyus kyis shul bzhag byas pa'i bag chags kyis mkhar de stong gsum du yong shong dka' ba zhig tu gyur te/ dga' skyo shugs drag bskyed pas had de lus pa zhig byung / nga tshos yam me tsam gyis bltas nas sngon gyi rgyal po de dag bsam blo dog la mig rgyang thung ba/ phugs bsam phra ba zhig yin snang shar yang / rgyal po de dag 'jig rten dar rgyas gtong ba la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lta ba yod pa go ste/ rgyal mkhar yod sna'i lung pa de ni snum shig shig yangs shar le/ lo tog skyes stobs bzang ba'i zhing sa gshin po mang ba sogs kyi dge mtshan mang bo 'dug ma zad yar klung shel brag dang / rten gsum gnas gsum/ rtse thang mgon po ri sogs phyogs 'dir yod tshul go ba tsam gyis mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyi lo rgyus gnas 'dir bkod myong ba go thub/ skabs de dus lung ba 'di ci 'dra 'khrugs po zhig min nam snyam ste lo rgyus la yid smon shor song / de nas tshur log gi lam nas khra 'brug dgon mjal bar phyin/ khra 'brug dgon ni srong btsan gyis btab pa'i dgon pa yin zer/ rten gtso spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso yin/ lho khar zhag gcig bsdad pa yin/phyi nyin bsam yas su mjal bar song / bsam yas 'gro skabs kyang yar klung chu bor gru la zhugs te yun ring 'gro dgos pa dang / skam sar bud tshar dus kyang rlangs 'khor chen po zhig la bsdad de le dbar gsum tsam zhig 'gro dgos kyi 'dug lo rgyus kyi bag chags sam dngos yod kyi gnas tshul ci zhig yin pa ma nges rung / gang ltar bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang chen 178

mjal ba tsam gyis chos srid gnyis kyi bya ba byed myong ba'i tshor snang gi rkang rjes shig nga'i snying la bkod song / thang bde la rtsi shing mang ba'i dkyil na bsam yas gtsug lag khang de 'dug spyir bsam yas min pa'i bod kyi rgyal sa yum bu bla sgang / po ta la/ rgyal rtse'i rdzong mkhar thams cad ri mgo kho na la bruzhengs yod pa mthong / lha sa'i mchod mjal pa phal che de bsam yas na thon pas bsam yas skor mkhan de nyin re 'a/ rlangs 'khor kha shas chad med du yong gi 'dug 'dir skor mkhan kha shas ni ar co byas te 'khar bar brten nas yong ba dang / mang shos de rlangs 'khor chen po'i nang 'gro ba mthong /nga tsho 'gro nyin thag ring nas yong pa'i gnas skor mkhan ha cang mang bo 'dugami de dag gi gos la dri nag mang ba dang / spus mi gtsang ba dang / lam rgyags kyang stabs bde ba zhig las gang yang mi 'dug mdor bsdus te bshad na mdog mi sdug pa dang / thabs skyo bo zhig red/ 'on kyang mi de dag gis sems kyi bde skyid ni nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhig ste/ spro dga' khog nas rgyas stabs dgod sgras sa gzhi kun tu khyab/ phyi gling pa de dag ya mtshar nas dpar mang bo rgyag pa mthong / khong tsho ya mtshar ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dpal 'byor gyi kha thabs zhan la cha rkyen sdug pa/ tha na 'khor ba la brten de gnas kun skor nas 'gro ba ste/ phal cher 'tsho ba bya 'tsho byi'u 'tsho la spyod pa 'di dag yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa ltar sems kyi bde skyid thob pa la/ sgor dung phyur can gyi mi dag kyang 'gran mi thub pa mthong pas/ 'di 'dra'i 'tsho ba rjes lus can la bde ba bla med thob pas ya mtshar ba red 'dug bsam yas nas yar klung gtsang bo'i kha bar khur ba'i grwa ba sga sgril gtong mkhan dang /gla chas ma 'grig nas 'dzing mo byed dgos byung / sngon byon rgyal blon gyi byang sems kyi gdan sa khyad par can de dag tu za 'dod spyang khu'i spyod pa 'dzin mkhan re zung yod pa de dag gis sdig pa tshabs chen bsags pa gdon mi za 179

ba zhig go / de nyin bsam yas nas thad kar lha ldan du phyin/ de'i phyi nyin lha sa'i slob 'bring dang bor lta skor byas/ 'di ni lha sa'i gling na ches phul byung dang mthong chen byed sa'i slob grwa zhig yin zer/ sngon dus khri byang rin po ches slob gtso'i 'gan bzhes myong ba red zer 'dug de rjes rim bzhin se ra dang 'bras spungs/ dga' ldan bcas mjal bar phyin/ se ra dgon de gshis rtsub pa'i rnam pa zhig 'dug nga'i pha yul phyogs kyi dar rgyas dgon pa'i grwa sa yang 'di red/ ma zad nga'i zhang bo rin chen rgya mtsho zer ba zhig kyang 'di nas 'dzing mo mang bo byas pas/ mthar smon lam chen mo 'tshogs skabs shig la lkog gri bsnun nas gzhan gyi g.yo 'og tu srog shor song / lo rgyus de dag yid la yang yang shar gyi 'dug dgon 'di nas rten gtso rta mgrin gsung byon ma mjal/ khang tshan so sor lha gnyer so so 'dug zhor du sku mkhar ma ru ste/ thon mis bod yig bzos pa'i gnas khyad par can pha bong mkhar mjal bar song / los yin snyam pa'i lo rgyus kyi gson nyams dod pa'i gnas de mjal ba tsam gyis dga' spro dang nga rgyal chabs cig tu skyes so/ / 'bras spungs dgon de lhod 'jam gyis gshis dang ldan pa/ dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal yang 'di na 'dug pas chab srid skyong ba'i lam lugs yod par ma zad/ des shugs rkyen yod pa khor yug dang mi sna mthong ba tsam gyis rtogs thub/ rten gtso rwa lo chen po'i sku gdung bzhugs par grags pa'i 'jigs byed sku de mjal/ dga' ldan dgon ni ri ngo mtshar che ba/ spro skyid ngang gis bskyed pa'i gnas shig na 'dug khyad par du rje tsong kha ba chen pos phyag btab pa'i gdan sa yin pa dang / mjal rten mang ba sogs dge mtshan chen po yod/ de rjes stod lung du mtshur phu dgon mjal bar phyin/ mtshur phu dgon ni karma bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i mched gzhi gtso bo zhig yin/ rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng bcu bdun pa o rgyan 'gro 180

'dul phrin las rdo rje mjal kha zhus pa ma zad/ zur bcar gyi dus tshod gnang bas si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i lo rgyus yar zhu dang / slob grwar zhabs pad bkod thub pa'i gsol 'debs byas pa yin/ snga phyi de dag gi bar skabs shig la pho brang po ta la'i nang rten rnams mjal bar song / pho brang po ta la de pho brang dkar dmar gnyis bgos 'dug pho brang dkar po ni srid skyong gi bya ba byed sa dang / pho brang dmar po ni chos skyong ba'i bya ba byed sa yin gsungs/ pho brang nang du sku gdung mchod rten mang ba dang / tshogs khang che ba/ gzim chung mang ba bcas kyis rkang pa na dgos pa zhig 'gro rgyu 'dug khyad par po ta la'i rtse mor srong btsan gyi rang byon sku gzugs bzhugs sa de ni/ ri yi rtse mo yin pa dang / srong btsan thog mar bzhugs gnas yin kho thag lags/ de'i nyin nor bu gling khar mjal skor phyin pas/dngos gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i gling kha zhig red/ skyed tshal dang / chu rdzing mang ba/ gnas khang de dag kyang mja'/ ba tsam gyis dga' dad lhan cig skyes thub pa 'dug zhor du lcags po ri la gnas mjal byas pas rten rtsa chen mang po mjal rgyu yod pa ma zad/ khyad par du srong btsan gyi sgrub phug brag dong zhig mjal bas/ rlabs chen mi rigs gzhan dag gi lo rgyus dang 'dra ba'i nyams snang zhig shugs kyis skyes pas bshad mi shes pa'i bro ba zhig myong ngo / / de ltar lha ldan gyi phyogs mang po zhig bskor ba'i mthar/ bod kyi mes po de dag gi shes rab dang stobs tshad med kyi rnam thar de go bar ma zad/ kho tsho'i bsam blo 'khor phyogs de yang shes thub pa byung / dngos gnas gser dngul g.yu sogs rin chen rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ spungs na ri dang 'dra ba mang bos sku gsung thugs rten bzos pa dang / zhal zas gangs ri ltar sgrig pa/ mchod me mar khu rgya mtsho ltar sbar ba sogs kyis thun min gyi khyad chos mang bo 'dug gal te bod kyi mes po de dag gis blo kha 'jig rten 181

dar rgyas gtong ba'i rig pa la bskor yod na/ su yi thad du yang langs thub pa'i chab srid dpal 'byor dmag stobs yod pa ma zad/ phas rgol me yi phung bor bsgyur ba'i cha rkyen yang 'dzoms nges kyi yid ches bcos min zhig skyes so 182 rī

phyi gling du song ba'i mthong thos/dang po/ khor yug gi skor/'jar man gtso bor byas pa'i yo rob kyis/ ljon shing dang / rtsi shing /rtswa ljang ne'u gsing sogs la mthong chen byed/ nags srab 'thug kyi khyad par ni los yod ma gtogs/ gzhung lam g.yas g.yon kun na shing nags med sa zhig mi 'dug der brten 'dzam gling 'di na yo rob ni khor yug srung skyob skor la gtam bshad pa'i dbang cha yod cing / khor yug srung skyob la sems khur ches ldan pa'i rgyal khab kyi gras su gtogs/ zhing sde'i grong pa dag gi sdod khang ni brtsegs gcig can mang ba las brtsegs ma can ni nyung / khang pa'i phyi rol tu ra ba chen po zhig gis bskor/ de'i nang du 'gro lam min pa'i sa gzhan rnams rtswa ljang dang me tog gis khyab par byas/ grong pa dag na 'ur zing med cing 'jam thing nge zhi ba'i rnam pa la mi grangs kyang nyung / de'i khor yug dag tu yang ljon shing gis khengs nas yod/ khyim tshang dag gi rlangs 'khor rnams ni ra ba chen po zhig gi nang mnyam du 'jog zhing las ni rgun 'brum dang gro las byas/ spyir las rigs gang la yang ched mkhas pa mang ba dang / zhing las lag rtsal tshad mthon po yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skyes stobs bzang ba'i gro dang rgun 'brum gyis sa gzhi kun sngo ljang gi rnam par gyur/'bras rtags kyis rgyu dpog pa ste/ lo tog de dag skyes stobs legs pa'i rnam pa mig sngar 'char dus/ so nam gyi bya ba la 'bad stangs yag pa/ lag rtsal 183

dang / spyod chas bzang ba shugs kyis go thub pa 'dug yo rob gling gi gzhung lam dag gi myur bgrod gzhung lam gyis sbrel nas yod/ dper na yo rob kyi rgyal khab mang po phan tshun sbrel mthud yod pa dang / rgyal mtshams brgal dus lag 'khyer dag bstan mi dgos/ 'jar man gyi shis the le dus su myur bgrod gzhung lam bzos pa dag deng sang yang spyod kyi yod/ yo rob rgyal khab dag gi mtha' mtshams rnams rgya mtsho dang thug pa zhig yin/ khyad par wus nyi'u hri'u phyogs kyi rgya mtsho nas e shar ya bar du gna' nas mtsho gru'i rgyu lam yod cing / i ṭa li'i mar khi po lo yang 'di nas rgya nag dang bod kyi sa khul dag tu song ba red/ yo rob tu dbyin ji dang ru'u si phar phud pa'i rgyal khab gzhan dag ni yo rob mnyam 'brel cha tshang bzos stabs kyis/ rgyal mtshams brgal ba'i lag 'khyer yang gcig gis go chod/ gnam gshis ni bod khul dang 'dra bo red/ bod kyi ri lta bu'i mthon po med rung ri chung chung mang po yod/ grong khyer chen po dag tu lha khang chen po re med sa med/ lha khang chen po re re'i 'dzugs skrun gyi yun la mi lo brgya tsho song bar bshad/ bod lta bu'i lha khang mang po med rung thun mong gi lha khang re re la/ dpal 'byor gyi 'gro song che ba/ 'char gzhi bzang ba/ las rgya che ba/ ar las bzo skrun phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin/gnyis pa/ 'cho ba'i skor/yo rob gling gi 'jar man dang h+pha ran si/ ru'e si rnams ni dbul phyug cha snyoms shing / spyi khyab kyi 'tsho ba bzang / zhing 'brog tshang ma'i yong sgo bzang zhing / lag rtsal la mkhas pa'i mi sna ches mang / bzo las/ zhing las/'brog las bcas kyi lag rtsal phul byung mi sna mang bas de dag gi thon rdzas 184

dag ni rtse dra yin pa/ dper na/ zhing las pas rgun 'brum dang gro yi so nam gtso bo byas pas/ de dag chud zos su mi 'gro zhing thon rdzas spus ldan du bsgyur ba ste/ rgun 'brum gyis chang bzo ba/ gro yis sgang sogs bsregs zas rigs byed pa/ ma rtsa rgun 'brum de nyid lag rtsal khyad par can gyi byed thabs spyod de btung ba zhim pa/ gzugs ngo/ la mi gnod pa/ pho ba gso byed/'jam sha can du sgyur byed sogs kyi dge mtshan ldan pa'i rgun chang ste/ 'dzam gling na grags pa/ 'dzam gling gi tshong ra chen po khag tu 'grim pa zhig byas/gro yi kha zas kyang lag rtsal gyi byed thabs sna tshogs kyis kha la zhim pa/ pho ba la mi gnod pa/ gzugs stobs skyed byed/ bro ba mi 'dra ba/ rnam pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byas/ rgya nag lta bu'i bro dkar po de 'dra med/ rang byung gi za ma la rtsis su 'dzin pas gro mdog ma bsgyur ba de nyid yin pas nag shas che/ de bzhin du 'brog pas kyang 'o ma phal che 'o log ste skyur log dang mi 'dra zhing mar gyi bcud ldan gyi zhim zas byas/ de tshong ra ru 'grim pa rgya che/ 'o log rgya ma gang la mi dmangs shog sgor dgu bcu nas brgya dang lnga bcu bar rnyed kyi yod/ 'o log nang du skyur po'i bro ba yod med gnyis 'dug 'o log 'di nga tsho'i mar las kyang rin gong che zhing / mar las kyang thon tshad mtho ba/ dus ring por nyar rung rul sung mi 'gro ba sogs kyi dge mtshan yod/ khyad par du mar rgya ma gang 'bud byed la 'o ma rgya ma bcu gcig dgos pa dang / 'o log rgya ma gang 'bud byed la ba 'o rgya ma nyi shu dgos pa/ 'bri 'o ni ba 'o dang mi 'dra bas rgya ma drug las mi dgos/ de ltar na mar dang 'o log gi 'gro gron dang yong sgo brtsi na khe gang gi che gsal por shes/ spyir phyi gling yo rob dang bod pa'i bza' btung rigs 'dra ba ste/ zho dang / 'o ma/ mar/ gro sgang /sha dang 'o log sogs gcig pa gcig kyang red/ rgyun du kha h+phe ja dang /dkyus ma'i ja/ rgun 'brum gyi chang sogs la spyod/ chu ni grang mo btung / sha 185

sra mo ma yin zhing snyi mo bzos pa zhig za/ phyi gling pas zhogs zas de ches zhim po zhig yin/ dper na 'o ma dang zho/ mar dang 'o log sha dang shing 'bras rigs/ ja dang shing 'bras kyi khu ba kun la spyod/ rgya gro ma sogs sra 'bras rigs phar phud 'phro tshod ma snyi mo rigs rnams brlan par gsol/ ma bcos pa ste/ rdzas sbyor ma byas pa'i za ma la btson bral zas rigs (྾6ṣ+peṭha)zhes mthong chen byed/ gon pa la rgyal khab so sos mthong chen bzo lugs mi 'dra/ dper na h+pha ran si ni rtog 'char gyi gon pa ste/ nyams mtshar mtshar dag gon pa'o/ i ṭa li ni gos nyams la phan pa ste/ rin gong che ba dag gon/'jar man gyis gos la de 'dra'i mthong chen mi byed cing / stabs ci bde bde byed kyi yod/ phyi gling pa de dag gis rlangs 'khor la rtsis su 'dzin pa ni/bod mis rta la rtsis 'dzin pa bzhin no/ phyi gling ba la bza' zla med na chog rung rlangs 'khor med du mi rung zer srol yod/ ngas gong du zhus pa bzhin 'tshospyod kyi yong khungs ni bzo las zhing las 'brog las spus ldan zhig byed/dper na bzo las la cha mtshon na nyer mkho spyod chas rigs nas 'phrul cha chen po'i rigs bar gang bzos pa dag ni spus ka bzang pa/ spyod yun ring ba/dgos mkho che ba/ tshan rig dang mthun pa sha stag go/ dper na rlangs 'khor ches bzang ba dag ni yo rob 'jar man gyi yin pa ste/ pa'o ma (dh+wapaṃ 7nesto)rlangs 'khor zhes 'dzam gling na grags pa de yang 'jar man rgyal khab kyi yin pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar ro/ ngas nang rgyal du 'di 'dra'i rlangs 'khor zhig yod na snyam ste mtshan mor rmis pa'i rmi lam gyi rlangs 'khor dag 'di na mngon gyur gyis snang / rlangs 'khor che 'bring chung gsum spus ka ldan pa dag ni nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar grangs mang ba zhig go/ de bzhin spyod chas gzhan dag gi thon rdzas rigs kyang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin/ mdor na 'gro ba mi yi rigs la mkho nges dag ni 'di na 'dug bdag cag gi ston 186

pas 'tsho ba'i zas la ma brten gang yang med gsungs pa dang / zas ma mchis na lus ma mchis/ lus ma mchis na chos kyang ma mchis zhes gsungs pa ltar 'tsho byed ni gnad che ba zhig yin par bstan/ gsum pa/ 'dod brtse'i skor/spyir 'dod khams 'dir chags pa shugs che la/ bltas pas gzugs kyis mi ngoms shing / reg sbyor dgos pas gnyis gnyis 'khrig spyod la zhugs pas 'dod khams zer/ 'dod khams 'dod chags kyi sa ba phyi gling yo rob gling na/ pho mo'i brtse sems mtshon pa'i bro gzhas 'khrab pa dang / pho mo'i brtse dung gi rnam 'gyur mtshon pa'i ri mo bris pa ches mang / de bzhin bya yi rigs dag las kyang phug ron la dga' zhen che zhing / phug ron la mthong chen byed/ phug ron ni srog chags gzhan la 'tshe ba mi byed cing / zhi bde'i mtshon byed cig brtsis/ mtha' na khong tsho'i chos lugs su yang phug ron la mthong chen byed pa dang phug ron bsad na nyes can gyi rigs su brtsis/ phug ron gyi brtse chags che lugs la/ dper na slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis/snyan ngag tu phug ron gyi rigs ched du brjod pa ste/ mgrin pa'i nang nas snyan sgrogs shing / mig ni kun tu 'phrul ba yi/ phug ron brtse 'dod dga' ma la/ yongs su bskor nas mchu dag sbyor zhes phug ron ni bya yi rigs dag las chags pa ha cang che ba'i rigs su brtsi/ 'dod khams 'dod pa'i sa ba ru mi yi rigs dag chags pa shugs che ba smros ma dgos/ de las kyang phyi gling yo rob gling gi mi rnams ni chags sems mngon gsal dod po ste/ grong khyer chen po dag tu mi tshogs kyi gseb na pho mo dag 'o 'khyud byed cing / lta skor byed sa'i gnas grags can du mi tshogs ji tsam mang rung de bzhin 'dzem med 187

kyis 'o byed pa dang / phan tshun 'khyud kyi yod par mthong / dper na/ h+pha ran si'i 'o byed tshul ni ha cang skad grags yod pa zhig yin/ ma zad khong tsho'i rgyal po'i pho brang dag dang / lha khang grags can dag tu yang / bud med skyes gzugs mdzes pa lang tsho rgyas pa dang / skyes pa nyams dang ldan pa dag gi ri mo bris pa las/ bod lta bu'i srog chag rigs dang shing 'bras me tog rigs bris pa ni ches nyung / dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis nyin mo grib ma tsam 'gom yug shor mi rung ba'i rigs rus kyi 'dzem dogs che ba'i pho mo dag mtshan mo nyal sar gcig tu 'dres pa dag ni/ brtse dung gi phan 'bras yin par brjod pa bzhin/ h+pha ran si'i grong khyer kha shas su sol ba ltar nag pa'i mi nag gi pho gsar dang / zla ltar dkar ba'i bud med gzhon nu ma dag mnyam du 'grogs shing / bud med gzhon nu ma byad bzhin legs pa dag gis skyes pa nag po dag la dga' brtse'i rnam pas lag pa'i dpung pa dag la 'jus te 'khyud par snang / de dus dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsungs de slar yang thengs gcig dran byung / gang nas bsam rung brtse dung gi 'jig rten dngos ma zhig 'di na yod par go/bzhi pa/ slob gso'i skor/slob gso ni mi yi rigs kyi chab srid dpal 'byor rig gnas yar 'gro mar 'gro'i 'gag rtsa yin pa/ mi yi rigs kyi rig pa'i dwangs ma mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud gsog gsog byas pa'i mi chos lha chos phyogs bsdoms kyis snyigs dor bcud len byas pa las byung ba zhig yin/ der brten kun gyi rtsa ba slob gso yin zhes bshad na yang thal mi che zhing 'tsham pa zhig yin/ de ltar na yo rob kyi slob gso lam lugs dang nang rgyal gyi slob gso lam lugs 188

gnyis ni ches mi 'dra ba ste/ chung byis pa'i slob gso nas che slob grwa chen mo'i slob gso bar mi mtshungs tshul ni/ phyi gling yo rob pas byis pa slob gso byed tshul ni byis pa'i skyes gzugs skyed sring byed thabs dang byis pa'i sems spro thabs gtso bor bzung ste/ lus bde sems spro can gyi byis pa'i zhing khams shig bskrun pa dang / mdor na byis pa la skyid gling rtsed rar zhugs pa'i myong tshor ster ba las slob sbyong gi dka' sdug de myong 'jug gi med/ rgyal nang du sngon thon mi rigs spus tshad mtho ba dag gis byis pa rig gnas can du 'gyur phyir chung dus nas re ba chen po 'don skad kyis byis pa rig gnas kyi ra bar btsan por bcug ste/ sgrig gis gcun gyi yod/ bod rigs kyi byis pa phal mo che ha lam mgyogs 'gro thub pa nas mig sngar gyi khe phan la bltas te be'u rdzi dang phag rdzi btang ba las rig gnas slob sar gtong gi med/ slob grwar 'gro ba'i phyi gling yo rob kyi byis pa dang nang rgyal gyi byis pa gnyis kyang mi 'dra ste/phyi gling yo rob 'jar man pas byis pas rgyugs skar mthon por len dgos pa'i re ba mi bton/ khyad par du rgyal nang lta bu'i byis pa phan tshun bar gyi 'gran rtsod de 'jar man la mi dgos/ de bzhin 'jar man pas khyim gyi las bya dang / rang sbyong sogs la do gal gyis skul 'ded mi byed/ gtso bo byis pa rang nyid kyi mos phyogs dang bstun pa las pha mas u tshugs kyis mthor 'ded de mi byed/ rang dbang gi slob gso zhig yin pa las btsan po u tshugs kyi slob gso zhig ma yin/ khyad par du byis pa rang nyid la lhan skyes su gnas pa'i mos pa de bskyar gso byas pa las pha ma'i 'dod phyogs de bu rgyud la btsan bkal mi byed/ slob chung ni de 'dra lhod dal yang pa zhig gis mthar phyin/ slob 'bring ni slob chung las cung dam zhing dka' khag cung che/ slob 'bring gi slob lo yang nang rgyal gyi slob 'bring las ring / 'on kyang nang rgyal lta bu'i slob spyong la dka' khag med/ yo rob 'jar man du lag rtsal ched 189
