gnyer slob grwa dang gzhung sgrub slob grwa gnyis las lag rtsal slob grwa 'don mkhan mang / rgyu mtshan ni lag rtsal la brten pa'i yong sgo ni sra brtan gyi rang bzhin du ngos 'dzin/ de min gzhan srid 'dzin gyi las sne dag la nges gtan med ces bshad/ 'jar man rgyal yongs gcig gis lag rtsal la mthong chen yod/ lag rtsal mi sna dag gis lag rtsal pa rang thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan bzhin gso skyong byed pa dang / lag rtsal ched gnyer slob grwa sogs slob grwa gang zhig yin rung rig gzhung slob khrid las kyang lag len slob khrid mang /rigs gzhung brgya cha bzhi bcu dang lag len brgya cha drug cu yin pa dang /slob khrid byas pa de dag lag len thog nas ra sprod byed dgos pa las stong bshad mi byed/ mtha' na srid 'dzin gyi las byed slob ma dag gis kyang lag len dngos sbyong byed par dus tshod mang po spyod kyi yod/ dngos sbyong slob mas dngos sbyong byed ring dngos sbyong byed sa'i las khungs kyis gla phogs sprad dgos/ de ltar na 'jar man gyi slob gso'i 'os 'gan rgyal yongs gcig la yod pa las ris su bcad pa zhig ma yin/ slob gso'i don du tshogs 'du dang gros zhib byed dus 1mnyam 'brel srid gzhung / 2khul srid gzhung /2spyod bya'i mi sna/ 4spyod mkhan gyi mi sna bcas zhugs dgos/ 'jar man gyi slob gso'i dbang cha che ba 'dzin mkhan ni khul yin pa las mnyam 'brel srid gzhung min/ gal te mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gis dbang cha cha tshang bzung na zhis the le gnyis pa zhig bud pa'i nyen kha la dogs kyi yod/ khyad par du 'jar man pas las rigs gang la khyad par mi blta zhing dam 'dzin byed kyi yod/ rgyu mtshan des spyi tshogs de cha mnyam pa/ 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig yong gi yod/ deng sang phyi gling phal che bas byang tshad slob gso la mthong chen byed pa las rig gzhung slob gso la de tsam rtsa ba mi 'dzin/ mdor na spyi tshogs la mkho nges kyi las rigs gang zhig yin rung gdam ga dang khyad par mi bltas 190

nas sbyong pa byed cing mthong chen yod/ tha na nga tsho bod pas chang las pa la chang tshong gi khyim zhes smad pa'i gnas de yang khong tshos gzi brjid can gyi khyim tshang zhig tu brtsis/ lnga pa/ chos lugs kyi skor/yo rob kyi chos lugs ni ye shu'i chos lugs red/ de la gnam bdag chos lugs sogs grub mtha' rigs kha shas mchis/ gang ltar khong tsho'i chos lugs ni 'jig rten legs par byed pa'i chos shig tu mthong gi 'dug gang yin zer na bza' btung sogs ni spyod bya yin pas de la longs su spyod na sdig pa gang yang med/ dper na sha bzar bya yin pa rta chibs bya yin pa rlangs 'khor bskor bya yin pa sogs lhas gnang ba dag la nga tshos longs su spyod pa yin zhes bshad/ mdor na 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad gcig phan gcig grogs su gnas pa las spang bya med pa lta bu'o/ / bsam pa bzang po la mthong chen yod cing dge bar brtsis/ de 'dra ba'i dge ba'i bya bas lha ru 'gro/ bsam ngan byas pas dmyal bar 'gro ba las 'gro sa gzhan mi 'dod/ngas gong zhus kyi sha bza' bya yin pa sogs longs su spyod thub tshod kyi sems can srog bcad pa las chud zos su gtong ba yin na sdig las su 'gyur/ de bzhin bya dngos gzhan dag kyang 'tsham po zhig byed dgos par 'dod/ de ltar na 'khor ba spang bya dang myang 'das thob byar mi 'dod/ 'khor ba ni lhas bkod pa yin pas skyon du mi lta/ gong zhus ltar tshe phyi mar 'gro sa gnyis te lha'i zhing dang dmyal ba'i gnas gnyis las gzhan yod par mi 'dod/las rigs gang la yang dbye bsal med par mthong chen yod/ dper na bod pas mgar gyi khyim dang chang tshong gi khyim la dma' 'beb pa lta bu ni chos 191

lugs pa 'di dag la dri tsam yang mi bro/ de ltar na chang tshong yin la chos pa yin pa/ srog gcod pa yin la chos lugs pa yin pa sogs 'gal med du 'dod pa/ 'jig rten 'phel rgyas gtong ba la chos lugs 'di ches 'tsham pa zhig go/ chos lugs 'di la dad mkhan mang zhing chos lugs 'di rgya che dar/dper na 'dzam gling gi chos lugs chen po gsum ste/ 1ye shu'i chos lugs/2e sa la'i chos lugs/ 2nang pa'i chos lugs yod pa la/ de las ye shu'i chos lugs 'di la 'byor ldan gyi rgyal khab mang po zhig gis dad pa byed kyin yod/ khyad par du ye shu'i chos sgrub pa rnams kyis chos dang 'jig rten mi 'gal ba'i thog nas bya ba bsgrub par 'dod pas/ 'jig rten 'phel thabs mchog tu bsngags/ 'on kyang spyir 'dzam gling gi nyin re bzhin rnyog 'dzing me ltar tsha ba/ ya nga ba gshin rje'i grong 'dra ba dag ste dper na pa dbyi'i bar gyi 'gal ba/ a mi ri ka dang dbyi rag bar gyi 'gal ba kun kyang mthar thug ste bshad na chos lugs kyi 'gal ba red/ ngas yo rob rgyal khab dag tu lta skor byed ring ha las dgos pa'i don tshan gcig ni khong tshos ye shu'i chos lugs la dad zhen dang dga' zhen de red/ grong khyer chen po re re na lha khang bsam yul las 'das pa re re med sa med/ de la skor mjal byed mkhan rgyun mi chad/ go thos ltar na lo re la khong tsho'i chos lugs mi sna khri sum brgya re kha snon yong thabs byed kyi yod pa red zer/ nye char rang khul gyi gzhon nu rnams la khong tsho'i chos lugs slob tu bcug nas khong tsho'i chos lugs dril bsgrags byed rgyu'i sta gon byed pa red ces go/ rgyu mtshan 'di dag la bltas pas chos lugs la dga' zhen ji ltar yod go thub/ khyad par du ye shu 'di 'dzam gling na shugs rkyen che ba/ grags che ba'i ston pa zhig red/ dper na deng dus yongs grags kyis brtsis pa'i spyi lo ni ye shu'i 'khrungs lo yin pa/ rgyal khams spyi'i gza' nyi ma'i ngal gso'i dus tshod ni ye shu'i chos lugs mi snas chos byed 192

pa'i dus yin zhing / de yang khong tsho'i lhas 'jig rten 'di nyin drug la byas pas ngal gso pa'i dus yin 'dug ye shu'i 'khrungs skar du ye shu'i chos la dad mi dad kun gyis rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo re byed bzhin yod/ ye shu khong ni a ma ma li'u ya (m+mu7sgro)la skyes/ skyes sa ni deng skad grags can gyi ye lu'u sa la (༅ar+sāphya)yin pa/ skyes tshu'/ yang bshad lugs mi 'dra ba kha shas mchis rung mdor na pha med pa lta bu zhig bshad/ lo grangs kyang nyi shu lhag las ma 'dug deng mi bzang don bzang gi bya ba sgrub rtags su rgya gram dmar po bzo ba dang ye shu bzhi rgyang byed pa gnyis la 'brel ba yod dam snyam/de bzhin e sa la'i ston pa ma ha ma ti de yang ye lu'u sa la ru skyes/ lo drug cu lhag 'dug mna' ma gsum khrid/ chos lugs 'di gnyis kyi bar du 'gal 'brel gyi rnam gzhag mang po yod snyam/ spyir sa paṇa gyis/ legs par dpyad na chos dang mi 'gal zhing / 'jig rten bya ba kun nas legs sgrub pa zhes chos dang 'jig rten gnyis mi 'gal nas bya ba bsgrub tshul bstan pa dang /phun sum tshogs pa sde bzhi zhes chos nor 'dod thar bzhi 'jog pa sogs chos dang 'jig rten mi 'gal bar bstan pa 'di dag dang ye shu'i chos gnyis kyi bar du 'gal 'brel ji ltar yod brtag par 'tshal/drug pa/ chab srid lam lugs kyi skor/yo rob 'jar man rgyal khab ni 'dzam gling dgra 'khrug gnyis pa'i rjes su mnyam 'brel gyi srid gzhung btsugs pa yin/ sger bcad kyi dbang cha su la yang med/ dgra 'khrug gnyis pa'i rjes su shar gyi 'jar man dang nub kyi 'jar man zhes gnyis su bgos/ shar gyi 'jar man ni u ru si'i kha 'og tu yod stabs spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi 'gro lugs dang mthun par byas/ nub kyi 193

'jar man ni a mi ri ka'i kha 'og tu yod stabs ma rtsa ring lugs kyi 'gro lugs byas/ lo bzhi bcu tsam song rjes phyogs gnyis kyi dpal 'byor gyi he bag gnam sa ltar khyad par shor ba dang / nub phyogs pa rnams 'byor ba che la shar phyogs pa rnams dbul ba zhig go spyi lo 1990lor zla ba 1kyatshes 2la 'jar man phyogs gnyis po gcig gyur byas te dmangs gtso mnyam 'brel srid gzhung btsugs/ mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gi tsung thang ni mnyam 'brel tshogs chen gyis bsko bzhag byed dgos/ mnyam 'brel tshogs chen ni mnyam 'brel gros tshogs kyi tshogs mi yongs dang de dang grangs ka mnyam pa'i khul so so'i 'go ba bcas las grub pa yin/ 'dems bya de tang srid so sos mi sna'i ming tho sprad dgos/ skor gsum 'dems pa dang / 'dems bya lo bzhi bcu lon pa dang 'jar man gyi spyi dmangs yin pa/ tsung thang gi 'gan tshad ni lo lnga yin pa sogs phyag srol mang / tsung thang la don gyi dbang cha chen po med rung mnyam 'brel srid gzhung gis tsung thang gi bka' ltar las ka byed dgos te/ khrims lugs ltar na tsung thang ni mnyam 'brel gyi sku tshab yin/tsung li'u ni tsung thang gis ming phud de 'dems bsal byed dgos/ spyir 'jar man ni khrims ldan gyi rgyal khab cig yin la/ gtso 'dzin sde khag man chad 'bangs sde spyi ba yan chad khrims 'og tu ma 'dus par med/ khrims lugs kho na la brten nas thag gcod bya ba las mi'i rang bsam gyi dbang cha spyod sa med/ khyad par du 'dzam gling dgra 'khrugs gnyis pa'i rjes su khrims lugs la de las kyang mthong chen dang khrims lugs kyi go sa je mthor btang ste/bya ba gros kyis bsgrubs te shis the le gnyis pa 'bud pa la sngon 'gog byed kyi yod/ de bzhin slob gso lam lugs bsgyur bcos dang gtan 'khel byed dgos na rtsa 'dzugs kyi sde khag so so 'dzoms te gros mol byed dgos/ dper na gzhung las las don phud pa'i sger don du tsung thang yin rung gzhung gi 194

gnam gru dang rlangs 'khor chung ba sogs spyod mi chog gal te de 'dra'i gnas tshul yod na bsam 'char bshad rgyu'i dbang cha mi dmangs la yod/spyir 'jar man ni 'jar pan dang mi 'dra zhing khong tshos dgra 'khrugs byas pa ni nor 'khrul yin pa'i ngos 'dzin yod par ma zad 'dzam gling du yang de bzhin dril bsgrags byed/bdun pa/ mngon gsal dod po'i dge mtshan gyi skor/yul lung gang du yang 'ur zing mi che zhing 'jam po'i 'tsho ba la dga' zhing dben sim mer gyi rnam pa yod/ sne len byed skabs rnams su yang nang rgyal dang mi 'dra zhing mi mang kha mang gi 'ur zing mi che zhing 'jam thing nge bzo/dngos gzhi'i tshogs 'du'i skabs su bshad rkyang nyan rkyang rnam pa ma yin zhing dri ba dris lan gyis gnas tshul shes pa dang the tshom chod par byas/ khyad par du nga tsho 'jar man gyi grong khyer po an du lag rtsal slob gso zhib 'jug so'u la blta skor song bas slob dpon chen mo gnyis kyis lag rtsal slob gso'i las don ngo sprod byed cing bsam blo brje res byas/ sne len byed mkhan bud med gcig las gzhan mi 'dug btung ba rigs sogs rang mos kyis ldug rgyu las mchod mchod gsol gsol gyi ngag 'jam byed mkhan med/ rang gang la mos na de nyid btung na rjes su 'thung mang nyung gi bgro gleng byed pa'i dogs pa mi dgos/ nga tsho yang wus su pa tan grong khyer du mtho rim srid 'dzin do dam slob chen du blta skor song skabs sne len pa dang slob grwa ngo sprod byed mkhan tshang ma 'go khrid gcig gis byas/ nga tsho nang bzhin 'go khrid de mi dkyus ma'i tshod las brgal ba'i 'du shes med cing / 'go khrid zer ba de las ka bzo mkhan yin pa las rdzig nyams bstan mkhan dang mthon por 195

bsdad de zhim zas la rol mkhan zhig min/ 'go khrid ni las ka'i ngos nas bzhag pa yin pa las/ 'go khrid rang nyid gang la mos na gang la zhugs chog pa zhig ma red/ rabs 'byams pa dpal ldan nyi mas phyi gling pa'i skad cha mol skabs phyi gling rgyal khab cig gi 'bru rigs thing gi thing krang la las ka gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig sa zhing lo tog la gnod 'tshe byed pa'i byi'u rigs bkag dgos pa/ gnyis mi ser gyi 'bru rigs phyi la btsong rogs byed rgyu/gal te de gnyis ma 'grub na mi ser gyis bsam 'char 'don chog pa/ de ltar 'go khrid la las ka nges can zhig yod pa yin/ spyir 'jar man pas rigs gzhung gi sbyong pa dang lag len lag rtsal gnyis las lag len lag rtsal de gal che bar brtsi/ de ltar na 'go khrid de shes rig gi tsog tsog tu ma gyur pa lag len lag rtsal la bsngags pa zhig mthong / dngos gzhir 'jug pa ni nga tsho he hran khul e po the ched las slob grwar lta skor song ba dang / slob grwa de na rlangs 'khor skyon bcos dang glog gi las ka ched las sbyong sa zhig red/ ngas gong zhus ltar de yang lag len gtso bo yin gyi rigs gzhung gtso bo ma red/dper na slob mas dngos su rlangs 'khor gyi skyon btsal ba dang skyon bcos kyi bya ba byed pa las lag len de logs shig dang rigs gzhung de logs shig min/glog gi ched sbyong yang sngar bzhin no/ slob khrid yang lhod po dang rang dbang shugs che ba las dam po de 'dra ma red/ de ltar na khong tsho'i sbyong pa de ni dngos gnas kyi sbyong pa zhig yin pa las btsan skul gyis sbyong pa min par rang shugs kyis go/ de nas yang wus su pa tan du tshod lta'i slob 'bring zhig tu lta skor song bas slob grwa de yang gu yang pa sos dal mo'i rnam pa zhig snang / spyir slob grwa phal che la ra ba de 'dras skor mi 'dug slob grwa rnam gsal dang sgo dbye'i rang bzhin du mthong /196

brgyad pa/ lam gyi mthong thos skor/de yang pe cin rgyal sa'i gnam gru'i sa tshigs nas 'jar man mo nyi'u he bar gnam gru chu tshod bcu gnyis 'phur dgos kyi 'dug gnam gru ni 'jar man rgyal khab kyi yin zhing nang gi zhabs zhu mi sna dag kyang krung go'i bu mo gcig ma gtogs gzhan ma tsho ni 'jar man gyi yin pa red/ mi sna yang de 'dra mang po ma red/ lo na yang cung che tsam pa kho na red/ de yang nga tsho lta skor mi sna dag phar phud rjes 'jar man ba kho na red/ khong tsho phal cher de bza' tshang gnyis can mang / khong tsho khyim tshang res krung go'i dwa phrug re khrid 'dug khong tshos dge sgrub kyi rnam pas dwa phrug de dag gso byar khrid pa red 'dug khong tshos khrid pa'i byis pa dag la bza' btung sprad pa dang / ches dga' snang dang ches byams skyong byed kyi 'dug 'on kyang byis pa de dag ni rgyus med mi dang gsar 'dris byed dgos stabs zas dang spyod lam thams cad mi 'dra bas ngu ba dang sems skyo bo byed kyi 'dug lhag par du byis pa cung che ba de rnams kyis phyi gling pa'i mi de dag gi gdong la bltas te/ ches mi dga' ba'i rnam pas ngu gi 'dug gang ltar yang phyi gling pa dag gis byis pa la gces skyong byed bzhin khrid kyi yod par mthong / gcig byas na byis pa de dag dwa phrug lus pas sems pham pa dang las dman gyi gang zag gi rigs su snang / gcig byas na phyi gling pa dag gis khrid de slob gso'i go skabs bzang por thob tu 'jug cing bde skyid can gyi mi zhig bskyed bsrings pas skal bzang gi mi zhig gyur/ 'dzam gling du dgra 'khrug gnyis pa slong ba'i mi rigs gdug rtsub can gyi khongs su gtogs pa zhig gis/ 'di 'dra'i snying rje'i las la zhugs pa de ni ha cang dga' 'os pa zhig red/ gnam gru'i 'phur lam ni pe 197

cin nas u ru su nas a se bhe rgyam nas byang lam len pa de red/smras pa/g.yag ra lung pa kyag kyog che zhing gu dog kyang / /stabs legs stes dbang rlung shugs la brten myur bgrod nas/ /yo rob rgyal khab bdun la bskor ba'i mthong thos kun/ /tshig nyung don bsdus yig phreng rim pa 'di na bkod/ /198

skabs babs bod mi'i shes rig las don mdor brjod dang po/dang po/ rig gnas spyo yi rnam gzhag cung bshad pa/deng sang 'gro ba spyi dang bye brag mi yi 'gro ba kun gyi rgyud na yod pa'i thun mong gi bsam blo gcig yod rgyu de bde bar 'dod cing sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa de yin/ de la brten nas sdug bsngal spong byed dang bde ba thob byed kyi thabs sam lam bu re btsal bzhin yod pa red/ thabs btsal ba'i btsal stangs sam 'tshol stangs mi 'dra ba las rig gnas mi 'dra ba du ma byung / de las mi'i rigs gcig yin yang ris su chad pa'i bsam blo dang /thun mong gi lta ba bcas kyis phyogs so so nas tha dad du gyur pa'i mi rigs grub/ der brten so so'i bde ba myong lugs dang sdug bsngal myong lugs kyang mi 'dra ste/ mi yi rigs 'ga' zhig gi rgyud kyi bde ba de 'ga' zhig la sdug bsngal du snang / dper na chos dad can gyi mi yi rigs kyi chos dad kyi bsam blo de bla med kyi bde ba zhig tu 'dod rung / phyogs gzhan zhig gis de ni ches rjes lus dang ches rmongs pa'i las su brtsis/ yang khag gcig gis dngos po'i dpal yon la mngon zhen drag po byas te chab srid dpal 'byor dmag don bcas dar rgyas btang ste dwangs med kyi rnyog 'dzing dang tshar med kyi las la 'bad cing zing zing 'khrug 'khrug gis me 'bar pa lta bu de ni mi yi rigs kun gyi sgrub 'os kyi las su bshad kyang / 'jam thing thing gi 'tsho ba spyod cing 199

brel med yid lhod lhod la dgyes bzhin ting 'dzin la gnas pa'i gang zag gis ches tha ma'i las su mthong / spyi lo199ṭ+wāṃlo'i zla ba 6pa'i mjug tu a ri'i tsung thung khe le ḍa krung gor zhib gzigs su phebs skabs gsar 'gyur tho 'god pa zhig gis krung go'i rig gnas pa zhig la a ri dang krung go gnyis bar la khyad par ci yod skor gyi bcar 'dri byed skabs/ des bshad don krung go dang a ri gnyis la gang thad nas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par chen po yod/ de'i khyad par byung rkyen ni phyogs gnyis kyi rig gnas mi 'dra bas red/ ces bshad/ dngos gnas de'i skad cha de bden par 'dug dper na/ mi rigs la las ni tha na tshod ma kun rjen zas byed pa dang / bya byed kyang ma bcos pa la dga' ba/ bka' blo bde ba/ kher rkyang gi 'tsho ba la spyod mkhan mang ba dang / yang na zla lo re gnyis kyi pho mo lhan 'dug gi ston mo 'jog srol yod pa yin pas kho rang la thun min gyi khyad chos mang po yod pas khyad chos de ldan gyi mi rigs shig logs su grub/ la la ni sdig pa mi 'dzem par srog chags phal che bza' byar lta ba/ g.yo sgyu dang dogs zon che ba/ bcos ma la dga' ba sogs kyi bsam spyod thun min gyi chos mang po ldan stabs kyis khyad par ba'i mi rigs shig grub/ la la ni gtsang sbra la mi dga' zhing / ma bcos pa'i bya spyod la dga' ba/ sdig las la 'dzem pa/ kha nyung la khog drang ba sogs mtshan nyid yod stabs kyis mtshan nyid de ldan gyi mi rigs shig grub/de dag kun kyang rig gnas kyis khyad par 'byed pa yin gyi gzhan gang yang min/ rig gnas zer ba de mi'i rigs kyi dngos po'i thon rdzas dang bsam pa'i longs spyod kyi spyi bsdoms la zer gyi yod/ rig gnas la dbye na gsum ste/ dngos po'i rig gnas dang / bsam pa'i rig gnas/ lam lugs rig gnas so/ thun min rig gnas kyi 'byung khungs ni thun min gyi khor yug dang / thun min gyi cha rkyen gyis skrun pa zhig yin/ der brten thun min gyi mi 200

rigs zer ba de ni thun min gyi rig gnas ngo bo can gyi mi rigs shig yin dgos kyi thun min gyi rig gnas med na mi rigs med zer chog rgyu mtshan des thun min gyi rig gnas kyis thun min gyi mi rigs shig tshe srog brtan par bzo thub/ rig gnas ga 'dra zhig yod na mi rigs de 'dra zhig yod/ mi rigs ga 'dra zhig yod na rig gnas de 'dra zhig yod/ rig gnas bzang ngan la bltas nas mi rigs bzang ngan dpog pa dang / mi rigs dang rig gnas gnyis kyi bar du de 'dra'i 'brel ba zab mo zhig chags yod stabs kyis rigs so so la rig gnas so so yod pas rig gnas phan tshun 'gal bas rigs so so'i 'gal ba yang de las grub pa zhig red/ 'di dang phyi ma la phan phyir sems can srog bcad pa de yang rig gnas shig yin la/ 'di phyi la phan phyir sems can gyi srog mi gcod pa de yang rig gnas shig go/ de bzhin dper na gang zag gcig la lta tshul gnyis te/ 'ga' zhig gis dgra ru lta ba dang 'ga' zhig gis gnyen du lta ba gnyis ka yang rig gnas las ma 'das so/ mi'i thob thang la brtsi 'jog byed na yang rig gnas yin la brtsi 'jog ma byed pa de yang rig gnas yin pas rig gnas kyis so so la lta tshul mi gcig pa'i he bag shor du bcug pa zhig yin/ der brten bsam blo dang bya spyod gang zhig 'gyur ldog dang sgyur bcos gtong dgos tshe thog mar rig gnas de sgyur bcos dang dgag sgrub byed dgos/ dper na rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin ma'o tse tung gis kyang rgyal khab dar rgyas kyi ched du phyi nang gi rig gnas mang po zhig la dgag sgrub byas pa las dpe deb de 'dra mang por grub 'dug de'i nus pa ni/ yan tsi me skyogs las kyang lhag la rno ngar can gyi ral gri las kyang lhag pa'i ra 'phrod byung yod pa red/ dper 'jar man gyi shis the lan gyis dmag mi de 'dra'i stobs can rtsa 'dzugs byas te 'gro ba mi yi rigs mang po zhig mtshon la drang te btsan 'dzul byas rung mthar rang nyid 201

pham kha 'khel ba des kyang mi yi bsam blo'i rig gnas 'gyur ba gtong ma thub na mi phan pa'i tshul de shes thub/ de bzhin sog dmag gis rgyal khab de 'dra mang po zhig la btsan 'dzul byas rung mthar sngar gyi ris nang du 'gro ba las 'gyur ba sor gang yang ma phyin/ der brten ma'o tse tung gis sngon rabs kyi dmag mi gzi mdangs can de tshos de 'dra mi mang po bsad pa de dud 'gro glag bsad pa bzhin phan thogs gang yang byung med gsungs pa'i sdom tshig gcig gnang yod pa red/ bod yig slob grwa'i dge rgan dpal ldan legs bshad kyis nga ni zhi bas rim 'gyur la skrag gi khrag zag pa la mi skrag zer ba de yang sngon gyi lo rgyus de dag gi gnad kyi sdom tshig cig yin/ zhi bas rim 'gyur zer ba de rig gnas gcig gis rig gnas gcig 'gyur ba gtong ba las gzhan gang yang min pa'i go ba len dgos/ mtshams 'di nas chab srid dang / rig gnas/ dmag don dang / dpal 'byor bcas khyad par cung zad bshad pa'i dgos pa 'dug pas de la chab srid ni 'jig rten gyi chos yin pa gang zhig gzhan dbang du bsdu pa'i dmigs yul bzung zhing rtsa 'dzugs kyi sgo nas gral rim zhig gis gral rim zhig la 'thab rtsod slong ba dang / spyi tshogs bar gyi 'thab rtsod dang phyi 'brel gyi bya spyod/ chab 'bangs skyong ba'i khrims lugs bcas la chab srid zer/ rig gnas zer ba de chab srid las kyang rgya che ba chab srid lta bu'i btsan shed med pa dngos po dang lam lugs bsam blo bcas pa la rig gnas zer/ dmag don ni/ kha gtod du dgra bo yod pa gang zhig rang rgyal lam rang sde srung ba dang gzhan sde dbang du bsdu ba'i dmag 'khrug gi 'brel ba yod pa'i bya bzhag la zer/ dpal 'byor ni/spyi tshogs kyi dngos po'i thon skyed dang / slar yang thon skyed byed pa'i bya bzhag la zer/ de ltar na chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/dmag don bcas kyi bar la 'brel ba dam po yod pa ma zad/ tha dad yin pa 202

yang shes dgos/ tha dad min na 'brel ba yod mi rung ba zhig yin te/gcig la 'brel bya 'brel byed mi 'thad pas so/ ma gzhi 'di 'dra'i rigs la dpyad zhib phra mo ma byas na/ rig gnas chab srid du 'khrul ba dang / chab srid rig gnas la 'khrul ba sogs kyi nor 'khrul che bas phyogs 'di la rtogs zhib phra mo byed dgos/gnyis pa/ slob grwa'i slob gso skor bye brag tu bshad pa/dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni/ dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs yin pas dpal 'byor med na bya ba gang yang mi 'grub pa lta bu snang gi yod pas/dpal 'byor yod na sa dang lam yang bzang / / dpal 'byor med na sa dang lam yang ngan/ / tham cad dpal 'byor dag la rag las pas/ / dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya/ / zhes pa'i lung 'dren srol chags yod pa lta bu red/ dpal 'byor dar rgyas gtong ba de yang rig pa zhig te dpal 'byor rig pa la thug yod/ der brten/ dpal 'byor rig pas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba dang / dpal 'byor la 'dod 'dun che ba'i mi rnams gcig tu zlum/ gcig tu zlum pas rigs gcig gi gong bur chags pa la 'byor ldan gral rim zer gyi yod/ de nas 'byor ldan dang 'byor med bar he bag shor bas 'gal ba rang bzhin gyis grub/ 'byor ldan pas 'byor med par dbang sgyur ba dang / 'byor med kyis 'byor ldan la ngo rgol byed/ 'byor ldan pas 'byor ldan gyi khe phan don du bsam spyod kyi bya 'gul spel pa dang / 'byor med pas 'byor med kyi don du bsam spyod kyi bya 'gul spel ba bcas ni chab srid zer ba de red/ gal te 'gro ba mi yi rigs su gyur pa kun gyis dpal 'byor la dmigs te dpal 'byor rig pa ste/ lag rtsal sna 203

tshogs kyi rig gnas te tshong las dang glog klad sogs la 'bad na thad kar dpal 'byor dang 'brel ba yod pa dang / ma zad spyi tshogs ni dpal 'byor la kha phyogs nas yod pas slob grwa bas spyi tshogs dgos mkho dang mthun phyir dpal 'byor rig pa kho na la kha phyogs te dpal 'byor rig pa kho na la 'bad tshe/ 1ya rabs gshis bzang can gyi mi sna je nyung du 'gro ba/ 2rgyu nor hab thob byed pa'i mi nag je mang du 'gro ba/ 2dbul phyug gi khyad par chen po shor ba/ 4srol rgyun rig gzhung gtor brlag shor ba/ 5grangs nyung mi rigs sam nus med mi rigs kyi skad yig nyams rgud du 'gro ba sogs kyi skyon yod/ dang po de yang yin te/ rgyu nor la zhen chags che na rgyu nor byung na spyod bzang la bsam blo gtong mkhan med/ de yang 'jig rten gyi dpe la/ cha lugs ngan yang rang don 'grub dgos zer ba lta bur 'gyur nges/ gnyis pa de yang yin te/ rgyu nor spyi tshogs kyis dang po'i gnas su 'jog tshe dbul po rnams kyis kyang rgyu nor la rkam chags che bas ma rung ba'i chom rkun gyi las la rang bzhin gyis zhugs/ gsum pa de yang yin te/ 'jon nus can gyi mi snas dpal 'byor gyi rtsa ba dang / sdong po/ lo ma yal ga bcas 'phel bar byed nus la/ nus med 'khos zhan rnams kyis shing sdong skam po chu la 'phangs kyang lo 'dab rgyas mi srid pa bzhin du don gnyer ga tshad byed rung dpal 'byor legs por 'gyur mi thub/ bzhi pa de yang yin te/ deng gi spyi tshogs ni da lta'i spyi tshogs red/ srol rgyun rig gnas ni gna' rabs kyi rig gnas yin/ des deng gi spyi tshogs la phan nus med snyam ste/ srol rgyun rig pa la spyod mkhan je nyung 'gro ba/ lnga ba de yang yin te/ nus med mi rigs kyi skad yig bed spyod ni nyung la brda 'phrad sa yang nyung bas dpal 'byor 'brel 'dzugs kyi ched du grangs mang mi rigs kyi skad yig spyod sgo che ru 'gro bas gcig shos spyod mkhan je nyung du 'gro nges/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas 204

dpal 'byor rig pa kho na la sbyong ba byas na ches mi 'os shing rgyal khab dang mi rigs la pham gyong chen po thebs kyi red/ 'jig rten yang dag byed pa'i rig gnas dang / bsam blo bzang bor bsgyur pa'i rig gnas bcas la 'bad dgos pa zhig yin gyi spyi tshogs dgos mkho dang mthun dgos mdog gis rig gzhung bzang po de tsho gtor brlag shor na de las sdug pa zhig ci yod/ deng sang chab srid dge rgan la las mar le ring lugs kyi mtshan nyid rig pa yang spyi tshogs dgos mkho dang mi mthun pas mkho med kyi skad cha bshad kyi 'dug rung / de yang don dam du rgyal khab dang mi rigs kyi bya spyod dang bsam pa'i 'khyer so bcas pa thun mong gcig gyur gyi rang bzhin chags par phan thogs chen po yod pas snang med du bskyur ga na rung / 'phral gyi khe phan la bsam nas phugs kyi don chen shor song na nga tsho'i mi rabs rjes mas ji ltar bya bsam dgos pa zhig yin/ der brten rig gnas slob gso de mig thag thung thung la ma ltos pa rgyang ring gi dmigs yul bzung ste slob gso byed dgos/bod kyi rig gnas kun las bzo gso gnyis dang / rtsomaphyerig zlos gar/gnam rig skar rtsis/ sum rtags dag gsum bcas spyi tshogs dgos mkho dang mthun la gzhan rnams dgos med smra ba kha shas 'dug khyad par nang tshad gnyis ni spyi tshogs dang ches 'gal bar brtsis te bed med pa ma zad tha na gnod pa yod pa'i skad cha shod kyi 'dug dngos gnas bshad na bod kyi nang tshad rig pa 'di mi rigs shig gi rig gzhung yin par ma zad mi rigs shig gi grub cha yang yin la/ da dung 'dzam gling shes rig gi bang mdzod nang du med du mi rung pa'i rig gnas shig yin/ mi rigs shig gi zhi bde'i lam bstan pa ma zad 'dzam gling zhi bde'i lam bstan thub pa zhig yin/ nang tshad gtso bo byas pa'i bod kyi rig gzhung ni 'dzam gling na gang thad nas 'di 'dra'i go sa yod mkhan zhig tu chags yod rung / deng dus dus rabs nyer gcig 205

pa'i dus skabs 'dir bshad na gang gi thad nas 'gyur ba ha cang che ba'i dus tshod cig yin pas/ dus rabs 'di la 'gyur ba'i dus rabs zer na yang chog pa lta bu zhig yin/ spyi yi slob gso dang bod kyi rig gzhung gi mdun lam la yang 'gyur ba chen po zhig thebs kyi yod pa ni mkhyen gsal ltar lags/gang ltar yang srol rgyun dang rig gsar gnyis kyi gom pa mnyam du spo ba ni thabs mchog yin pa mkhas dbang rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu smra/gsum pa/ bod kyi shes rig dar spel gtong tshul cung zad bshad pa/da ni spyir bod kyi rig gnas dar spel gtong ba la ci 'dra zhig dgos min thad la mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mkhas dbang rnam pa'i lhag bsam 'o mtsho las bsam gzhig kyi rba rlabs bar snang du 'phyur bzhin pa'i sgang 'di phran gyis kyang lta tshul cung zad zhu snying 'dod pa la/ deng sang bod kyi shes rig gi slob gso dar spel gtong ba la 'di 'dra dgos zhes gtan 'khel gyis 'di yin zhes pa zhig bshad rgyu de yang las sla bo zhig ma red/ bshad rung yang dag min dang 'os 'tshams yin min bcas kyi thad la the tshom gyi dra ba ma chod stabs kyis sems pham dgos pa zhig byung / 'on kyang sngon byon mkhas pa'i gsungs ltar chos thams cad rten 'brel dang ltos grub yin pa'i gnad don la yid ches zab mo zhig bdog der brten mi srid pa'i bya ba ste rmi lam du yang 'char ma myong pa'i gnas tshul yang mngon sum du gyur pa'i go skabs yod pa yin pas/ de yang rten 'brel lam ltos grub yin pa'i gnad kyis yin snyam/de phyir bod kyi rig gnas de yang da lta'i yid la shar ma myong pa zhig ma 'ongs pa na dar rgyas phyin pa'i dus kyang srid pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang de'i rten 'brel dang ltos grub sgug nas sdod na bod re bas phung zer ba de 'byung srid 206

pas 'bad brtson bya rgyu gal che/ spyir deng dus phyogs gcig nas bsam na bod kyi rig gzhung phar zhog bod kyi skad yig gi bstan pa 'di yang nyams rgud du mi 'gro ba'i nges pa med pa lta bu'i sa tshod du slebs pas ha cang 'jigs skrag che ba ma zad 'dzam gling na yang ngo tsha'i grenas su lhung la nye ba lta bu zhig tu gyur skabs 'dir/ bod kyi rig gnas dar spel gtong bar ci la 'bad dgos zer na/1 yig rmongs sel dgos/thog mar rtsa ba nas ma 'jug na bar mtha' gnyis nas 'jug rung 'bras bu bzang po thob mi thub/ rtsa ba zer ba de yig rmongs bsal rgyu de red/da lta dus rabs nyer gcig par slebs grabs yod rung bod mi bod kyi skad yig shes mkhan brgya cha nyi shu tsam las yod mi thub pa lta bu zhig red/ der brten las ka 'di ha cang gal che ba mthong ste mchog sprul thub bstan nyi mas/rong brag gi sde ba rnam pa khyed tsho nga la dga' zhen yod na yig rmongs bsal rgyu'i las ka bsgrub dgos gsungs pas rgan pho mo tshos kyang gsal byed sum cu nas 'go rtsom te slob pa lta bu yin/ gal te yig rmongs bsal rgyu'i don de 'grub pa yin na tshes gsum gyi zla ba shar ba yin la/ tshes gsum gyi zla bar brten nas tshes bco lnga'i nya gang ba'i zla ba shar ba bzhin du yig rmongs bsal rgyu'i don de 'grub pa yin na bod kyi rig gnas slob gso de gang thad nas dar rgyas yong gi red/ rdzogs chen bla ma u rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis kyang sngon dus 'brog sde so sor yig rtsob dge rgan ba'ag ste nyid kyis zla phogs gnang sbyin byed kyi yod/ de bzhin dkar mdzes khul slob gso cus kyis bod skad yig rmang gzhi'i deb ste yig rmongs bsal deb sgor khri tsho mang pos dpar skrun byas pa dang / si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwas kyang slob grwa gung gseng skabs kyi las bya la slob ma tshos yig rmongs bsal rgyu'i 'gan lo mang ring sprad 207

pa yin/ gangs can gyi slob gso'i don du mig rgyang ring gzigs kyi skyes chen dag gis gong zhu'i 'di'i don rnams la thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang rgyu gal che/ ma gzhi mi rigs shig yig rmongs gyur na pham dang gyong thams cad khur dgos pa zhig tu gyur/ pham gyong khur snying mi 'dod pa'i mi bla srog can zhig yin tshe thog mar yig rmongs bsal dgos/ don med kyi mi tshe gtong pa/zin med kyi las la brtson zhing / ma 'ongs 'dun lam la bsam gzhigs mi shes dzeshing kha phyogs 'dzam gling la gtod ma shes shing lung ba zhig gi mgo mjug gi tshul las gzhan gang yang mi shes pa'i gnas su ltung ba de yang yig rmongs kyis skyon red/2 mi spus tshad can grangs mang bskyar gso byed dgos/mi la spus tshad med na rig gnas dar spel gtong rgyu phar zhog tha na bde 'jags kyang mi thon zhing rnyog 'dzing me ltar 'bar ba zhig yong gi yod/ sa lag mthil tsam dang chu phor kha tsam gyi rin la che srog 'jal ba de yang spus tshad ches rjes lus su gyur pa'i rtags shig yin/ gsal byed sum cu'i mgo mjug mi shes mkhan tshos kyang lha 'di pha lha red/ chos 'di ni pha chos red ces lha chos gcig la blo snying gtod ni yin zer nas mi rigs gcig yin rung grub mtha' gzhan zer nas dgra ltar sdang ba 'di yang bsam blo ches rjes lus kyi rtags shig yin/ khog sol ba las kyang gnag kha 'o ma las kyang dkar ba'i mi dag gi rjes su khyi bzhin rgyug cing rang tshugs gzung ma thub pa dang legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros med pa de yang spus tshad ches zhan pa'i rtags yin/ dngos nas bshad na grong khyer chen po rnams su lta skor du 'gro skabs grong khyer de dag bkod legs pa/ khrom lam g.yas g.yon rnams su bdag po med rung stabs bde ba'i kha dpar shel khang can dang / tshar du dngar ba'i glog sgron/ nam yang spyod chog pa'i 'phrin sgam rnams mthong tshe nga tsho bod la 208

'di 'dra'i cha rkyen zhig yod na ci ma rung snyam pa dang / yang cha rkyen 'di 'dra 'dzoms rung dus yun thung ngu tsam las mi brtan par kha lag rgod po'i mi de tshos gtor brlag gtong gi red bsam te sems pham po 'dug gang byung gis gtor brlag gtong mkhan mang ba de yang dngos nas bshad na mi yi spus tshad ches dma' ba mang ba'i rtags red/ da per na gtam tshig gsum bshad mi khom nas gri mgo 'phur/ tshig tsher ma ltar tsub pa/ gshis kha ko sgog las gyong ba/ zhe sol ba las gnag pa/ mgo bo ba glang las glen pa/ rang 'dod yid byed kho nas dus 'da' ba/ thun mong gi bsam blo spu tsam med pa/ rgyu mtshan med bzhin ca co sgrog pa sogs ni spus tshad ches dma' ba'i rtags red/de 'dra ba'i mi rgod de tshos rig gnas dar spel gtang rgyu phar zhog spyi tshogs la bde 'jags kyang sprad rgyu ma red snyam/ deng gi dus su slob grwa la la'i slob ma bu mo 'gas skra gzengs gzengs byed/ mchu dmar po byed/ mig mtha' nag po byed/ ngo gdong skya bor sgyur/ dor ma phra phra gyon/ 'gro 'dug thams cad 'khyog por bsgyur/ bya spyod nges med bzos/ sgrig lam la brtsi srung med pa/ ci bsam na ci bshad pa/ ci mos na ci las/ phan tshun bar du dbyen sbyor byed/ shes rig la zhib 'jug med par pho mo'i brtse dung la zhib 'jug byed/ slob khrid thams cad gnyid la bcol/ sgor mo thams cad byug par bcol/ 'gro song grangs med gtong / skyes pa 'gas ni du ba 'then chang 'thung / sho rgyag 'dzing mo byed pa bcas ni pho rgod kyi las su brtsis te nga rgyal byas/ mgo skor lag tu bzung / gri chung sked la drangs/ tshig gsum gyis kha phor sgrim/ dpung pa'i sha rgod ngoms/ mthe mo'i mda' srang rgyas/rgyu mtshan med pa'i gtam bshad/ gnyom chung la brnyas bcos byas/ shes rig yon tan mi sbyong / bu mo mang po mgo skor gtong ba la skyes pa phor brtsis/ba glang 'bus gtsag pa bzhin nyi ma rtag par bro ra nang du 'phag 'tshag byed/209

de dag kyang ches spus tshad zhan pa'i rtags yin pas gzab gal che/ de 'dra'i rigs su gyur ba'i mis spyi tshogs su sa bzung tshe mun pa'i spyi tshogs shig las shes rig gi spyi tshogs shig tu 'gyur mi thub nges can lags/ de 'dra'i spus tshad zhan pa'i mi dag gi las don ni rig gnas dar spel gtong rgyu ma yin pa/rig gnas dar spel gtong mkhan yin na mi tshad ldan nam spus tshad mthon po'i mi zhig yin rgyu'i thag gcod chog spus tshad mthon po'i mi zhig yin phyin las don gang zhig sgrub rung ya rabs kyi las las phal che 'da' mi thub ces bshad chog ya rabs kyi las ni shes rig gi las don las gzhan gang yang med pa zhig yin/ der brten/ ma 'ongs dus rabs ni shes rig gi dus rabs shig tu gyur te/ bya byed thams cad shes rig gis kha bsgyur te 'phrul gyi deng rabs can du 'gyur rgyu'i thag gcod chog de dus zhing 'brog dmag gsum 'grem ston khang du bzhugs te ston mo bstan mkhan yin pa the tshom med/der brten bod kyi shes rig dar spel gtong ba la mi spus tshad mthon po can dgos kyi 'gro lugs med pa'i mis bya ba gang yang mi thon zhes bshad chog2 slob grwa'i slob gso hur thag gis 'bad dgos/dgon pa'i slob gso las kyang slob grwa'i slob gso gal che la slob grwa'i slob gso dar rgyas byung na mtho dman dang skya ser sogs kyi dbye ba med par slob sbyong gi go skabs ldan la/ slob gso de spyi'i 'gan du 'gyur bas bod kyi gtam dper sangs rgyas na ma rgyas bu rgyas/ bya 'phur na ma 'phur bu 'phur zer ba ltar/ cha mnyam gyis mi kun shes yon can du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod pa dang / me tog mnyam bzhad/ mkhas brgya 'gran gleng zer ba'i dus rabs der dngos gnas slebs nges yin/ de min dgon pa'i slob gso kho na la re sgug bya tshe 'jig rten sgrub mkhan ni je nyung du 'gro zhing slob gso phyogs re ba las cha mnyam du 'gyur mi thub/ bod 'di la bshad na yang slob grwa'i 210

slob gso dar phyi bas gyong pham chen po thebs yod pa ni deng gi dus su shes/der brten slob grwa'i slob gso la da dung yang dam 'dzin ma byas na mig ldan gad la lhung pa dang 'dra/ nga tsho'i bod mi'i skyes pho mo phal che la rang tshugs 'dzin pa'i lta ba med par gzhan gyi rjes su rgyug dgos pa byung ba 'di yang shes rig med pas lan pa red/ da lta rnga ba'i tshong pa dang / dkar mdzes kyi sprul sku rnam pas slob grwa btsugs pa de ni dus dang mthun pa'i las don zhig dang / kha tsha dgos gtug gi mkho nyag che ba zhig kyang yin/ slob grwa'i slob gso 'og nas byung ba'i skyes pho mo gang zhig yin rung chos srid dpal 'byor dmag don sogs gang sgrub kyang sgrub sla ba dang sgrub shes pa'i dgos pa rgya che yod/ tha na gzhan gyis mgo skor mi thub pa dang / rang nyid la yang legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros yod pa bcas kyi dge mtshan bla med mchis/ dgen bsod nams rgya mtshos rang dgon du sgor khri lngas zhabs phyi zhu skabs dgon gtso la las sgor mo 'di'i lha bzhengs na yag po 'dug gsungs rung / dgen bsod nams rgya mtshos ngas bem po'i lha bzhengs mi 'dod la/ lha gson po bzhengs 'dod yod gsungs te slob grwa la zla phogs byas/ ngas skad cha 'di la rgyu mtshan chen po zhig yod pa go ste/ blo gros can gyi mi de dngos gnas kyi lha zhig yin/ khyad par mi rabs nas mi rabs rnams su yal med kyi byas rjes/'gyur med kyi phan 'bras de ni slob grwa'i slob gso las byung ba sha stag yin/dus rabs 'di mtshan nyid ldan pa'am tshad thub ste shes rig can gyi mi rabs shig tu chags thub tshe de'i mi rabs rjes ma ni de las kyang bzang ba zhig yong nges kyi mi rabs 'di sru ma rjes gra ma nyams pa'i glen pa zhig yin na shugs rkyen des mi rabs rjes ma de yang de'i ris nang du 'gro ba las thabs ci yod/de phyir bod mi'i shes rig dar rgyas phyin pa la slob grwa'i slob gso de gnad 'gag cig yin/211

7 yig sgyur gyi bya ba'am lo tsā'i bya ba bsgrub dgos/de yang rang rigs kyi yig sgyur bya ba la sgyur bya'i nang don ngos nas dbye na gsum ste/ 1chos dang rig gnas bsgyur ba/ 2 chab srid bsgyur ba/ 2tshan rig bsgyur ba/ dang po chos dang rig gzhung bsgyur ba ni snga rabs sngon byon lo tsā ba rnams kyi gtso bo'i las don yin pa dang / gnyis pa chab srid bsgyur ba ni nye rabs kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi gtso bo'i las 'gan yin/ gsum pa tshan rig bsgyur ba ni deng rabs kyi lo tsā ba'i gtso bo'i las don yin zhing /dus rabs gsum gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi sgyur thabs sam sgyur stangs mchog tu bsngags yul de ni sngon rabs kyi lo tsā ba de rnams yin/ dper na sngon rabs kyi lo tsā bas rgya chos bod du sgyur ba'i spus ka ni 'dzam gling na yang ang dang po'i gnas su 'jog gi yod de/ de dus ston pa'i zhal gsungs dri ma med pa de ma nor bar bsgyur zhing / bsgyur nas rnam rtog gis gang byung ma bcos pa de gangs can na yod pa'i snyan pa sa gsum na khyab pas/ pad ma'i tshal na bung ba'i 'du 'god bzhin 'dzam gling gi shes yon pa mang shos shig bod brgyud nang bstan gyi las la brel bzhin mchis/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba 'di rnams la deng rabs lo tsā bas mig dper gzung rgyu gal ha cang che ste/dper na sngon gyi lo tsā bas/ 1 bod mi'i spyi tshogs la kha gtad de zhabs phyi zhu ba'i dmigs yul gzung ste/ gzhan rigs kyi rig gzhung bzang po rnams rang gi skad yig thog tu tshur drangs pa/ 2lo tsā ba'i rgyud na rang rigs kyi rig gnas byang chub pa'i mkhyen rgya chen po mnga' ba/ 2 lhag bsam rnam dag gis sgyur pa'i ched las la spro ba las rang 'dod yid byed dang dpal 'byor thob re sogs kyi skyon phra mo tsam yang med pa/ 4 sgra sgyur don sgyur thad sgyur sogs sgyur tshul thad nas 'os 'tshams yin min sogs kyi byed pa zhib pa/ tshig don gyi nor 'khrul med pa bcas so/ phran gyi bltas na deng 212

dus rang rigs la ha cang dgos gal che ba'i sgyur ba de ni tshan rig gi rig gnas yin pa dang / tshan rig la rgyab gtad nas/ rig gzhung gzhan zhig la skyabs bcol na nyin mo'i snang ba la ma brten pa mtshan mo'i mun nang du stong bsam gyi 'khor lo skor ba bzhin no/ nga tsho'i skad yig gis tshan rig dang grogs sgrig thub pa byung na khyim tshang zhig gis su'i kha gtad du yang 'dug thub mkhan gyi 'jon nus can gyi mas/ pa gsar pa zhig lon pa bzhin no/spyir rgya nag gi tshan rig rig gnas 'di dag kyang thog ma nas rgya nag rang du dar ba ma yin pa gzhan zhig nas tshur bsgyur ba sus kyang shes/ de bzhin 'dzam gling gi rig gzhung kun kyang phan tshun bsgyur te dar rgyas phyin pa red/ma gzhi nga tshos deng dus spyod bzhin pa'i nang rig 'di rgya chos yin yang /deng gi dus rgya chos 'di dag bod skad thog 'dra chags po yod stabs kyis bod brgyud nang bstan zer nas/ bstan pa'i bdag po bod rigs gyur pa lta bu yin/ de bzhin gzhan rigs kyi tshan rig rigs gzhung de dag bod skad yig thog tu tshur drangs te bod mi la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos/ de las gzhan rang rigs kyi rig gzhung bzang po de dag gzhan gyi skad la ma bsgyur na rig gzhung 'di dag gi bstan pa nyams dogs byed pa de ni ri bong gnam rdib kyi sems khral ltar dgos med kyi sems sdug cig tu mthong / nga tsho'i rig gzhung nor bu lta bu 'di ni gzhan gyis thabs brgya jus stong gis len ci thub byas te 'dzam gling na nyi ma re re bzhin je rgyas su 'gro ba sus kyang go/ ma gzhi rang skal mi lcogs bzhin du gzhan skal rang gis khur ba 'di ni glen pa yin pa'i rtags bstan pa yin/ der brten sngon byon lo tsā bas rgya chos bod du sgyur ba bzhin phan byed tshan rig gi gzhung bzang po de dag gang na yod rung tshur len dgos pa ni lo tsā'i 'os 'gan yin/ bsgyur zin pa'i rig gzhung de dag sbyong rgyu ni bod mi spyi'i 'gan yin par shes dgos/ ji skad du/ phan byed phyi ru 213

yod kyang nang du blang / gnod byed nang du yod kyang phyi ru bskrad/ gcig la dam du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig 'dis/ phyi ma'i 'jig rten 'di na go mi chod/zer ba ltar snyigs dor bcud len gyi bya ba la 'bad dgos/ de ltar byas na mi'i shes rig dar rgyas kyi skul 'ded yong gi red/5 slob deb 'dzugs skrun byed dgos/slob deb zer ba de slob sbyong ches byed 'os pa'i deb cig yin/ slob deb ni rtsa ba'i gnad don zhig yin/ slob deb bzang ngan la brten nas spyi tshogs sam 'jig rten la phan gnod 'byung gi yod/ spyi tshogs kyi mkho dgos la gzhigs te slob deb byas pa yin la byed dgos pa zhig kyang yin/ spyi tshogs dang mi mthun pa'i slob deb cig byas pa yin na slob deb de dgos med du thal ba'i skyon yod par ma zad/ mi mang po der mgo 'khor te dus tshod 'phro brlag gtong ba'i nyen kha yod pa dang / tha na gnod pa chen po 'byung ba sogs kyi gnas tshul tshang mas mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ slob grwa'i slob deb ni dgon pa'i slob deb dang mi 'dra ba zhig dgos/ slob grwa'i slob deb ni gtso bo spyi tshogs sam mi yi 'jig rten la phan pa zhig yin par ma zad/'jig rten dar rgyas gtong ba'i rig pa zhig yin dgos/ dgon pa'i slob deb de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sa ste thar ba'i go 'phang thob byed dang /tshe phyi mar dmigs nas phan thabs gtso bor byas nas grub pa zhig yin/ der brten slob grwa'i slob deb gang 'dra zhig dgos min ni mi'i spyi tshogs dang sems khams bya byed bcas la bsam gzhigs bya dgos pa las/ rang 'dod kyis gang mos byed mi chog pa yin/ deng gi dus su rang rigs lta bu la mtshon na ha cang mkho gal che ba'i slob deb ni/ yig rmongs bsal deb dang / tshan rig rigs gzhung / rang rigs skul brda'i rtsom deb bcas yin/ dgon pa'i slob gso'i slob deb kyang rigs mthun dum bur gtong ba dang / rang 214

rigs rang gis dkrug pa'i la rgya'i tshig dang / grub mtha'i kha 'dzin byed pa'i chags sdang gi gtam rnams gnas skabs shig la nyung na mdzes snyam/ sngon gyi lo rgyus rnams su bltas na grub mtha'i rtsod pa dang / rig gnas kyi rtsod pa bcas ni lo rabs mang po'i ring dar bar/ de ni shes rig gros zhib byed pa las gzhan gang yang min rung / des skul mar byas te bla grwa mang bo mtshon gyi kha la drangs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa yin / der brten rang rigs kyi bstan pa bshig pa'i ral gri dang / rang mgo rdung byed kyi pha bong lta bu'i rtsod pa de dgos med du 'jog na legs/ khyad par du shes rig gi ma ma gangs can pa'i rgan rim gyi mkhas dbang rnam pa/ khyed tshos bod phrug brgya phrag mang por shes rig gi nu 'o ldud skabs rigs mthun gyi phu nu spun sring rnams dum bur bgos te phan tshun dgra ru 'dzin mi dgos pa'i slob gso re gnang rogs ma gtogs khyod tsho song rjes shul du lus pa'i gangs phrug rnams nang dme byas na snying mi rje'am/ sha mi tsha'am/ ma gzhir rigs gzhung gang la yang dpyod pa zhib pa dang / snyigs dor bcud len byed pa dang / gros mol byed pa bcas mkhas pa'i las su bshad pas dgos gal che rung / rkyen de dag gis dgra ru 'dzin zhing / rang nyid rgyal 'dod dang gzhan pham 'dod kyi kun slong ngan pas rgyud ma bcos par gangs can pa la phan re byed rgyu gal che/ gal te rnam dpyod kyi rig pa glog ltar myur ba/ shes rab kyi rno ngar ral gri lta bu/ blo gros nyi ma bzhin gsal ba'i mkhas dbang re yod na khyod kyis da lta'i bod mi'i spyi tshogs dang 'os shing 'tshams pa/ da lta'i bod mi'i blo rtse gtod sa'i legs bshad gsar ba zhig dgos kyi 'dug pas slob deb de 'dra zhig re ba snying nas bya rgyu yin/ spyir deng gi dus su ni/ tang bzang srid bzang mi rigs la brtse bas rjes skyong byed pa 'di lta bu ni lo rgyus thog byung ma myong bas go skabs bzang po 'di dam 'dzin byas te rang rigs la phan pa yod shag shag gi legs 215

bshad kyi deb re bzo thub na mes rgyal la zhabs phyi dang mi rigs kyi la rgya bzung ba yin pas shin tu bzang snyam/ gna' rabs kyi rigs gzhung 'ben du btsugs te de la rnam dpyod kyi mda' mo gtod pa las kyang / gna' rabs kyi rig gzhung du med pa'i dus kyi 'gros las byung ba'i rig gsar mang bo zhig dgon sde la dgos mkho yod pa de dag la bsam gzhigs nan por bya rgyu yang gal che/ dper na sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ legs par bshad na chos dang mi 'gal zhing / 'jig rten bya ba kun nas legs 'grub pa/ zhes chos dang mi 'gal ba'i 'jig rten zhig bsgrub lugs yod par 'dod pa dang / de bzhin du sde bzhi zhes pa bshad pa'i skabs chos nor 'dod thar bzhi ste/ tshe 'di la phan pa'i nor dang 'dod pa yod chog pa dang / phyi mar phan pa'i chos dang thar ba yod chog pas 'di dag zung 'brel byed chog na de las dga' ci yod/de ltar na dgon par mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam sne zin byed kyi bslab bya'i slob deb yod thog sdig las dang sbrel mi dgos pa'i 'tsho rten du thon las lag rtsal re sbyong rgyu yod na yag shos red/ slob deb la rig gzhung gi deb gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos yod dgos/ slob deb ni rig gzhung gzhan dag shes byed kyi rkyen te sgo 'byed byed kyi lde mig lta bu zhig yin/ slob deb rang ngos nas spyi tshogs thog tu be+ed spyod med rung de sbyong ba las yig cha 'bri ba dang rig gzhung shes pa/ dbye 'byed kyi nus pa yod thub pa zhig chags dgos/ slob deb la dgos nges kyi cha rkyen te/ 1 bsam gzhigs/ 2gtso gnad/ 2 dka' gnad/ 4 las bya sogs zur du phud dgos/ de dag 'dzoms na slob mas slob sla ba dang dge rgan gyis khrid sla ba/ dus tshod gtan khel gyi slob khrid 'char 'god ltar legs grub yong thub pa'i dge mtshan yod/ slob grwa so so'i slob ma rnams slob mthar phyin te spyi tshogs thog tu slebs skabs slob deb bshams te bya ba bsgrub rgyu med pa sus kyang shes/ 216

der brten/ slob deb ni shes rab kyi nar son byed kyi lag cha zhig tu ngos 'dzin byed dgos pa las/ slob deb de rang nyid thad kar spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba yod pa bsam mi rung / khrid gzhe rig gzhung spyi yi deb kyis slob deb byas pa 'di la dge rgan gyis 'chad rgyu mang ba/ slob ma'i sbyong rgyu mang ba shugs kyis 'byung bas dka' ngal chen po yod/ der brten bod mi'i shes rig dar spel gtong ba la bod kyi spyi tshogs la mkho nyag che ba'i slob deb bzo dgos/ 6 bod mi'i skad yig tshan rig dang / dpal 'byor chab srid/dmag don sogs la 'brel ba yod dgos/ skad yig ni lag cha zhig yin la/lag cha de bed spyod de bya ba bsgrub dgos/ skad yig ni shing gcod byed kyi sta re lta bu zhig yin la/ sta re rno ngar ldan rung shing ma gcod na sta re yod med kyi khyad par med pa bzhin/ skad yig phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod rung shes rig mang po dang 'brel bar byed ma thub na skad yig dgos med du thal ba'i skyon yod/ sngon byon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis skad yig chos dang rig gnas la 'brel ba phun sum tshogs pa zhig bzos pa sus kyang shes/ de bzhin deng bod mi'i skad yig tshan rig dang dpal 'byor/ chab srid dang dmag don sogs la 'brel ba yod dgos/ dper na/ dbyin yig de 'dzam gling sgang na spyi skad du gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan la/ mkhas pa 'gas dbyin ji mis 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang por btsan 'dzul byas pa'i stobs kyis dbyin ji'i skad yig khyab spel cher song ba red zer/ phyogs gcig nas bshad na/ de ltar yin tsang /phran gyis blta na gtso bo dbyin ji'i skad yig de tshan rig dang dpal 'byor sogs la 'brel ba cher stabs kyis spyi skad du gyur ba zhig red snyam/ dper na/ deng dus rgya nag gi nub sman gyi tha snyad mang po zhig dbyin ji'i skad rang sor 'jog pa las bsgyur ma thub pa gang mang yod/ de bzhin dngos po la la'i tha snyad kyang dbyin ji'i skad spyod bzhin pa dang / spyi rtsis rig pa dang 217

glog klad rig pa kun gyi nang na dbyin ji'i skad ma spyod na mi 'grig pa zhig chags yod/ der brten skad yig ni spyod sgo che ba'i tshan rig dang dpal 'byor sogs la 'brel ba ji tsam mang na de tsam gyi skad yig de spyod sgo che zhing khyab spel che ba zhig yin/ de byung na skad yig gi tshe srog de mi nyams pa'i rgyal mtshan gyur te 'gro mang la phan pa rgya chen zhig bsgrub thub/ deng sang tha na 'dzam gling na nyi ma re re bzhin dngos po gsar pa mang po zhig gsar skrun byed bzhin yod pa la rgya skad dang / dbyin ji'i skad kyi tha snyad gsar ba de tsam gyis je mang 'gro ba la/ nga tshos rang skad kyis tha snyad gsar ba ma sbyar nas gzhan skad bshad pa de stabs bde ba dang brda 'phrad sla bar bsam ste de spyod pas dpal 'byor des gzhan skad la srog gsar ba zhig byin rung / rang skad bag la nyal grabs bzo yi yod par shes dgos/ spyir mi gang 'dra zhig yin rung 'tsho ba la brten pa sha stag yin/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang / 'tsho ba'i zas la ma brten gang yang med gsungs pa dang / de bzhin dbu ma 'jug pa las/ mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la/ zhes/ longs spyod med na bde ba mi thob gsungs pa dang / longs spyod ni dpal 'byor dang tshan rig sogs la 'brel ba che bas/ tshan rig dang dpal 'byor sogs thob par 'dod pas de'i shes rig la 'bad pa dang / de'i shes rig ni skad yig la thug yod pas skad yig la shugs kyis brtson dgos pa zhig tu grub/ de brtson pas skad yig mi nyams gong 'phel du 'gro zhing mi rigs kyi srog rtsa yang brtan po zhig tu 'gyur/ der brten tshan rig dang dpal 'byor gyis skad yig la shugs kyis zhabs 'degs zhus pa yin/ gal te nga tsho'i skad yig 'di tshan rig dang dpal 'byor/ dmag don dang chab srid bcas la 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin na/ nga tsho'i skad yig legs po zhig shes pas tshan rig 'dod pa la tshan rig de bzhin dpal 'byor dang dmag don chab srid sogs gang 218

'dod kyang de shes pa'i thabs kyang yod la/ gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa'i tshugs thub kyi shes yon can zhig tu gyur te/ rang skyong bzang bo zhig chags thub/ de min sprang bo la nor med na gzhan la slong dgos pa bzhin du nga tsho'i skad yig thog tu shes rig bzang bo de tsho med na gzhan rigs la skyabs bcol ba las thabs ci yod/ gzhan la skyabs bcol tshe rang tshugs shor te rang rigs nyams pa'i nyen kha yod pa zhig yin/ der brten rang rigs kyi skad yig thog tu shes rig mang po zhig yod thub par byed dgos/7 blo tshod ltar slob gso byed dgos/de yang khyim gyi slob gso yin na yang 'dra/ spyi tshogs slob gso dang slob grwa'i slob gso bcas gang zhig yin rung slob gso bya yul gyi blo tshod dang bstun nas slob gso byed dgos/ nang gzhung rnams las kyang / gdul bya'i khams dbang bsam pa dang bstun nas don bstan dgos gsungs pa dang sgo kun nas mtshungs/ dper na/ byis pa'i dus kyi slob gso ni za 'chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam sgrig dang mthun par byed rgyu/ me chu rlung gsum gyi gnod pa dang /g.yang 'gril gad lhung gi nyen kha/ tha na khyi dang byi la'i gnod pa thams cad las skyob cing / de rnams la 'jigs shes kyi slob gso gnang / de bzhin so so'i kha skad dang snabs phyi lugs tshun chad slob dgos pa zhig yin/ slob chung 'don 'go brtsams pa nas yi ge slob pa dang / bsam spyod bzang bor sgyur thabs dang / ngal rtsol la zhugs pa dang / skyid sdug gi lo rgyus kun kyang slob khrid slob gso byed dgos pa ma zad/ slob 'bring du thon dus blo tshod je mtho cung song rung khrid bya'i nang don gsar ba zhig 'go btsugs yod pas da dung gtso bo khrid sbyong gi bya ba byed dgos/ 'bring rim ched gnyer slob grwar thon dus khrid sbyong brgya cha brgyad cu dang rang sbyong brgya cha nyi shu tsam byed chogadeng skabs si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i slob ma'i bod kyi shes rig gi 219

chu tshad ni slob grwa chen mo las kyang lhag yin zer/ de 'dra yin na slob ma'i rang sbyong gi bya ba de gang mang bzo dgos/ ma gzhi rang blo shes rig la skor bskyod ma byas nas dge rgan la brten mi dgos par rang sbyong gi nus pa ldan pa de yin/ byis pa a ma'i lag par ma 'jus rung rang nus la brten te 'gro thub pa bzhin no/ spyir dge rgan gyis shes rig thams cad khrid de mjug rdzogs pa'i dus med par rang 'gul gyis shes rig la 'bad de rang sbyong gi nus pas blo tshod mthon por gyur dgos/ slob ma rang sbyong gi nus pa can du gyur tshe dge rgan yod rung med rung / gzhan gyi lta skul byed rung mi byed rung dpe cha klog 'dod shugs kyis skyes pa yin/ slob ma la rang sbyong gi nus pa med na bka' bstan thams cad khrid rung de tsam las ci yang med/ yang la lar rig gzhung kho nar blo rtse gtad de tshig nag 'gros kyi go ba bzang po re yod kyang / rigs gzhung dang kha bral rjes mun nag tu song ba bzhin ci bsam 'di dran med pa dang / tha na yig skur legs po zhig 'bri ba'i blo stobs kyang med pa/ de dag kyang rang 'gul gyi bsam pa'i skor bskyod mi byed pa'am/ shes rig gzhan dag la blo gtod nyung song bas lan pa red snyam/der brten rig gzhung gang zhig sbyong rung de'i gnad rnams gtso bor shes dgos/ shes par ma zad blo thog tu yod dgos kyi rig pa dpe thog tu lus na dgos dus bu med/ sbud dus phyen med zer ba'i dper dang 'dra bo zhig yong nges/ slob ma la shes rig sna mang slob nas phan thogs yod na de bzhin bya rgyu dang / ched sbyong rigs nyung ngu slob nas phan thogs che na de bzhin byed na blo dang 'tshams pa'i slob khrid yin/ de min slob ma blo'i nus pa zhan pa zhig la shes rig mang po slob pa yin na/ rig gzhung thams cad snang la ma nges par gyur te dper na rang 'thag gi nus pa la ma bltas na yos mang po blug pas rtsam pa zhib mo yong mi thub pa bzhin no/ der brten sngon byon mkhas pas 220

slob khrid gnang tshe/ tha na rtsed mo mtshar gtam tshud chad kyis slob ma dpe khrid de nyid nyan 'dod can du bsgyur ba lta bu red/ de yang gdul bya dang 'tshams pa'i slob khrid yin/ spyir dge rgan ni slob grwa'i slob gso'i nyams myong yod mkhan yin par ma zad/ spyi tshogs slob gso dang spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul bcas mkhyen mkhan zhig yin dgos/ gal te dge rgan la de 'dra'i yon tan med na slob ma la de las kyang med/ rgyu mtshan de dag gis dge rgan zhig yin tshe/ slob deb ma zad slob gso rig pa dang sems khams rig pa tshun chad byang chub pa zhig shes dgos/ gong zhus kyi chu tshad de ldan gyi dge rgan zhig yin na slob ma'i sems khams dang mthun pa'i slob khrid byed nges lags pas cis kyang thugs la 'jog par zhu/shrī dpe mdzod khang 'dzugs dgos/bod kyi shes rig spel ba la dpe mdzod khang ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ 'dzam gling gi kha phyogs/ mi rigs kyi mdun lam/ ma 'ongs pa'i phugs bsam/ 'das don gyi phyogs bsdoms/ da lta'i bsam gzhis/sa thams cad slob gso la rag las shing slob gso ni de kun gyi rtsa bar snang / ma zad chab srid dpal 'byor dmag don bcas kyang rtsa ba slob gso la thugaslob gso bzang ngan ni khrid gzhi'i dpe cha la thug yod/ khrid gzhi'i dpe cha de dag do dam byed par dpe mdzod khang ni med du mi rung ba zhig yin/ dpe mdzod khang 'dzugs pa'i lam lugs de ni shes yon can mang pos nyams myong phyogs bsdoms byas pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin/ khyad par dpe mdzod khang ni 'thab 'khrug dang zing cha che ba'i rgyal spyi'i 'gyur ba sogs 'tshub cha chen por byung rung srung skyob byed pa las gtor brlag gtong mi chog pa'i spyi khrims yod/dpe mdzod khang ni shes rig gi mdzod khang dang / chos dang 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs gsal por mthong sa dang / rlabs chen gyi mi sna skyed bsrings 221

byed sa ma nor ba zhig yin/ khyad par du yid bzhin nor bu las kyang rin che ba'i dpe cha de rnams me chu rlung sogs kyi 'jig pa las skyob ste bskal ba nas bskal ba'i bar du mi'i yul du gnas te phan par sgrub mkhan zhig yin par ngos zin dgos/ shes bya thams cad slob nas byang chub dgos pa zhig yin/slob tshul la khrid sbyong dang rang sbyong gnyis yod pa las khrid sbyong ni las dang bo ba'i bya ba yin la/ rang sbyong ni blo gros kyi nar son te rang stobs kyis sbyong thub pa'i blo gros can gyi bya ba yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa la yang shes bya thams cad slob dgos/ ji skad du/ ma bslab pa la kun mkhyen nyid/ 'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden gsungs pa dang / de bzhin rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa/ de ni gang yang yod min te/ de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la/ bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med gsungs pa sogs lung shin tu mang / de ltar dpe cha slob tshe dpe khrid kho nas slob pa ma yin pa/rang sbyong rang 'gul gyi stobs kyis rig gzhung gi deb mang po sbyong dgos pas dpe mdzod khang dang kha bral thabs med/ de bzhin rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin ma'o tse tung gis kyang rang stobs kyis dpe mdzod khang nas shes rig sbyong ste blo gros kyi nar son tshul gsungs pa dang / blo mthun kro'u en len dang ting zha'o phin bcas kyang shes rig gi dpe khang zhig gis bskyar gso byas pa zhig yin/ yul skor byas te rgyal khams skor ba'i cha rkyen ma 'dzoms rung shes bya thams cad skyur ru ra rlon pa lag mthil bzhag pa ltar gsal le shes byed kyi cha rkyen ang dang po de dpe mdzod khang yin/ dpe mdzod khang na skad yig mi 'dra ba dang lo rgyus mi 'dra ba/ nang don mi 'dra ba sogs shes rig sna mang yod pa de dag la brten nas blo stobs gsar ba skye thub/ mkhan rin po che pad ma tshe dbang rdzogs chen du bzhugs skabs khong gis gzim shag phyed ka dpe chas bkang ste dpe klog byed bzhin yod par snang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 222

dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis kyang pe cin rig gnas pho brang du dpe cha mang po klog pas dgongs pa'i klong brdol ba bzhin rin thang can gyi dpe cha mang po bzos pa red ces slob dpon chen po mi nyag mgon po'i zhal nas gsungs/ der brten rlabs chen gyi mi rabs shes yon can gyi mkhas pa/'jon nus can gyi gtso bo thams cad srog 'tsho ba la tshe dang bla dgos pa bzhin shes rig gi mdzod khang dang kha 'bral thabs med pa zhig yin/ de brtenagangs can pa'i dpe rnying mang po zhig tun hong gi bye ma'i gseb nas thon skabs sha sbrang sha la 'khor ba bzhin phyi gling gi mkhas pa mang po ma bos rang 'khor gyis der phyin te dpe cha 'bor chen phyir drangs ste dpe mdzod khang du bzhag pa lta bu red/bzhi pa/ gal che ba'i bya ba 'ga' bshad pa/1 spyi sems yod dgos/de yang spyi sems dang phan sems ni tshad gzhal mi nus pa'i rin thang can gyi bya ba zhig yin rung / spyir 'gro ba mi yi rigs kyi bsam blo dang dmigs yul sogs gang thad nas mi 'dra ba yin tsang so sor skye bo zer gyi yod de/ rgyu so sor bsags pas 'bras bu so sor skyes pas so/ der brten gang zag 'gas ni sger sems bzung ste khyim tshang gcig gi cha rkyen rtse dra zhig 'dzoms na mi tshe'i rin thang ches che ba zhig brtsi/ de bzhin bya ngan ga 'dra bsgrub dgos rung sgor mo zhig byung na snyam ste sgor mo las rin thang che ba med par brtsi mkhan dang / yang 'ga' shas kyis tshe grogs yid du 'ong ba zhig dang 'phrad na rang nyid kyi mi tshe don ldan du mthong mkhan dang / 'thab mo byas te khe kha lon pa de phul byung du brtsi ba sogs nas tha na gang zag 'gas ni 223

khyi ngar pa skad chen po gcig byung na snyam te de'i don la 'bad brtson byed pa bzhin/ mi sum cu la bsam pa sum cu/ mdzo sum cu la rwa co drug cu zer ba ltar rnam rtog gi grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod/ ji skad du/ ji srid sems kyi 'jug pa ma zad par/ de srid theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med zer ba ltar sems kyi 'jug pa ma zad bar du sems kyi bya ba tshar du med pa zhig yin/ rang gi kha phor shor bar dogs ste spyi yi don la 'bad brtson mi byed pa'am tha na gnod par byed pa de ni spyi sems med pa'i rtags bstan pa red/dam pa'i skyes bu 'gas ni lus longs spyod dang bcas pas spyi don bsgrubs te ris med 'gro ba la phan 'dogs pa de ni mi tshe'i rin thang ches khyad par 'phags pa mthong ba ma zad gzhan don sgrub pa la skom pas chu la don gnyer byed pa lta bur lhod med kyis brtson pa ltar ro/ yang gang zag 'gas lung pa gcig gi ris mthun gyi sems can de rnams g.yog la bkol te rang gi khe phan kho na bsgrub tu bcug ste/ da dung ya rabs kyi ming khur te sha nye rgyud dang bcas pa ya rabs kyi mi rgyud zer nas mthong chen byed du 'jug pa red/ de ni dngos gnas bshad na mi ma rabs kyi mi rgyud cig la ya rabs kyi mi rgyud du 'khrul ba zhig yin/ ya rabs zer ba de spyi sems che la rang 'dod chung ba blo rno la drang bor gnas pa zhig la zer gyi yod/ sngon dus rgya gar de dbyin ji'i btsan rgyal ring lugs dbang sgyur 'og nas thar ba byas te mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs kyis rgya gar la rang btsan len pa'i 'bad brtson lhod med byed pa'i dpa' bo ma hā gadha yis rang nyid 'tsho rten du ra ma gcig gnyis gsos te/sger don med par spyi don kho na bsgrub pas mdzad rjes rlabs po che zhig bskal pa ji srid bar gnas par byas/ rang re'i bod mi rigs la mtshon na rgyal po glang dar ma med par byas nas bzung rgyal rabs sil bur 'thor nas/ spyi mthun gyi las la 'bad ni med cing lung chung re la dpon chung re/ dpon 224

chung res gong zhus ltar rang nyid kyi khe phan la dmigs te yod rgu rtsal du bton te mi tshogs g.yog tu bkol thabs byas/ spyi la phan pa'i bya ba sna gcig kyang ma bsgrub nas/ rang mtshang phyi ru bstan par dogs te spre'us shing mgor rtse ba bzhin gzhan mgo skor thabs sna tshogs spyod pa de tsho yang spyi sems med pa'i rtags red/ rang nyid kyis gtod pa'i lugs srol la lha lugs su 'dzin cing 'gyur med rdo rje'i chos bzhin mtho gang dang sor gang yang 'gyur ba gtong mi rung zhes lcags ri'i ra ba las 'da' mi chog pa'am lcags ri'i nang du 'khor dgos par bshad/ gal te khong tshos bzos pa'i lugs kyi lcags ri'i phyi rol du gang zag 'ga' 'bud grabs byed skabs lta log dang dad log gi zhwa mo bkal te/ mgo bo bteg tu med par gnon/ spyi don sems pa'i myu gu 'bud grabs byed rigs rnams la sha 'khon gyi dgra bo bzhin kha zer gyi mtshon cha'i char phab te med par byas/ de 'dra byas pas bod kyi spyi tshogs chu bzhin thur du gzhol te nyams rgud du song ba yin/ der brten bod kyi dbang thang dang bsod nams bcas kyi dar rgud ni bod mi rang la rag las kyi gzhan gang la yang le brda byed rgyu med/ da lo ngo stong phrag kha shas kyi lo rgyus la phyi mig bltas dus ma 'grig pa'i gnad don che ba de bra bas spang ri thams cad sa nag tu phud pa bzhin spyi sems med par sger sems can gyis gangs can kha ba'i ri la gang bas lan pa yin/ da dung yang spyi don mi gnyer sger don kho na la 'bad na tshe 'dir mug 'dod can gyi ming khur dgos la phyi mar 'dre dang btsan gyi skye ba len par gdon mi za/ ji skad du/ gzhan don sems pa lha yi tshul/ rang don sems pa 'dre yi tshul zhes gsungs ba de don dang mthun pa'i gtam mo/ gal te gzhan don la gcig tu brtson pa'i skyes bu de tsho la rgyu 'byor ba thob go sa bcas gang yang med rung 'dzam gling na de'i grags pa nyin re bzhin gsal lam mer gyur ba lta bu zhig yin/ dper na/225

dge 'dun chos 'phel zer ba de la dpe cha lcags sgam gang las gzhan rgyu 'byor gang yang med pa'i mi dkyus ma zhig lags kyang / 'jig rten 'di na nyin re bzhin grags pa 'bar bas khong tshe pha rol du phebs te lo bzhi bcu kha lhag song rung sku dngos bzhugs pa las kyang gsal cha che tsam zhig rgyal khab phyi nang kun gyis spyod yul du gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan yang khong gi lhag bsam rnam dag gi gzi mdangs de khra lam mer gson nyams ldan par shul du bkod pas red ces bshad chog spyir thob go sa rgyu dang 'byor ba bcas ni phyi nang gi 'brel ba dang ngan g.yo sgyu sogs thabs 'phrul sna tshogs spyod de thon thub par byed chog la/ gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam de tshong khang du btsong du med la rin sprad kyang nyo mi thub pa sems gsal rig thog nas 'char ba zhig yin/ me tog gi ldum ras gling kha la mdzes sdug snon pa bzhin/ 'jig rten yid 'ong gi dngos por bskrun par med du mi rung zhing / chos dang 'jig rten gyi mthar thug gi dmigs gtod byed sa de spyi sems yin/ spyi sems med pa'i mi de spyang ki dang 'dra ba mthong na yid du mi 'ong pa/ 'gro na 'grogs mi bde ba/ 'dug na grogs mi lon ba zhig yin/ 'jig rten yang dag byed pa la yang spyi sems yod dgos/ gal te spyi sems kyi dung zla dkar bo 'di med na srid pa ches tsub pa'i mtshon cha kha gshibs pa dang / dug sgrul gyi tshang bzhin bde ba thob pa'i skabs shig gtan nas mi srid/ dngos gnas bshad na 'jig rten 'di na grags pa'i ba dan dkar bo mkha' la sbreng nas ji srid bskal ba me'i phung bor ma gyur bar lo rgyus kyi ri mo rdo rje pha lam la bkod rgyu ni spyi sems yod mkhan gyis gzhan phan sgrub pa'i mdzad phrin de las gzhan gang yang min/mdzes ma yin rung / dpa' bo yin rung / rgyu che rung / shes rab can sogs gang zhig yin rung sems rgyud rang 'dod yid byed kyis dkrug na ma dag pa'i dri mas g.yogs te yon tan sna gcig kyang mthong pa'i skabs med/226

2 byis pa la mthong chen byed dgos/deyang tshes gsum gyi zla ba med na nya gang gi zla ba ni gtan nas med ces bshad pa bzhin/ byis pa med na chab srid dpal 'byor dmag don bcas dar spel gtong rgyu phar zhog tha na mi rgyud kyang chad de mi rabs kyang ming gi lhag ma tsam du 'gyur nyen che/ der brten/ mi rgyud spel ba ni mi rabs kyi gnad don zhig yin/ mi rabs kyi dar rgud ni byis pa la slob gso byed stangs sam byis pa'i bsam blo sgyur lugs la thug yod/ byis pa'i rig pa ras gzhi dkar bo lta bu la slob gso tshos mdog dang 'dra bas kha sgyur ba zhig yin te/ pha ma ci 'dra bu phrug dge rgan ci 'dra dge phrug zer ba'i dper 'jog srol yod pa bzhin no/ de bzhin bod kyi byis pas ma ngo shes dus ma ṇi 'don shes pa dang / pha ngo shes dus phreng ba bgrangs shes pa bcas/ mdor na kha ma ṇi dang mi 'bral/ lag phreng ba dang mi 'bral ba zhig byed phyir slob gso'i mtshar rlabs tsha 'ur 'ur du 'phyur bzhin yod/ 'on kyang / lung khug 'gor bo dag gi byis pa rnams la byis pa'i slob grwa med cing rtsed chas nyung ba/pha mas kyang bdag po byed long med par sgo kha'i phyags ma ltar snang med du bskyur bzhag de 'dra'i byis pa tshos grong gseb dag tu snabs lud mtho gang tsam lug cing ya mchu ma mchu thams cad gas shing hrug ger/ skra thams cad zing zing nge dri nag gis g.yogs pa'i ltag skra rnams su shig dang sro ma'i tshang bcas te ngus pa'i mchu mas gdong la rjes shul gtod bzhin/ bye ma'i khang bu brtsigs te nyin gang bor chu 'dam la rtse/ dkar yol shel ril chag po la rtsed chas byas pas lag pa thams cad rma ru song / khrus ma byas pas lag rgyab thams cad nag cha re dol sgrog med pa'i dol ma'i khar 'jus te lham gyi rtse nas mdzub mo bud bzhin rlung lhags pa'i kha na don med kyis mi tshe gtong ba mthong tshe ches skyo dgos pa zhig red/ de bzhin byis pa 'ga' res thal ba'i 227

rtsed mo la g.yeng bzhin gon pa thams cad sa rdul gyis skya shar re byas/ de rnams la byis pa'i slob ra zhig med pa ma zad tha na bdag gnyer byed mkhan zhig kyang 'dzoms mi 'dug byis pa 'ga' re lo bcu yan man la slob grwar zhugs pa'i go skabs ldan rung / snying rje med pa'i dge rgan te byis pa'i slob gso dang mdun lam la bsam blo spu tsam yang mi gtong zhing / rang don du tshong rgyag pa'am sho rgyag pa/ yang na chang 'thung ba sogs bya spyod nges med byed mkhan zhig dang 'phrad bas/ byis pa de tshos dpe cha'i rkub stegs byas te bzhin ras nyi mar bsros/ ka kha blo 'don byed bzhin dbyug pas brdung res byas te mgo la skrang 'bur bzos pa dang kha khrag sna khrag thal le btang / rig gnas slob rgyu phar zhog tha na rang lus bsrung mi thub pa'i nyen kha yang yod pa zhig yin/ ma gzhi byis pa bsam med yin pa la/ de'i steng dge rgan bsam med cig dang 'phrad na de las sdug pa zhig ci yod/ dge rgan de tsho la mgo rul ba sna yis ma tshor zer ba'i dpe de 'jog na thal mi che/ de nas byis pa'i na tshod de je mthor song / sbyangs 'bras zhan pas rgyugs ma 'phrod cing phyir rang khyim du mi log ka med du gyur/ tha na yig skur legs po 'bri ba'i shes rig kyang ma slob cing / mi dgos pa'i kha mchu ni tsher ma ltar rno ba/ las ka la zhugs 'dod med pa ni rdo pha bong dang 'dra ba/ shing sdong skam po gnam la slong ba ltar mi reng por gyur te rang bsam gyis bya ba mi byed pa zhig tu gyur bas de nas bzung dge rgan ngan pa'i shugs rkyen gyis slob grwa su'i mig gis mthong na dgra ltar yid du mi 'ong pa/ rna bas thos na tsher ma ltar tsub pa sogs ches ngan pa'i gnas shig mthong bas khyim grogs sogs mi su thug na slob grwa'i lo rgyus bshad dus slob grwa ni byis pa g.yung ba zhig mi rgod du gso skyong byed sa red ces sogs slob grwa'i skyon rnams lhag lus med par kha gsab dang bcas te zhib par bshad pas shugs rkyen des byis pa'i shes rig sbyong 228

ba'i go skabs med par gyur/ mthar thug ste bshad na bod mi'i spyi'i dge rgan de rigs kyis snying rje ba'i byis pa de tsho shes rig sbyong ba'i go skabs gtan nas brlag pa'i bya ba de 'grub yod pa zhig red/ byis pa'i shes rig sbyong ma thub na mun nag gi 'jig rten zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grig tshar ba red/ phyi gling ba phal che dang sngon thon gyi mi rigs rnams kyi byis pa ni rtsa ba zhig dang / yar 'dren mar 'dren gyi gnad 'gag cig tu mthong ste byis pa gso skyong byed pa ni phrag tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan ches lji ba zhig yin te/ pha ma yod med ji ltar rung / phyug sprang ji ltar rung / pho mo ji ltar rung / mdor na byis pa yod do cog la 'dra mnyam gyis slob gso'i skal ba thob tu 'jug pa ni/ rgyal khab kyi 'gan red/ pha ma med pa'i dwa phrug rnams bdag gir byed rgyu lta ci/ pha ma yod pa'i byis pa bdag gnyer byed stangs ma 'grig pa dag kyang rgyal khab gzhung gis gso skyong cha tshang byas/ byis pa gso skyong byed pa'i las rigs la zhugs pa ni mi tshe'i rin thang che shos zhig tu brtsis/ byis pa'i slob ra ni phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsed chas kyis bkang / byis pa bsu skyel byed pa'i rlangs 'khor yang spus legs pa/ rlangs 'khor de lam du rgyug skabs gzhung lam du dus tshod gtan khel gyi bkag sdom byed sa dag la yang dmigs bsal gyis 'gro chog pa las bkag mi chog de'i phyir byis pa'i bde 'jags la phan pa'i bya ba byed pa zhig yin/ byis pa la mthong chen byed tshul de dag gis byis pa ni mes po'i shul bzhag byas pa'i rin bral gyi dngos po de srung skyong dang / dar spel byed pa'i 'jig rten gyi bdag po zhig yin pa'i tshod dpog byed thub/2 rig gnas kyis dpal 'byor la ram 'degs yong dgos/rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang sogs phyogs yongs nas bshad rung dpal 'byor ni rtsa ba zhig tu snang / dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba ni sus kyang ldog mi 229

thub pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag pa zhig yin par ma zad/ de las kyang dus rabs 'di ni dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs yin/ spyir mi yi 'tsho ba legs por yong ba'i rtsol ba ni u tshugs mi dgos shing shugs kyis 'bad pa'i bya ba zhig yin te/ mi'i srog gi 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba yod pa'i phyir/ mi yi 'tsho ba ni dpal 'byor bzang ngan la rag las/ der brten dus rabs ci 'dra zhig dang spyi tshogs gang 'dra zhig yin rung mi yi ngal rtsol ni dpal 'byor gyi phyogs su rang bzhin gyis 'khor yod/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i skabs/ bod la sangs rgyas chos lugs thog mar dar 'go tshugs pa de ni/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas kyi 'gyur ldog gsar pa'i 'og dbang sgyur gral rim gyi chab srid lam lugs thad la chos lugs kyi bsam blo gsar pa'i dgos mkho byung bar bstun nas dar spel gtong thub pa byung ba zhig yin zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ nang pa'i chos de yang spyi tshogs dpal 'byor dang 'brel ba yod 'dug pa zhig yin na/ bod kyi rig gzhung gzhan dag bshad ci dgos/ yang dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi nang don rnams skabs de'i spyi tshogs dpal 'byor 'brel ba dang mthun po yod pa de'i rkyen gyis srong btsan gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la dad mos mdzad pa dang dar spel gtong thub par byung ba red gsungs/ skad cha 'dis rig gnas dpal 'byor dang 'brel ba med na rig gnas nyams rgud du 'gro rgyu yin pa gsal por bstan yod/ der brten/ bod kyi rig gnas 'di dpal 'byor dang kha bral thabs med pa dang /bod kyi rig gnas kyi bstan pa yun ring gnas par byed pa la/ rig gnas dpal 'byor dang lag sbrel dam por byed dgos/ dbu ma 'jug pa las kyang /mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la/ longs spyod kyang ni sbyin las 'byung mkhyen nas/ thub pas dang bor sbyin pa'i gtam mdzad do/ / zhes 230

gsungs pas/ longs spyod kyi don du sbyin pa gtong dgos gsungs pa dang /longs spyod med na mi'i bde ba mi thob gsungs pa 'di dag gis bdag cag gi ston pas kyang dpal 'byor rig pa gnad la 'khel ba zhig gsungs yod/rig gnas kyis dpal 'byor sna khrid byed pa dang / rig gnas kyis dpal 'byor la ram 'degs byed dgos/ tha na tshong las zhig yin rung tshong rtsal shes dgos/ tshong rtsal mi shes pa'i tshong las ni tshod 'dzin yod pa zhig yin/dper na deng dus tshong rtsal mi shes pa'i tshong pa 'gas gna' rdzas kyi tshong byed pas/ gnas skabs su dngul sgor dga' rab cig thob rung / gna' rdzas zad dus tshong las kyang zad tshar ba red/ rgyu mtshan ni tshong las kyi shes rig med pa'i rkyen gyis/ tshong las rig pa'i 'phrul mi shes pa'i lan pa red/tshong las rig pa'i 'phrul rnams shes na/ 'jig rten gyi dpe la/ khab kyis 'bug dang / 'bug gis mdung zhes pa ltar 'phel bskyed byed thub/ gang ltar bshad rung shes rig dpal 'byor dang sbrel nas lus srog la phan pa'i bya ba dngos yod thog nas sgrub thub dgos/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis kyang / sa 'bu rkang med bde ba'i ched du rgyug grog ma mig med bde ba'i ched du rgyug mdor na 'jig rten thams cad bang 'gran nas/gcig las gcig mgyogs bde ba'i phyogs su rgyug gsungs pa ltar dud 'gro tshud chad kyis 'bad phyogs ni bde ba yin/ bde ba'i rgyu dpal dang 'byor ba yin pas/ dpal 'byor la rig gnas kyis ram 'degs yong bar bya/de ltar bod mi'i shes rig las don skor la lan tshan kha shas shig bkod pa 'di yang deng dus rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang sogs su 'gyur ba tshabs che la/zing cha che ba'i dus su/ bod kyi shes rig gi bsam gzhig gi las bgo de me tog gangs la bab pa'i lha skal bzhin/ bod mi'i phrag tu bab pa las 'os ci 231
sdo mi'i dra zhithas zhing

skabs babs bod mi'i shes rig las don mdor brjod gnyis pa/dang po/ bod kyi rig gnas che chung lnga yi dgos mkho bajod pa/dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i 'jig rten 'di legs pa'i lam du skul byed dam pa'i chos/ dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas rung sems gshis sol ba ltar gnag pa'i gang zag mtha' dag la gso sman du gyur ba'i dam pa'i chos/ dam pa'i chos ni dam pa'i chos te/ phul byung gi chos/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang ba/ tshig 'bru bzang po/yang dag pa sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pa bshad ci dgos/ 'dzam gling na yang dam pa'i chos ni rgyal mtshan ltar ngom rin yod pa/ bla bre ltar mngon par mtho ba/ rgyu skar ltar bkra ba'i chos lugs sna tshogs kyi dbus na nyi zla ltar gsal ba'i dam pa'i chos la dad pa'i skyes bu sa yi rdul grangs dang mnyam pa byung rkyen yang rgyu mtshan des red/ 'o na dam chos rnam dag yin na de sgrub pa'i gang zag yang dag yin pas khyab bam zhe na de ni ma nges te/ chos pa'i ming 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig gi rgyu nor la brkam chags che lugs la bltas na so skyes phal ba las thu/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyis gzhan mgo gdugs ltar bskor nas rang rgyud kyi sdom pa nyams par byed pa'i pham pa phog rung ci mi snyam pa/rgyu nor gyi ched du dam chos btsongs pa/ dam chos tshong rar 'dren pa sogs dam chos dang rgyab 'gal gyis tshe 'di'i 'tsho sdod kyi don du 'bad 'bungs 233

hur thag byed pa/ chos kyis dpal 'byor 'gugs thabs byed cing / chos kyi rin du byung ba'i dngul sgor des mgron khang gang skyid du 'dug rlangs 'khor gang bzang de spyod/ za ma gang zhim la rol/ dpon su che dang 'brel ba byed/ rgyu gang che la ngo dga' byed/ btsan shugs che ba de rang phyogs su bkol te mdor na dam pa'i chos kyis 'jig rten phun sum tshogs pa zhig sgrub pa 'di ni blang bya dor bya gang yin gros mol zhig byed 'os/ spyir deng dus blo gros gsar bu ba 'jig rten 'chad la dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir ba/ bod kyi srol rgyun la than ltas su lta ba/ bod mi'i yul srol goms gshis brlag par seng ge dang 'dra ba/ bod ma'i 'tsho sdod la bsam gzhigs kyi rba rlabs 'phyur ba/ rgyu nor gyi 'byor ba la zhen chags che ba spyang ki sha la gzan pa lta bu/bdag 'dzin la gces spras che ba/ bdag med dgra ru sgom pa/ bla sprul ni 'jig rten 'phel rgyas kyi bkag rdo ru ngos 'dzin pa po de dag kyang dam chos kyis 'jig rten skyong nas dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shing / rang don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bla sprul dag gi rgyu nor gyi rjes su chod pa lta ci/ chos pa ri khrod 'grims pa'i 'tsho ba las bzang tsam pa zhig las mi snang / dngos gnas bshad na/ blo gros gsar bu pa de dag gis bod mi'i 'tsho gnas la ram 'degs yong thabs dpal 'byor gtso zhes bshad de dpal 'byor 'phel thabs la jus 'god khri stong mang po dgos lugs gleng bzhin yod mod/ rang nyid kyis dpal 'byor 'phel thabs lag len ni ri bong gi rwa ltar gtan med du snang / de ltar na kha bshad las kyang lag len gal che bas dpal 'byor spel thabs lag len gyi thog nas spyi tshogs la ra sprod cig byas na ches legs snyam/ 'di ni zhor 'phros su smros pa'o/ dam chos kyi che ba la brten nas rnyed pa btsal ba'i dus rabs 'dir sku gsung thugs rten tshong rar drangs pa dang thabs brgya jus stong gis sku gsung thugs rten za thabs byed pa/ dper na 234

mgron khang chen po dag gi gsang spyod khang gi phyi nang kun du yang sku gsung thugs rten bzhag 'dug pas/ mdor na dngul lam sgor mo zhig byung na sngar bsam phyi 'dang gang yang mi rgyag pa'i dus rabs shig tu slebs/ de ltar sku gsung thugs rten tshong zog gi 'du shes 'dzin pa'i dus rabs 'dir/dngos po gzhan la de las kyang tshong 'brel dang thon skyed kyi nus mthu ldan par ngos bzung yod pa smos ci dgos/ 'on kyang zhe pham pa zhig la tag tag de las ldog ste rang la yod pa'i ma rtsa bzang po 'di dag rang rigs kyis thon rdzas su sgyur ma thub nas gzhan la sdeb tshong rgyag dgos byung ba 'di red/'di'i steng nas nga tsho bod mi'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu la pham kha brgya/ gyong kha stong rag gi yod pa mngon sum du grub/ dper na/ lug gi bal/ g.yag gi ko ba/ sha rwa gla rtsi/ 'bu rdza be'u mog de bzhin gter rdzas rigs mtha' dag dang / tha na rtswa rtsi shing dang bcas pa gzhan gyi sar drangs nas thon rdzas su bsgyur rjes ldab log dang ldab log gi rin can du gyur nas rang rigs kyi mgo bo rdung byed du tshur drangs yong gi yod/ yang deng sang blo gros gsar bu 'gas bod kyi rig gnas bcu yis bod mi'i 'tsho gnas la phan thogs med tshul rags bshad dam spom bshad kyi tshig sgros snyan mo'i kha lce g.yo bzhin yod/ dngos gnas bshad na 'di 'dra'i skad cha byung ba de yang rang rigs la sha tsha ba'i snying gis ma bzod nas yar thon gyi bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis btang / blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bskor ba'i tshig don zhig yin kho thag red/ 'on kyang pho gsar gyi bshad 'dod dang rta sar gyi rgyug 'dod dag ni na tshod kyis bkyag rgyu shugs che bas rang rigs skyabs mgon gyi mdzub ston du yong dka'/ dper na/ rig gnas bcu'i che ba lnga las bzo rig pa'i ri mo skor la lha bris thang ga dang / shing tshon ri mo/ mgar bzo la nyer spyod skor dang lha mgar skor/ 'jim bzo la lha bzhengs pa'i skor dang nyer spyod rdza gyo 235

yi skor bcas yod la/ bzo rig gis dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas la nus pa thon yod med reb kong gi brtson 'grus rab rgyas dang khams kyi dkon mchog bkra shis sogs la dris dang da gzod nges shes shig skyes rgyu yod/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa las sman rdzas la cha mtshon na/ rdzas sbyor gzhan dang ma 'dres pas gtsang ba dang / nus pa log par mi 'gyur bas phan nus yang dag lus sems la gnod pa'i nyen kha med pa bcas kyi dge mtshan yod/ sman pa'i cha nas bshad na/ sman pa'i dam tshig skor las sman pas nad pa la byams dang snying rje dgos lugs sogs khyad par can gyi lag len yod/ da lta gangs can bod kyi gso rig lag bstar byed mkhan mtsho sngon a khu 'jigs med kyis bod sman gyi tshong ra la brten nas ma rtsa sgor mo dung phyur la 'gyur yod pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags/ bod kyi bzo gso gnyis kyis dpal 'byor rgya cher 'phel skyed gtong thub rgyu ma red/ dpal 'byor 'phel skyed gtong thabs khyad par can zhig yod snyam na de khyod tshos lag bstar gnongs dang dga' bsu zhu/ ngas bltas na blo gros gsar bu pa 'di dag ni dkar mdzes rong pa tsha lwa dkar bu zhes pa des skad cha bshad pa dang 'dra bo 'dug lwa dkar bus mi mang 'dus pa'i khrod du ma ṇi 'don rgyu min/ de rgad po rgad mo'i chos red/ dpe cha chen po re kha 'don byed 'dod kyang shes kyi mi 'dug ces bshad myong / kha dper de bzhin du da yod rig gnas dpal 'byor gyis ni yid mi tshim/ dpal 'byor khyad par can zhig ni rnyed thabs byed mi nus pas sems kyi 'gyur ba cha mi snyoms pa'i skad cha yin las che/ rig gnas bcu dgos med smra ba khyod tsho bsam pa dkar pos tshig pa zos pa yin stabs nga tsho dga' bo 'dug dper na khyim tshang zhig gi pha ma dag la rgyu nor rnyed pa'i nus pa chen po mi ldan la/ de'i bu rgyud dag gis kyang rgyu nor chen po ni mi rnyed/chung ngu la ni 'bad mi 'dod par pha ma'i steng du tshig pa za ba dang 'dra/ sgra 236
