rig pa 'di yang rig gnas shig yin par ma zad/ phan nus nges can mnga' ba'i rig pa zhig yin/ rig gnas 'di la rang rigs las kyang gzhan rigs kyis mthong chen byed srol yod 'dug rig pa 'di ni mkhas pa'i skad yig gam phal ba'i blor chud dka' ba'i rig pa'i rol rtsed byed yul du gyur pa zhig yin 'dug spyir yang rig pa 'di dab rang rigs la sbyang mkhan nyung ba'i skyon las mang ba'i skyon med/ de ltar na rig pa 'di dag gis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la bkag 'gog ji ltar thebs/ sgra rig 'di ji bzhin shes na zhib 'jugagi rin thang khyad par can yod cing bde skyid skrun pa'i sa khongs zhig kyang yod thag chod red/ za 'thung gi rig pa kho na las rig pa gzhan gang yang mi dgos zer na ci 'dra zhig tu 'gyur bsam dgos pa zhig yin snyam/ma gzhi sgra rig sbyang che nas 'jig rten 'phel bskyed la gnod pa ji ltar bzos myong ba red/ mtshan gzhi zhig 'jog rgyu e yod/ da lta sgra ka tsaṇa dbyangs gsum la ri mo cha tshang 'gro mkhan yang ches dkon pa'i dus su slebs yod pa las sgra rig sbyang rgyu mang song nas dus tshod chud zos su sus btang 'dugangs bltas na da lta rang rigs kyi mi grangs brgya cha drug cu tsam zhig yig rmongs su song ste rig gnas gtan nas mi shes pa long ba thang dkyil du lus pa bzhin 'khyams yod pa 'di dag la sha tsha ba dang snying rje ba'i skad cha re bshad na cis kyang dga' snyam/ nga tshos bsang khri brgya gtor/ bla ma stong dmar gsod byed pa las/ ma gzhi go la zlum po 'di'i steng gi bod mi'i skyid sdug la bsam gzhigs byed pa'i blo gros gsar bu ba rnams/ khyed rnam pa la ngas snying thag pa nas zhu rgyu zhig la/ tshig sbyor gyi cha la sdeb legs pa/ don gyi cha la rags bshad kyi rnam pa mang ba dang / tshig spobs mtho ba/ lhag bsam dkar po'i snum shugs je cher song stabs kyis snga rgol 'joms pa'i ngar sgra ldir ldir du bsgrags kyang / khyed tshos snga rgol gyi 'ben btsugs sa de bod 237

mi'i sems gshis dang / yul srol goms gshis bcas byas te mda' mang po zhig 'phangs 'dug pas gtod sa'i 'ben de gtor thub tshe rang lugs la 'jog rgyu de gang yin/ nga tsho la dgos rgyu tshan rig mang po zhig gi ming tsam bsgrags pa las dngos su lag bstar byed rgyu phar zhog rig gzhung de dag rang rigs kyi dpal 'byor 'phel thabs kyi jus 'god sna gcig kyang byas mi 'dug grogs po tsho dngos gnas bshad na rang rigs la mkho gal che ba'i 'jig rten rig pa de ji ltar lag bstar byed/ gsal por 'bri ba'i shugs kyis nga tsho la dgos med kyi bya dngos dag med par 'gyur rgyu chos nyid red/spyir 'u cag kun gyis shes gsal ltar rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su lo bcu'i gtor brlag byas pa'i gyong gun de bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang brjod kyis mi lang zhes yongs la grags/ rjes su dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu'i srid jus gtan 'khel byas pa dang / de slob gso dang lag bstar byas pa'i grub 'bras la dus yun ring po zhig sgug dgos kyi yod pa yang kun gyis shes/ de bzhin du khyod tshos gtor brlag byed pa'i rig pa thog ltar ngar rung / 'dzugs skrun dang 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i rig pa ni nam mkha'i me tog dang mtshungs pa 'di ya mtshar/ gtor ba'i rig pa las kyang 'dzugs pa'i rig pa mkho gal che bas cis kyang thugs bsam re bzhes na snyam/ dngos gnas bshad na nga tsho 'jig rten pa yin pa las sangs rgyas byang sems min pas lus gso thabs dang / sems bde thabs la 'bad rgyu ni 'os 'gan rlabs po che zhig red/ skad cha brgya bshad stong bshad/ sku stod nas me 'bar ba dang sku smad nas chu 'bru ba/ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung dang ldan pa sogs ni nga tsho 'jig rten pa la bshad na rmi lam gyi gtam las dngos yod du mi snang /da lta nga tsho la rdzu 'phrul brgya stong bshad pa las za ma thengs gcig gis dga' tshod yin rung / nga tsho 'jig rten pa de yang ya mtshar can zhig yin te/ kha la 238

za rgyu med na yang rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bgro gleng byas te sems la dga' bdes khyab thub pa zhig yin/ ngas blta na gnad 'gag rang rigs yig rmongs kyis khengs pa'i 'jig rten chung chung zhig yin pa dang legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros can nyung bas lan pa yin rgyu red snyam/ gal te nga tsho'i 'jig rten chung ngu 'di la legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros ldan pa je mang du song na/ nga tshos khong tsho la 'di 'dra'i tshig tsub kyis kha rdung sprad rgyu phar zhogatshur rgol gyi rig pa thog las tsha ba mang pos nga tsho mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin du bcug thag chod red/ rang rigs kyi 'jig rten pa la legs nyes 'byed pa'i rig pa bzang po de 'dra zhig ldan dus lha mchod byed/ klu gso byed/ rang la za rgyu/ gzhan la sbyin rgyu'i dpal 'byor gyi cha rkyen nges can zhig bzo thub/ de dus rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung gi skad cha dag kyang rgyan cha zhig las skyon du mi 'gyur/ 'dzam gling 'dir a ri'i po dbyi kung si'i dpal 'byor de ni rgya che ba gting zab pa/ 'phel tshad ni bya 'phur ba lta bu yod ces kun gyis bshad/ de bzhin du kho kho'u kho lo'i kung si'i gnas tshul yang nga tsho la cha yod yin/ yo gling gi ri'u su'i rgyal khab gcig gi ched las gtso bo gnyis te/ yul skor sne len dang chu tshod (rakhor lo bzo rgyu de red/ de la brten nas dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas zas gos gnas mal dang rlangs 'khor che chung sna tshogs ci dgar longs su spyod rgyu yod par ma zad/lha mchod byed dang 'dre 'dul byed kyang yod pa red/ nga tshos a ri'i po dbyi kung si lta bu'i bzo grwa zhig ma thon rung / ko lpags bal rigs dang gter rdzas sogs kyi ma rtsa bzang po 'di dag gzhan lag tu brgyud ma dgos par rang rigs kyis bzo grwa bzos nas thon skyed byed thub tshe dpal 'byor gyi yong 'bab bzang bas lha mchod klu gso byas kyang mi gnod de shul du lhag rgyu yod/nga tsho 'jig rten pa yin tsang 'di 'dra'i bzo grwa re 'dzugs gnyer byed mkhan 239

yod na chos lugs pas dgag pa mi rgyag thag chod yin/ rta 'do bar gom lag yod na/ thang a chen la zad pa med zer ba bzhin du/ nga tsho la dpal 'byor 'phel thabs kyi rigs lam bzang po yod tshe bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkhor zad mtha' med/ de ltar na rnam pa tshos lha 'dre'i gtam gyi 'tshang kha rgyag pa las bod mi'i 'tsho sdod la phan pa'i dpal 'byor 'phel thabs kyi lag rtsal sna gcig shes thabs byas na yang dga' 'os pa zhig red/kha bshad brgya las lag len gal che dus 'dir gnam bshad sa bshad stong phrag byed pa las rang rigs kyi chos don du gyur ba'i dngos yod kyis phan pa sgrub rgyu gal che/ nga tshos zhing las mi shes/ 'brog las mi shes/ bzo las mi shes/ gzhan pa'i lag rtsal ngom chog gcig kyang mi shes bzhin bod mi'i 'tsho sdod kyi mthun rkyen du lha klu gnyan gsum gtor/ yul lha gzhi bdag gtor bas phan e thogs dper na byang thang zhig tu sbra gur gyi 'tsho gnas byas pa'i 'brog sdes sbra gur ni mi mkho skyid po mi 'dug ces med par byas/ shing khang ni bzo ma thub pas gnas khang gang du byed/ de bzhin srol rgyun ni dgos med du mthong bas rgyang du bskyur/ deng rabs kyi dngos chos dag ni ldan thabs byed ma thub pas da ji ltar bya/ de las thog mar byang thang du shing khang zhig bzos te bde bar sdod/ sbra gur spyod dgos na spyod/ mi dgos na nang du bzhag na ci bde bde zhig yong gi mi 'dug gam/ shing khang bzang po yod pa zhig la sbra gur yang yod na phyug po'i rgyan du 'gyur ba las skyon ci zhig yod na/ de bzhin srol rgyun gzhir bzhag thog nas deng rabs kyi bya dngos dag 'phel rgyas song na gcig grogs gcig gcig gi rgyan cha gcig gis yong bas mi dga' rgyu ci yod/ dpal 'byor sngon thon gyi gral du tshud pa'i mi rigs dang rgyal khab/ zla ba'i go lar 'khor skyod byed pa'i mi rigs dag gis kyang rang gi lha la dad gsol dang / kho rang gi chos la zhen chags ni rang 240

rigs las kyang brgya 'gyur gyis che bar snang / nga tshos dgag byar 'dzin pa ste/ 'jig rten dar 'phel gyi bkag rdo ru ngos bzung ba'i bla sprul mkhan gsum 'di dag kyang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thabs shes nga tsho las kyang dga' tsam yod pa mngon sum gyis grub/ dper na/ tshong las ni khong tshos shes/ khyim dang nye ba kha gso thabs kyang khong tsho mkhas/ da dung bzo grwa chung ngu re byas te dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo ni kho tsho bzang / za khang dang ja khang / mgron khang dag byas te yul skor dang spro gseng ba'i sgor mo dag kyang khong tshos bsdu rgyu rnyed/ bya ba 'di dag ni chos pa'i las su 'os rigs su yin shag shag las dgag mkhan su yang mi snang / da dung bla ma chen po chos pa'i ming 'dzin pa dag gis rlangs 'khor ches bzang ba'i 'khor lo bzhi can gyi steng du 'dug ste sa la brten pa'i 'khor bskyod kyis srog chags grangs mang zhig dmar gsod byas kyang skyabs su mchi ba las dgag mkhan su yang mi 'dug da dung lag gzung kha par yag shos dang rtsis 'khor yag shos dag kyang khong tshos spyod rgyu rnyed/ de ltar khong tshos kyang 'jig rten gyi bya ba yang dag cig sgrub bzhin 'dug pas nga tshos su la dgag pa brgyab/ dngos gnas bshad na lha med 'dre med kyi lta ba yang dag gam tshad ldan can 'jig rten pa dngos ma dag gis kyang 'jig rten gyi bya dngos 'phel rgyas gtong tshul 'di bla sprul mkhan gsum gyi rjes mi chod 'dug pas ci dgag dgag bya stong pa rang red/ bya btang gi chos pa ri khrod 'grim ste blo phugs chos la gtod/ chos phugs sprang la gtod/ sprang phugs brag phug skam po la gtod/ brag phug skam po shi ba la gtod pa'i dben sa ri khrod du tshe dang bsgrub pa mnyam mkhan ni nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin ha lam med pa'i dus su 'di 'dra'i rigs ni mang skyon mi 'dug nyung skyon 'dug ngas blta na bla sprul mkhan gsum lta bu'i chen po yang min pa/ las kyi sne mo 'dzin pa'i ched las pa yang min pa/ shes ldan gyi 241

blo gsal dag kyang min pa'i mdor na rang rigs la bar ma dor gnas pa'i mi ste/ dud 'gro las drag tsam mi tshad ldan las dman tsam pa'i rkang gnyis can mang song bas mgo bkyag ma thub pa red ma gtogs lha mchod klu mchod tsam gyis gyong chen po de 'dra rag gi ma red/ tshad ma rig pa ni thun mong gi rig pa zhig yin pa las thun min gyi rig pa min pa ni kun gyis shes/ de ltar na nang ba dang phyi rol pa dang / 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten spong ba kun gyis longs su spyod chog pa gang gis spyod na gang la ram 'degs yong ba'i rig pa zhig yin/ dper na shing gcod pa la sta re lta bu/ sa brko ba la 'jor lta bu zhig yin/ sngon dus 'jam mgon sa pan sogs kyis tshad ma chos kyi rig gzhung la spyod de chos lugs dar spel ji ltar btang 'dug nga tshos go tshad ma 'jig rten pa'i phyogs su spyod song yod na des kyang nus pa thon pa the mi tshom/de ltar na 'di yang blang bya'i khongs su gtogs pa las dor bya gang na yin/nang rig ni rang la yod rgyu nang gi che ba/ gzhan la ngoms rgyu'i nang gi dra ma zhig yin/ da lta mi rigs gzhan pa dang rgyal khab gzhan pa dag gis kyang rang rigs la gsal gsal rig rig byed cing khyad par can gyi lta tshul 'dzin pa/ rang rigs kyi skad yig la snang 'jog mtho tsam byung ba 'di nang rig gi drin red ma gtogs nga tsho'i lha 'dre'i rtsod pa'idape chas go chod pa ma red/nang rig gis gzhan la phan pa ji tsam yod med gsal bo mi shes rung / rang rigs la dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo che zhing / gzhan rigs kyi dngul sgor 'gug pa'i lcags kyu 'di rang red/ mdo dbus khams gsum na nang chos las logs su gyur ba'i dpal 'byor 'gug byed kyi nus pa che ba zhig gang na 'dugadeng sang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu las/ bya de khrung khrung dkar mo'i dbang bskur byin rlabs kyis go chod cing / da dung dbang bskur ba po go sa mthon por 'jog srol byung ba 'di yang nang chos kyi drin red/ sku gsung 242

thugs rten gyi tshong gi 'khor lo bskor zhing / thon rdzas nus can du gyur pa 'di yang chos kyi drin red/ 'byor ldan gyi las don lam du 'gro ba'i sku rim 'don par skul phyir sgor mo khri tsho'i gan rgya bzhag rgyu byung ba 'di yang chos kyi drin red/ nga tsho chos btsong ched las la zhugs pa'i go skabs med pa dag tshig pa za thabs ci la yod/ gang ltar rang rigs kyi phu nu dag gis bya rgyal khyung chen gshog bya la pha wang phye leb kyis nyi 'don byed pa bzhin nang chos kyi drin las 'tsho sdod la phan nges kyi 'byor ba rnyed pa yin pas dga' bar sgoms shig / de ltar nga tshos 'jig rten bshad ni yin zer/ nang chos tshang ma dgag na 'tsho sdod la phan pa'i dpal 'byor rnyed pa'i sgor mo bkag pa yin pas kha bshad dang lag len rgyab 'gal ma so/nga ngam/ yang rang rigs kyi mi ser dkyus ma 'di dag snying rje/ khur po mi lcogs steng du sgro lu zer ba ltar ma gzhir dpal 'byor gyi 'khos zhan/ de'i steng du za mkhan mang ba bya rgod mang po rta ro la bskor ba dang 'dra snyam na/ rang rigs kyi yon gyi bdag po dag la 'bul rgyu'i dngos po nyung zhing / 'bul ba thob mkhan phyug byed du mi 'gyur zhing / 'bul pa po sprang por 'gyur bar sus kyang mi byed/ rang rigs kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi rtsa ba nas ches zhan pa zhig yin pa las 'bul ba byas pas sprang por gyur ba'i lo rgyus shig gtan nas med/ 'on kyang dgon khag la las sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la kha g.yar te mi ser gyi khur po je lji btang ste/'di khur shog dang de 'khyer shog ces mi mang gseb tu 'bod pa gtong zhing da dung na ning khyim tshang che ge mo tshang gis 'bul sprod byas ma byung / khyed tsho gnam rdib pa e red ces bka' bkyon byed srol yod 'dug 'di 'dra'i rigs la ma gzab na/ med po khur shog shi bo langs shog ces btsan tshugs byed kyi yod pas sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa yin pa las spel ba min te/'gro la phan pa ma gtogs pa/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs ma mchis/ zhes 243

gsung pa bzhin yin pas gzob shig 'di nas rang rigs kyi bla grwa dag la zhu snying 'dod pa ni khyed tshos rang rigs dang gzhan rigs kyi mi ser dkyus ma skyo bo dag gi nor rdzas dag la brkam chags chen pos kha gsag gzhogs slong /thob 'jal/ rnyed pas rnyed 'tshol sogs kyi log 'tsho'i lag cha spyod nas thob thabs ma byed ma gtogs thob rgyu ni gang yang med pa'i mi kha che byed rang red/ri bong sha gzugs steng du lha 'dres dmag sgar brgyab pa zer rgyu dang 'dra ba zhig yin snang gis/ spyi tshogs kyis khyod tsho la kha nas bsam 'char mi 'don rung / snying nas mi 'byor ba'i skad cha shin tu mang / gal te rang sde dang gzhan sde'i 'byor ldan rnam thos bu dang 'dra ba dag gis rgyu nor rtsed chas kyi 'du shes 'jog pa dag gi 'bul ba ni ga tshod byung na len ma thub na gyong kha red/ mngon brjod dang sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dag ni nga tshos longs su spyod bya mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin pas rgyus la rgyus yod gtam dang rta bdag la rta rgyus bshad mdog byed na ngo tsha byed las ci yod/ rig gnas 'di dag nga tshos longs su spyod bzhin dgos med smra na gang dran dran yin pas khyab pa zhig khas lon pa las thabs ci yod/ zlos gar zhes pa rnam thar gyi 'khrab tshan dag la 'dod na bed chod pa mngon sum du grub/ gcig 'khrab tshan 'di dag la slob gso'i rang bzhin ldan pa/ gnyis/ dril bsgrags rang bzhin ldan pa/gsum/ gzugs po'i bde thang la phan pa/ bzhi/ las bshol ba mang po'i las don rnyed pa sogs kyi dge mtshan yod/ de ltar na rig gnas bcu phan med smra ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yang med pas lce la rus pa med rung gang byung du mi g.yo bar zhu/ 244

gnyis pa/ rang rigs kyi chos pa'i 'gro lugs brjod pa/'dzam gling na chos lugs sne mang yong na yang / nang pa'i chos lugs ni ngo bo zhi ba/ spyod pa mi 'tshe ba zhig yin pa yongs la grags/ khyad par du phyi ma phan chad kyi don du bsam gzhig byed pa zhig yin dgos/ phyi ma don du gnyer ba'i chos pa dag tshe 'di'i las la do snang mi che zhing ci mi snyam pa bzhag mkhan mang / der brten rang gi lto gos kyang gzhan brten gyi 'tsho ba la ltos pa las rang nus kyis thon pa zhig med/ ngas gong zhus kyi bla sprul mkhan po 'jon nus can de dag dang bcas pa phyi mar don du gnyer ba'i chos pa khag gcig dang / tshe 'di ba'i don du gnyer ba'i chos pa khag gcig dang / 'di phyi gnyis ka don gnyer byed pa khag cig 'di phyi gnyis ka don gnyer mi byed pa'i khag gcig ste khag bzhir 'dug gang ltar nga tsho zhe pham pa zhig la chos kyang mi 'grub 'jig rten yang mi 'grub gnyis med kyi chos pa'i ming 'dzin dag gis 'jig rten chung ngu 'dir khengs pa de red/ ma gzhir 'jig rten gyi bde sdug la zhen pa log ste chos pa'i lam du zhugs te 'jig rten las logs su gyur ba'i bde ba zhig btsal 'dod yod pa red/ phugs kyi bde ba la bsam nas 'phral gyi bde ba ring du dor ba'i chos pa rnam pa/ nga tshos phugs kyi bde ba la bsam nas 'phral gyi sdug bsngal khyad bsad kyis 'tsho ba yang gzhan brten byed dgos pa 'di dka' mo zhig red/ spyir bdud kyi mtshon cha tsub mo dag la 'jam mnyen me tog lan du sbyin pa/ lhas sbyin khros nas skyogs rdo 'phangs tshe mi smra brtul zhugs dang du len pa/ rang gi dgra bo la 245

sdang mig tsam yang lta bar mi nus pa'i shākya'i sras po de'i rjes 'brangs dag ni chos pa yin zhing / rang sde'i chos pa dag ni sprang po yin pas/ pham kha lon mkhan yin pa lto gos gtam gsum gyong la skur mkhan zhig yin dgos/ nga tsho'i chos pa'i 'gro lugs de 'dra yin rung rang gi 'tsho chas la bsam gzhig mi byed thabs med rang red/ de bzhin du nga tsho gser khri thog nas chos kyi skad gsang mthon por sgrog mkhan dag gis 'di 'dra'i 'jig rten legs po zhig sgrub bzhin yod na/ chos nyan pa po dag gis kyang rang nyid 'tsho sdod kyi don du bsam gzhigs yang dag byed dgos nges red/ khyad par du deng sang grong gi srang lam rnams su bla grwa kha shas kyis khrel dang ngo tsha bor te sgor mo'i slong mo byed bzhin yod par ma zad/ mgron khang dang ja khang dag gi nang du ston pa'i rjes 'jug ba dag gis lus la sangs rgyas kyi na bza' dang / kha la sangs rgyas kyi chos tshig gis brgyan pa dag gis dngul sgor rnyed pa'i slong mo byed phyir mthe bong slong ste gus gus zhum zhum byed bzhin pa dag la/ las sgrub pa dag gis na bza' la 'jus te rgyang bskrad byas shing tshig tsub smra ba go dus snying la tsha gzer rgyas bzhin 'dug nga tsho'i chos lugs pas rang gi lag rtsal spyod de dngul dang rnyed pa thob chog chog yod pa de bskyur nas/ 'tsho sdod la dmigs nas khyi 'khyar bzhin grong gseb tu rgyu ste slong mo byed pa 'di skyo 'os ba zhig las dga' 'os pa zhig ma red/ las ka 'di 'dra lto gos gtam gsum gyong la bskur ba'i go chod dam/ deng sang mi rigs gzhan dag gi chos lugs pas 'di 'dra yid mug pa dang / thabs skyo bo byed pa'i rnam pa mig gis ma mthong zhing rna bas kyang ma go khyad par du ye shu'i chos lugs pa dag gis khong rang gi bstan pa spel phyir dngul dang rnyed pas 'gro gron rgya chen btang ba ma zad/ lus srog la ma bltas nas bstan pa'i ched du phyag las rgya chen gnang / lo re la mi sna khri phrag mang po khong tsho'i chos sgor btsud rgyu'i 246

'char 'god byed pa/ de'i mthun rkyen du gyur ba'i dngul sgor dang rnyed pa phal che ba rang gi thon las las byung ba'i dngos po yin pa las gzhan las slong nas byung ba ma yin/ khong tsho ni dpal 'byor gyi rgyab dpung mthug la/chos lugs dril bsgrags kyi nus pa che ba/ slob gso sprad thabs la byang cha che ba/ nga tsho nang ba'i chos lugs pa dag gis/ sgor mo dang rnyed pa bsdu ci thub kyis rang gi khug ma gang thabs byas te za 'dod dang hab thob kho na byed bzhin 'gro la phan pa'i bya ba ma sgrub na nga tsho'i bstan pa nyams rgyu gdon mi za/rang gi khe phan la gtsigs su 'dzin pa'i dus 'dir/ phar bsdu mkhan dang tshur sbyin mkhan gnyis dmangs tshogs kyis gang la dad gus byed kun gyis shes/ de ltar na nga tsho'i chos lugs pa la yang sems can gyi re ba bskang ba'i dngos po dang rnyed pa zhig ldan na bzang snyam/ ngas gong zhus chos pa 'byor ldan pa de ni mtho rim gyi chos pa ste/ srid 'byor 'gug pa'i thugs rje lcags kyu ldan pa ste/ chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ka bdag gir 'dzin pa po de red/'di nas bshad pa'i chos pa sprang po de ni/ phyi ma don gnyer can tshe 'di blos gtong po min rung / srid 'byor sgrub pa la 'khos ka zhan pa mang rab cig yod pa de dag dang / spyir nang ba'i chos pa'i 'gro lugs 'di ltar red ces bshad pa de'o/ 'di dag la rnam pa tshos shes rab spyan gyis dbye 'byed zhib par mdzod cig ma gtogs hril gyis len pa dang hril gyis 'dor na blun po'i las su shes par bya zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ yang nga tsho'i dmangs khrod du 'di 'dra'i skad cha bshad srol yod pa ste/ grwa pa bla ma zhig byung na 'gro na rta thog 'dug na gdan thog ces/ kha za 'a dga'/ lus nyal la dga' ba'i dmigs yul zhig las/ phugs bsam gzhan gang yang med pa'i rnam pa zhig snang bas 'di la yang gzab pa gal che/ de bzhin rang rigs kyi 'jig rten pa 'ga' ni byis pa dbang po skyon can dang / glen pa 'dra bo/ 'jon nus 247

med pa dag grwa pa byed pa'i rgyu cha 'os shing 'tshams par snang ste/ grwa pa'i chos sgo la zhugs bcug pa 'di dag la bltas na/ grwa pa zer ba de dus tshod chud zos gtong mkhan zhig las yar thon dang / yar bskyed/ yar rgyas kyi bsam blo med pa lta bu zhig snang bas 'di yang gzab gal che/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs yin pa/ 'byor ba 'di yang gzhan las slong mi dgos shing rang nyid kyi thon las yin na de las kyang bzang / ston pas 'dul ba rnams su/ brtag pa mtha' bzung gis gal te chu yis 'jig pa byung na chu yi gnod 'tshe las thar thabs byed dgos/ de ltar na chu rkyal gyi shes rig sbyong dgos zhes dge 'dun pa la bka' gnang ba ltar/ nga tsho'i yul phyogs 'di na dpal 'byor gyis dbul ba dang / zas gos la dka' ngal shar na/ ston pa'i rjes 'jug dge 'dun pa dag gis kyang 'jigs pa de sel byed/ kha rgyab gso thabs kyi lag rtsal re shes na dga' ba las skyon ci yod/ lag rtsal dgos na spyod cing mi dgos na lhag ma yin pa'i skyon med/ nga tsho bla grwa dag gis sbag sbag dang rlangs 'khor bskor te srog chags bsad pa'i lag rtsal las dga' tsam srog gcod ma dgos pa'i 'tsho chos kyi lag rtsal re sbyong na ches bzang snyam/ nga tsho chung byis pa'i dus su 'di ni grwa pa yin/ 'di ni jo mo yin zhes gtan khel byas/ grwa ba dang jo mo dag las kar zhugs na mi mdzes zhes grwa ba dang jo mo gtan 'khel byas pa'i byis pa de za nyal gnyis las gang yang mi dgos pa'i slob gso byas mthar shing sdong rul ba nang bzhin las ka gang yang mi nus pa'i mi zhig chags khar bcug grwa jo de dag chen po chags rjes grwa jo byas pa'i nges pa med/ deng sang dpal 'byor gyi dus rabs 'dir/ dpal 'byor gyis brdab dkrug byas pa'i skyon gyis grwa jo dag kyang 'jig rten phyogs su bskor/ de dus 'jig rten sgrub byed kyi lag rtsal ni mi shes/ chos bsgrubs pa'i grwa jo'i bsam blo ni dor tshar/ de 248

ltar na gnyis med seng ge mi 'gyur ram/ nga tsho bod mis rtsod med gong du bkur ba'i grub chen thang rgyal gyis lcags zam btsugs pa dang / zlos gar 'khrab tshan gyi srol btod pa/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos mi yi bde thang la phan pa'i gso rig rgyud bzhi brtsams pa dang / lag bstar byed pa/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi shing tshon ri mo dang thang ka ri mo/ bzo rgyal bi sho karma'i bzo'i lag rtsal ni 'tsho sdod kyi phyogs su gyur pa'i mthun rkyen yin/lag rtsal 'di dag ni thon las dpal 'byor gyi 'byung khungs red/ da dung spyi tshogs la phan nges kyi rig gnas te/ tshong ba/ rdza mkhan/ 'phreng rgyud mkhan/ chang ma/ phyugs rdzi/ 'breg mkhan/ 'bru mar mkhan/ phywa mkhan/mgar ba/ shing mkhan/ 'thag 'khan/ ko lpags mkhan/ nya ba/ btso lag mkhan/ smyug ma mkhan/ shan pa/ gshed ma/ shing rta mkhan dang bco brgyad 'di dus 'khor gyi lugs la 'di 'dra'i zhib mor bris la 'di las chang ma dang / phyugs rdzi 'di dag kyang rig gnas pa'i las ka yin par go thub pa ma zad/ rig gnas 'di dag la dam pa de dag gis mthong chen yang tshad med gnang yod/gsum pa/ rang rigs kyi re sgyag gi 'bras bur brjod pa/spyir 'jig rten gyi dpe la/ bod re bas phung / rgya dogs pas phung /zer ba de dngos gnas red/ rang rigs bod 'di yar thog gdod ma'i bon gyi bstan pa dar nas sha mchod khrag mchod kyi dus rabs shig yod myong / de dus rang gi 'jon thang dang nus par bstun pa'i lag shes kyis 'tsho sdod byed pa shugs che/ rang nyid kyi thon las te/ ri dwags rngon pas sha zos pa dang 249

lpags pa gon pa'i las ka tshang ma rang nyid kyi thon las yin/ de'i rjes su yang zhing las rmo rko so nam la brten nas byung ba'i 'bru rigs dang / 'brog las la brten pa'i zho mar thud gsum la spyod pa dag kyang rang nyid kyi thon las red/ skabs de dag tu lha 'dre mchod pa dag kyang 'jig rten 'tsho sdod kyi las la 'bad brtson hur thag byed pa/ rang nyid khe thabs dang gzhan pham thabs te/ 'jigs rung gi las la zhugs pa shugs che bas gdug tsub kyi rnam pa mngon gsal dod po yin pa dang / rgyu mtshan des gnod sbyin nag po'i sde zer ba sogs 'gro ba mi ma yin pa'i snang tshul zhig ster gyi yod/ dper na/de tsho'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa kun kyang rags rtsub kyi rnam pa las zhi 'jam gyi rnam par mi snang / bod rgyal gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal po glang dar ma yan gyi lo rgyus la phyir mig ltos dang / 'jig rten gyi 'tsho thabs la phan pa'i mdzangs pa mi bdun gyi las ni de'i ring la byung / khri bdun dang legs drug lde brgyad steng gnyis mtha' dag bon gyi bstan pa la dad cing /'jig rten 'tsho thabs kyi las la rgyug pa sha stag red/ ma gzhir skabs der rang stobs rang spel byed rgyu de tsam shed che zhing / tshe 'di ba'i don la gtso bo byed mkhan zhig yin rung / tshe 'di ba'i don la yang lha 'dre la gsol 'debs dang re ltos med pa zhig min/ 'dis kyang rang rigs kyis re sgug gi rten 'brel 'go btsugs pa de mtshon yod/ nga tshos rgyun du gleng ba'i srong btsan sgam po de yang 'jig rten srid lugs la mkhas shing / 'tsho gnas la bsam gzhigs byed cing / 'tsho gnas kyi las ka rgyun du 'bad mkhan zhig yin pa las phyi mar don gnyer can zhig ga na yin/ srong btsan sgam pos dmag mi de tsam zhig rtsa 'dzugs byas/ skabs skabs su ri dwags rngon sar phebs kyi yod pa sogs la bsam na rang gi stobs shugs bed spyod byas te tshe 'di ba'i las la 'bad mkhan zhig yin/ 'di dag gis 'tsho sdod gzhan la re 250

sgug ma byas shing rang stobs rang spel/ rang shed rang spyod kyis 'tsho thabs la 'bad bzhin lha gso klu mchod kyi rten 'brel re bsgrigs kyang rang nyid kyi las don lha klu la bcol ba'i rnam thar ma lags/ glang dar ma'i rjes su bod kyi lo rgyus chu bo bzhin thur du 'gro dus der bod mi'i nang gi gsal gsal rig rig can/ cung mngon par 'phags pa de tsho lung pa'i nang gi blo shes rab can red/ skabs de dus rang gi mgo bo 'di lha'i dpang du bzhag ste skyabs bcol byed rgyu shugs je cher song nas/ tha na mis 'thab 'khrug byed mi dgos pa'i lha dmag gi 'khrug pa/ mis dka' tshegs las ma grub pa'i lha klu gnyan gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang dang pho brang ya mtshan can/ sman pa la bsten mi dgos pa'i nad gso ba'i lha/ rtsol ba las ma byung ba'i rgyu nor rang 'khor sogs thams cad nas thams cad lha la re bcol kho na byas te dus 'da' song / tshe 'di ba'i las don kun po lha la bcol bar ma zad/ phyi ma'i thar lam thob thabs kyang lha la skyabs bcol byas/ spyir rang rigs 'di gzhan rigs dang mi 'dra zhing rgyang mthong bi 'dun pa che ba/ gtan bde'i phyi thag la mno bsam gtong ba/ 'phral gyi bde sdug la mi blta zhing / gtan gyi bde sdug la bsam gzhig byed pa/ thung ngu la mi blta zhing ring por blta ba sogs kyi dge mtshan rlabs po che mchis/ dngos gnas bshad na/ 'phral gyi phan pa dang gtan gyi bde ba kun po yang rang nyid kyi brtson pa la rag las te/ji skad du/ ngas ni khyed la thar ba'i thabs bstan gyi/ thar ba rang la rag las brtson par gyis zhes pa dang / de bzhin du/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel zhing / nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spor mi nus/ chos nyid zhi ba bstan pas grol bar 'gyur zhes rang gis brtson pas bsgrub pa'i dge ba dgos tshul gsungs na yang / 'bad sgrub kyi dge ba ring du dor te lha la re bcol byed pa'i bstan pa ches che ba dar sa rang rigs kyi sa khongs su mchis/251

'dis kyang bar du re sgug dar 'phel byung tshul de mtshon yod/ tha na byis pa dang gzhon nu lang tsho dar ba dag gi shes rab kyang 'bad sbyong mi dgos shing /'jam dpal dbyangs kyis shes rab lag mthil du rdog rdog tu 'jog rgyu'i re bcol byed pa 'di dag re sgug gi ngan goms song ba'i shugs rkyen red/ dus rabs gsar ba'i nyi gzhon gangs ljongs 'dzin ma'i khyon du 'phos te/dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i dus 'dir/ a rogs blta sa/ khyim mtshes nyan sa'i gzhan rigs dang gzhan gyi rgyal khab kyi mi sna de dag gis yan lag lnga sogs rang lus rin po che be+ed spyod btang nas bdag nyid bdag gi mgon du bzung ste/ 'tsho gnas gzhan la re sgug mi byed cing rang stobs rang spel tshad ldan zhig lag bstar byed dus/ rang rigs kyi mi mang shos shig gis gzhan gyi rogs ram dang / gzhan rten gyi 'tsho ba la spyod cing / rang lus rin po che bed mi chod cing chud zos su btang ste/ za nyal gnyis kyis dus 'da' ba 'di ches sems pham 'os pa zhig red/ gzhan la re sgug kho na byed pa'i mi rigs de la 'phel rgyas kyi re ba gtan nas med/dud 'gros kyang rang gi 'tsho sdod gzhan brten byed mi dgos na nga tsho 'gro ba mi yin pa/ smra shes don go yin pa zhig gis gzhan brten byed dgos na ya mtshar/ deng sang 'dzam gling spyi 'gros ltar/ dbul phyug snyoms pa dang /dbul po la lta rtog khyad par can byed pa/ phyug pos dbul po la rogs ram byed pa/ 'di dag ya rabs kyi las su snang zhing bkur 'os pa zhig lags kyang / 'di 'dra'i dar srol gyis dbul po za lobs kyi goms gshis song na rang thog gi 'bad brtson mi byed cing / rang thog gi yar thon dang / yar bskyed gang yang mi thon zhing phan pa las kyang gnod pa e che che ru 'gyur rgyu gdon mi za/ dper na/ sa khul 'ga' ru lta rtog la re ba'i mi dag gis lta rtog kho na la bltas te/ de kho na la re sgug byas te/ rang lus yid bzhin nor 252

bu bed mi spyod cing / sang lo'i lta rtog de da lor za 'thung byas te/ yas nas chang dang a rag mas nas sha dang mar 'khyer shog nga la sang lo lta rtog sgor mo yod pas sprad chog ces de kho na la 'byung pos lhag ma sgug pa bzhin ltos te sdod kyi 'dug de ltar na/ lta rtog rogs ram gyis za nyal gnyis slob pa las gzhan yar bskyed dang / mi spus gtsang zhig tu bskyed bsring byed thub pa'i dus mi 'dug khor yug bzang po 'di 'dra la ma rtsa'i rgyu cha ste thon khungs phun sum tshogs shing / dngos po gya nom pa 'di dag rtsol ba cung zhig gis dpal 'byor can du bsgyur nas rang nyid rang gi skyabs su bsten na 'di las bzang ci yod/ gal te re sgug kho nas dus 'da' na mthar 'bras ni stong pa rang red/bzhi pa/ si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa'i shugs rkyen brjod pa/go la zlum po 'dir si khron zhing chen bod yig slob grwa zhes pa'i zlum gzugs zla ba'i go la ste dra zur gyi tsha zer mi ldan yang zhi 'jam gyi 'od mdangs can zhig 'dzin ma'i mkha' la mngon par shar nas mi lo nyi shu lhag tsam las ma song / blo gsal gzhon skyes kyi kun dā tshar du dngar ba bskyed bsrings thub pa 'di kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags/ deng dus mkhas brgya 'gran gleng / me tog mnyam bzhad kyi dus rabs 'dir/ dge slob rnams la yang bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ 'jig rten lta tshul/ blo sgo 'khor phyogs chos dang 'jig rten la lag len bstar tshul bcas kyis 'jig rten chen po'i nang du 'jig rten chung ngu'i sa khongs shig chags yod/ de las kyang deng dus lha chos 253

rig pa'i bla bre mkha' la bres/ chab srid rig pa'i dar cha mtho ru bsgrengs/lha 'dre gtor byed kyi rigs pa mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro sgrog gsar rtsom rig pa'i myu gu 'tshar longs rgyas/ deng rabs rig pa'i 'brug sgra 'byin pa sogs 'di bzang dang de bzang / 'di dga' dang de dga' sogs rtsod pa'i nga ro bsgrags te rnyog 'dzing me ltar 'bar/ bsam gzhig chu ltar 'khol dus 'dir/ slob grwa 'di yang ma nor lam bzang zhig tu 'jug rgyu gal che/'jug na don che ba/ ma 'jug na gyong che ba'i yar 'phen mar 'phen gyi stobs nus nges can yod pa zhig yin pas/ slob grwa'i slob gso'i 'khor phyogs la do snang byed rgyu gal che/ nga tsho'i da lta slob grwa 'di'i bya bzhag skor cung zad zhig gleng 'dod pa ni 'di ltar/ nga tsho'i mig gi 'dzer ma ru gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi bkag rdo ru mthong ba'i bla ma dang mkhan po de dag slob ra 'di'i rgyan du gyur pa ste/ mkha' la nyi zlas rgyan pa dang 'dra/ slob grwa 'di thog ma 'dzugs dus kyang dgon sde khag gi mkhas chen tsho gdan zhus byas te bod kyi rig pa slob pa'i 'go btsugs/ dngos gnas bshad na dgon pa khag gi chos lugs pa tsho 'jig rten 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i bkag rdo zhig yin zhes bshad srol mchis kyang / 'jig rten 'phel rgyas gtong ba la med du mi rung ba yang yin zhes bshad chog pa lta bu zhig snang / slob grwa 'di yang khong tsho'i dpang nas 'tshar longs byung zhing lag chags pa red/ gso rig mkhan po yang kho tsho yin la/ lha bzo mkhan po yang kho tsho yin/ rtsom rig mkhan po kho tsho yin la/ shing bzo mkhan po yang kho tsho yin/ nang tshad mkhan po kho tsho yin la rdo bzo mkhan po yang kho tsho yin/ zlos gar mkhan po kho tsho yin la/ skar rtsis mkhan po yang kho tsho yin/ kho tsho'i drin las na gzhon mang po zhig 'tsho sdod kyi mthun rkyen cha tshang rnyed/ slob grwa 'di ni kha bshad nyung la lag len mang tsam pa/ rtsod pa nyung la mthun sgril mang tsam pa/ stong 'ur nyung la don dngos 254

mang tsam pa/ bsam gzhigs nyung tsam la lag rtsal rig pa mang tsam pa lha 'dre'i rtags gsal nyung la 'tsho sdod rig pa mang tsam pa/ bag chags dkrug rgyu nyung tsam pa/ lto rgyab phan nges kyi rig pa mang tsam pa/ gnam mchong sa mchong nyung tsam pa/ las don lag tu len rgyu mang tsam pa/ kha za ma dang 'phrad thabs/ lus las don dang 'phrad thabs rig pa 'di na dar/ 'tsho sdod rig pa dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas rung / mes po gong ma la dmod sngags 'don mi dgos pa/ bzo rtsal rig pa skar tshogs ltar bkra rung sgra skad rig pa la ngan btsog blta mi dgos pa/ gso/ ba rig pa'i lo 'dab rgyas rung /nang tshad rig pa la bka' bkyon byed mi dgos pa dag ste/ gzhan gyis me chu ltar 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i rigs mang po zhig 'di na 'gal med grogs su sbran thub pa dang / dngos gnas bshad na/ 'jig rten gyi kha dpe la/ kha bshad chu yi wu ba/ lag len gser gyi thigs pa zhes pa/ kha bshad las kyang lag len gal che zhing / kha bshad las kyang lag len dka' ba/ bshad pa mi bden bya ba bden/ rgas pa mi bden gnyer ma bden zhes pa dang / de bzhin du bshad pa mi gtso bsgrub pa gtso zer ba sogs kyis bsgrub rgyu 'di gnad du bzung ste/ rang rigs 'tsho sdod la phan nges shig lag bstar byed na cis kyang mi dga' 'am/ rig pa thog las tsha ba/ lhag bsam zla ltar dkar ba/ phod pa ri las mtho ba/ dpa' snying ge sar las che ba'i na gzhon 'di dag ni nga tsho'i nang du ma yod de yod yin pas khong tshos nga tsho'i 'tsho sdod la phan nges de lag len gyi thog nas ra sprod bzo rgyu'i gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa yin/ sman dpyad bklag pas nad pa la mi phan pa ltar/ nga tshos smre ngag 'don pas ci phan/ gal te nga tshos 'tsho sdod la phan nges mi thon khyi dang 'dra zhes ngan smad pa kho nas dus 'da' na/ dpa' mi thon mkhan la bshad rgyu mang zer ba de mi 'gyur ram/ slob ra 'dis kyang 'di 'dra'i lag shes sna 255

re'i bstan pa btsugs pa dang / bstan pa spel ba la bsam gzhigs nges can dang / brgyud rim nges can/ dka' spyad nges can zhig dgos kyi 'dug pas las sla mo gang na yin/ lha 'dre gtor byed kyi dpe cha khri phrag cig bris pa las kyang 'di 'dra'i lag rtsal sna re'i bstan pa btsugs na 'tsho sdod la phan nges su gyur 'dug snyam/ nga tshos ko lham zhig la lhan pa thabs chag cig phog pa'i lag rtsal mi ldan bzhin gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi rkang 'dzin te bgro gleng gis dus tshod chud zos su 'gro byed las phan pa e yod/ zla ba'i go lar dpung 'jug byed pa'i/ sngon thon gyi rgyal khab 'di dag gis kyang lag len gtso bo byas pa las kha bshad gtso bo byas yod tshod ma red/ 'di dag la thugs bsam re bzhes pa'i re ba yang snying nas zhu ba yin/ ma gzhir ngas kyang phu nu tsho la re ba thal che ba'i skyon 'dra e yod na ma gtogs/ phu nu 'di tshos ma thon na sus thon/ 'di tshos rang rigs 'di mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba/gzhan rigs las kyang mchog gyur gyi go sar bkod pa/ 'das pa'i lo rgyus la yid smon shor mi dgos pa/ lha klu gnyan gsum la re bcol byed mi dgos pa/mes po la le brda byed mi dgos pa'i nyi ma zhig 'char khar bcug pa'i yid ches yod/ nga tsho'i lha klu gnyan gsum la re bcol byed mi dgos par rang nyid kyis rang mgo thon pa zhig byung na de las dga' ba ci yod/ lha la re bcol byed pa 'di rang rigs u thug pa'i rtags shig yin pa las skyid che ba'i rtags min pa sus kyang go de bzhin du mes po dag la le brda byed dgos byung ba 'di yang bkra shis pa'i rtags ma yin zhing sna nag ma'i khongs su gtogs pa zhig red/ deng sang 'dzam gling zhi bde/ spyi tshogs mdza' mthun/khor yug bde 'jags/ skye dngos yar rgyas bcas ni dus rabs 'dis bton pa'i re ba dang po de yin pa la/ nga tshos pha ma'i thog la bka' bkyon byed/ phu nu bar la 'thab rtsod slong dgos byung ba 'di ngu 'os pa las dgod 256

'os pa zhig min/ nga tshos srol rgyun gyi lag rtsal rig pa 'di dag tshad ldan zhig lag bstar byed thub na dpal 'byor gyi yong sgo bzang ba/ gzhan rigs la yid smon shor mi dgos pa zhig yong nges red/ dper na 'jar man gyis rgun chang bzos pa'i lag rtsal spyod pa dang / i ṭa li yis ko lpags kyis lag rtsal spyod stangs bzang bas rgyal khab gnyis la sgor mo'i yong 'bab bzang ba la skad grags 'dug de bzhin ri'u si rgyal khab gcig gis yul skor sne len dang / chu tshod 'khor lo bzos pas kha gso rgyab 'geb kyi mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dzoms pa dang / go thos ltar na ri'u si rgyal khab kyi khyim tshang dang khyim tshang gis chu tshod 'khor lo spus ldan bzos te tshong ra la 'grem gyi yod pa'i skad cha 'dug nga tshos phu nu nang rtsod byas pa las dpal 'byor rig pa dang sngon thon rgyal khab 'di dag gis dpal 'byor lag bstar byed tshul la mig rna bed spyod de mig dper bzung nas 'bad brtson byed na dga' snyam/ ma gzhi nga tsho'i rgyal khab 'di klad pa'i rig pa sbyong rgyu shugs che la/lag rtsal rig pa sbyong rgyu ches nyung / rgyu mtshan des 'chad rtsom gyi las byed pa je mang song rkyen lag rtsal gyi shes can je nyung phyin stabs/ da lta gnas tshul 'di 'gyur ldog gtong 'char yod pa red/ khyad par du rang rigs ni de las kyang bshad rkyang gis dus tshod btang ste/ gtang rgyu ril ma tsam la brla rgyal sgo trem bsgrad de gnam bshad sa bshad byas te/ las ka sna gcig kyang phun sum tshogs pa thon dka' bzhin rtsod pa 'phar ma dang / bsam gzhigs 'phar ma byed kyin 'dug snyam/257

lnga pa/ chos srid kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin brjod pa/chos zhes pa'i sgra 'di don bcu la 'jug pa las/ skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos la 'jug gi yod pas/ dam pa'i chos zhes pa ni phul byung gi chos sam/ don dam pa'i chos zhes pa'am/ yang na sangs rgyas dam pa de'i chos yin pas na zhes pa sogs la 'grel chog nang pa'i chos 'di la/ sgrub stangs kyi thad nas/ legs smon gyi chos/ mngon mtho'i chos/ nges legs kyi chos sogs su 'gyur ba/ yang na spros bcas kyi chos dang / spros med kyi chos zhes pa gnyis su 'gyur/ bdag cag gi ston pas rgyal srid mchi ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs te rab tu byung ste dka' bar spyad nas mngon par sangs rgyas pa/ rgyu mtshan 'dis rgyal srid chos srid gnyis gang zag gcig gis stan thog gcig tu lag bstar byed thabs med pa zhig go dgos kyi ston pa nus med u thug gis rgyal srid chos srid gnyis las gcig gtong dgos thug pa zhig go mi rung /de ltar na chos dang 'jig rten gnyis ni me chu ltar 'gal zlar gyur ba zhig mthong / yang 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis legs par dpyad na chos dang mi 'gal zhing / 'jig rten bya ba kun nas legs grub pa/ zhes chos dang 'jig rten 'gal med kyis gcig grogs gcig dang / gcig phan gcig gis byed pa'i rigs pa zhig yod pa ltar byas te/ nyid kyis chos srid zung 'brel gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed pa/ chos srid gnam sa gnyis kyi bstan pa de hril bor 'dzin pa'i srol gsar du gtod pa lags/ de bzhin du phun sum tshogs pa sde bzhi zhes chos nor 'dod thar bzhi yod chog pa zhig 'dod pa 'di ji ltar 'jog mno bsam gtong dgos pa zhig yin/ tshe 'di'i bde thabs 258

nor dang 'dod yon gyis phyug pa/ phyi mar bde thabs chos dang thar bas rgyan chog pa zhig yin na de las bzang ba zhig ci yod/ ma gzhir nga tsho bod mis kyang 'dzam gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung la dad cing / ge sar rgyal po'i rnam thar la 'dun pa/ khyad par du dkar phyogs dge ba skyong tshul/ nag phyogs bdud sde bcom tshul/ da dung khong ni sa bcu thob pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'gro drug 'dren pa'i bla ma yin zhing / bdud sde rtsa lag dang bcas pa'i ru dpung 'joms pa la dme shi khrag gi 'khor lo skor rung / dam pa'i chos dang 'gal med zung du sbrel thub pa zhig yin par 'dod/ de ltar na ge sar rgyal po'i las ka 'di chos srid zung 'brel zer ba yin nam brtags par 'tshal rang rigs kyis dam pa'i chos la dad 'dun byed bzhin chab srid kyi dbu 'phang ri las mtho tsam pa zhig bskyangs te ge sar rgyal po'i rjes 'jug bya thub na los bzang / ge sar rgyal po de don du chos pa yin rung 'jig rten srid lugs la ched mkhas te/ dpal 'byor dar rgyas gtong ba/ chab srid brtan brling byed pa/ 'bangs mi bde la bkod pa/ dgra bo 'dul la mkhas pa/ lha dang bla ma la dad pa byed mkhan bcas ci mtshar mtshar dang / ci 'dod 'dod lta bu zhig bshad 'dug chos nor 'dod thar te phun tshogs sde bzhi de yang khong gis lag bstar byed 'dug ngas gong zhus ltar/ ge sar rgyal po'i rnam thar la dbye zhib byed na 'di ltar/ seng lcam 'brug mo'i skra bdag skya lo mi zog gi bdag po/ sgang pa bod kyi skyabs mgon/ khra mo gling gi dpon po/ nag phyogs bdud kyi kha gnon/ mdor na mi gsad kyi lag dmar/ dgra bo rdung byed kyi tho ba/ rang phyogs skyong zhing gzhan phyogs bcom pa sogs 'jig rten srid lugs la med du mi rung ba'i skyes bu zhig yin pa las/ rnam pa'i cha nas gshe la slar mi gshe/ brdegs la slar mi brdeg khros la slar mi khro ba/mtshang 'bru la slar mi 'bru ba'i dge sbyong gi chos bzhi lag bstar byed mkhan 259

zhig tu mi snang / ge sar gyis gzhan sde chom la phab phyir drag po g.yul la 'jug cing / gzugs med kyi lha 'dre 'dar bar byed pa dang / 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis chos gos rnam gsum sku la brgyan te/ gzhan sde chos kyis skyangs nas/ ris med byang sems kyi bslab pa la 'jug pa gnyis la dbye zhib cig byos dang go rgyu yod/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis chos srid lag len ji ltar byas kyang chos pa yin pas chos shugs che bar byas/ ge sar rgyal pos chosasrid gnyis la lag len byas kyang srid shugs che bar byas pa zhig tu mi snang ngam/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyi lugs la gzhan sde khe zhing rang sde pham pa de dam pa'i chos yin pa la/ ge sar rgyal po'i lugs la de las ldog na chos pa'i las su rigs pa 'di dag la nga tsho'i blo gros kyis zhib mo rnam 'thag cig dgos nges red/ slob dpon chen mo mkhyen rab 'od gsal gyis/ chos ldan rgyal khab rgyal khams kun la yod/ chos srid zung 'brel bod kyi yul du dar/chos ldan tsam gyis rgyal khab mi phung kyang / zung du sbrel bas gnyis ka'i nus pa shor zhes gsungs pa la/ ma gzhi chos srid zung 'brel gyi tshad gzhi 'di yin zhes pa zhig gtan 'khel med na chos srid zung 'brel zhes brgya bshad stong bshad byas kyang phan med du snang / de ltar na mi rigs sam rgyal khab cig la chos srid gnyis yod kyang zung 'brel yin pas ma khyab ste/ chos srid zung 'brel zer ba de yongs grags kyis bshad tshul ltar na/ chos srid gnyis gang zag gcig gis bdag gir byed cing bdag dbang byed pa zhig ste/mdor na gsal por bshad na chos srid gnyis kyi 'go gtso mi gcig gis byed pa la zer gyi yod/ skad cha 'di la go rgyu nges can zhig yod de thun mong gi snang ngor ge sar rgyal po de ni srid kyi 'go gtso zhig yin pa las chos kyi 'go gtso ma yin zer na chog de bzhin srong btsan sgam po ni de las kyang srid kyi 'go gtso yin pa las chos kyi 'go gtso min/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug dang / lha 260

chos dge ba bcu sogs srong btsan gyis gtan la phab pa yin pas srong btsan ni chos pa red snyam na/ de ni ma yin te chos kyis srid la zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin bar shes dgos/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar srong btsan gyis chab srid rgya bskyed cing / dmag don dang rig gnas dar spel byas pa las chos lugs mi sna gso skyong byed pa'i lo rgyus gtan nas med/ dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis chos srid zung 'brel dngos su 'go tshugs pa'i dus ni dpal ldan sa skya pa dang mong gol mi rigs kyi rgyal po gnyis 'brel ba chags pa nas yin gsung / nga tshos srong btsan sgam po la chos kyi rgyal po zhes mtshan btags srol byung ba 'di ni/ chos lugs pas phyis su btags pa yin gyi/ srong btsan sgam po ni 'jig rten srid lugs la mkhas shing chab srid kyi 'go gtso yin pa las chos lugs kyi 'go gtso byas ma myong / de bzhin du ge sar rgyal po'i lo rgyus la bsam gzhigs shig byed na/ ge sar rgyal pos kyang 'jig rten srid lugs kyi 'go gtso byas pa las dgon sde ma btab pa dang / chos lugs mi sna gso skyong byas pa'i lo rgyus kyang med/ de ltar na chos la dad pa yod pa tsam gyi mi snas 'jig rten gyi bya ba byed pa yin na de la chos srid zung 'brel mi bya ste/ chos la dad pa yod pa tsam gyis chos lugs kyi 'go gtso ga na 'gyur/spros med bya gtang gi chos sgrub mkhan zhig yin na chab srid skyong rgyu phar zhogade lta bu'i gang zag de 'jig rten gyi phyogs la yang med/ de lta bu'i chos pas 'jig rten skyong thabs gtan nas mi ldan/ dper na mi la ras pas gal te chab srid cig skyong na de'i chab srid kyi lam lugs de ci 'dra zhig yin rgyu red/nga tshos bsam blo thongs dang go/ da lta 'dzam gling na nang chos dar ba'i rgyal khab dper na 'jar pan dang the'i go lta bu'i gtso 'dzin pa de dag gis nang chos la dad pa tsam yod bzhin 'jig rten srid lugs yang dag bsgrub na/ de la chos srid zung 'brel mi bya/ gang yin zer na srid kyi 'go gtso yin zhing 261

chos lugs kyi 'go gtso ma yin pa'i phyir/ chos la dad pa tsam gyis 'jig rten spong ga la dgos/ chos la dad pa yod pa tsam gyis 'jig rten 'phel rgyas mi gtong ba yang ma yin/ chos la dad pa yod pa tsam gyis dmag las mi spel ba yang ma yin/ de lta bu'i 'go gtso des 'jig rten gtso skyong byed cing chos lugs gtso skyong mi byed na de la chos srid zung 'brel mi bya zhing / chab srid gtso skyong byed pa'i gras la gtogs/ chab srid kyi bdag po zhig la chos lugs kyi dri bro rung 'jig rten yang dag cig gtso skyong gnang chog de bzhin du chos lugs pa zhig la 'jig rten gyi dri tsam bro rung chos lugs pa gtso skyong byed chog nang chos tshul bzhin nyams su blangs te spros med bya btang pas chos lugs gtso bor byas pa las 'jig rten ga la bsgrub/ nang chos la dad pa yod pa tsam gyis kyang chos lugs gtso skyong dang chos lugs pa'i 'go gtso byas pas khyab rgyu ma red srid kyi 'go gtso yang byed la 'jig rten gyi 'go gtso yang byed po zhig la chos srid zung 'brel zer/ de 'dra'i mi sna la srid phyed ka dang / 'jig rten phyed ka yod pa zhig yin pas lugs gnyis kyi bdag po zer/ ma gzhi 'jig rten gyi las don shugs cher song na chab srid pa dang /chos kyi las don shugs cher song na chos pa yin zer na chog snyam/ bdag 'dzin shugs cher song na bdag med rtogs pa'i blo nyams chung ba dang /bdag med rtogs pa'i blo shugs cher song na bdag 'dzin nyams pa chos nyid yin pa bzhin/ chos kyi blo shugs cher song na 'jig rten gyi blo shugs chung du song ba/ 'jig rten gyi blo shugs cher song na chos kyi blo shugs je cher 'gyur rgyu yin pa las/ chos dad tsam gyis chos pa yin pa dang / rtsam zan yin pa tsam gyis 'jig rten pa yin zhes kha tshon gcod mi thub/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi gtso skyong zer ba de gang zag des snying thag pa nas gang la 'bad brtson byas/ gang zhig 'bur du thon par byas gang zhig mngon par byas pa de la 262

de'i gtso skyong byed po zer dgos/ yang chos kyis chab srid la zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu dang / chab srid kyis chos la zhabs 'degs zhu ba ste rigs gnyis yod de/ dper na/ srong btsan sgam po dang khri srong lde btsan 'di dag gis chos chab srid kyi ram 'degs su bsgyur te/ rgyal khams rgya bskyed/ 'bangs mi'i bde 'jags/ skye dngos srung skyob bcas la dgos dbang gis dam pa'i chos las spyod sgo che ba dag lag bstar byas/ chos pa khag cig gis chab srid chos kyi ram 'degs su yong thabs byas te rang gi chos lugs kyi grub mtha'i che ba bla na bsgrengs/ chos srid kyi skor la 'di 'dra'i dbye zhib byed dgos kyi ril bo rdog rdog gcig tu 'dzin na go rgyu gang yang med snyam/ dper na/ chos la yang skyes bu chung ngu'i chos/ skyes bu 'bring gi chos/ skyes bu chen po'i chos zhes tshan pa re re la lam cha tshang re yod pa yin pas/ chos zhes pa'i tshig gcig gis ril bu lta bu rdog rdog cig go mi rung / de bzhin du chab srid ces pa de yang chab 'bangs te mnga' 'bangs skyong bar byed pa'i 'jig rten srid pa'i khrims kyi bya bzhag la zer ba yin pas chab srid kyang mi 'dra ba ches mang ste/ gna' rabs kyi chab srid dang / nye rabs kyi chab srid/ deng rabs kyi chab srid bcas dang / rgyal phyi nang gi tang so so'i chab srid bcas dbye sgo mang zhing ngo bo dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par che/ yang gang zag khag cig gis/ chab srid ni drag po g.yul gyi 'bras bu yin snang byed kyang / me skyogs kyi kha na srid dbang cha tshang ba dang / rgyun ring zhig thob rgyu ni ri bong rwa dang mtshungs te dper na/ 'dzam gling gi dgra 'khrugs dang po dang gnyis pas nga tsho la ra sprod byas pa ni/ pho rgod grangs med cig gis me sgrogs grangs med spyod de/ mi grangs de 'dra mang po zhig shi rmas byas kyang / mthar 'bras srid dbang thob rgyu phar zhog mi shi rgyu zad kyi gyong kha rag pas lo grangs mang por rang nyid nyams gso byed ma thub pa'i lo rgyus mngon sum du grub pa 'di ka 263

lags/ ngas blta na chab srid lam lugs thugs rje lcags kyu de dang /btsan po gnya' nas bkug pa'i drag rgol rdo rje'i thog mda' gnyis spyod na de las bzang ba zhig mi bdog snyam/ rang rigs kyi chos srid zung 'brel byas pas chos kyang ma 'grub/ chos ni chos su ma rung / srid ni srid du ma rung zer nas zhe 'gyod drag por byed cing chos srid tha dad/ chos bzang srid bzang ya rabs kyi las la 'bad yod na 'di 'dra'i rjes lus shig gang na thebs zhes sems pham pa ltar byed rung / chos srid zung 'brel ma byas pa'i mi rigs/sngon dus gzhan sde zil gyis gnon pa de dag kyang nyams rgud song ste nya las nyams chung / phag las mgo dma' tsam zhig chags 'dug pas/ de 'dra gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen nges can zhig ni los yod ma gtogs/ de dag gi dar rgud de chosasrid kyi gnad don yin tshad ma red/ der brten rang rigs kyi nyams rgud dang chos srid zung 'brel gnyis sbrel na 'grig min brtag pa'i gnas yin/ 'jig rten ma bsgrub na chos 'grub pas ma khyab pa dang / de bzhin du chos ma bsgrub na yang 'jig rten 'grub pas ma khyab pa'i dber brjod grangs las 'das pa yod pas shes par bya/ rang rigs kyi grub mtha'i gtso bor 'dzin pa de dag gis chos srid zung 'brel byas song zhes rags snang tsam dang /rags bshad tsam gyis kha tshon bcad rung / don du de dag gis chos 'bangs bskyangs ba las/ chab 'bangs bskyangs ba ma yin zhing / grub mtha' rtsod pa lasasrid dbang rtsod pa ma yin pa/ hril gyis dril na chos kyi bstan pa dam don byas shing / srid kyi bstan pa lhod la shor bas/ chab srid skyong po dngos ma zhig min zer na chog snyam/ rang rigs kyi chos srid bstan pa dar ba 'dis bzang ngan gyi shugs rkyen ga 'dra thebs yod bshad dka' ba ste/dper na/ deng sang mi rigs mang po zhig gi khyad chos dang rang gshis la 'gyur bar thebs te/ kha ba dkar po chu la 'gyur ba bzhin nyams rgud 'gro 264

dus 'dir/ rang rigs ni 'dzam gling chen po'i sgang na thun min gyi ngo bo dang rnam pas lhang nger 'gying ste/ rang zhig ma song bar srog gi ka ba 'di 'dra'i brtan po chags pa 'di gang gi bka' drin yin ngo shes dgos/ rang rigs kyi rgyal rabs sil bur 'thor te/ lung chung re la dpon chung re byas te/ dgun kha'i rtswa skya bzhin 'thor la khad de yang me tog gi chun po gcig dang 'dra ba las gtor brlag ma shor ba gcig tu zlum pa 'di yang chos dam tshig gi drin rang red/ spyir skyid la sdug pa'i 'jig rten mi yul 'dir mi rigs kyi 'du shes shugs che la rgyal khab kyi 'du shes shugs chung ba/ rgyal khab kyi 'du shes shugs che ba la/ mi rigs kyi 'du shes shugs chung ba/ mi rigs kyi 'du shes shugs chung la khyim tshang gi 'du shes shugs che ba/ khyim tshang gi 'du shes shugs chung la mi rigs kyi 'du shes shugs che ba sogs sna tshogs shig mchis/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi 'du shes shugs che la chos lugs kyi 'du shes shugs chung ba/ chos lugs kyi 'du shes shugs che la 'jig rten gyi 'du shes shugs chung ba sogs rgyu bsags lugs mi 'dra bas 'bras bu thob lugs mi 'dra ba la so sor skyes bo zer ba ltar 'bad lugs mi 'dra ba las thob lugs kyang mi 'dra ba zhig go /drug pa/ la rgya'i dgos pa dang dge mtshan brjod pa/la rgya zer ba 'di 'tsho chas la med du mi rung ba'i nyer spyod dang 'dra ba/kun la yod dgos pa/ yod na bzang gras su 'gro ba las ngan gras su mi 'gro ba yin/ la rgya zhes pa'i tshig 'bru gnyis po 'di ma ṇi bgrangs pa nang bzhin nyi ma re la grangs med cig kha 'don byed tshad red/ de bzhin du mtho rgyal po 265

nas dma' sprang po'i bar/ yang na che sa nas rgyal khab dang chung sa nas khyim tshang bar du/ la rgya mkho gal che zhing yod na des chog pa med na thabs chag pa lta bu'i rtsis mthong yod pa red/ la rgya can ni rlabs chen gyi mi sna'i gral du bzhag pa las/ ngan pa tha shal gyi gral du 'jog srol ni 'dzam gling 'di na mi dar/ dper na ri 'gog dmag 'khrug skabs kyi nga tsho rgyal nang gi dpa' bo stag gzig 'dra ba/ mes rgyal gyi don du lus srog phangs med du btang ba/zas gos gnas mal sogs 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen de tsam sdug na yang rang tshugs ma shor bar/ rang srog 'ben la btsugs te 'thab 'dzing gi gras su zhugs/dgra bos mdzes mos mig khrid dang / zhim pos kha khrid ji ltar byas rung yid yul la yang mi byed cing / khyi la rtswa byin pa ltar zhen log byed cing / rang rgyal gyi chos don du bsam gzhig byed cing / rang rgyal gyi dbu 'phang mtho bstod byed pa de dag byas rjes can dpa' bo'i gral du 'jog cing bstod bsngags kyi me tog sil mar 'thor ba 'di ka lags/ de bzhin du rang rigs kyis dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas btsan 'dzul la 'gog rgol byas pa'i snying stobs de dag kyang / rang rigs la sha zherne rus zhen yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ 'di'i don du sngon gshegs dpa' bo de dag kyang bstod bsngags kyi yul rang red/ la rgya'i shugs rkyen 'di 'dras che stabs kyis deng sang nga yang la rgya can kho yang la rgya can/ 'di yang la rgya can de yang la rgya can zhes la rgya can ni grangs med cig 'bud kyi yod/ rang rigs la cha mtshon na dge rgan yang la rgya can yin la slob ma yang la rgya can yin pa/ bla ma yang la rgya can yin la grwa ba yang la rgya can yin pa/ btsongs mkhan yang la rgya can yin la nyo mkhan yang la rgya can yin pa/ snang zhing srid pa'i 'jig rten 'di na la rgya can ni skar tshogs las kyang mang ba zhig 'dug 'on kyang la rgya zer ba de ci 'dra zhig yin bshad mi shes pa'am ngos 'dzin mi shes pa lkugs 266

pas bu ram gyi ro myong ba lta bu/ gla lpags mnyes ma ltar gang du yang 'then chog pa zhig e yin na/ deng gang zag khag cig a pha'i kha phor gtsang zhen byed mkhan dang / lung khug 'gol bor mi tshe bskyal ba/ kha ma ṇi dang mi bral/lag phreng ba dang mi bral ba dang / rang rigs kyi yul srol goms gshis la lha lugs su 'dzin pa/ jo mo glang ri nas mched pa'i lo rgyus dang / kha ba dkar po nas 'byung ba'i bsam gzhig/ a myes rma chen gyi zhwa mo tshun chad/ rnying zhen dang bag 'khums kyi rigs su bltas te/ srol lugs 'di dag gis tshan rig la gnod shugs thebs pa/ 'tsho gnas dpal 'byor la 'gog rkyen bzo ba/ mdor na sngon thon gyi bkag rdor 'dzin te/ srol lugs 'di dag bshig ste/ rang rigs 'di yang gzhan sde'i rgya mtsho dang gzhi gcig tu 'dres te/'tsho sdod gyi mthun rkyen da lta'i gnas bab las bzang tsam byed thub na dpa' bo dang mdzangs pa yin snang gis/ la rgya can gyi gral du brtsis/ da dung la rgya 'di ni don gyi la rgya yin zhing / la rgya 'di ni sha zhen rus zhen gyi la rgya/bsod nams dbang thang gi la rgya/ bkra shis g.yang khug gi la rgya yin zhes srid pa'i rtse mo nas mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga ro bsgrags pa'o/ la rgya 'di ni 'tsho gnas kyi mthun rkyen legs tsam byung na rang tshugs ji ltar shor rung 'dzem pa dang sems pham gang yang med pa'i ra rgya de red/ ma gzhi la rgya'i go don ni rang phyogs kyi sha zhen la zer ba dang / la rgya 'di la chos lugs pa'i la rgya dang / 'jig rten pa'i la rgya/ rgyal khab kyi la rgya/ mi rigs kyi la rgya/khyim tshang gi la rgya/ bla ma'i la rgya/ grwa ba'i la rgya zer ba sogs dbye ba'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/ rgyal khab la rgyal khab kyi la rgya dang / mi rigs la mi rigs kyi la rgya/ bla ma la bla ma'i la rgya yod pa yin pas rgyal khab kyi grub tshul dang / mi rigs kyi grub tshul/ bla ma'i grub tshul mi 'dra bas rang tshugs bzung lugs kyang mi 'dra/ de la ltos pa'i la rgya yang mi 'dra/ der 267

brten bla ma'i la rgya bzung dus bla ma'i rang tshugs ma shor ba zhig dgos pa bzhin du/ mi rigs kyi la rgya bzung dus kyang mi rigs kyi rang tshugs ma shor ba zhig dgos/ gal te bla ma'i la rgya bzung ni yin zer nas bla ma'i rang tshugs btang ste 'jig rten pa dkyus ma ste skya sa ru bab ste ci dgar longs su spyod du yod pa dang / gzhan gyi gong du bkur rgyu zhig byung rung bla ma'i la rgya 'dzin pa ga na yin/ de bzhin du rgyal khab kyi la rgya 'dzin dus kyang rgyal khab kyi khyad chos ma shor ba zhig dgos pa shugs kyis grub/ rgyal khab kyi tshe srog la nyams rgud thebs pa'i bya ba spel nas/ rang nyid la khe phan bgrang las 'das pa zhig thob rung la rgya 'dzin pa ga na yin/ der brten bla ma'i la rgya zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i bstan pa dang / bla ma'i khyad chos/ bla ma'i las su bya ba bcas 'phel rgyas btang ste/ bla ma ci bzang bzang zhig tu 'gyur bar byas na la rgya yin snyam/ de bzhin khyim tshang la rgya yang khyim tshang de je dar dang je rgyas gtong dgos kyi/ la rgya 'dzin ni yin zer nas khyim tshang kha 'thor du btang ste/ khyim mi la 'tsho gnas kyi mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa zhig bsgrub na yang khyim tshang gi la rgya 'dzin pa e yin na/ yang gang zag khag cig gis/rang rigs kyi 'jig rten chung ngu 'di sngon thon gyi gral du tshud thabs byed dgos/ sngon thon gyi go sar 'dzegs dgos na gsar brje'i bya ba bsgrub dgos/ gsar brje zer ba de rig gnas rnying pa dor te/ rig gnas gsar pa dang du len par 'dod do zhes lha klu gnyan gsum dang yul lha gzhi bdagayul srol goms gshis bcas kyi bag chags rtsa ba nas brlag dgos zhes skul 'ded rgya che gnang 'dug las ka 'di gsar brje'i sngon thon gyi bya ba yin na/de'i bag chags ni sngon ma nas bcom zin pas/ 'dir bcom pa'i don du dka' las byed mi dgos te/ lha ri klu ri gnyan ri dang / lha shing klu shing gnyan shing dang bcas pa gos hrul nyi mar bsgrad pa ltar yar slog mar slog 268

yaragacod mar gcod byas te 'tsho gnas la phan pa'i bya ba sgrub bzhin yod pas shes gsal ltar lags/ lung khug 'gol bo dag na slog ma thub pa khe ru 'dra lus e yod na/ 'tsho gnas la re ba'i 'jig rten pas shes rig dpal 'byor dang / lag rtsal dpal 'byor la 'bad brtson bgyis pa'i stobs shugs de tsam med rung / lha ri gtor zhing lha shing gcod pa'i dpal 'byor la/ 'bad brtson tshod las brgal nas da lta tshod 'dzin byed dgos pa'i dus su slebs yod/ de bzhin du yul lha gzhi bdag gi sgo phyugs su 'dod pa'i ri dwags shwa rna dgo gsum dang gcan gzan stag gzig dom dred bcas pa lha'i sgo phyugs 'dzin pa'i bag chags ni sngar sa nas med de/ srog chags de dag ming gi lhag ma tsam du gyur la/ da dung yang gsod gcod rmas gsum byas 'dug pas rang rigs sngon thon gyi gral du sle/bas pa la phan ci tsam thogs yod/ma gzhi gsar brje zer ba de sdug po zhig ci la yin/ rang rigs kyi gnya' khri btsan po dang / srong btsan sgam po/ khri sro nga lde btsan 'di dag kyang gsar brje ba yin zhing / de dag gis gsar brje lag bstar ji ltar byas rung la rgya gtor brlag shor med/ gal te gsar baji dang la rgya gnyis rgyab 'gal du 'dod de/ gsar brje 'dis la rgya gtor gyi red snyam na/ de ni min te/ la rgya gtor byed kyi gsar brje de ni gsar brje yang dag cig min/ de bzhin du rang rgyal gyi rlabs chen gtso 'dzin de dag gis kyang la rgya gtor ma dgos bzhin du gsar brje phul byung zhig lag bstar byas/ gsar brje de yang yul gyi chos nyid dang mthun par byed dgos pa las/ gsar brje log pa zhig lag bstar byas na ga la 'grig rang rgyal gyi mi bzhi phyogs khag gis gsar brje byed stangs ma 'grig pa red ces deng gi bar du gsal bsgrags byas te/ rig gnas gsar brje ni g.yo thal che bas yo bsrang byed thabs kyi srid jus spel zhing / lag len bstar nas grub 'bras thon pa 'di ga lags/ yang la rgya 269

bzung ni yin zer nas bya dngos gang yang rang sor gnas pa las mtho gang 'dzub gang 'gyur ba 'gro mi rung bar 'dod pa ni glen pa'i las su shes dgos/ngas gong zhus ltar rgyal khab kyi la rgya la cha mtshon na/ rgyal khab kyi rang tshugs mi shor ba/ rgyal khab kyi sha zhen mi gtong ba/ rgyal khab phun sum je tshogs gtong ba/ rgyal khab sra brtan yong bar byed pa/ rgyal khab kyi sku tshe brtan thabs la dmigs nas 'gyur ba ji ltar gtong rung / gsar brje ji ltar byed rung / rgyal khab kyi la rgya 'dzin pa yin gyi gtor ba ga na yin/ de bzhin du mi rigs dang khyim tshang gi la rgyas mi rigs dang khyim tshang gi ram 'degs su yong dgos/ gsar brje dang la rgya gnyis phan tshun 'gog rkyen thebs mi rung zhing gcig grogs gcig yong pa zhig byed na bzang snyam/ nga tsho 'gro ba mi yin pa'i ngos nas mtho rim gyi srog chags shig yin/ mtho rim srog chags la dma' rim srog chags/ dud 'gro lta bu dang mi 'dra ba'i don snying nges can zhig yod dgos za 'thung tsam ni dma' rim dud 'gros kyang rnyed kyi yod pas/nga tsho mtho rim srog chags te/ 'gro ba mi yin stabs zas gos gnas mal gyi 'dod yon la mgo 'khor nas bsdad rgyu ga la yod/ nga tshos 'du shes dang phugs bsam/ gsal rig bcas ni srog chags gzhan la med pa'i rin thang ches ldan pa'i dngos po zhig yin pa yang kun gyis shes/ rin thang de ldan gyi mi lus 'di bed ma chod na 'di las phangs pa dang / 'di las gyong che ba gang na yod/ mtho rim srog chags la dma' rim srog chags las lhag pa'i bsam gzhigs dang / re 'dun/ las ka/ dmigs yul bcas gang mang zhig yod/mgo bo sgur ste rtsa chu gang bzang la spyod pa/ gzhan gyis ji ltar bkol rung ci mi snyam pa/ gshed mas lag gi gshed gri ske la bzhag rung zhum zhum du bsdad pa/ tshe srog hril bos gzhan phan las la brtson kyang ngo so med pa/ tshig rtsub char ba 'bebs rung sdang mig tsam yang byed mi nus pa'i rtags mtshon 'di 270

dma' rim srog chags te/ dud 'gro phyugs kyi khyad chos red/ de ltar na nga tsho 'gro ba mi yin stabs kyis/ 'jig rten gyi dpe la/ sa la ri thang dpyis gsum/ mi la mgo sko phrag gsum zer ba ltar/ phyi yi bde skyid tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin nas yid smon 'chor ba'i lhag bsam dang / 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i yon tan/ rang tshugs zin pa'i la rgya/ bla med kyi phugs bsam bcas la 'bad par bya/ yang la rgya 'dzin tshul gyi sa tshod de yang mda' la 'phen tshad gtong tshad zer ba bzhin nges dgos pa zhig yin gyi/ grub mtha'i la rgya 'dzin ni yin zer nas rang phyogs gser la bsgom zhing / gzhan phyogs ra gan du bltas te/ sha rus gcig pa'i mi rigs sil bur gtor ba dang / sa khul gyi la rgya 'dzin ni yin zer nas rtsa spar mo gang dang sa lag mthil tsam gyi don du dme shi khrag gi 'khor lo bskor te/ mi rigs grangs nyung zhig je nyung gtong ba/ gser khri go sa'i la rgya 'dzin ni yin zer nas dgon sde dum bur gtor te/ bla grwa mang po grong 'khyar byas pas dad ldan zhen kha log pa/ 'di dag ni la rgya 'dzin tshul nor ba yin pas gzab par bya/ de bzhin du la rgya 'di la log pa'i la rgya/ phyogs lhung gi la rgya/ don gyi la rgya/ rnam pa'i la rgya sogs kyi dbye sgo mang / mkhas pa dung dkar pas kyang / la rgya zer ba de rgyal khab kyi la rgya dang mi rigs kyi la rgya ma shor bar byed pa ni dga' zhen yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rang nyid kyi legs po'i dge mtshan ji yod gong du spel nas rjes lus kyi yul srol goms gshis sogs spong thabs byas pa de la la rgya ma shor ba zer chog cing / dga' zhen yod na de'i don du gtam don bzang po ma shor ba byed pa'i la rgya rang shugs kyis 'ong ba yin zhes gsungs pa ltar ci bzang gang bzang byed pa las ci sdug gang sdug byed mi rung zhing / la rgya ma shor ba zer ba 'dis rang tshugs zin dgos pa las blun po chu sna gar khrid byas pas la rgya mi zin par bstan/271

bdun pa/ 'cho sdod kyi don du thon las lag rtsal la 'bad dgos tshul brjod pa/de yang dbu ma 'jug pa las/ mi rnams bde ba'ang longs spyod med min la/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ mi yi bde ba 'di longs spyod med na mi 'byung zhing / longs spyod med na mi 'byung gi 'brel ba yod pa'i tshul gsungs/'tsho sdod dang nga tsho bar sha rus ltar thad kar 'brel ba yod pas/ 'tsho sdod la mi 'bad khag med yin stabs/ srogs chags shig yin nas bzung 'di la rdo rus 'phrad dgos pa zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan des 'tsho sdod kyi don du skar ma zhwa byas/ ba mo lham byas/ gdong sha mi la byin/ nya sha khyi la byin zhes pa'i dka' sdug de myong ba yin/ de bzhin du 'gag 'phrang gi jag pa/ la kha'i rkun ma/ lung khugs kyi mgo skor mkhan 'di dag kyang 'tsho sdod kyis dbang med bdas pa yin gyi lus dang srog la'ang nyen kha yod pa'i las rigs de dag la su yang 'jug snying mi bro/ rgya gar gyi rigs bzhi'i tha ma gdol rigs ni/dmangs rigs te dman pa mgar ba dang / bshan pa/ rngon pa/ nya ba/thags mkhan/ chom po sogs yin la de dag kyang 'tsho sdod kyi don du de'i las la 'jug pa red/ da lta'i dus rabs 'di yar thon gyi dus rabs/bsam spyod kyi bzang tshad kyang legs tsam yod pa/ phyogs gang nas bsam gzhig byas kyang mi'i spus ka'ang dga' ru phyin pa/ de ltar na'ang dug dang me mda'i nyo tshong dang / tha na sha rus gcig pa'i mi'i nyo tshong byed pa sogs ni/yang na longs spyod rgyas pa'i don dang / yang na 'tsho sdod kyi don yin pa yang kun gyis shes/ de ltar na pad ma la bung ba 'khor ba bzhin nga tshos 'tsho sdod 272

kyi mthun rkyen la bsam blo ma gtong rang gtong yin/ 'tsho sdod ni kun gyi 'gag rtsa ste/ chos dang 'jig rten kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ thar pa chen po'i mdo las/ zas ma mchis na srog ma mchis/ srog ma mchis na lus ma mchis/lus ma mchis na chos kyang ma mchis zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang 'tsho ba'i zas la ma brten gang yang med gsungs pa sogs 'tsho sdod gal che ba'i tshul mang tsam gsungs/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis kyang / lus kyi tho yor zas dang skom la btags/ zas dang skom ni phyi rol rkyen la btags gsungs pa 'dis kyang zas skom gyi 'tsho ba dang kha 'bral thabs med par bstan/mdor na 'jig rten 'di ni 'tsho sdod nas 'go brtsams te bya byed dang /bcas bcos/ spros pa'i rnyog 'dzing me ltar 'bar/ chu ltar 'khol bar byas/cha med yul nas thon pa'i rgyus med kyi mi dag kyang gzhi gcig tu 'dres par byed pa/ gzhi gcig tu 'dres pa'i mi sna dgra ru log ste mthong na mi dga' ba'i tshad la phyin pa yang 'tsho gnas kyi don las byung / mi rnams phal che ba phyug po'i bu la dga' zhes bshad srol yod pa 'dis kyang / phyug po'i bu'i rnyed pa la dga' ba'i skad cha red/ sngon dus dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis rtsed mo'i tshul du/ rgyu yod de la thar ba yod/ rgyu med de la thar pa med ces gsungs pa nas deng / sgor mo yod na sa dang lam yang bzang / sgor mo med na sa dang lam yang ngan zhes kha mtshar ku re'i tshig 'di dag la yang lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs nges can zhig yod pa yin da dung rgyu yod na a khu'i tsha bo yin/ rgyu med na a khu'i g.yog po yin zer ba 'dis kyang rgyu nor gyi rin thang mtshon yod/ khyad par du rgyu sna khung nang gi spu 'jag 'then bzhag na mig gi mchu ma shor zhes pa de ni dngos yod 'jig rten gyis rgyu nor la brkam chags kyis sems gshis mtshon pa'i skad cha red/ 'tsho sdod kyi phyir du nor rdzas la chags sred che ba ni glang po tshwa chu dang 'phrad pa bzhin no/ 'tsho sdod la rem pa'i 273

'jig rten 'dis/ 'tsho ba'i thon skyed la mthong chung byed pa ma lags shing /'tsho sdod lus srog gi don yin pa/ ma bshad rung shes pa/ 'tsho ba'i thon skyed la dung zhen dang / rtsis mthong byed shes rung / thon skyed lag rtsal ma shes pa'am/ shes rung rnam g.yeng che bas gyong rag pa red/ deng chos pa khag cig la rgyu nor gyi rnyed pa mang po byung ba 'di/ chos pa ri la sdod na zas log ri la 'gril zer ba ltar/ rnyed pa la ma 'bad rang 'khor lta bu zhig gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus su bshad du yod pa de dang mi 'dra zhing / deng rgyu nor gang la thug na chos pa der mang ba zhig snang gi 'dug chos pas rnyed pa btsal ba dang / rnyed pas chos pa btsal ba gnyis gtan nas mi 'dra/ rnyed pas chos pa btsal ba 'di ni dam pa'i lugs su snang zhing / rnyed pa las dbang gis rang la 'byor ba yin pas/ za rgyu khro yi ril bu de/ za byed lcags kyi 'gram pa yod pa'i rtags red/ rnyed pa'i rjes su chos pa 'brangs na chos pa'i rang tshugs e zin na/ gang ltar rnyed pas chos pa btsal ba'am chos pas rnyed pa btsal ba gang zhig yin rung / chos pa la rgyu nor gyi rnyed pa byung ba 'di yon bdag gi dka' tshegs rgyun mar bsags pa/ dbyar tsha drod/ dgun grang rlung gang la'ang mi skrag cing / sha dang rus pas las la bsgrims te rngul chus bsags pa'i 'bras bu de rang red/ de ltar na yang nga tsho'i chos lugs pas rnyed pa thob pa la mi dga' rgyu ci yod/ bde ba'i phyogs su bang 'gran pa'i 'jig rten 'dir gang ltar yang 'byor ldan ni dpa' bo'i gral du 'jog cing / 'byor ldan gyi 'jig rten ni mtsho sdod la sems khral tsam yang mi dgos shing blo bde gu yang gis sdod chod pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang nga tsho chos lugs pa 'di/ 'tsho lugs yon bdag kho na la re sgug byed dgos na skyo bo zhig red/ yon bdag gi ngo 'dzum dkar nag la bltas pa las/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyis 'bad de thon bskyed kyi bya ba bsgrub na de las bzang ci 274

yod/ nga tsho chos lugs pas kyang rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas (dza༈r+hatshi'iṭha)la bsgrims na mi 'grig rgyu ci yod/ nga tsho'i bde skyid de mi rabs rjes ma'i thob skal las blangs te spyad na de la rgyun mthud 'phel rgyas zer gyi ma red/ nga tshos mi rabs rjes ma'i bde skyid kyi bgo skal de 'phrog nas/ gter slog nags gcod/ ri dwags gcan gzan rngon byed pa/ khor yug 'bag btsog byed pa'i bzo grwa btsugs pa 'di dag ni ma 'ongs ba'i lo rgyus la sems khur med pa'i rtags yin/ nga tsho chos lugs pas rang ngos nas shes rig dpal 'byor dang lag rtsal dpal 'byor mi thon 'ing slong mo la brten nas byung ba'i rnyed pas bzhengs pa'i gser gyi mchod rten zhig yin rung / rin thang de tsam ste/ rang nyid kyis bsags pa'i rten bzhengs ma yin pa'i phyir/ chos lugs pas 'byor phyug ldan pa'i sa khul nas rnyed pa mang bo thob ste dbul bo'i sa khul du 'tsho ba'i ram 'degs byed pa 'di/ 'byor ldan gyi dpal 'byor de 'byor med sa khul du spyod pas 'tsho ba cha snyoms byed pa la phan thogs na ma gtogs/ rang nyid kyi thon las ma yin pa ni kun gyis shes/ de ltar na chos lugs pa khag cig gis phyogs gnyis mthud sbrel gyi zam pa'i nus pa thon gyi yod/ spyir shes rig lag rtsal la brten nas thon las kyi bya ba bsgrub na/dbugs len srog gcod kyi bya ba bsgrub mi dgos bzhin thon las 'phel rgyas gtong thabs yod de/ yul skor dang 'brel ba ste/ yul skor sne khrid/ yul skor thon rdzas bzos pa/ yul skor 'dzugs skrun/ yul skor rig gnas sogs dang / bzo rig dang 'brel ba ste/ lha ris dang / shing tshon ri mo 'bri ba/ sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa/ gon pa bzo drub/ gser dngul zangs lcags kyis lha dang nyer spyod rigs mgar ba/ gso rigs dang 'brel ba ste/ sman pa'i lag rtsal shes pa/ sman gyi sdeb sbyor la mkhas pa/ sman tshong ra la 'dren pa sogs lag shes skar tshogs las mang tsam 'dug pa la/ de 275

las gdam ka byas te dpal 'byor la 'bad na rgyun ring ba/ zad med gter lta bu/ 'phel bskyed che ba/ ljon shing dang 'dra ba/ rang nyid thon skyed lag rtsal yin pas rin thang che ba/ rang nyid kyi ched las yin pas gzhan la ngo gnong mi dgos pa sogs kyi dge mtshan yod/ ngas mtshams 'di nas 'jar pan gyi lo rgyus shig bshad na/ 'jar pan ni rang byung thon khungs ches nyung ba'i rgyal khab gcig yin/ da dung ngal rtsol gyi nus pas kyang mi 'dang ba/de 'dra'i gnas tshul 'og 'jar pan dpal 'byor gyi rgyal khab tu gyur rkyen ni/gtso bo shes rig lag rtsal gyi nus pas dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba red/de ltar na 'jar pan gyis ma rtsa'i rgyu cha kun po gzhan las 'dren te/ rang gi lag rtsal spyod de thon rdzas su bsgyur nas/ gzhan gyi tshong ra la 'dren dus ma rtsa'i rin gong dang ngal rtsol gyi rin thang sdom 'bor las ldab mang po 'phar ba'i gong khug pa/ de ltar na shes rig dpal 'byor gyis 'jar pan 'byor ldan du gyur ba red/ shes rig gi zhing khams gang na yod na 'byor ba des rgyas pa 'di yang chos nyid cig red/ shes rig dpal 'byor gyi khyad chos ni/thon khungs chud zos su mi shor ba/ thon khungs gron sri byed thub pa/ 'bag btsog med pa/ thon rdzas kyi tshad mtho ba sogs kyi dge mtshan yod/ chos lugs pa la 'tsho sdod kyi mthun rkyen bsod snyoms rgya chen po thob pa 'di/'tsho sdod la phan pa yod nges pa lags/ nga tsho dga' 'os pa yin na yang /rang gi lag pas rnyed pa 'tshol ba'i shes rig dpal 'byor dang bsdur na bsod snyoms kyi dpal 'byor 'di la mtha' ci tsam yod phal che tshod dpog thub kyi red/ nga tsho'i dpal 'byor mkho skrun byed pa'i shes rig de/ spyi tshogs la dgos mkho yod la/ mi rabs nas mi rabs rnams su bed chod pa zhig yin na de las bzang ci yod/276

brgyad pa/ rang rigs kyi rgyu nor thad kar brjod pa/spyir tshad ma rnams su rgyu 'bras rnam gzhag 'jog skabs/ rgyu'i mtshan nyid la phan 'dogs byed 'jog pa bzhin/ rang rigs kyi 'jig rten pas kyang / rgyu nor gyi rgyu yi mtshan nyid la phan 'dogs byed ni rgyu yi mtshan nyid ces bshad/ de ltar na rgyu zhes pa de phan 'dogs byed cig yin dgos/tshad ma'i skabs kyi phan 'dogs byed zer ba de ni/ skad cig sngar mas skad cig phyi ma bskyed pa la phan 'dogs pas rgyu zhes pa dang / yul gang zhig gis dmigs rkyen byed pa tsam gyis kyang rgyu zhes 'jog pa de dang mi 'dra zhing /ngas 'di nas bshad pa'i rgyu de ni rags snang gi phan 'dogs byed de/ dngos po 'dis nga la phan thogs ma thogs zhes sbom snang gi tshul de 'jog rang rigs kyi rgyu nor nang du/ gser dngul g.yu gsum gzi byur spos gsum sogs rin chen rigs dang / dar ras phrug gsum/ stag shan gzig shan sram shan gsum dang / wa tshar g.yu tshar lug tshar sogs gon pa rtsa chen rigs sogs nom pa che ba shin tu mang / mtho sgang kha ba ri ba'i 'jig rten 'di cha snyoms kyis grang ngar cung che ba/ drod tshad dma' tsam yod pas pags pa tsha ru'i rigs kyis gon pa byed na grang 'khyag 'gog pa/ gzugs por phan pa che ba / nad mi bskyed pa sogs kyi dge mtshan yod nges red/ bdag cag gi ston pas 'dul ba'i nang du ko lpags kyi gzhi 'chad skabs kyang / yul dbus su gnam mal skyob phyir ko lpags kyi lhag tsam dang gtsug lag khang las gzhan pa'i khyim du stan gzhan med na/ ko lpags kyi stan la 'dug pa tsam gnang gi nyal bar ma gnang / mtha' khob tu grang ba skyob pa'i phyir lham dang mal stan gnyis kar brten par gnang zhing / shin tu grang ba che sar gos 277

sogs ci dgar brten du rung bas dmigs gsal can/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang rigs kha ba ri bas ko lpags la brten du rung ba zhig yin nges te/bdag cag gi 'tsho gnas grang rlung gi khrod du lus yod stabs ko lpags la brten chog pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang de 'dra'i gnang ba sbyin pa 'di ka lags pas blo bde ste spyod chog rdo yi rigs rin po che 'di dag 'dzam gling spyi 'gros kyis rgyan cha byed kyi 'dug pa ma zad rin chen rigs de lus la 'dogs na/ nad med bde thang byed pa/ tshe ring lo brgya thub pa/gzugs mdzes la gzhon sha chags pa/ rgas ka sra la gdon gyis mi tshugs pa'i dge mtshan yod par bshad/ de ltar rin chen rigs rgyan cha byed pa ni bod gcig pu ma yin pa kun gyis shes/ 'on kyang dngul sgor yod tshad rin chen rigs la gtong ba 'di rang rigs kho nas 'gro lugs shig tu snang / skra la 'dzer rgyu mgul la btags rgyu lus la 'phyang rgyu sogs de 'dra mang po zhig gi don du sgor mo mang ba zhig gtong gi yod/ de bzhin du mtha' shan can gyi gon pa 'di yang / 'dzam gling spyi la dar ba'i gon pa rtsa chen te/ wa lpags dang g.yu lpags sram lpags sogs kyis mtha' shan byed pa'i gon pa mang /spyir rang rigs kyi 'jig rten 'di gna' snga mor bon yang dag gi bstan pa dar zhing / rang rigs ni gzhan rigs dang mi 'dra ba'i stag gzig lpags pa la de 'dra'i rtsis su 'dzin pa 'di ni/ don med kyi las zhig bsags 'dug snyam/ ma rtsa'i sgor mo phran bu yod pa des stag gzig lpags pa chen po re nyos te/ blo bde ste sdod na yar bskyed gang yang thon rgyu med/ bon gyi cho ga rnam dag lag bstar byed dus te/ rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis skabs dang / de rjes rgyal rabs rim byon gyis rgyal po glang dar ma yan la/ dmag las la dga' zhing / drag tsub cung che ba'i mi rigs shig yin pa yang lo rgyus dag na gsal/ de dus kyi dmag mi'i lugs srol mang shos shig rjes su rgyan cha dang 278

chos kyi lugs srol du 'gyur ba yin pa/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsungs/ dper na/ da lta lha 'khyam dus ru 'dren sde bzhi zhes pa 'di/sngon dus dmag gi ru 'dren pa yin pa/ da lta'i ma ṇi sogs kyi jo dar 'di sngon dus dmag gi ru dar yin pa/ gdong dmar zhes pa 'di yang sngon dus bod dmag g.yul la chas dus gdong dmar po byed srol yod pa/ de bzhin du g.yul 'gyed skabs kyi dpa' bo rnamaru/ la stag gzig lpags pa/ sdar ma rnams la wa lpags sbyin srol yod pa 'di yang / da lta rgyan cha ru 'gyur ba 'di ka lags/ ngas gong zhus kyi phal ba'i snang ngo'i phan 'dogs pa rgyu yi mtshan nyid 'jog pa 'di ltar/ rang rigs kyi rgyu nor rtsis che ba 'di dag gis/don du phan ci tsam thogs pa nga tshos bsam gzhig cig byed na/ rin chen gyi rigs dang stag gzig lpags pa'i shan gos can 'di dag nyar tshags dka' ba/ dus tshod re 'ga' tsam las phyir phud pa'i go skabs nyung la/ sgor mo yod tshad gtong ba 'di gzhan gang gi lugs la'ang mi snang / bed spyod kyi go skabs nyung la lcags kyi sgam rnams su btsud rgyu'i dus tshod mang / de ltar na nga tsho'i rgyu nor 'di dag phar g.yog rgyu las tshur bed chod rgyu ci tsam 'dugarang rigs ni zhor las dang / tshong las/ zhing las/ 'brog las kyi rnyed pa'i sgor mo de dag rin po che'i rigs dang stag gzig lpags pa'i thog tu brgyag rgyu mang / rgyu nor de dag gis khe bskyed gang yang mi thon zhing / da lo la stag gzig lpags pa/ sang lo la yang byu ru dang spos shel/ rgyu nor 'di 'dras khyim du nyal na ma rtsa'i sgor mo nyal tshar ba red/ ma rtsa'i sgor mo nyal bas khe skyed gang yang mi thon/ de ltar na rgyu nor 'di dag gis phan ci tsam thogs bsam gzhig byos dang go/ gal te ma rtsa'i sgor mo de shes rig gi phyogs te/ mi shes rig can gso skyong byed par btang nas/ mi spus tshad mtho ba/ 'jon thang yod pa/ bsam blo'i 'phrul tsha ba zhig byung na/ ma rtsa'i 279

sgor mo ldab log dang ldab log 'phar ba rnyed rgyu gdon mi za/ rgyu bzo mkhan mi yin zhes pa lta bu/ da lta 'dzam gling spyi 'gros kyi lo rgyus chu rgyun ring mo las thob pa'i sdom ni/ mi ni rtsa ba yin zhes pa de red/ 'dzam gling dgra 'khrugs gnyis pa'i rjes su 'jar man g.yul las pham pa dang / a mi ri kha dang u ru su'u gnyis kyis 'jar man gyi rgyal khab bgo bsha' byed skabs/ ca lag dang /'phrul cha rnying pa dag u ru su'u yis bdag por byas/ a mi ri khas shes yon can gyi mi sna de dag bdag por byas pas/ mtha' 'bras su che nga tshos mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ de ltar na rang rigs kyis ma rtsa'i sgor mo yod pa 'di dag mi gso skyong byed pa'i phyogs su btang ste/ mi yi ma rtsa btsugs na/gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa zhig byed thub/ mi la spus ka yod na ri lung stong ba rnams su/ kha zas dang / rgyab gos dang 'phrad thabs thon gyi red/ mi'i spus ka zhan na 'byor ba'i grong khyer du yod kyang yi dwags bzhin sdod mkhan yod/ ma gzhi rang rigs ni snying rje'i rang gzugs spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing / byang chub sems bskyed kyis rgyud brlan pa'i ya rabs kyi rigs su gtogs la/ pha sprel rgan spyan ras gzigs dang / ma brag srin rje btsun sgrol ma gnyis las mched pa yin pas/ zhi 'jam lhod dal 'dzoms pa'i mi rigs zhes rgyal phyi nang du grags pa zhig gis/ stag gzig lpags pa'i mtha' shan ci che gang che re btags te/ gzhan la ngoms na nga tsho kha don rgyab 'gal gyi las bsags pas ngo gnong dgos pa zhig tu gyur/ rnam pa 'di snang ba tsam gyis drag tsub kyi 'gyur ba mtshon pa las/ yon tan dang rgyan du snang gi mi 'dug stag gzig lpags pa brgya las yon tan sna gcig gis dga' ba'i dus rabs 'dir/ nga tshos shes rig gi zhing khams shig gsar bskrun byas te/ 'gro la phan pa'i 'dod rgu char ltar 'beb rgyu byung na de las spro 'os pa zhig ci yod/ yang rang rigs kyi mi khag cig gis/ phan 280

'dogs pa rgyu yi mtshan nyid ces/ phan 'dogs byed kyi rgyu nor dgos skad kyis stag gzig lpags pa sogs snang med du bskyur te/ dgos med mthong ste mi nyo zhing / gzi byur spos gsum la yang dga' ba med par/ phan 'dogs byed ni rlangs 'khor red ces/ rlangs 'khor re la phyugs zog brgya so dang /rta lug mang po sprad de nyos pa dang / 'phru'/ cha la rgyus mnga' med pa/ pho rgod lag rgod kyis rlangs 'khor bskor bas/ rlangs 'khor chag krum shor ba/mthar rlangs 'khor nyams bcos byas ma thub pas mgo rkang so sor 'thor te/mgo sgam yas na 'phangs/ mjug sgam mas na lus te lcags phye dum bu mang bo zhig tu gyur ba ma zad/ phyi la sgo phyugs med pa/ nang na mar chur med pa/stong seng nge sdod dgos byung ba 'di/ skyo bo zhig snang gi 'dug de bzhin du rlangs 'khor skor ba'i byang cha tshad ldan med pa khag cig gis rlangs 'khor bskor nas/ g.yang 'gril gad lhung dang / rlangs 'khor chag cing / kha lo pa shi rmas shor ba/ rkang lag chag hrug byed pa grangs mang / da lta ya an then chan gyi rus pa chag skyon gso ba'i sman khang du song dang / rang rigs kyis rlangs 'khor sogs 'phrul cha'i rigs bed spyod byas pa'i 'bras bu mthong rgyu yod/ 'di 'dra'i rigs de ma gzab na mi shi rgyu zad kyi gyong tshabs chen rag gi yod/ yang rang rigs kyi pho gsar khag cig gis/ kha la za rgyu med rung /zhabs la chibs rgyu dgos zhes/ sbag sbag nyos te/ rlung long pa nang bzhin gyis yar rgyug mar rgyug gis dus 'da' bas snying po gang yang med/ tha na sbag sbag skor byed sa snum nyo rkyen med pa dang / khyim gyi sgam khri sa khri yis byas pa'i thabs skyo bo de dag gis 'bru rigs btsongs nas sa snum nyos te/ sbag sbag skor gyi yod pa 'di yang / mi yi spus tshad ches dma' ba'i rtags dang ma bstan pa lags/ yang rang rigs kyis rgyu nor gsog 'jog gi gras la/ bed spyod yod med ci rigs dang / bed chod min sna tshogs shig 'dug nga tsho 281
