bod 'di bdag 'dzin che rigs su snang ste/ dper na/ rdo 'jam po zhig yin na nyar tshags byed pa/ tha gu thung thung zhig la'ang nor rdzas brtsi ba/mdor na sgam chag rnying pa/ lo rabs du ma'i sngon gyi ca lag bed mi chod pa dag gis khang khyim gang bar byas/ da dung de la zhen chags byed cing / phyir bor mi bra nas khyim phug tu 'jog phyug sprang su zhig gis kyang bed mi chod pa'i dngos po ci zhig yin rung zhen chags kyis gsog 'jog byed pa 'di/ byi bas snyigs ma sna tshogs bsdu rug byed pa dang 'dra/ nga tsho gsog 'jog gi goms gshis chags pa'i phyug po 'di dag gis/ rgyu nor nang du bzhag ste/za mi bra zhing / gon mi bra/ longs su spyod ma phod cing / sbyin ma bra ba rgyu nor gyi srung ma byed pa 'di ni yi dwags gter srung gi tshul ltar du snang / der brten rgyu nor gyis bed chod pa'am yang na khe bskyed thon par byas te/ 'byor ldan gyi 'jig rten te dpal yon gnyis kyis phyug pa zhig byed dgos/dgu pa/ rang rigs kyi mo dang ju thig skor bshad pa/de yang 'jig rten 'dir mi rigs gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos gyi phyag len/ bod kyi mo dang ju thig skor gleng bar bya ste/ mo dang ju thig gi bstan pa 'di ni bon las dar zhing / ya thog gdod ma'i bon gyi dus su byung ba zhig yin pa yongs la grags/ ju thig gi skor la/ mkhas dbang dung dkar gyis 'di ltar gsungs te/ ju thig gi ju thig la brten nas mo 'debs spyad kyi mo chas sna tshogs la go dgos pa zhig dang / ju thig la brten nas mo 'debs pa'i 'bras bshad kyi mo gzhung la go dgos pa zhig bcas yod/ dper na bya drug la brten nas mo 'debs pa'i yo byad phreng rdog drug yod pa de las/phreng rdog khra bos skya ka dang / sngo sangs kyis phug ron/ ljang khus ni tso/ nag 282

pos pho rog dkar pos khrung khrung / ser pos ngang pa mtshon pa yin zer ba'i phreng rdog lcags skud thog brgyus pa zhig dang / de'i mo gzhung bcas kyang mthong myong ba de ju thig gi gras shig yin tshad 'dug sba bzhed nang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po sang shis dang sba gsal snang gnyis thang gi gong mar 'tshams 'dri zhu bar btang skabs gong ma'i mdun du ju zhag la brten nas mo 'debs grwa pa de 'dra yod lugs bshad 'dug pa rgya nag gi bon po'i rigs shis yin nam brtag ju thig la brten nas mo 'debs pa'i gzhung deng sang mthong rgyu yod pa ni sde dge mi pham rin po che'i gsungs 'bum pod ja ba'i nang zhang zhung srid pa 'phrul gyi ju thig gi dpyad don snang gsal sgron me le tshan gnyis pa shog grangs 427tsam yod pa der gzigs dang gsungs 'dug yang mkhas pa dung dkar gyis/ ju zhag ni rgya nag hwa shang dang bon po rnams kyis rtsis rig la brten nas btab pa'i mo phywa zhig yin nam snyam ste/rtsis rig la brten nas mo 'debs skabs mgron phywa zhig yin tshe/ mgron po de'i gzugs che chung gi tshad dang / gdong gi dbyibs/ lo na che chung bcas gsal por ston thub zer srol yod pa dang / 'phreng ba'am/ skud pa'am/rde'u sogs la brten nas mo rgyag stangs shig yin cing / 'di'i skor dpe cha mang po yo da gsungs/ gsungs 'di dag las go thub pa gcig ni/ ju thig dang ju thig gi mo 'debs kyi bstan pa'i bdag po dngos ma de bon yin pa/dper na/ zhang zhung gi srid pa 'phrul gyi ju thig ces pa'i mo gzhung dang / mo gzhung de dag tu bstan pa'i gto dang / mdos sogs kyi lag len dang /ming tshig gi tha snyad spyod stangs thad nas kyang / mgron phywa dang / don phywa dang /gdon phywa dang / nad phywa zhes bon gyi tha snyad yang dag spyod kyi yod pa/ phyis su mo yig la lar phywa 'gyur nas bya bris pas/ mgron bya dang / don bya zhes bris 'dug sba bzhed nang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po sangs shis dang sba 283

gsal snang gnyis thang gi gong mar 'tshams 'dri zhu bar btang skabs gong ma'i mdun du ju zhag la brten nas mo 'debs mkhan gyi grwa ba zhig yod tshul gsungs pa 'dis/ rgya nag gi rgyal po de dag gis rgyal srid dang chos srid/sger don kun po yang ju zhag gi mo la mgo btags yod par shes/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ mdun na 'don ni rgyal po la mo rtsis dang kun rim byed cing / rgyal po'i mdun 'dug de yin gsungs/ de ltar na chab srid mo rtsis kyis skyong ba 'di bod gcig pu'i lugs srol yin tshad ma red/bod kyi zhang zhung srid pa 'phrul gyi ju thig dang / bod kyi chab srid sgrung bon lde'ugasum gyis skyong zhes pa'i ju zhag lde'u la brten pa'i mo 'debs kyi phyag len dang / rgya nag kong tse ste/ khung tsi zhes pa de yin na/ kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin pa'i skyes chen gyi gral du 'jog cing / mo rtsis la phul du phyin pa'i mkhas pa zhig yin zhing / skabs der rgya nag gi slob gso'i kha phyogs skor mkhan gyi ded dpon yang kong tse yin pa kun gyis shes/ de bzhin du thang gi gong ma'i dus su mo dang ju zhag bon la brten tshul gyi ni bshad ma thag pa ltar ro/ 'on kyang rgya nag tu rjes su gzhung don du mo 'debs mkhan med cing /rang gi gsal rig gis bya bzhag thams cad tshod 'dzin byas pa las mo la skyabs su mchi mkhan je dkon song 'dug rang rigs ni mo dang ju zhag la nam yang blo phugs bcol te/ mo dang ju zhag ni rtag brtan g.yung drung gi skyabs su 'dzin gda'/ deng gang zag khag cig gis mo rtsis ni sems can mgo skor byed kyi lag cha ru ngos 'dzin te/ mig phye nas gnas tshul ma mthong na/ mi btsum nas phreng rdog gi rtsis rig gis ci yang go mi thub/ las ka tshang ma mo rtsis la bcol ba ni mi rigs rjes lus kyi rtsa ba/ rang khag mo la dkri nas bag yangs kyis sdod snying spros bas bsam blo rul bar gyur ba/ bsam gzhig gi ngal rtsol ring du dor te/ le lo ngan goms su shor byed du gyur pa yin zhes 284

skyon kho na mthong gi yod/ de bzhin du srid pa'i las dang bya ba mtha' dag shes rab rig rtsal gyis dbye 'byed mi byed nas mun nag lag snyog gi rtsis kyis gang yang mi 'jon zhes pa dang / rang 'gan rang gis mi khur nas rang 'gan mo dang ju thig la bcol ba 'di da'/ 'byor gyi mi lus kyis bed ma chod pa'i rtags dang / gsang ba lkog gyur thams can mo dang ju thig gis gsal bshad byed nus na rang rigs kyi 'jig rten 'di 'di las bzang tsam zhig ci la mi 'gyur ba red ces bka' bkyon byed pa 'di dag don la gnas min brtag par 'tshal/ ma gzhi sngon byon dam pa de dag gis kyang / mo rtsis kyi phyag len la bka' bkyon byed pa mang ste/ chos nyid bden pa mngon sum ma mthong bar/ mo dang rmi lam rdzun gyis mgo ma bskor zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nas bod kyi rdza dpal sprul yan chad la/ skyes chen dam pa de tsam zhig byon pa dang de dag gi khrod na'ang mo dang ju thig la dgag pa gnang mkhan mang la/ phyag len mdzad po che nyung / spyir zhang zhung srid pa 'phrul gyi ju thig nas da lta ma ṇi 'bru drug gi mo dang / ge sar gyi mo dang dpal ldan lha mo'i mo bar 'gyur ldog dang go rim bcas la bsam gzhig byos dang / chos mo 'di dag gi 'byung khungs dngos ma ni bon po yin pa bshad ci dgos/ngas 'di nas zhu 'dod pa ni/ bon mo dang chos mo gang yin na 'dra/ thig mi thig ji ltar rung / yid ches mi ches gang yang rung / nga tsho'i dngos yod gnas tshul mdun du bzhag ste/ logs shig na mo dang ju thig 'debs pa 'di dgos med cig snang / da lta gang zag phal mo che la nad kyis thebs nas zug gzer mngon sum du myong bzhin/ nad par phan pa'i sman gyi phyogs su mi 'gro nas/ mo dang ju thig la brten nas mgo 'khor bas mthar nad tshabs chen du gyur te/ sman gyis phan bskyed med pa/ sgor mo'i 'gro song che ba/ rin chen srog dang bral ba/ gnyen bshes rnams sdug la sbyar ba bcas dus gcig la 285

shar bar byas/ go thos ltar na bod khul gyi sman khang so so'i nang du nad tshabs che ba bcos dka' ba'i nad na mkhan mang shos de bod rigs red zer/rgyu mtshan nad chung chung na skabs sman la ma bsten nas/ nad tshabs chen ma 'gyur bar bzod bsran byas/ bcos dka' ba'i nad du 'gyur dus gzod sman khang du phyin pa red 'dug de bzhin du deng sang bod khul gyi sa cha 'ga'i phyugs zog bdag po de dag gis/ phyugs zog ri la bor brlag shor dus/ 'tshol nyul gyi dka' tshegs las byol te/ lung khug su yong nas mo la brten pa mthong bas 'di rnams gzab gal che/ de ltar na nga tshos bsam gzhig dang / gros mol gyis thag chod thub pa dag mo dang ju thig la brten na dgos med yin snyam/ gna' sngon ma bod khul gyi dpon blon rnams kyis gzhung don gros mol dang / bsam gzhig rig pas thag bcad ma thub pa dgayang na mo dang ju thig la brten pa/ yang na lha bab la brten nas gtan 'khel byed kyi red zer/ rgyu mtshan des bod kyi chab srid mo rtsis kyis skyong ba red ces bshad srol yod myong / rang gis bsgrub nas 'grub rgyu can zhig yin na/ rang gi 'bad brtson la rag las pas/ rig pa lcags ltar bsgrims/'bad brtson ri las che ba/ yang zor bya las kyang bde ba zhig byas te/'gan cha tshang rang gi phrag tu khur na bya ba 'grub rgyu red/ de min mo dang ju thig la blta na bya ba 'di 'grub nges red ces lung bstan pa tsam la yid brtan byas te/ sos dal bag phebs kyi ngang du bya ba 'grub rgyu'i re sgug byas te bsdad na sna 'then nas kha nang du mi slebs pa bzhin 'bras med du 'gyur rgyu red snyam/ mtshams 'di nas gtam rgyud cig bshad 'dod pa 'di ltar/rgyal po nor bzang gi rnam thar du btsun mo nag phyogs la dga' ba dag gis/yid 'phrog lha mo la gnod pa bya phyir/ a mchod ha ri nag po dang 'brel bar byas te/ a mchod ha ri nag pos rgyal po nor bzang sa phyogs gzhan du 286

bskyod dgos pa'i mo bab khul byas te mgo skor btang ste/ yid 'phrog lha mo gnod par byas pa'i skad cha zhig yod pa red/ rtsom rig le tshan 'di'i lo rgyus rgyab ljongs ni/ spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos ma zhig ste/ bla mchod kyis mo dang ju thig gi yon bdag gi 'dod pa bskang ba'i bya ba 'di 'dra'i rigs la khyi spyang lag sbrel zer gyi yod/ go thos ltar na spyi tshogs khrod du yang / bzang ngan gang yin ma nges rung / mo ba dang sman pa zung 'brel gyis gcig grogs gcig gis byed kyi yod ces bshad 'dug rang rigs ni re sgug la dga' ba'i mi rigs shig yin/ bod re bas phung zer rkyen yang des red/ ngas gong zhus ltar nga tsho mi rigs 'di gzhan brten te/ gzhan ltos kyi 'tsho bar rol rgyu dga' tsam yod pas/ mo dang ju thig la re ltos byed pa 'di yang rgyu mtshan des red/ 'di yang bdag nyid bdag gi mgon du bzung ma thub nas/rang thag ma chod nas u thug gis mo la skyabs bcol zhus pa rang red/thabs zad sdug thug gis mo dang ju thig la skyabs su mchi ba yin gyi/ rang gis thon na skyabs su ci la mchi/ der brten nga tshos mngon shes lnga dang spyan lnga ldan pa'i thabs byed ma nus yang / mngon rjes kyi lung rigs la phul phyin sbyangs te/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la dbye 'byed kyi nus pa ldan par byas shing rang thag rang gis chod thabs la 'bad nga ra bya/ spyir mo la brten na los chog kyang / mtha' cig tu mo kho na la brten te/ bya ba bsgrub 'os rigs ma bsgrub na 'bras bu thon rgyu med pa'ang / mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di ka lags/ ma gzhir deng sang mo dang ju thig 'debs mkhan mang rung / mo dang ju thig gi 'gro lugs shes mkhan dkon pa/ de las kyang mo dang ju thig gi sngon 'gro bsnyen sgrub tshad ldan song ni dkon pas/ ma nor lam ston byed thub dka'/ tshong gi khe kha thob dgos na/ 'phrin brda lag rtsal la myur skyen pa dang rtsis rig la zhib mo rnam 'thag bya rgyu/ nad na tsha byung na gso sman 287

bdud rtsi'i thigs pa la bsten rgyu/ phyugs zog bor brlag shor na dka' tshegs la mi skrag na nas bor brlag shor sa'i phyogs su btsal rgyu/ las don rnyed thabs kyi rgyugs sprad dgos na shes rig gi chu tshad je mthor gtong rgyu 'di dag ni rgyu 'bras kyi 'brel ba yod pas/ mo dang ju thig la brten mi dgos shing / sngon byon dam pa'i gsungs kyi gces pa zab mo rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag gis zhib rtsis byed na chog snyam/bcu pa/ nang rigs kyi chong las skor la cung zad dpyad pa/de yang rtsol med rang byung gi 'tsho ba shing 'bras rigs la brten nas/mthar rtsol bcas kyi 'tsho ba rol bas spra dang spre'u'i sru byi/ mjug ma chad cing / smra shes don go ba'i 'du shes khyad par can ldan pas/ rang byung khams la 'thab rtsod byed thub pa'i stobs shugs skyes te/ ngal rtsol gyi thon skyed 'go tshugs pa'i dus mi yi rigs byung ba yin/ de nas bzung lo ngo brgya phrag mang por brgyud de/ spyi tshogs dang / khor yug lam lugs sogs kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mi yi rigs kyi nang sems la g.yo 'gul thebs pa/phan tshun gcig la gcig brten dang / phan tshun gcig gi sgul shugs gcig gis byas te/ gnyis ka la 'phel rgyas rgyun mar byung zhing / khyad par du mi yi rigs kyi 'du shes dang tshor ba ni srog chags gzhan las kyang phul phyin gyi tshad la slebs pas/ dngos po phal pa la longs su spyod rgyu ni smos ci dgos/ srog chags rigs de dag kyang g.yog tu bkol thub pa byung 'dug de nas rim bzhin so so'i yul lung khor yug mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis/ 'tsho chas skor la/sa khul 'di na 'bel bo yod pa dag de na dkon po yin pa/ 'di na mkho dgos che rung / de na mkho dgos mi che ba sogs rkyen sna tshogs kyis bskul te/288

dngos po brje res kyi tshong las dar ba zhig yin/ de ltar na ya thog gdod ma'i bon gyi bstan pa rnam dag dar zhing rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis skabs nas dngos po brje res kyi tshong las dar ba bshad ci dgos/ 'on kyang skabs der dngos po sdeb brje byas pa las/ bre srang gi tshad 'jal byed yod pa ma red/ rgyal rabs rnams su 'di ltar/ bod kyi rgyal po i sho legs dus su mdzangs blon gnyis pa lha bu mgo dkar byung zhing / mdzangs pa'i las su zhing la dor kha brtsis/ 'brog la thul rtsis phu chu yur du drangs/ mda' ru chu ma rmo ba 'di nas dar zhes pas/ zhing kha brtsis pa dang / 'brog la thul rtsis pa sogs 'di'i skabs su dar bar bshad/ bya ba 'dis dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong bar skul 'ded shugs chen thebs/ de rjes mdzangs blon gsum pa khri ngor snang btsan mong gi bu bya bas bre phul srang sogs kyi 'jal byed gsar gtod byas/ des kyang sngar las kyang dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas phyin pa'i g.yo 'gul thebs/ de nas rim bzhin du tshong sna tshogs kyi bstan pa dbyar gyi rtsi shing ltar rgyas so/ tshong las la brten nas phan tshun 'grim 'grul gyis 'brel 'dris byung ba dang / phan tshun bar gyi bsam blo brje res kyis kha skad gcig gyur/ khrom ra rgyas byed/ dpal 'byor 'phel thabs la skul 'ded byas pa sogs dge mtshan mang / da lta tshong pa nges med kyis sa gnas so sor rgyu 'grul byas te/ nyo tshong byed po 'di dag gi bsam blo dang / skad cha bshad stangs/ mi dang 'brel ba bzo lugs/ tha na kha skad kyi gdangs dang bcas pa/ lung khug gnas gcig la brten pa'i shes yon pa zhig las kyang byang tshad mtho tsam yod/ tshong las la brten nas nyo tshong mkho sgrub gcig bu ma yin pa'i bsam blo dang / rig gnas/ srid don/ goms gshis sogs phan tshun skyel 'dren byas te/ khyon yongs nas spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas phyin par nus pa shugs kyis bton yod/ da lta lha sa'i skad la 'gyur ba phyin pa 'di 289

yang / tshong las la brten pa'i khrom 'dus kyi skad gdangs sna mang zhig gis grub pa'i 'bras bu red/ da lta rgya gar na rong 'brog tshang mas gcig mthun du spyod pa'i skad 'di yang / phyogs khag so so'i mi sna dag gnas gcig la 'dus sdod byas pa'i spyi skad yin/ spyir bod kyi lo rgyus thog tu tshong las mkhas pa mang rab cig byung ste/ bod mis tshong 'brel byed sa yang / rgya gar/rgya nag bal bo/ li yul/ sog po sogs yin la/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo bod kyi tshong pa rnam bzhi dang / ming grags can gyi tshong dpon nor bu bzang bo sogs tshong las kyis kha gso rgyab 'gel byas shing / yul dgon kun la rgyu nor gyi 'gyed brgyag pa'i lo rgyus mang / 'on kyang zhe pham pa zhig la bod kyi tshong rdzas 'bu rdza be'u mog sha ra gla rtsi sogs rang byung gi thon khungs dngos rdzas yag shos de dag ja dang tshwa/ sna du dang dar ras brje ba de red/nga tsho'i dngos rdzas yag shos de dag gis thon rdzas bzo ma thub nas/ hril bo sdeb tshong byed pa 'di ka lags/ ngas 'di nas bkras zur tshang gi gsang ba'i gtam rgyud las tshong rtsis skor cung zad drangs 'dod pas 'di ltar/ pad ma'i 'phrin yig 'byor gsal/ bod du bzo grwa ma btsugs par rgyu cha kho na phyi 'dren pa ni bod kyi rgyu nor phyir 'dren byed pa dang gnyis su ma mchis nga tshos bal do gcig phyir tshong byas par rgya gar sgor 200re babs par blo yid yongs su tshims khul byed kyang / don du bal do gcig nas mar mthar ther ma lteb sgril gsum tsam thon thub pa dang / ther ma lteb sgril gsum tsam rer rin rgya gar sgor 20re brtsis tshe/ ther ma lteb sgril gsum nas rgya gar sgor bsdoms 12 rkyarkya'am tam rdo 120byung bar gzhigs nas bal do gcig gi ma gnas tam rdo 10 'di khongs bdal gla tshud kyi ldab bcu gnyis zin gyi yod/ yang dper na/ bod kyi pags rigs phal mo che bed med du lus te/g.yag lpags ko bub gcig la srang sum bcu tsam las mi gnas pas/ g.yag 290

lpags gcig nas 'jur ta yu ring cha gsum thon par mtshon na 'jur ta cha rer rin srang 200re brtsis bsdoms srang 600thob rgyu yin pa ste/ g.yag lpags gcig gi ma gnas srang 20yi ldab nyi shu zin gyi yod pa'i skor dang /de bzhin yul zhig gi rgyu cha phyir 'dren bya rgyu mtshams 'jog dgos na yul der rang gi bzo las spel dgos gshis/ 'on kyang de ltar lag len du 'khyol dgos na bzo grwa gsar 'dzugs dgos pa ma zad/ de la dpag pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang / skyel 'dren byed pa'i mo ṭa'i lam/ 'gul shugs kyi 'byung khungs glog khang la sogs pa tshong gsar du bskrun dgos pa'i skor rnams zhib par 'khod/ nga tsho bod gangs can yul na ma rtsa'i rgyu cha sdeb tshong byed mkhan zhig las/ thon rdzas su bsgyur te/ ldab log dang ldab log gi khe bskyed rgyun ma chad par rnyed mkhan gyi tshong ba ni nyin mo'i skar ma dang 'dra/ nga tshos ma rtsa'i rgyu cha'i tshong las byed na/ rgyu cha mjug rdzogs te/ stong par gyur dus tshong las la yang rdzogs tshig brgyag tshar ba red/ der brten dus rabs bcu dgu pa yan man la sku gsung thugs rten gos chen rnying pa/ shing tshon rnying pa sogs gna' rabs kyi rig gnas zhib 'jug byed pa'i rgyu cha dag rgyal phyi nang kun tu 'grim pas/ tshong gi tsha rlabs 'phyur te/ rig gnas kyi mtshon dod rin thang can de dag btsong ba'i rin gyis/ bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la rol te/ma 'ongs pa'i tshong khe skyed la bsam gzhig ma byas nas ma rtsa'i sgor mo stong zad du song 'dug ma gzhi gna' rabs kyi gtam dpe la/ khab kyis 'buga'abug gis gri zhes ma rtsa chung ngu las ma rtsa rgya chen po chags par byed dgos tshul gsungs kyang rang rigs ni de las ldog ste gris 'bug byas/ 'bug gis khab byas/ khab yul med du song bar byas pa lta bu zhig snang / da lta tshong las la gnyer pa'i gang zag cig yin phyin/ rtsis rig pa la rgyus mnga' med na tshong ji ltar byed/ bod kyi dpe la/ tshong ma red rtsis red zer ba ltar/ tshong 291

rtsis zhib mo zhig phog na tshong pham nyen mi shor bar phan nges red/ nga tshos rlabs chen gyi bya ba yin skad kyis/ tshong rtsis ma byas nas sdeb nyo sdeb tshong byed na pham gyong thebs pa'i nyen kha yod/ der brten da lta tshong las rig pa'i sbyong tshan la zhugs dus/ rtsis rig la phul phyin gyi sbyong pa byed rgyu ni tshong las kyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig red/ yang tshong zhes pa ni gzhan mgo skor byed cig yin pas/ tshong pha mgo yin rung brdung dgos zer srol yod ces/ gzhan la rdzun dang g.yo sgyu byed dgos snyam na de ni nor 'khrul tshabs chen zhig yin/spyir tshong pa zhig gis khe skyed thob rgyu med na tshong byas pa'i dgos pa ci la yod/tshong la khe skyed yod pa ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ 'on kyang ra gan gser du bsgrub pa/ rtol le mdzo ru bzos te u tshugs byed pa/ rdo dmar byur dmar ru byas pa/ snga dro'i skad cha dang phyi dro'i skad cha mi 'dra/ de ring gi skad cha dang sang nyin gyi skad cha mi mtshungs/ rang tshig snga phyi'i 'gal tshig bcas glog 'tshub pa bzhin byas na/ de la tshong pa mi zer zhing / mgo skor mkhan zhes bya/ de 'dra'i tshong las ni phyi thag mi ring zhing / rnga ma thung thung zhig las med pas/ tshong pa rnam dag de bshad thog don thog yod pa/bden pa rnal ma zhig yin dgos/ yang tshong byed mkhan des khor yug gi 'gros/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul/ rgyal khab kyi srid jus/ sa khul so so'i khyad chos bcas la rgyus mnga' len pa dang / tshod bstun shes rgyu gal che/tshong byed rgyu de khor yug gi 'gros dang ma mthun na/ hos rigs la phag sha btsong ba dang / bod mi la rta sha btsong na tshong pa de la ngo rgol drag por byed nges/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul ma shes na/ dngos po gang zhig nyo tshong la 'grim mi shes pas/ mkho bstun gyi tshong byed mi shes par 'gyur/ rgyal khab kyi srid jus ma shes na/ nyo tshong gi dngos po la srid jus kyis tshod 'dzin yod pas/ lo 'di'i nang gi dngos po nyo tshong byed chog pa dag lo rjes mar nyo tshong 292

byed chog pa'i nges par med pas/ srid jus la rgyus mnga' len rgyu gal che/sa khul so so'i khyad chos ma shes na/ sa khul gang la dngos po gang zhig 'dzol zhing 'tsham pa mi shes pa/ sa khul so so'i khyad chos ha go dgos/ de bzhin du dus tshod shes pa dang / dmigs gsal kyi gnas tshul yang shes dgos/dper na dus ma shes nas dbyar gyi spyod chas dgun dus btsong pa lta bu/dmigs gsal kyi gnas tshul ni nyis stong lor glo tshad kyi 'gos nad drag po na dus/ kha shubs dang / skyu khu rnams nyo mkhan mang bas dngos po de dag mthar tshong khang du btsong rgyu med pa 'grim kha che ba lta bu yin pas de dag shes dgos/ tshong las thengs gcig la gyong rag na/ des sems pham gyis tshong las de gtong mi rung / nyams rgud thengs gcig thebs na shes rab thengs gcig 'phel zer ba ltar lags pas/ tshong las mi sna la kha brdab sna brdab kyis brdab gsig re yong na shes rab rig pa'i ral gri je rno 'gro zhing / zhi 'jam yid dbang 'gug pa'i byang tshad je mthor 'gro thub/ sngon dus tshong dpon nor bu bzang po tshong las skor ma dgu la ma kha shi bas/ mthar a thang chad de rtswa gseb tu nyal nas yod skabs/ 'bu grog ma zhig rtswa 'jag ma gcigagi rtsa ba nas rtse mo/ rtse mo nas rtsa ba bar skor ma mang por song bar mthong nas/ mar thur du bab pa dang / yar rtser 'dzegs pa'i gnas tshul la bltas te/ go bskon slob gso thob ste/ mar nyams rung / yar dar rgyu yod par shes te tshong las la slar yang zhugs pas rgyal kha thob pa'i gtam rgyud yod/ tshong 'dus mgur mo rab kha ni dus rabs bcu ba'i dkyil du dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcus mdo smad nas slob ma grub ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dge slong gi sdom pa zhus rjes lo shas nas bod du phebs/ de'i nang lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi 'khrungs yul gtsang mgur mo rab kha nas yin pas khong gis mched grogs gzhan rnams la/ khyed rnams gnas skabs bod 293

dbus gtsang du log ma phebs par 'dir bzhugs/ ngas sngon la dbus gtsang du 'gro ba'i tshong ba dang mnyam du song nas chos dar nus pa 'dug na ngas log ma yong bar dbus gtsang du bsdad kyis/ de tsa na khyed rnams yar phebs na mthus/ gal te dbus gtsang tu chos dar bar byed ma nus na nga yang tshong ba dang mnyam du bod la phebs/ khong rnams sum 'phrang du slebs mtshams tshong pa rnams de gar byas te mdo smad du log rtsis yod skabs lo ston gyisak+ṣed rnams 'di nas ma sdod par gtsang la song nas mgur mo rab khar slebs tshe nga'i pha lo nad gtsug na zer ba zhig yod pa de la nga dbus na 'dug ces lan skyol zhes mngags te gtsang du btang / tshong pa rnams kyis kyang khong gis gsungs pa ltar byas pas tshong legs po byung / de nas bzung gtsang gi mgur mo rab khar tshong 'dus chags pa'i ming du tshong 'dus mgur mo zer/deng sang bod rang skyong ljongs snye mo rdzong khongs mar rkyang chus su yod/ de sngon bod kyi gser dngul gyi lji tshad thang gzhi yang tshong 'dus mgur mo'i khrom ra'i rin thang gi tshad gzhi gzhir bzung nas chos khrims dang srid gzhung gi khrims yig brkus pa 'jal gyi khrims yig skor bshad skabs tshong 'dus mgur mo'i gser dngul dang 'bru rigs kyi rin thang gzhir bzung bar bshad/ rta ja tshong lam ni thang rgyal rabs nas dar bar bshad la/ rjes sor yon rgyal rabs nas ming rgyal rabs skabs su bod rgya bar gyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas spel res nyin bzhin gong du 'phel bas/ rgya nag nas ja dang ras cha/ dar gos sogs bod rigs la mkho ba rnams khyer yong ste/bod kyi rta dang pags rigs/ sman sna sogs la brje bas ja yig sngon du yong ba'i ja rta tshong las (skrupaṃ.oṃ) bod pas rta btsong bas na rta sngon du 'bod pas na rta ja tshong lam zhes brjod/ bod du 'dren pa'i ja rnams gtso bo da lta tsu yun/ than chad/ g.yag rnga sogs nas thon gyi yod/ tshong gi rnam pa la lo 294

du ma nas mi 'dra ba'i gnas tshul yod pa ltar/ dper na/ skabs 'gar rta sdug shos shig nas ja rgya ma bzhi brgya lhag tsam brje thub pa ltar yod la/ rgya nag tu rta 'dren mang shos shig ni sung rgyal rabs spyi lo 12kya4la lo gcig gi nang rta grangs khri tsho gsum tsam 'dren pa ltar ro/ spyir rta ja tshong lam 'di rgya nag dang bod bar 'brel ba byed sa'i lam ka gtso bo gsum lta bu ni dar mdo nas dkar mdzes brgyud chab mdo yi lam zhig dang / dar mdo nas li thang 'ba' thang brgyud pa gcig dang / yun nan bde chen nas 'jol mda' dang smar khams brgyud pa gcig bcas gsum nas rta dang ja phan tshun brje ba'i nyo tshong byed pa de'o/ da lta tshong ra dpal 'byor dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ tshong ra la 'grim rgyu ches mang / phyi yi dngos po sna tshogs shig tshong ra la 'grim par ma zad/ dam pa'i chos kyi cho ga dag kyang tshong ra la 'grim gyi yod/ dper na chos kyi cho gas 'byor ldan gyi bya ba lam du song ste/ bsam don bzhin 'grub na/ cho ga byed po bla mchod la sgor mo ji ltar sprad gan rgya bzhag gi yod pa red zer/ da dung bar skabs shig la btsong mkhan rang nyid la ni/ la rgya yod med mi shes rung / mi rigs kyi la rgya'i rba rlabs 'phyur te/la rgya dang la rgya zhes la rgya'i phreng ba bgrangs dus/ la rgya'i rtags can gyi dngos po grangs med cig tshong zog byas/ 'char gzhi can gyi dpal 'byor tshong ra dpal 'byor la 'gyur ba'i dus 'dir/ slob gso dang / rig gnas/'phrod bsten bcas pa tshong ra'i khrod du ded zin pa red/ der brten slob gso dang / rig gnas/ 'phrod bsten bcas par rin gong je cher song bas/dmangs tshogs dkyus ma dag la slob gso'i go skabs thob rgyu nyung la/ rig gnas la longs su spyod ma thub pa dang / 'phrod bsten la yang brten mi thub pa'i gnas tshul tshabs chen du gyur/ yang da lta tshong ra la mi 'grim pa'i dngos po de dag nam zhig na spyi tshogs dang khor yug slob gso'i shugs rkyen 295

las tshong ra la 'grim pa mang ste/ dper na 'dzam gling na thog mar sbig chang dar dus 'thung mkhan nyung la/ tshong ra la 'grim rgyu yang mi mang / rim bzhin 'thung mkhan je mang song ba'i gnas tshul yang da lta shes gsal ltar lags/ bed mi spyod rgyu spyod thabs byas pa'i slob gso'i shugs rkyen thebs dgos pa yang yod/ tshong lam yangs po zhig gsar gtod byas dgos/ tshong lam de la brten nas tshong spus gtsang yong gi yod/ dper na h+phe gling pa dag gis rkang la lham mi gon la/ gal te rkang la lham gon pa'i slob gso byed thub na/ lham grangs med cig gis tshong byed chog pa bzhin no/ yang tshong zog gi dngos po la grags pa'i ming rtags bkod pa 'di gnad 'gag che/ deng ming rtags kyi rin gong khug pa'i dus su slebs yod pas/ nga tshos ming rtags gnad du 'dzin rgyu gal che/ da lta rang rgyal la grags can gyi ming rtags de 'dra med pas dka' tshegs che ba'i lo rgyus mang / dper na rang rgyal gyi ko stod cig rgyal nang nas btsong na mi dmangs shog sgor bzhi brgya yan man yin pa la/ a ri'i tshong khang gi ming rtags ko stod de la bkod rjes rin gong ldab log gis je cher 'gro/ tshong ra la 'grim pa'i shugs kyang je rgyas yin pa red/rang rgyal gyis spyod pa'i ming rtags grags che ba de dag phyi gling pa'i yin pa las nang rgyal gyis min no/ de ltar na tshong las shig la cha mtshon na ming rtags la do snang dang / mthong chen byed dgos/ nga'i pha yul rong pa tsha la rta 'gros ma mang zhing / tshong la 'grim pas rta tshong gi khrom rgyas pas/ thag ring gi tshong pa dag kyang rta nyo bar slebs/ rma bya zhes pa'i rta zhig rta'u'i tshong pa zhig gis nyos pas mi dmangs shog sgor khri bzhi stong phrag lnga sprad pa red/ de rjes rong pa tsha ni rta 'gros ma'i pha yul zhes kun la dril bsgrags byas/ da lta rta rma bya'i rigs su gtogs pa'i rta rnams kyis gong yag por rag gi yod/kun la grags pa'i ming rtags 'di gnad du 'dzin rgyu gal che/ tshong ra bdag 296

po byed rgyu 'di yang gal chen zhig red/ da lta bod kyi sa khul gi tshong ra phal che mi rigs gzhan dag gis bdag tu bzung nas/ tshong ra gzhan lag tu shor bas/ tshong las gnyer mkhan med cing / tshong gi sgor mo ma rnyed pas gyong chen po rag gi 'dug der brten ma rtsa'i rgyu cha de thon rdzas su bsgyur te/thon rdzas tshong ra la phud de tshong lam cha tshang ba go rim ma nor ba zhig yong thub thabs byed dgos/ nga rang yo rob tu lta skor song dus/ myur bgrod gzhung lam thog gi zas khang gi tshong ra dag tu gro thug phor ba gang la mi dmangs shog sgor bdun cu kha lhag gnas kyi 'dug pas/ gal te tshong ra de bdag gir 'dzin ma thub na/ sgor mo'i yong sgo de yang bdag gir gzung mi thub/ tshong ra de bdag gir 'dzin rgyu ni ches gal che yin par go dgos/ bod kyi rig gnas tshong rdzas bzo dang mi bzo/ bod kyi rig gnas thon las can du bsgyur mi bsgyur gyi thad la/ lta tshul mang zhing / mkhas pa khag cig gis/ bod kyi rig gnas nyams pa slar gso/ mi nyams gong spel byas te/ nor bdag po'i rang lag tu 'jog ste/ mi gzhan gyi lag tu ma shor bar byas te/ rang sor bzhag dgos par bshad/ mkhas pa khag cig gis bod kyi rig gnas de gzhan la ma tshong na rin thang med pas/ rig gnas thon las dang tshong lam gyi skar khung nas ma brgyus na/ rig gnas kyi rin thang gi tshad 'jal mi thub ces bshad/ gang ltar nga tsho bgro gleng ji ltar byed rung / dngos gzhi'i tshong las pa dag gis btsong mkhan gyis btsongs nas/ nyo mkhan gyis nyo yi yod pa red/ nga la bla sprul 'ga' shas kyis bshad rgyu/ bod kyi rig gnas tshong ra la 'dren pa 'di sems pham pa/ yid mug pa zhig red/ 'di 'dra'i las ka ni nga tshos nam yang byed mi rung zer gyi 'dug khong tshos chos 'don pa dang /chos bshad pa'i rin du byung ba'i gor mo ni dad pas 'bul ba yin pas/tshong gi gral du mi 'gro zhes dbyar rnga ldir gyi 'dug rung / 'di tshong las gyi 297

gral du 'gro min ni a khu chos rgyal gyis thag gcod bya rgyu red/ bya ba lam du 'gro ba'i sku rim gyi cho ga 'don pa dang / chos shes par 'dod pa la chos bshad byed pa bcas la rin yon 'di tsam dang de tsam dgos zhes gong tshad brgyab ste/ chos nyos pa 'di dag la blta na rig gnas gzhan gyis nyo tshong byed chog pa dang / rig gnas gzhan tshong las can du 'gyur bar bya chog pa ni smros med red/ dper na bzo rig dang / gso rig dang / skar rtsis dang /rtsom rig dang / nang rig dang / zlos gar rig pa bcas kyi tshong las byed kyi yod pa ni mngon sum du grub pa 'di ka lags/ ngas mtshams 'di nas rtsom rig gi tshong byed tshul phyogs tsam bshad na/ dper na mi la ras pa'i rtsom deb gcig de 'dzam gling na tshong byas mkhan de tsam mang zhing / rgyun de tsam ring pa/ khyab rgya de tsam che ba bcas ni rtsom deb de'i rin thang red/ bod la de lta bu'i rtsom deb rin thang can mang po zhig yod pa yang mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ sde rong tshe ring don 'grub kyis rtsom pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus kyi deb de dkon pa'i dus su mi dmangs shog sgor sum brgyas nyo rgyu mi rnyed ces bshad 'dug pas/ de yang rtsom deb de'i ring thang red/ de bzhin du/ bzo rig la bshad na/ bris bzo dang / mgar bzo dang / blug bzo dang / brko bzo dang / bzo drub kyi skor dang bcas pas gong mi khug pa gcig kyang med/ de bzhin du gzhan pa'i rig gnas dag gis spyi tshogs la nus par thon zhing tshong las byed chog pa bshad ci dgos/ sgra tshad gnyis te don shes pa la sgras phan 'dogs pa/ 'khrul bar sel ba la tshad ma shes dgos pa bcas rig gnas 'di dag mi mkho rgyu gcig kyang med pa shugs kyis ha go dgos/ tshong las byed po zhig gis skad brda yag po shes rgyu de gal che/ bod kyi tshong pa zhig yin phyin mdo dbus khams gsum gyi skad nyan shes pa bshad shes pa zhig yin par ma zad/ rgya skad spyi skad dang / dbyin ji'i skad dag kyang nges can zhig shes 298

dgos/ da lta kan su'u hu'e rigs kyi tshong pa de dag gis tshong las la phan phyir bod skad sbyong sa'i 'dzin grwa chung ngu zhig rtsa 'dzugs byed pa lta bu/ hu'e rigs kyi tshong pa dag gis 'brog skad bshad dus kyang 'brog pa dag ma zhig gis skad cha bshad pa lta bur snang bas/ skad shes rgyu gal che ba'i tshul shugs kyis go thub par 'dug skad kyi rim pa la brgyud de/ gzhan sems bkug cing / gzhan sems lhod la bab dus tshong las byed bde ba'i dge mtshan yod pa red/ tshong las do dam skor gyi yig cha rgya che/ grangs mang / gting zab pa sogs gang mang mang zhig 'dug kyang / ngas blta na do dam byed thub dang mi thub de/ gtso bo mi sna la thug cing / gtso bo'i mi sna de yang sgrig yig la thug pa zhig yin/ mdor na gtso 'khor dang bcas pa sgrig yig 'og tu yod na/do dam gyi las ka phul phyin zhig yong gi red snyam/ bdag cag gi ston pas/rab byung gi tshul spyod bya ba do dam yong phyir dge tshul gi sgrig dang / dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gsungs pa bzhin no/ mdor na do dam gyi yig cha mang ngam nyung yang rung ste/ sgrig yig tshad ldan zhig gis 'og tu kun 'dus na de las lhag bya rgyu gang yang med snyam/bcu gcig pa/ 'phel rgyas de phyogs re'i 'phel rgyas la go mi rung ba'i chul bshad pa/'phel rgyas zhes pa 'di mtho dpon po/ dma' sprang bo/ bar cha snyoms kyi skyes 'gro kun la mkho zhing / kun gyis kha nas 'don rgyu/ sems la bsgom rgyu/ lus kyis dka' sdug byed sa 'di rang yin zhing / 'phel rgyas dgos med 'dod pa ni srang lam rnams su nges med rgyu ba'i smyon pa rnams las gzhan 299

sus kyang mi 'dod/ bla ma la 'phel rgyas mkho ste/ bla mas 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu ni/ lung rtogs kyi chos dang de 'dzin gyi dge 'dun yin zhing / chos dang dge 'dun 'phel rgyas gtong ma thub na bla ma'i las ka nyams rgud 'gro rgyu red/'go khrid la yang 'phel rgyas mkho ste/ 'go khrid kyis 'phel rgyas gtong rgyu ni/dmangs tshogs dang / spyi tshogs dang / khor yug bcas yin zhing / de dag cha snyoms kyis 'phel rgyas gtong ma thub na 'go khrid kyi las ka la skyon shor tshar ba red/ de bzhin du mtha' na rkun ma la yang 'phel rgyas mkho ste/ rkun ma'i bstan pa dar rgyas song na/ rkun mas sa bzung rgyu mang zhing / rkun mas gnam phyed gon zhing / sa phyed bting nas go sa mthon por 'dzegs pa de yin pas/ rang gi las rigs gang zhig yin rung 'phel rgyas mi mkho ba ni gcig kyang med/ der brten rang gi ched las de bzang ngan gang zhig yin rung de la dga' zhing / de la mngon zhen che ba/ de 'phel rgyas gtong 'dod pa ni kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags/ ngas 'di nas bshad 'dod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas te/ dmangs tshogs kyi 'byor ba dang / 'tsho ba de yin zhing / 'di'i skor la bsam gzhig byed mkhan mang zhing / yig cha bzo mkhan yang mang / 'di'i 'phel rgyas zhes pa 'di/ sa brko rdo slog gis gter rdzas sngog 'don dang / ri dwags rngon nas sha rus lpags pa'i tshong dang / shing nags bcad nas skyel 'dren byed pa sogs kyis/sa 'og gi gter dang / sa thog gi nags/ nags la gnas pa'i srog chags bcas pa stong par byas te/ de'i yong sgo cung yod pa des 'dzugs skrun byas na de la 'phel rgyas mi zer/ 'phel rgyas zhes pa de spyi tshogs dang / khor yug dang / skyes dngos srog chags dang bcas pa cha snyoms kyis 'phel rgyas song ba la zer/ der brten deng sang 'phel rgyas kyi don snying nang du mdza' mthun dang / skye dngos dang / dpal yon bcas kyang bsdus yod pa red/ de ltar 300

na 'phel rgyas zer ba de da lta'i mi rabs 'di la zas gos gnas mal 'dzoms pa tsam la mi zer zhing / sa khul 'ga' dang / khyim khag 'ga' shas shig la dpal 'byor yar rgyas song ba la yang 'phel rgyas mi 'dod/ da lta'i mi rabs 'di tsam zhig la 'tsho chas mtha' dag 'grig tsam la yang 'phel rgyas zer mi rung / spyi tshogs kyi khyon yongs dang / khor yug dang skyes dngos/ mtho rim srog chags dang dma' rim srog chags bcas la/ da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i gnad don bcas la 'dang brgyab te/ de dag cha snyoms kyis 'phel rgyas song zhing / de dag la mdza' mthun gyi rnam pa mngon gsal dod po byung ba la 'phel rgyas zer/ da lta 'phel rgyas gtong mkhan rnams kyis/ ri nag po kha bas g.yog pa ltar/ gzhung lam gyi zur dang / grong pa cung che sa dang / tshong 'dus kyi mi sna mang sa la grong pa'i 'dzugs skrun rnam pa mdzes mo zhig byas te/grong gseb sa khug 'gol bo na gnas pa'i mi ser dkyus ma rnams yar 'phel rgyas btang rgyu phar zhog mar je sdug tu phyin pa mang / de rigs ni phyi tshul ring lugs zhes bya/ yang 'phel rgyas gtong mkhan gcig gis/ da yod rang byung gi gter dang / shing nags mtha' dag gis nyo tshong byas te/ gnas skabs mgo phud de ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rjes ma'i bde skyid kyi bgo skal 'phrog ste/mig sngar gyi 'tsho chas kho na la bltas pa/ de la mig sngar ring lugs zer/yang 'phel rgyas gtong mkhan gcig gis/ gzhi rim las kyang grong par mthong chen byed/ ngo bo las kyang rnam pa la mthong chen byas te/ grong ba'i 'dzugs skrun dang 'phel rgyas gtong dus nang gi don snying la mi blta nas/ phyi tshul gyi rnam pa gtso bor byas/ grong pa'i phyi tshul tsam las grong pa'i nus pa gang yang med pa zhig byas/ de la rnam pa'i ring lugs zer/ yang 'phel rgyas gtong mkhas khag gcig gis/ 'byor ldan pa dang lag sbrel te/ ri yi shing nags bcad/ sa 'og gi gter slog khe skyed gang yod rang gi khug mar 301

bcug pa dang / de bzhin grong gi 'dzugs skrun byed nas khe phan gang yod rang gi yin par byas pa 'di dag ni/ sger don ring lugs pa zhes bya/ gal te nga tsho cha snyoms kyis 'phel rgyas ma song na/ 'phel rgyas cha mi snyoms nas dbul bo 'byor med kyi rigs dag 'byor ldan gyi rjes su mi chod nas/ khra chung mig gis rgyu mthong na/ gangs dkar sems la 'dre zhugs te/ rkun jag byed mkhan je mang song ste/ mi gsad rta sgril gyi bya ba byas te/ spyi tshogs bde 'jags med par byas/ spyi tshogs bde thang gi gong bu la phra phung btsog pas zos te/ mthar rang gzhan thams cad nyams rgud du 'gro rgyu red/ der brten nga tsho la sgrig med lugs med kyi phra phung 'di dag legs bcos byed pa'i 'gan yod la/ spyi tshogs 'dir bya ngan byed pa'i phra phung ngan pa dag bzang phyogs su bsgyur ma thub na 'phel rgyas tshad ldan du mi 'gyur/ khyim tshang spyi tshogs kyi phra phung yin zhing / khyim tshang re re bzhin gyi phra phung dag 'phel rgyas cha snyoms dang / mdza' mthun legs po byung na spyi tshogs dar rgyas dang mi rigs bde 'jags yong nges yin/ gang la zing 'khrugs dang / 'thab 'dzing dang / mi bde ba'i rnam pa yod na de la mtha' gcig tu drag rgol byed mi rung zhing / nga tshos de la zhi bas gshag bcos byas te/ mdza' mthun legs po zhig chags su 'jug dgos/ de dag la tshad ldan gyi 'phel rgyas zhes bya/ dper na 'gos nad drag po na ba'i gang zag cig gi nad de bsal ba'i 'gan tshang ma la yod pa bzhin du/ 'byor med dbul phongs kyis mnar ba'i mi sna'i dka' sdug de nga tshos ma bsal na mthar kho yid chad de ci mos gang mos dang / khrims med lugs med kyis/ g.yag chad kyis myi rdung ba bzhin/gnas tshul ngan pa slong srid/ ma gzhir dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas tshad mthon por phyin pa'i mi dag la sgrig lam yod cing / snga bsam phyi 'dang rgyag rgyu mang zhing / khrims med lugs med mi byed cing / gzob pa lhur len yod pa yin 302

la/ a skya la skya rgyu dang / a sngo la sngo rgyu med pa'i 'byor med de dag gis ci yang byed srid pas gzab par bya/ da lta rgyal khab chen po 'phel rgyas kyi tshad mthon por phyin pa dag gis/ rdul rdzas mtshon cha ngan pa de dag bzo chog pa/rgyal khab chung chung 'byor med dag gis rdul rdzas mtshon cha bzo mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang gnad 'gag gong zhus dang 'dra/ der brten 'phel rgyas song ma song gi gzhir 'dzin sa ni/ khyon yongs la blta dgos pa las phyogs re la blta mi rung ba zhig yin/bcu gnyis pa/ 'drug dang gnam yig la dpyad pa cung byed pa/de yang bdag cag gi ston pas/ thar ba chen po'i mdo las/ sems can rnams kyis 'brug gi sgra zhes bya ba de ni sprin gyi sgra'o/ zhes sprin chen po rlung gis bsrub pa'i sgra yin par 'dod kyi yod/ 'on kyang gang zag khag cig gis 'brug ces ba'i srog chags shig nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ bar snang sprin gyi gseb tu ldir ba/ tha na mtsho chen po nas chu btung ste/ mid lam du ma chud pa'i chu'i lhag ma rnams phyir shor bas 'brog sde mi phyugs dang bcas pa chu yis ded pa'i lo rgyus yod ces bshad/ da dung 'brug nam mkha' la dngos su 'gro bzhin yod pa mig gis mthong zhes bshad mkhan yang kha shas 'dug nga rang dang thug 'phrad byung ba'i mkhas pa khag cig gis/ 'brug ces pa'i srog chags shig med cing / nam mkha' la ldir ba dang / mtsho chen po nas chu 'byin mkhan de ni rlung gor drag po ldang ba yin zer/ de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di ltar bshad de/ rlung gor gyis chu drangs pas shed kyis mi lcogs pa dag phyir shor te/ 'brog sde chu phyar gyis ded pa yin zer/ da dung rlung gor drag 303

pos chu 'byin pa'i rtags 'di ltar bkod de/ skabs skabs su nya lcong sbal ba sogs kyi char 'bab pa bshad pas/ rgyu mtshan des rlung gor drag pos chu 'byin pa dang mnyam gcig tu nya lcong sbal ba dag kyang mkha' la drangs te/nam zhig na sa la 'bab pa red zer/ de ltar rlung gis khur ba'i dngos po de dag sa thog tu nam zhig na lhung ba ches mang zhes bshad/ de bzhin du sa rdo'i phye ma'i char babs pa yang / thog mar rlung gor gyis mkha' la khyer te/ nam zhig na sa gzhi'i thog tu 'bab par bshad/ ma gzhir deng sang gnam grur 'phur dus nam mkha'i sprin gyi yan nas 'phur gyi yod/ gnam gru nang sdod mkhan brgya stong mang po yod rung nam mkha'i sprin gyi gseb nas dngos po zhig mthong ma myong ba la/ sa gzhi'i thog nas bar snang sprin gseb tu srog chags 'jigs rung can 'brug zer ba de mthong zhes pa 'di ya mtshan gyi gtam du snang / dper na u rgyan yul nas 'bab pa'i mkha' 'gro'i brda yig zer ba 'di yang / yod mi srid pa zhig yin tshad ma red/ u rgyan yul zhes pa da lta a h+phu han(༅oṃ po) la ngos 'dzin gyi yod pas/ sa cha de ga nas rlung drag pos yi ge nam mkha' la 'khyer te/ bod kyi lung bar 'bab mi srid pa yang ga na yin/ de bzhin du sa cha gzhan nas rlung gis khur ba'i dngos po sa cha 'dir 'bab pa la nam mkha' nas 'bab pa red zer na yang 'gal ba yod tshad ma red/ go thos la lha sa'i gling nas shog bya srog chags kyi mgo can nyams mtshar ba zhig nam mkhar btang bas/ shog bya'i skud pa chad de sa cha gzhan thag ring zhig tu shog bya lhung bas/ sa cha de ga'i mi rnams kyis srog chags mgo can gyi shog bya de nam mkha' nas lhung ba yin shag gis rtags ngan par rtsis pas yul der nad yams tshab chen na bas sku rim drag po byas pa'i lo rgyus yod pa red/ ma gzhir sa'i go la 'di thog mar chags skabs rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags/ de nas chu'i dkyil 'khor chags/ chu'i dkyil 'khor 304

de yang / rlung gis bsrubs pas sa yi dkyismu 'khor chags pa sogs la bsam na yang / rlung gi nus pa de tshad mtho shos yin par go gi 'dug deng skar ma'i go la thog gi dngos po/ sa'i go la thog tu lhung ba'i go skabs yod na/ go la gcig la brten pa'i dngos po de dag phan tshun rlung shugs kyis drangs thub pa yang zhu ma dgos pa red/ rlung po ches sa mtho'i dngos po rnams sa dma' sa'i lung khug tu khyer yong ba ni sus kyang go de bzhin du nad ngan gyi phra phung dag kyang rlung po ches skyel 'dren byed kyi yod par shes dgos/ rang lo bco brgyad lon yan man la/ ngas gnam yig ldeb ma re re can dang ldeb ma kha shas yod pa dag mthong myong ba dang / rang rigs kyi spyi tshogs kyis gnam yig gi nang don brgya bshad stong bshad kyis khyab bsgrags byed kyi yod/gnam yig phal che'i nang don ni/ bskal ba 'jig pa la yun mi ring ba dang /dus ngan gyi rnam pa mang po shar rgyu yod pa dang / tha na srog chags gdug pa can gyis sa steng kun gang bar bshad de/ ci skrag skrag tshabs ci che gang che/mtshan mor gnyid khug dka' ba lta bu re bshad kyi yod/ 'on kyang mi skrag la mtha' med zer ba ltar/ dus tshod thung thung zhig la skrag ste/ kha ma ṇi dang mi 'bral/ lag phreng ba dang mi 'bral/ sems dad pa dang mi 'bral pa'i dge blo re yod rung / phugs kyi rgyun ring mtha' 'khyongs byed pa'i chos sems yod pa ma red/ dngos gnas bshad na gnam yig zer ba dngos ma'i yi ge zhig nam mkha' nas 'bab rgyu yod pa e yin/ dus phyis gnam yig yin zhes yi ge zhig lag du 'byor ba dang / slob dpon chen mo mkhyen rab 'od gsal la gzigs 'bul bkyag pas/ nyid kyis 'di gnam yig cig dang ma red/'on kyang 'bri stangs legs por 'dug gsungs/ sngon dus snga 'gyur rnying ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa bod pa sprul sku mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyi mas/ phar phyin gyi 'grel ba 'bri dgos snyam ste/ gra sgrig byed bzhin yod skabs/ nam 305

mkha' las sher phyin gyi dpe cha ldeb gcig khong gi rtsar lhung bas/ rten 'brel bzang bar rtsis te/ phar phyin gyi 'grel ba brtsams pa'i skul 'ded thebs/bcu gsum pa/ ngal rtsol gyi dge mtshan bshad pa/de yang spyod 'jug las/ skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed pa/ 'khor ba pa la snying rje skyes/ sdig la 'dzem zhing dge la dga' zhes gsungs pas/dkon po'i rgyu nor thob dgos na/ dka' mo'i tshegs la brten dgos zhing /dka' mo'i tshegs la brten dus skyo sdug gi yid thang chad pa/ zhe pham pa/yid mug pa sogs rang thog tu 'bab nges lags/ der brten sdug bden 'di las skyob thabs su/ ston pas nges 'byung dka' bar spyod de zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas kyi gnas lugs rang zhal mjal bar byas/'jig rten gyi bya ba'i thad nas sngon thon gyi gral du slebs pa de dag kyang /rig pa sa dang bsres/ rdo dang bsnol nas/ dka' spyad rtsis grangs mi thebs pa zhig bsags mthar rgyal kha thob pa red/ de ltar na ngal rtsol gyi skyo sdug 'di la dgos pa chen po yod par shes dgos/ gna' rabs kyi spra dang spre'u mi ru gyur pa dang / go la ru 'phur bskyod thub pa 'di dag kyang ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu red/ tha na sprang mu ge mi 'chi ba'i thabs kyang ngal rtsol la brten dgos/ bod kyi dpe la/ gom re spos na kha gang rag tsog ge bsdad na mu ge 'chi zhes pa bzhin yin/ de ltar na ngal rtsol la dga' zhen yod dgos la/las chod che ba'i ngal rtsol la 'bad dgos/ rang rigs 'di mi rigs gzhan gyi rjes su lus rkyen yang / sos dal bag phebs kyis bsdad rgyu mang drag pa'i skyon yin/ nga tsho mi rigs 'di gna' rabs cig nas ja ska mo la dga' zhing /306

sna du la de las kyang dga'/ de ltar na ja ska mo 'thung zhing sna du 'then nas nyi ma dro sar bsdad de/ 'tsho ba 'jam bo la rol bas dpal 'byor gyi thad nas yar bskyed ma byung / khyad par du ja dang sna du la 'gro gron gtang rgyu mang bas snga lo ja dang sna du blangs te phyi lor rin 'jal rgyu byas pa sogs kyis ha zhabs lhung ba dang / ja dang du ba la rol rgyu mang nas ngal rtsol byed snying mi bro bas nyal du 'then pa bzhin/ mi rul ba chags pa las sra mkhregs can zhig yong gi yod tshad ma red/ bod kyi dpe la/ pho nyal nyal nyal ba'i tha ma la rgyu med na mi nyal ka med red/ shing tsan+dan nyal bas rkub nas rul/ rdo gor mo nyal bas 'khyags la 'byar zhes pa lta bu yin pas gzab gal che/ ma gzhi tshe srog gi rtsa ba g.yo 'gul la thug yod ces pa 'di tshan rig dang mthun pa'i skad cha zhig yin pa yongs la grags/ de ltar na ngal rtsol la zhugs na tshe ring ba dang / nad med pa/ gzugs gzhi bde thang / sra brtan rang bzhin bcas yong gi yod pa red/ mtshams 'di ngas zhu snying bro ba zhig la/ rang rigs kyi bla sprul mkhan gsum tsho/ khyed rnam pa yang sems kyi ngal rtsol la zhugs pa ma zad lus kyi ngal rtsol la zhugs na yon tan yin pa las skyon gtan nas min/ ngas gong zhus ltar ngal rtsol gyi phan 'bras thob thabs la 'bad na dge mtshan chen po yod pa red ces pa de yin/ bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa/ bslab pa lam gyi gnas skabs/ dmyal ba'i gnas su phebs te/ gyad kyi shing rta 'dren pa'i grogs su zhugs nas/ ngal rtsol byed myong ba red/ de bzhin du mi la ras pas kyang / mkhar dgu thog bzhengs pa'i lus kyi ngal rtsol dang / sdig bsags la 'gyod bshags byed pa'i sems kyi ngal rtsol la brten nas sdig sgrib mtha' dag byang bar byas pas sangs rgyas pa red/go thos ltar na mchog sprul gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma phyi gling gi slob grwar slob gnyer mdzad pa'i ring la/ slob grwa ngal gso la khel dus/ zas khang 307

rnams su phor ba dang za thur bkrus pa'i ngal rtsol la zhugs te/ gla rngan gyis slob yon dang / 'tsho rten byed kyi yod 'dug mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ dge chos shi rjes ming shul gtsang ma yin zer ba de yang / nyal te shi gson gyi dkor ma zos nas/ rang gi ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu zos pa yin zhes pa'i don red da lta'i dus su rang rigs kyi zhing 'brog mi ser phal ches rang nus dang bstun pa'i ngal rtsol la zhugs tshul ni/ sbrang mas rtsi bcud blangs pa'i ngal rtsol nang bzhin brel 'tshub byed kyi 'dug 'on kyang ngal rtsol gyi lag rtsal zhan pa dang / ngal rtsol gyi thon 'bras mi bzang ba/ thon 'bras kyis rin gong mi khug pas dpal 'byor yar bskyed yag po byung byāb kyi med/ ngal rtsol las rigs nus rtsal sbyong brdar byed don ni deng rabs ngal rtsol las bgo'i blang bya la mthun slad du yin/ ngal rtsol ba'i las rigs nus rtsal mtho dman gyis thad kar ngal rtsol thon skyed las chod kyi chu tshad la shugs rkyen thebs pa shes dgos/ deng sang ngal rtsol ba'i las rigs nus rtsal la rgyal khab so sos mthong chen byed kyi yod/ a me ri kha'i khe las kyis las bzo ba'i lag rtsal sbyong brdar thad lo rer a sgor dung phyur 40 00 6000tsam gyi ma rtsar phud kyin 'dug de ni phal cher a mi ri kha'i slob grwa ba chen mo 40 skyuskyulhag gi lo gcig gi 'gro gron yongs rdzogs yin/ 'khrugs chen thengs gnyis pa'i rjes kyi 'jar man rgyal phran mnyam 'brel gyis las bzo ba'i lag rtsal rkang 'dzin pa dang / 'jar pan gyis ngal rtsol ba'i lag rtsal byang tshad mthor 'degs byed rgyu ni/ lag rtsal gyis rgyal khab skyong ba'i rmang rdo dang mtshungs par bzhed/ lho kho re ya dang sing ka phor gyis dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas byung ba'i skabs su kho tshor rgyu spus mtho zhing lag rtsal bzang ba'i ngal rtsol ba'i ru chen zhig yod par 'brel ba che bar snyam/ nga rang tshogs 'du che chung mang por zhugs dus shes rtogs byung ba ni/ nga tsho zhing 308

'brog gi ched las kyis yong sgo sems kha gang ba zhig mi 'dug da lta dkar mdzes khul gyi rdzong so so'i mi grangs spyi la lo re'i yong sgo snyoms rtsis la phab dus/ mi re la lo re'i yong sgo mi dmangs shog sgo stong phrag re 'dug thub kyi med/ de ltar na zhing 'brog gi las ka 'di dka' tshegs che tshad dang mthun pa'i yong sgo ma rag pa ni/ gtso bo zhing 'brog gi ched las lag rtsal mi shes pas las chod spus gtsang med pas lan pa red/ zhing las pas zhing las lag rtsal tshad ldan sbyangs te/ zhing las tshan rig dang mthun par byas te/ yong sgo je rgyas su gtang dgos/ 'brog las pas kyang 'brog las tshan rig dang mthun par byas nas/ las chod kyi nus pa 'don zhing 'tsho ba yar rgyas yong thabs la 'bad dgos/ de ltar na sa zhing yin na 'bru rigs kho na skyed byed bzo mi dgos shing / yong sgo gang che na de'i gzhi rten bzo na yag shos red/nga tshos tshong ra mi lag tu shor ba nang bzhin gyis/ las ra dang / lag rtsal mang bo zhig kyang mi lag tu shor 'dug dper na khang pa che chung sna tshogs kyi bzo bkod dang / rgyan bkod/ chu chen po'i thog gi glog khang brgyag rgyu dang /'grim 'grul gzhung lam 'char 'god/ tha na grong khyer nang gi lham snum byug pa'i las ka tshun chad de mi lag tu shor zin/ de bzhin du rang rigs kyi lag rtsal gzhan rigs kyis spyod kyi yod pa ni ngas smros ma dgos pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar lags/ da lta nang rgyal gyi zhing gsum gyi las la 'bad dgos zhes dril bsgrags kyi dbyar rnga ji ltar ldir rung / kha yod lag yod kyis las skul gyis lag len dngos ma'i sbrang char ma 'bab na stong pa rang red/ de ltar na ngal rtsol la dga' dgos zhing / las chod che ba'i ngal rtsol la de las kyang 'bad pa cher bskyed byed dgos/ spyir ngal rtsol la 'bad pa ma zad ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bu/ 'bru rigs de dag gi ro dang nus pa/ byed las dang bcas pa zhib 'jug phul phyin zhig byas te/ rgyal khyab kyis dril bsgrags byas nas/309

tshong ra gang che la 'dren thub par byung na ches bzang / nga tsho'i nas kyi 'bru 'di sa mthon po 'di 'drar skyes thub pa ni/ nas 'bru'i nus stobs kyis mtho sgang gi phyi rkyen sna tshogs kyis 'gog rkyen byed ma thub pa'i rtags red/ skyes sa stobs bzang ba 'di nas kyi 'bru rigs kyi dge mtshan red/ dge mtshan ldan pa'i 'bru rigs 'di la 'brel yod sde khag gis zhib 'jug byas pas/'bru bcud kyi thad nas ches bzang ba'i skad cha zhig go byung / de bzhin du 'brog gi phyugs zog gi thad nas mtho sgang byang thang na 'tsho sdod byed thub pa'i 'brong dang / g.yag 'bri 'di dag ni/ 'dzam gling gi sa cha gzhan gang na'ang med pa/ ri mtho sa gtsang / kha dbugs dwangs/ 'bag btsog med cing / skyes dngos gtsang seng seng la brten nas 'tsho ba'i phyugs zog 'di dag gi mar phyur ni bcud che ba/ gtsang zhing ro nus bzang ba sogs kyi dge mtshan yod pas su la yang ngo gnong mi dgos/ rang rigs la yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i 'bru rigs dang snum rigs 'di dag 'dzam gling gi tshong ra la brgyab ste/ bed chod pa zhig byed dgos/bcu bzhi pa/ deng gi bla slob kyi chul cung zad bshad pa/bla ma zhes pa de rgya gar skad la gu ru zer/ gu ru'i sgra lci ba la 'jug pas/yon tan gyis khur lci ba la bla ma zhes bya/ bod kyis bla ma zhes pa dbang lung khrid gsum byed mkhan zhig la 'dod na/ dbang lung khrid gsum byed mkhan la gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa rtsa ba'i bla ma zhes bya/ de ltar na gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa rtsa ba'i bla ma ni yon tan gyis khur lci ba yin pas gu ru'i sgra dang yang mthun la/ bod skad du bla ma zhes pa gong ma dang / mtho sa la go bas/ bla ma 310

ni yon tan gyis gong ma dang / bla ma yin pas bla ma zhes bya/ ngas 'di nas bla ma'i skad cha bshad pa 'di la rgyu mtshan yod de/ deng sang bod kyi nang chos kyi tsha rlabs 'phyur zhing / nang chos khyab rgya che ba'i dus 'dir/ gzhan dag mi rigs mang shos shig bla ma btsal ba dang / bla ma bsten pa la bsgrims kyi yod/ khyad par du sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar te/ mi la ras pas mar pa lo tsā la bsten tshul dang / rje sgam po bas mi la ras pa la bsten tshul dang / de min skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan gyi che ba bla med ldan pa'i rnam thar mjal bas/chos la yid ches kyi dad pa skyes te/ chos sgo la zhugs mkhan mang zhing / rang nyid la yang bla ma bzang bo de 'dra ba mang po bsten rgyu'i go skabs rnyed pa dang /rang nyid la yang dam pa'i yon tan thob 'dod kyis bla ma bzang bo 'tshol mkhan mang / sa dge dka' rnying sogs kyi bla ma ci che gang che ngo sprod byas te/ra sprod bzo mkhan yang mang la/ ming ci tsam che rung bla ma ni mi yi sha tshugs can yin zhing / mi skad bshad mkhan zhig yin pa dang / mi yi 'gro lugs byed mkhan zhig yin pa las/ khyad mtshar ba'i nyams mi snang zhing / de la ltos ba'i slob ma rang nyid la yang dad pa brtan po med pas/ snang ba bslu mkhas/ rig pa col chung zer ba ltar yin pas/ 'di snang khra khra sing sing gis rig pa col chung de bslus te/ bla slob gnyis kyis mthar chos kyis don mi thon pa zhig byas pas/ slob ma de dag nang chos la dad log mi byed tsam gyi sar bzhag thub na dga' rab cig brtsi 'os pa ltar bur snang / nga dang thug 'phrad byung pa'i mi rigs gzhan ma chos dad pa zhig yin zer mkhan gyi rgan gzhon 'gas/ bod kyi sa dge bka' rnying gi bla ma ci che che mang bo zhig mjal myong / 'on kyang sems la phan pa'i gdams ngag zab mo yang ma thob la/nyams rtogs kyi yon tan khyad par can yang rgyud la ma skyes pas/ bla ma chen po ci tsam gyi rtsar bcar yang re ba che sa nas 'bras bu gang yang thon ma song 311

zhes/ yid chad nas chos kyi yin lugs la yon tan khyad par can skyes thabs yod rgyu e red ces the tshom gyi dri ba 'don gyi 'dug ma gzhir bla mas mi 'jon sa yang los yod kyang / slob mas mi 'jon sa yang ches mang gi red/ spyir mi la ras pa dang mar pa lo tsā lta bu'i bla slob kyi 'brel ba la mig dper byas te/skad cha bshad mkhan mang zhing / mi khag cig gis mar pa lta bu'i bla ma zhig btsal 'dod yod pa red/ 'on kyang de dag gis mi la lta bu'i slob ma zhig med na mar pa lta bu'i bla ma zhig dang mjal mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan de shes med pa red/ hang kang bla ma zhig gis nga la bshad rgyu/ khong rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bla ma chen po 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse mjal bar song / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse ni skad grags ha cang che ba'i bla ma zhig yin la/ sprul sku yang yin par ma zad/ sku phreng rim byon kun po mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyis rgyud phyug pa sha stag phebs/ der brten hang kang bla mas kyang mkhyen brtse rin po che mjal 'dod kyis/ sa nag po 'dom la 'jal/ sprin skya bo thod la bzhag ste/ rgya gar du 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i mdun nas/ dbang dang gdams ngag 'thob 'dod kyis sku bcar phyin/ mkhyen brtse rin po che mjal nyin mkhyen brtse yis chos gsungs nas/ chos mtshams la khel bas ngal gso'i dus tshod nang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses phyag ma zhig mdzub rtser bzhag ste/ rtsed mo gnang gi yod pa la/ hang kang bla ma'i sems ma bde/snyan grags de tsam che ba'i bla ma 'di ni rtsed mo la g.yengs kyi 'dug snyam pa dang / de mtshams chos khrid kyi 'go btsugs pas hang kang bla mas kyang chos zhus pas/ sems kha gang po zhig gsungs rgyu 'dug snyam rung / sngon la mthong ba'i shugs rkyen cung ngan pa des blo bde ma thub/ de nas hang kang bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i sku drung du zur bcar byas pas/ hang kang bla mas bton pa'i dri ba dang bo de/ deng sang mar pa lo tsā lta bu'i bla ma zhig yod 312

rgyu e red zer ba de yin/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses de'i lan du 'di ltar deng sang mi la ras pa lta bu'i slob ma zhig e yod na zhes pas/ hang kang bla ma kha grag rgyu med par gyur/ deng sang bla ma bsten pa po rang nyid la thig rtsa gtan nas med cing / gang byung byung du gyur bzhin/ bsten sa'i bla ma de thig khongs tshad ldan zhig tu btsud dgos pa'i re ba bton pa 'di/ gzhan la blta ba'i mig yod kyang / rang ngo blta na me long dgos zhes pa lta bu yin pas/rang nyid thig khongs su btsud dgos/ rang nyid thig khongs su btsud rjes da gzod bla ma la re ba bton chog ngas bltas na mar pa lo tsā bla ma de 'dra grags che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / mi la ras pa'i drin rang red/ mi la ras pas lho gro bo lung gi phyogs su mar pa lo tsā 'tshol nyul byed pa'i lo rgyus 'di ltar/ngas kyang lho brag gis mda' nas/ mi phrad tshad la skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā gang na bzhugs zhes 'dri zhing phyin pas/ rgyus yod zer ba zhig kyang ma byung /gro bo lung mthong ba'i la khar slebs pa'i tshe mi zhig byung ba la sngar ltar dris bas/ mar pa zer ba ni yod/ skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā zer ba ni med zer/ 'o na gro bo lung gang na yod byas pas/ gro bo lung pha gi yin zer nas bstan byung / pha gi na su bzhugs byas pas/ mar ba zer ba de ga yod zer/ de la gzhan mtshan med dam byas pas/ la las bla ma mar pa'ang zer zhing 'dug zer/ bla ma'i gdan sa yin par thag chod de/ la kha 'di la ci zer byas pas/'di la chos la sgang zer/ chos la sgang nas bla ma'i gdan sa mthong ba rten 'brel shin tu legs snyam dga' ba zhig byung / de nas kyang yang 'dri zhing 'ong pas/ phyugs rji mang bo zhig 'dug de rnams la dris pas/ rgan pa rnams na re rgyus med zer ba la/ de rnams kyi nang nas byis pa yid du 'ong la bzhin dang rgyan bzang / smra lce bde ba/ snum gyi ral ba shig ge ba zhig na re/nged kyi pha jo la zer ba yin nam/ de yin na nged kyi pha jo ni nged rang gi nor 313

gang yod kyis gser nyos nas rgya gar la khyer 'gro/ tshur 'khyos ma la po ti phra la ring ba mang bo khyer nas slebs yong ba zhig yod gsungs 'dug pas/ mi phrad tshad la skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā gang na bzhugs zhes dris kyang rgyus yod zer mkhan zhig ma thug pa dang / yang gro bo lung mthong ba'i la khar slebs tshe mi zhig byung ba la sngar ltar dris pas/ mar pa zer ba ni yod/ skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā zer ba ni med zer ba/ de bzhin phyugs rdzi rnams la dris pas/rgan pa rnams kyis rgyus med zer ba 'di dag la bltas na/ mar pa lo tsā yang dang po snyan grags can gyi bla ma zhig yin tshad ma red/ lung pa gcig gi mi rnams kyis kyang rgyus lon med pa lta bu zhig snang / mi la ras pa lta bu'i slob ma tshad ldan/ spus gtsang zhig dang thug nas/ mar ba'i yon tan je gsal song ba 'di ka lags/ der brten slob mas bla ma brtag dgos la/ bla mas kyang slob ma brtag dgos/ slob mas bla ma bsten tshul 'di ltar gsungs te/ dang po brtag pa mkhas pa zhig dgos gsungs pa lta bu ste/ slob mas bla ma gang byung gis bsten mi rung ba'i tshul gsungs pa dang / slob ma yang gzur gnas dang / blo ldan dang / don gnyer te/ cha rkyen gsum 'dzom dgos pa'i tshul gsungs pa dang / de bzhin du dam chos seng ge'i 'o ma lta bu de/ slob ma rin po che'i snod lta bu zhig med na/ chos kyi 'o ma ldug mi rung ba'i tshul mang po gsungs/ deng sang ni dpal 'byor gyi bam cung tsam 'thug po yod mkhan tshos/ bla ma su'ang bsten rgyu rnyed/ dbang lung khrid gsum yang / ci zab zab zhu rgyu rnyed rung / rang nyid snod tshad ldan min stabs kyis nyams rtogs kyi yon tan sna gcig kyang rgyud la ma skyes pas/ mthar bla ma de la dad log byas te/ 'bras med stong par lus 'dug deng gi bla ma rnam pas kyang dpal 'byor gyi pad tshal du/ dam chos kyi bung bas lding skor byed kyi yod pa yang kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ bla ma dpal 'byor la sems pa shor ba 314

'di chos kyi ro myong ma shes pa dang / chos kyis sems kha ma gang nas/ 'jig rten gyi phun tshogs longs spyod kyis sems bslus song ba red/ yang deng sang 'byor ldan gyi gang zag 'gas/ bla ma dam pa mngon shes ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs dang ldan pa/ nyams rtogs kyis rgyud phyug pa/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa dag ni mar pa lo tsā nang bzhin lung khug tu sdod pa las/ grong khyer rnams su mi 'khyar zhing / nang du nyams len la rem ste bzhugs pas khyed dang thug rgyu'i go skabs mi ldan la/ gal te thug rung khyed mi la ras pa lta bu'i slob ma tshad ldan min stabs kyis bla ma dam pa'i yon tan mthong dka'/ gal te bla ma'i yon tan cung zad mthong ste/ bla ma la bsten rung / bla mas mar pa lo tsās mi la ras pa la sdug gtad pa'i sum cha gcig khyed kyi thog tu phab na khyed bla ma la dad log ma byed na yag shos zhig tu brtsi dgos par 'gyur/ deng sang bla ma slob ma btsal mkhan dang / slob ma bla ma batrel mkhan gnyis/ 'du 'dzi'i 'tshub cha che ba'i grong khyer du lhan 'dzoms kyis chos kyi bgro gleng byas mthar/ chos kyi bgo bsha' 'gyed phyir slob ma sne khrid kyis bla ma sa cha nges med du drangs te/ dad pa'i yon du 'byor ba'i dpal 'byor rnam thos sras la 'gran pa lta bu re thob kyi yod/ ma gzhir bla ma mar pas/ mi la ras pa la slob ma skyong ba yin na/ slob ma chos kyis skyong ba zhes bya/ go thos ltar na deng sang bshad grwa rnams kyis dpe cha re zhus te/sdod khang du log rjes rgya'i skad yig kho na sbyong gi 'dug zer/ bla grwa de rigs kyis nang du nyams len la mi rem nas lha gru( 7ṣ+ka)la bsdad de slob ma btsal bar 'gro 'dod yod pa red/ bya ba 'di rigs la ma gzab na chos kha la yod kyang khog na med ces pa de 'gyur srid pas/ nang du nyams len la 'bad pa ci thub bya rgyu'i re ba zhus pa lags/ nang gi ting 'dzin la rem nas dam pa'i chos kyi ro myong ba dag ni/ phyi rol gyi rkyen dag gis bslu mi thub cing / 'jig 315

rten gyi 'tsho ba las logs su gyur ba'i lha chos la longs su spyod kyi yod pa red/de 'dra'i dam pa'i rigs kyis ni/ rang gi yon tan phyir mi ngoms shing /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul du bzhugs kyi yod/ 'jig rten gyi 'tsho chos la sbar 'thoms byed pa'i gang zag dag gis dpal 'byor gyi don du tshang ma phyir phud dgos na'ang 'dzem pa spu tsam med nges kyi gnas tshul go thos byung / de 'dra'i bla ma ni rnyed sla la/ rnyed pa don med kyis mthar re stong du lus pas slob ma mang shos kyi sems bsad de ngu dgos par byung 'dugabaco lnga pa/ khog yangs dang thabs mkhas kyi stobs shugs bshad pa/de yang sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ thabs la mkhas pa'i bya ba la/ g.yo sgyu thub pas ma gsungs so/ zhes thabs mkhas kyi bya ba ni ya rabs kyi las su rtsis/ de bzhin du thub pa'i bstod pa las/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ gser gyi lhun po lta bu brjid pa'i sku/ shākya rgyal po de phyag 'tshal lo gsungs pas/'di las kyang ston pa ni thabs mkhas thugs rje'i che ba ldan pa zhig la 'dod pas/ bdag cag gi ston pa la thabs mkhas thugs rje'i che ba ldan pas gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i bdud stobs can dag kyang 'joms pa'i mthu thogs med ldan pa/ 'dzam gling gi mkhas dbang bsam pa mi mthun pa'i mi sna grangs med cig gis skyabs kyi gtsug tu bkur/ de ltar na nga tshos ngang thung gi khu tshur 'phur ba las/ ngang ring gi khog pa che na dga' ba zhig yin zhes bshad choga'ajig rten gyi kha dpe la/ ring pos myi do/ thung thung gi rang do zer rgyu de yang 316

gnad ka 'di la thug pa red/ nga tshos da lta glang sna khu tshur byas pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rtswa sa rtsod gleng dang / zhing sa 'gran gleng / a pho stag 'dra gzig 'dra/lung pa khyed 'dra nga 'dra byung te/ stag gzig la dpa' po rtsis pa'i rnam thar 'chang ba dag gi bya spyod yin zhing / (sprudi rigs kyis ni thabs dang bkod pas 'bangs mi bde la mi bkod nas/ nga che nga dpa' byas te stag mo kher skyes kyis/ gzhan sde'i gong du 'bud thabs byas shing / ngo thog tu phog pa'i tshig re gnyis lji tshad kyang mi lcogs shing / tshig ka'i mtho dman tsam gyis khog nas zhe sdang skyes/ lag tu mtshon cha len te/ gzhan sde chom la phab te 'jam thabs byed kyi yod/ 'di ni dpa' bo stag gzig 'dra ba'i kha ri kha thug zer ba de yin pa las/ rgyang ring du dmigs 'ben bzung ste 'jam pos rtsub po 'dul ba'i rnam thar de ma red/ bdag cag gi ston pas 'jam po'i 'phrin las kyis 'jam po 'dul bar ma zad/ rtsub po yang 'dul ba ni kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ mi la ras pa rgyu nor gyis ches dbul zhing tha na rang kha gso ba'i 'tsho chas kyang med cing / 'tsho ba bya 'tsho bye'u 'tsho la brten nas byang chub sems rgyud la sbyor nas thabs mkhas thugs rje'i spyod pas/ khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje dang / sha khyi dang / sha ba bcas pa'i sems rgyud gyong po de 'dul thub ba byung / der brten nga tsho la dgos rgyu ni zhi ba'i thabs dang bkod pa/ blo rgya mkha' ltar yangs pa/ phan sems sbrang char dang 'dra ba/ shes rab nyi ma ltar gsal ba zhig byung na/ 'dug bde shi skyid/gzhan sdes gong du bkur ba/ rang sdes rtsis mthong che ba/ lha dang lha min bcas pa kha 'og tu 'du ba/ kha 'og tu 'dus ba'i sems can de dag yang /sems kyi dga' ba dang / lus kyi bde ba sprad thub pa/ kun gyis mchod bstod yul du gyur rung / ngo gnong mi dgos pa/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang / 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig ces gsungs 317

pa ltar gyur srid pas/ 'di las phan pa che ba gang na yod/ de bzhin du spyod 'jug las/ chu skyar byi la chom rkun dag sgra med 'jab cing 'gro ba las/'dod pa'i don rnams bsgrub pa ltar/ thub pas rtag tu de bzhin spyad ces gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ 'dzam gling dbang bsgyur ba'i rlabs chen gyi bya ba yi ram 'degs la/ thabs mkhas kyi bya ba ste/ chu bya dang byi la sogs bzhin du drag rtsub kyi rnam pa mi bstan zhing / 'jam po'i spyod pas skyongs te yongs kyis rtsod med gong du bkur ba zhig byung na dpa' bo yang de yin la/mdzangs pa yang de yin/ don med kyis 'thab mo byas te/ mi tshe thung thung nang du 'phag 'tshag brgyab nas/ mgo lus rnams su rma shul bzhag pa dag dpa' bo'i lag rjes yin snyam na nang dkyil nor 'khrul tshabs che ba de yin/'dzam gling na chos srid gnyis kyis 'gro ba dbang du bsdu ba'i cha rkyen du mtshon cha spyad cing / drag rtsub kyi rnam pa ldan pas ma yin zhing / / mi sna grags can yongs kyis bkur 'os pa/ sems can dbang du bsdu pa po de dag mtshon cha la lag pas gtan nas reg ma myong pa yang yod/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ bdag cag gi ston pa la/ bdud kyi mtshon cha tsub mo dag la 'jam mnyen me tog lan du sbyin/ lhas byin khros pas skyogs rdo 'phang tshe mi smra brtul zhugs dang blangs/ rang gi dgra la sdang mig tsam yang blta bar mi nus shākya'i sras/ 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i dgra chen skyob pa'i grogs su shes ldan su yis bkur zhes zol bstod kyi tshul 'di la gzigs dang / phar ci tsam gyis ngan par byas rung tshur de tsam gyis bzang por byas shing / ngan lan bzang 'jal byas pa'i che ba 'di bdag cag gi ston pa la yod pas/ mi rigs mi 'dra ba/ rgyal khab mi 'dra ba/ lo rgyus mi 'dra ba kun gyis ston pa thugs rje can la bkur ba'i rgyu mtshan yang des red/ der brten mig thag thung zhing khog pa chung ba'i las ka ring du dor te/thabs dang bkod pas sgyu 318

rtsal ngoms shing / rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i bya ba bsgrubs te/ rtsod med kyi skyes bu chen po gyur thabs la 'bad cig dkar mdzes rong pa tsha la dar rgyas dgon zhes dge lugs pa'i dgon pa chen po zhig yod cing / sngon dus dpe cha'i slob gnyer de tsam mi byed na yang / rjesastasu grwa sa nas dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub ched mngags kyis dar rgyas dgon du zhabs pad bkod/dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub grwa sa nas dar rgyas dgon du phebs dus dpe cha sgam gang las/ dngos po gzhan gang yang med pa'i bya btang gi tshul du phebs/ de nas rim bzhin dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub kyis zhi 'jam gyi slob gso dang / thabs mkhas kyi spyod pas dgon par chos ra tshugs shing /dpe cha slob gnyer gyis bstan pa rgya cheno dar bar byas/ khong gis grwa pa zhig la tshig tsub cig bshad ma dgos shing / lcag tshan gcig bzhu ma dgos par dbang du bsdus te/ slob gnyer gyi sar bkod pa 'di thabs mkhas thugs rje'i grub 'bras red/ da dung khong la grwa rgod mang pos kha zer dang / rnam 'gyur ngan pa ci tsam bstan rung / de trem gyis yag por byed pa/ dpe gcig bshad na/ kha sgang sde ba la skal bzang dngos grub zer ba'i grwa pa zhig yod pa la/ grwa ba de rig pa rnon po yod pas/ dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub kyis/ skal bzang dngos grub la/ khyed rig pa yag po 'dug dpe cha blta na yag po yod sa red gsungs pas/ skal bzang dngos grub tshig pa zos te/ g.yag sngo lu zhes dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub kyi dbu skra skya ser sngo ser la ming ngan gyis 'bod de/ khyed kha tshums mgo la rdo zhig mi brgyag re zhes drag por ngoms/ dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub kyis tshig lan gcig kyang mi sprad nas phebs song / khong phebs rjes dus tshod ring tsam song dus skal bzang dngos grub sems lhod la bab pa dang / de 'dra'i tshig tsub smra zhing / rnam 'gyur ngan pa bstan pa bcas kyis cung skrag pa dang / ma zad 319

dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub ni gang ltar yang dar rgyas dgon gyi mkhan po yin pas/ nga la lcag tshan zhig bzhu nges yin snyam ste/ lcag tshan bzhu sar 'bod dogs kyis nyin kha shas la blo ma bde zhing / mdun rgyab tsho la blta dgos mkhan 'dra ba dang / rna bar 'bod snang dang / tshegs sgra zhig go na yang 'bod mkhan zhig yin rgyu red snyam pa byung / 'on kyang nyin kha shas song rung / khyed ga na yod zer mkhan zhig kyang ma byung / nyi ma gcig la dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub grwa pa kha shas dang lhan cig tu gling skor byas te/sgo chen khar phebs pa dang / skal bzang dngos grub sgo chen nas phyir bud pa gnyis gdong thug pas/ skal bzang dngos grub 'jigs dngangs kyis rngul chu shor song / dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub kyis/ zhal 'dzums mdangs dang bcas te/ skal bzang dngos grub khyed rang khams dwangs ba yin pas gsungs te/ 'tshams 'dri mdzad pas/ skal bzang dngos grub ni dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub la dad pa snying khong nas skyes te mig chu dbang med kyis shor zhing re zhig had de lus/ dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub phebs tshar rjes skal bzang dngos grub kyis bsam blo btang btang pas/ ha las te de 'dra'i bya ngan btsog pa zhig byas kyang da dung byams skyong gi tshul du 'tshams 'dri mdzad pa 'di bsam yul las 'das pa'i don zhig red snyam ste/ khyim nas dar dkar po zhig khyer te dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub rtsar song ste/bzod gsol zhus pas/ dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub kyis ci yang mi skyon/khyed rang dpe cha ltos gsungs pas/ de nas bzung skal bzang dngos grub kyis dpe cha bltas pas rjes su dge bshes gtong thub pa byung 'dug dngos yod kyi lo rgyus 'di las go thub pa ni/ dge bshes byams pa mkhas grub la nor gyi 'byor ba mi ldan zhing / rgyab dpung gang yang med rung / shes rab dang / thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas kun kyang dbang du bsdu ba de'o/ 'di 320

dang 'di 'dra ba'i lo rgyus ni ha cang mang bas bri bar mi lang /bcu drug pa/ sangs rgyas dang sems can la bya ba byed pa'i chul cung zad bshad pa/de yang rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ gcig sems can la phan btags na sangs rgyas thugs dgyes par 'gyur ba'i tshul 'di ltar gsungs te/ 'gro la phan pa ma gtogs pa/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs ma mchis zhes gsungs pas/sangs rgyas thugs dgyes pa'i thabs nyag gcig de sems can la phan btags pa de yin pa dang / gnyis/ sems can la phan btags na phan yon khyad par can yod pa'i tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ phan pa bsam pa tsam gyis kyang / sangs rgyas mchod las khyad 'phags na/ sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ bde don brtson pa smros ci dgos zhes gsungs pas sems can la phan sems yod pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas la mchod pa byas pa las kyang phan yon che na sems can gyi don dngos su bsgrub na lta ci smos zhes pa dang /gsum/ sems can dang sangs rgyas gnyis chos 'grub pa'i cha nas 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sems can la gus par byed dgos pa'i tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba las/ sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/ rgyal la gus byed de bzhin du/ sems can la min ci yi tshul zhes gsungs pas sems can la brten nas kyang chos phun sum tshogs pa 'grub par 'gyur bas sems can la gus pa byed dgos pa dang / bzhi sems can bdag tu mdzad po sangs rgyas yin pas sems can la gus pa byed dgos tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ 'gro ba 'di kun thugs rje bdag can des/ bdag 321

tu mdzad pa 'di la the tshom med/ sems can ngo bor mthong ba 'di dag nyid/mgon de bdag nyid ci phyir gus mi byed zhes gsungs pas sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis bdag tu mdzad pa yin zhing / mthong tshul la sems can gyi ngo bor mthong ba yin pas/ don du mgon po sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid can yin stabs gus pa byed rgyu dang / lnga/ sems can la rgyab dpung stobs chen yod pas gnod par byed mi rung ba'i tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ de bzhin gnod byed nyam chung ba/ 'ga' yang khyad du gsad mi bya/ 'di ltar dmyal ba'i srung ma dang / thugs rje ldan rnams de yi dpung gsungs pas/ sems can nyam chung la khyad bsad bya mi rung ste/ dmyal srung dang thugs rjes can thams cad sems can nyam chung de'i dpung rogs yin pa dang / drug sems can la mi mgu ba byas pas rang la gnod pa che ba'i tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ rgyal po lta bu zhig khros na yang / sems can mi mgu byas pa yis/ myong bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ dmyal ba'i gnod pa des byed dam zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po la gnod pa byas pas rgyal po ci tsam khros rung dmyal bar 'phen mi thub cing / sems can mi mgu ba byas pas dmyal ba ru 'gro nges yin pa dang / bdun/ sems can mgu bas sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ rgyal po lta bu zhig mgu na yang / sems can mgu bar byas pa yis/ 'thob par 'gyur ba gang yin pa/sangs rgyas nyid sbyin mi srid do zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal po mgu bas sangs rgyas mi thob cing / sems can mgu bas sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur ba dang / brgyad/ sems can ni sangs rgyas kyis zhabs phyi zhu yul yin pas nga tshos nga rgyal mi byas nas bran dngos byed dgos tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/re zhig bdag gi rje gyur nyid kyang ni/ gang phyir rang gi sku la'ang mi gzigs pa/ de la rmongs ba bdag gis ji ltar na/ nga rgyal bya zhing bran gyi dngos mi bya 322

zhes gsungs pas/ bdag cag gi rje bo sangs rgyas de dag gis sems can dga' ba'i bya ba byas na/ bdag cag gis sems can la nga rgyal bya mi rung zhing bran g.yog dngos byed dgos/ ngas gong zhus kyi rgyu mtshan dgus sems can gyi don bsgrub na phan yon che chung dang / sems can gyi don bsgrub dgos pa'i skor la zhib tsam bris pa bzhin/ nga tshos sems can de gtso bo'i gnas su 'jog dgos shing / sems can la bya ba byed rgyu mang na/ spyi tshogs dang / lo rgyus dang / dus rabs bcas kyis khas len zhing / gus bkur zhu nges yin/ spyir rang rigs kyis sangs rgyas la bya ba byed pa ste/ sangs rgyas mchod pa'i tshogs bsags kyi las te/ gser dngul g.yu sogs/ gzi byur spos shel sogs bdog pa'i dngos po phal che ba zhig lha la mchod 'bul dang /'bru rigs dang mchod mar gyi rigs dag kyang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rten la 'bul mkhan mang zhing / gtor ma ri rab tsam dang / mchod me rgya mtsho tsam re lo 'khor gyi tshul du tshogs bsags kyi las bsags mkhan/ dgon pa dang / sa khul/ khyim khag kun na yod cing / tha na rang gis re zhus kyis thob pa'i/ lta rtog gi dngul nor gyi dngos po dag kyang dgon par tshogs bsags kyi rten la 'bul mkhan snang / gang ltar nga tshos mchod 'bul gyi 'gro gron gtang ba ni rgya che la gting zab pa zhig lags/ da dung mchod 'bul gyi las la zhugs dus ser sna spu tsam med cing / gang yod blos gtong thub yod la/ sems can gyi don la de tsam gyis snang chen dang / mthong chen mi byed pa'i ngan goms rgyu 'byams 'di bzo bcos gang legs byas te/ sems can gyi don bsgrub rgyu 'di gal che snyam/ de ltar na rgyu nor 'bul ba 'di sangs rgyas byang sems kyi ched du ma yin zhing / rang nyid tshogs bsags kyi ched du yin pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems la dka' ngal yod pa ga na yin/ der brten mthar thug nas bshad na mchod 'bul tshogs bsags kyi bya ba 'di 323

dag rang don du 'bab pas mchod 'bul byed rgyu mang song ba e yin na snyam pa zhig bdog sems can gyi don du sbyin pa gtong na byang sems kyi las su bsngags pa/ sems can gyi don 'grub pa/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgyes pa/rang nyid kyi dge ba sogs kyi dge mtshan yod pas phan rlabs che snyam/ ma gzhir sangs rgyas byang sems la mchod pa 'bul ba dang / sems can gyi don bsgrub pa gnyis las/ sems can gyi don bsgrub pa dka' zhing / tshegs che la/ 'jug dka' bas dge ba yang 'grub stobs che rgyu red/ ngas bsam pa la mchod 'bul gyi ma rtsa thams cad gcig tu bsdus te/ bsdoms nas mi sna gso skyong gi don du btang nas sems can gyi don bsgrubs te/ shes rig gi 'i/nga khams shig bskrun zhing / mi ya rabs tshad ldan lha 'dra ba mang bo zhig bskyar gso byas te/ mi rabs 'di'i rjes lus dang / ma rabs kyi rnam pa bcas 'gyur ldog btang thub na de las lhag bya rgyu gang yang med snyam/ bdag cag gi ston pas kyang mi sna re'i gso skyong gi don du ston pas pi wang bkrol ba'i rnam thar la ltos dang go sems can la bya ba byed na/ sangs rgyas la bya ba byed pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pas/ tha dad kyi 'dzin pa ring du dor te/'gro la phan pa'i bya ba sna re yin na'ang bsgrub thub na dge mtshan che/ ngas gong zhus ltar sems can gyi don sgrub lugs nang dkyil legs pa de/ mi gso skyong byed rgyu 'di lags pas/ ya rabs dam pa'i mi snas rang rigs la phyug na/ phyug po chen po/ gtan gyi phyug po/ mi rabs nas mi rabs rnams su phyug rgyu'i 'go tshugs pa yin zhing / bde skyid kyi 'go yang tshugs shing / kun gyis bsngags pa 'os pa'i zhi bde'i dpal la rol ba'i sa khul zhig chags thub kyi red/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ sems can mgu las byung ba yi/ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'grub lta zhog/ tshe 'di nyid la dpal che dang / grags dang skyid 'gyur cis ma mthong zhes sems can mgu na 'bras bu bzang bo de 'dra thob rgyu 324

yod pa dang / de bzhin du ji skad du/ byis pa rang gi don byed dang / thub pa gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ 'di gnyis kyis ni khyad par ltos zhes pa sogs la blta na yang sems can gyi don bsgrub na gal che ba'i tshul shes par 'gyur ro/ / bcu bdun pa/ gtso bo dang rgyal po'i rnam gzhag cung bshad pa/de yang rang rigs kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus kun na 'dzam gling gi thog ma'i rgyal po mang pos bkur ba 'di bshad yod/ ngas kyang 'dzam gling gi thog ma'i rgyal po mang pos bkur ba nas 'go btsugs te bshad 'dod pas/ mang bkur rgyal po 'di rgyal sar bkod lugs la/ khong tshos 'bras sā lu bgo bsha' byas pas rang skal bcad de gzhan la sprad pa dang / de 'dra'i rang sger gyi bsam blo ring du dor te/ spyi sems yod stabs kyis/ phyis su rgyal po gdam dus 'di ni rang don las spyi don rtsis su 'dzin pa'i mi drang bden dang / bsam bzang zhig 'dug pas rgyal por bskos rigs so zhes/ mang pos bkur nas rgyal sar bkod pas/ mang bkur rgyal po zer/ mang bkur rgyal po'i lo rgyus kyi shugs rkyen las/ rang rigs kyi 'jig rten pas rgyal po zer ba de/ drang bden dang / spyi sems yod pa zhig yin dgos pa'i bag chags shig sems rgyud la gtan 'jags byas yod/ de yang ji skad du/ srid skyong mkhas pas 'bangs sems thob ces pa bzhin yin pas/ srid skyong ba la mkhas pa des 'bangs mi'i sems thob par byas te/ 'bangs mis snying thag pa nas gus bkur thob dgos/ de ltar na gna' rabs shig nas spyi sems yod pa/ blo rgya che ba zhig dpon po 'os rigs su brtsi lugs la bltas na/ da 325

lta de las kyang dpon po zer ba de/ dmangs tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan zhig yin dgos te/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas/ bsam blo je bzang las ka'i byang tshad dgar phyin pa bcas ni dus kyi 'gros las thob pa'i chos nyid kyi gtan tshigs red/ de nas ngas mtshams 'di nas rang re'i srol rgyun rig pa las byung ba'i rgyal bo'i rnam gzhag cung bshad 'dod pa la/ gcig rgyal po la shes rab dgos pa'i skor la/ rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos las/ sa skyong yon tan ldan gyur na/ 'khor gyi skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang / rang 'dod ma rabs bya ba la/ 'jug pa'i go skabs 'gag par 'gyur zhes 'bangs kyi bya ngan tshod 'dzin byed pa'i shes rab kyi spyan stobs ldan pa zhig dgos zhes pa dang / deng sang 'go khrid shes yon can zhig dgos zhes pa gnyis don du 'bab sa gnad gcig red/ gnyis rgyal po bya ba la thogs med 'jug cing /blo khog mkha' ltar yangs pa'i na tshod gzhon pa zhig dgos pa'i tshul la/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ bya ba rdul ltar zhib na yang / blo rgya sa gzhi ltar che la/legs nyes 'ja' ltar gsal na yang / blo khog mkha' ltar yangs rnams mchog ces/ bya ba la 'jug pa'i rig pa rno zhing / phra zhib kyis 'jug pa dang /blo rgya sa gzhi ltar che ba'i gzhon skyes shig dgos zhes pa dang / gsum rgyal por kun la snyoms pa'i sems khams shig dgos pa'i tshul la 'di ltar gsungs te/ phyogs lhung med par mnyam na spyi rje ste/ yon tan 'di dang gang ldan rgyal por 'os/ bshes ngor byed cing bya ba mi snyoms pa/ khrims 'chal gnod pa du ma'i rgyu ru 'gyur zhes rgyal pos bshes ngo mdza' ngor byed cing / kun la mi snyoms na khrims 'chal gyi rgyu ru gyur pa dang / gsum rgyal po la bden drang gi gshis ka dgos pa'i tshul la/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ rtag tu bden par smra ba ni/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ yin rton 'os yin yon tan mchog 'di ni yon tan nyer gnyis pa zhes bden smra la lha dang 326
