bcas pas gus pa yod tshul bstan pa dang / bzhi rgyal pos 'os 'tshams kyi thag gcod byed dgos tshul skor la 'di ltar gsungs te/ brdog dang bsdig dang gnod spyod dang / gnas nas dbyung dang nor 'phrog sogs/ ji ltar 'tshams par sbyar bar bya zhes zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhis srid skyong gi bya ba la 'jug dgos pa dang / 'di'i nang don 'di cung rgyas pa zhig bkrol na/rang rigs la rgyal po snying rje can zhig dgos pa'i rtsom rig dang / ngag sgros ches mang rung / rgyal po'i snying rje gcig gis bya ba thams cad legs par 'grub mi thub cing / gnad 'gag la thug na rang gi pha ma yang tshe pha rol tu btang ste/ srid skyong gi bya ba byed mkhan gang mang bdog gtso bo de dag kyang pha ma la mi dga' ba dang / pha ma la mi gces pa ma yin yang / spyi chos gtso bo'i gnas su 'jog dgos dus de 'dra mi byed thabs med shar ba red/lnga rgyal po zhig gis srid skyong ba la khrims dgos pa'i tshul la/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ khrims zhes bya ba phyogs lhung med/ drang bo gnam gyi thig yin pas/ las 'bras mngon sum ston pa dang / 'dra phyir sus kyang bsgyur du med ces pa dang / 'gal na rgyal bo'i bu yang pham/ bsrungs na grong gi dbul bo rgyal/ klad par gnam lcags bab pa ltar/ mi khur dbang med khrims zhes bya zhes rgyal khrims tshangs pa'i drang thig gis kun la snyoms shing /khrims lugs kyi mdun na 'dra mnyam zer ba de yin pas/ btsan pos btsan shed khur sa med cing / sprang pos sprang shed khur sa med par drang bden la lam yod byas pa ni khrims kyis nus stobs red/ drug rgyal po rang gis rang nyid bsrung dgos pa'i skor la/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ rin chen sman dang rig sngags kyi/ sbyor ba'am rlung gi rnal 'byor sogs/ thabs dang ldan pa'i cho ga yis/ lus ni legs par bsrung bar bya zhes thog mar rgyal po rang nyid kyi lus legs par bsrung na/ 'bangs mi'i don bsgrub thub pas/ lus po 327

bsrung thabs kyi cho ga sna tshogs la 'bad dgos pa'i tshul gsungs pa dang /bdun rgyal pos bya ba kun po gros mol gyis bsgrub dgos pa'i tshul la/ 'di ltar gsungs te/ bye brag phyed pa'i blo yod kyang / bya ba gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ 'grub 'gyur kho na ma zad kyi/ ma 'grub na yang mdzes pa yin zhes/ bya ba gros mol gyis bsgrub na phyi'i lta snang dang / nang gi don dam bcas phyogs yongs nas bzang ba zhig yin gsungs/ rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos las/rgyal po'i rnam gzhag bshad pa'i skabs don tshad bdun drangs pa ste/ gcig rgyal po la shes rab dgos pa/ gnyis pa rgyal po lo na gzhon pa dgos pa/gsum pa rgyal pos 'bangs la phyogs med byed dgos pa/ bzhi ba rgyal po la gang la gang 'tsham gyis thabs shes dgos pa/ lnga rgyal pos khrims la nan por byed dgos pa/ drug rgyal pos rang nyid rang gis bsrung dgos pa/ bdun rgyal bos bya ba grol mol gyis bsgrub dgos pa bcas kyis srid skyong legs po byed thub pas/ don tshan bdun te/ ma tshang na thabs chag pa/ tshang na phan thogs pa'i dge mtshan yod/ de nas ngas 'di nas rgyal po'i srid skyong gi legs nyes kyi dper brjod kha shas bgrang 'dod pas/ 'di ltar/ mkhar phying ba stag rtse na ni rgyal po stag bu snya gzigs bzhugs/ spur ba'i yu sna na/zing po rje'i khri pangs gsum mchis nyen kar rting ba na zing bo rje stag skya bo mchis/ zing bo rje ni bya ba ci yang phyin ci log pa sha stag byed/ legs pa nyes par bcug nyes pa legs par bcug mdzangs shing snying nye ba la ni blo gros bstan kyang mi nyan/ myi gcam bu ngo srung gi smra ba dag la ched du mnyan to/ /de ltar rje bo ni bla nas smyos/ 'khol po ni 'og na bkram mo/ gcig la gcig snying mi brtan te/ yul gyi srid kyang dmas so/ de ltar zing po rje stag skya bos phyin ci log byed rgyu mang drag pas/ dba' dbyi tshab dang myang tseng sku gnyis zing po rje la ngo rgol te/ rgyal po stag bu gnyan gzigs la mgo btags nas/328

mna' bzhag te mnyam sbrel gyis zing po rje'i rgyal srid rtsa med btang ngo/ nga tshos rgyal rabs 'di dag la zhib mo blo yis dpyad na/ gtso bo bzo lugs dang / gtso bo'i las don dang / gtso bo'i sa tshod bzung stangs/ gtso bo'i las don srung skyob byed tshul bcas pa la mkhas pa chags thub/ de bzhin du nga tshos shes dgos pa zhig la/ ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi mi tshe hril bo de red/ ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gzhon nu skabs su/ bla ma bdag chen pa'i drung du bzhugs te/ slob gnyer byed ring nas/ dpon po byed nus pa'i rtags gsum bstan pa ste/ gcig yon bdag cig gis dge 'dun pa rnams gdan zhu byas te/ cho ga tshogs par phebs pa'i skabs bla ma bdag chen pas ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan la gtso bo 'gan khur dgos pa'i bka' gnang ba dang / phyi dror dge 'dun pa rnam tshur phebs ran pa'i dus tshod la/ bla ma bdag chen pas phag cig nas sgug te bltas pa dang / grwa pa gzhan rnams kyis rtsed mo'i rdo 'ben bkol gyi yod pa la/ ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis ca lag rnams bdag por byas te tshugs yod kyis tshur phyogs der bzhugs par mthong bas bla ma bdag chen pa shin tu dga' nas thugs la 'dir re ba bzhin yong sa red snyam pa dang /gnyis bla ma bdag chen pa'i grwa slob gzhan dag dgon par 'gyed skal len par song yang / ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan ni bla ma'i rtsar bzhugs te/ 'gyed skal len par ma song bas/ bla mas 'di rgya che sa la lta mkhan zhig yin pa las/ chung sa la lta mkhan zhig ma red snyam nas dga' ba dang / gsum grwa slob tshang ma dgon par phebs rjes bla ma bdag chen pa khong gnyis khe ru yin stabs/ rkun jag bkag phyir/ ta si byang chub pas nyi ma gcig la snga gung phyi gsum la gos mi 'dra ba gsum brje ste/yul sde'i ngo na mi mang yod pa ltar byas pa dang / mtshan mor skad gdangs phra sbom mang bar byas te mi mang yod khul byed pa sogs/ 'di dag gi mdzad pa 329

rnams ni ta si byang chub pas gzhon nu'i dus kyi mdzad pa yin la/ de nas rim bzhin bar gyi srid skyong gi 'thab rtsod dang / 'bras bu rgyal khab thob pa'i bar dang / mtha' mjug dgongs pa rdzogs kha'i zhal chems tshun chad la slob sbyong dpyis phyin zhig byas na rin thang chen po yod pa red/ ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar las/ g.yog rab de dpon rab dang / g.yog 'bring de dpon 'bring dang / g.yog mtha' de dpon mtha' —zhig yong gsungs pa sogs rgyu mtshan yang dag gi skad cha shin tu mang zhing / bod kyi dpe la/ myi brgya'i g.yog depamyi brgya'i dpon zer ba de dang mthun pa dang /dpon po zer ba de 'bangs mi la zhabs phyi zhu mkhan yin pa las/ 'bangs mi la sdug bkal mkhan dang / 'bangs mi'i khur po je ljid gtong mkhan zhig yin mi rung ba'i tshul gsal po go rgyu yod/ ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar la slob spyong legs por zhig byed na/ rgyal srid rig pa zhig sbyong ba'i go chod nges zhes bshad na ches 'tsham pa zhig yin/ de bzhin du 'thor zhig song ba'i bla ma'i rgyal khab ces pa'i deb de'i bshad tshul la/ rwa sgreng dang stag brag gnyis zhib sdur byas na/ stag brag gis rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i skabs kyi mtho rim gyi spyod bzang dag bskyar gso byas pa dang / stag brag rang nyid kyi bla brang gi don du tshong las gtan nas byed rgyu min pa'i gsal bsgrags byas pas/ gnas tshul 'di gnyis kyi thog nas stag brag srid 'dzin gyi spyod pa bzang po de gsal por shes thub 'dug ces bshad pas/ nga tshos stag brag bzang ngan gyi tshad mjal mi shes rung / khong gis bskyar gso byed pa'i sgrig spyod dang / rang nyid kyi bla brang gi tshong las la brtson rgyu min zhes pa 'di gnyis kyi thog nas bltas na/ stag brag la dpon sa 'dzin lugs kyi shes tshod mthon po tsam yod pa go thub pa 'dug ngas 'di nas gtso bo'i lam lugs cung tsam bshad pa 'di/ rang nyid kyis gtso bo de ji 'dra zhig 330

byed dgos pa'i skor la lta tshul zhig yod pa de/ phyir 'don de gtso bo'i las la 'jug par 'dod pa rnams la/ phan res spyan 'bul zhus pa lags na/'grig min dpyad par bya'o/ /bco brgyad pa/ gtsang sbra'i 'phrod bsten skor bshad pa/de yang mdo las gtsang sbra byed pa'i phan yon lnga gsungs te/ rang gis sems dang ba/ gzhan gyi sems dang / lha rnams yid dga' ba/ mdzes pa'i las byas shing bsags pa/ lus zhig nas bde 'gro ru skyes ba bcas so/de ltar na da lta mi yi rigs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas sngar las lhag pa'i 'phel rgyas dang / sngar med gsar dar gyi dngos po nyin re bzhin je mang du song zhing / ar skrun las ka ha cang mang zhing /dngos po rnying pa ro snyigs kyi rigs phyir spung rgyu yang je mang du 'gro zhing / de la brten nas sa khams dang mkha' dbugs bcas pa mi gtsang ba byed cing /sngar med kyi nad tshabs che ba mang bo mang bo zhig gis dpung 'jug byas te/'gro ba mi yi rigs la 'jigs dngangs tshabs chen zhig skul gyi yod/ der brten gtsang sbra 'di gtso bo'i gnas su 'jog ste/ nga tshos ngan goms song ba'i gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten snang med du bskyur ba'i blo 'di 'dor dgos/ tha na gad snyigs dang dri nag ci tsam mang na de tsam gyis bsod nams che bar 'dzin pa'i skad cha dang / gshis ka bcas pa gtan spong byed na khe kha zhig las pham kha med nges red/ gtsang sbra'i bya ba 'di la dpon mtho dman dang /rgyu stobs che chung kha dbang che chung la ltos pa med cing / sus kyang bsgrub chog pa'i bya ba zhig yin pas kun pos/ gtsang sbra'i rig gnas la sa mtshams chu 331

mtshams med la/thun mong gi rig pa zhig yin gyis snang 'jog byas te/ dag zhing lta bu 'jig rten zhig skrun na ci'i mi legs/ bstan pa'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro yin zhing / skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing gi dmigs rim du'ang / yangs shing rgya che ba'i sa gzhi/ rtswa ljang ne'u gsing me tog gis gang ba/ khod snyoms pa la lag mthil lta bu/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba/ chu mtsho lha yi bya skad snyan par sgrogs pa'i chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan sogs gsal gdab pa zhig gsungs pa/ skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing nas 'go btsugs te/ gtsang sbra'i rigs la snang 'jog de tsam zhig byas/ der bzhin du rtag tu ngu yis sangs rgyas chos 'phags mdun nas chos yum chen sher phyin gyi skor rnams zhu ba'i sta gon la/ gtsang sbra'i bya bar 'jug dus chu ma rnyed nas khrag gis chag chag btab pa'i lo rgyus yod pa red/ dam pa'i chos kyi 'gro lugs byas na yang gtsang sbra la mthong chen de tsam byas/ ma gzhi nga tsho gangs can bod kyi sa cha 'di la/ gna' nas rang rigs dang gzhan rigs kun gyis ri mtho sa gtsang zhes yongs la grags par byas/ don gyi cha nas kyang ri mtho la sa gtsang zhing /mkha' dbugs dwangs ba/ chu dwangs ma yin la/ sa gtsang 'di 'dra 'dza ma gling na yang dkon pa zhig yin/ jo bo rjes bod kyis tshogs bsags byed pa la chu 'di ma gtogs mi dgos pa 'dug gsungs pa yang / chu bo yan lag brgyad ldan gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis red/ ri mtho sa gtsang / thang yangs/ nags tshal ldan/ gcan gzan ri dwags 'bel/ khor yug 'bags btsog med cing mkha' dbugs dwangs shing / nyi zer tsha ba/ rlung bser ldang zhing / dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi dro grang gsal bas dus bzhi'i dbye mtshams ma 'dres ba/ nad ngan gyi phra phung rigs dag rang byung khams kyis 'gog gnon dang 'bur 'joms byed thub pa/ sa yi dge mtshan ma lus tshang ba'i gnas 'dir gzhi bcas te 'tsho sdod byas pa'i 332

gangs can bod mi dag la/ khor yug bzang bo'i bka' drin las/ gtsang sbra'i las la snang 'jog byas mi dgos pa'i gshis ngan zhig lobs su 'jug pa 'di/ bzang rtags ngan rtags gang yin cha ma 'tshal rung / rang sde'i mi sna dag grong khyer che sa tsha drod 'bar sa zhig tu slebs na/ gtsang sbra la snang 'jog gzhan las kyang che ba zhig yong rgyu red la/ de 'dra zhig yong dgos nges yin/ skabs der gtsang sbra la do snang mi byed na dus tshod thung ngu nang du nad ngan 'gos rgyu yang gdon mi za/ gtsang sbra'i bsam blo yang shugs kyis 'ong ba zhig yin/ mtho sgang gangs can yul na snga nas gtsang sbra la do snang de tsam mi che zhing / gtsang sbra ma byas rung rang bzhin gyis gtsang zhing 'gos nad mi ldang ba'i dge mtshan yod la/ blo goms song ste rang 'gan rang byung khams la bcol ba'i bya ngan rgyun 'byams rigs la snang chen byed dgos/'di'i ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi bag chags de dkrugs ci thub dang / gzhom ci thub byas na ches bzang ba las/ skyon gtan nas med/ deng gangs can mtho sgang yul na yang sngon chad dang mi 'dra ba'i dngos po sna tshogs shig mkha' la sprin 'khrigs pa ltar je mang song bas/ do snang gi bya ba la sngar las kyang shugs je che btang dgos/ dngos bo 'di dag gis sa chu thams cad la btsog par byas nas/ mthar bed spyod mi nyan pa'i gnas su 'ded nges yin pas gzab dgos/ dper na gna' rabs kyi dus su sa bcud yul bcud bzang stabs kyis/ 'bri mar de dag bcud che la/ kha dog ser shar re yod pa/ bro ba zhim pa/ gzugs po gso nus kyi tshad mtho ba zhig yin la/ da lta de 'dra'i 'bri mar bzang bo yod rgyu phar zhog tha na nad skyed byed kyi rgyu ru gyur ba yang yod/ khyad par du shog bu dang / chu shog khug ma rnying hrul de dag la lung kun tu rlung gis khyer te/ 'bri g.yag de dag gis zos pas/ shi byed gyur ba yang mang rabs shig mthong / sngon chad rang byung gis gtsang ba la/ da ni rtsol 333

bcas kyis gtsang mar byed dgos kyi/ rang sor 'jog mi rung / gangs can bod kyi gtsang ma'i lta ba 'dzin tshul ni/ kha phor so so yin pa nor mi rung ba/mi sna dang kha phor gtan 'khel byed la/ kha phor so so'i bza' btung ldug pa las/ thun mong kyis bza' bya phar bsres tshur bsres mi byed pas/ gtsang mar bya ba'i lugs gcig dang / gyon gos kyang so sor 'jog pa las lus stod smad kyi gyon gos so so mi bsres rgyu/ spyod chas snod kyi rigs kyang mi bsnol zhing / dper na gon ba bkru snod cig ci tsam zhig gtsang khrus byas rung / de dag tu zas g.yos snod mi byed cing / za ma g.yos myong pa'i snod ka de ci tsam rnying rung gon pa 'khru snod mi byed cing / so sor ma 'dres pa byas/gal te bgom yug tu song ba'i mi gtsang ba yin na/ de dag la dri bzang shug dri'i kha ru g.yug tsam byas pas gtsang mar 'gyur zhes bshad/ 'di dag la rgyu mtshan chen po yod nges te/ mi rabs rgyud ma nas bsags pa'i nyams myong phyogs sdom gyi gtam yin par gdon mi za/ dper na mi gtsang ba'i phra phung de dag dri bzang rnams la sel ba'i nus pa yod nges red/ yang mgo dang rna ba/ khog stod dang mig sogs gzer na/ btsog grib phog pa yin zhes btsog grib sel byed du rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi khrus byas te/ nad de dag las grol thabs byed/ rdo rje rnam 'joms las chu yi gser ram yang na ni/ dngul gyi bum pa dag kyang rung / gtsang ma'i gos kyis dkris shing dgongs/ zhes gtsang sbra la snang chen de tsam mdzad/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ rgyal ba sras bcas la nyes pa'i dri ma med kyang bdag sogs 'gro ba'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma khrus kyis sbyang phyir lha la khrus gsol ba ste/dang bo khrus khang gi tshul la/ ji skad du/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ / rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ / mu tig 'od chags bla re bres ba der zhes gtsang zhing noms pa che 334

ba/ yid du 'ong ba'i khrus khang der khrus bya lugs la/ rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ / rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol zhes lha mo rnams kyis rin chen bum pa'i nang du spos chu yid 'ong rnams kyis bkang ste/ glu dang rol mo bcas pas sangs rgyas byang sems la khrus gsol ba'o/ de nas na bza' 'bul lugs la/ ji skad du/de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ / na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ / gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / / rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang /'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi zhes na bza' kha dog legs pa/ dri zhim pa/ srab la 'jam pa dag 'bul ba 'di dag nas 'go brtsams te/ gtsang sbra la snang 'jog de tsam byas/ de bzhin du gzhan ma dad pa bsrung ba'i thad la/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ so shing dang ni mchil ma dag / dor ba na ni dgab par bya/ / gci la sogs pa'ang longs spyod pa'i/chu dang thang la dor ba smad ces khor yug gtsang zhing yid 'ong bskrun pa dang /chu dang thang la mi gtsang ba mi dor ba sogs gtsang sbra'i bya ba la 'jug dgos gsungs/ gzhan yang / chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las/ me tog stan sogs rab 'bul zhing / / sa phyogs spyod lam sdom pa dang / srog chags kun la 'tshe mi bya/ bla ma la ni yang dag dad/ / ma g.yeng bla ma'i gdams ngag nyan/ / dogs sel phyir na skyon tshig dri/ / nyan po yan lag drug dang ldan/ / zhes pa ltar/ chos nyan po la phar phyin drug ldan dgos pa las/ phar phyin gnyis pa'i skabs su sa phyogs phyag bdar dang chag chag la sogs legs par bya zhing rang gi spyod lam ma gus pa la sogs pa sdom pa tshul khrims zhes gsungs pas gtsang sbra la go sa gal chen sprad pa 'di ka lags/ deng sang las khungs dang sde khag so so'i spus tshad mthod dman 335

dang / ya rabs yin min gyi tshad gzhi 'dzin sa de/ gsang spyod khang dang /'khyams lam rnams kyi 'phrod bsten bzang ngan gyis dpog gi yod/ 'phrod bsten gyi bya bas gnas tshul mang bo go thub kyi yod pas kun gyis snang 'jog byos shig rang rigs kyi skyes bo 'ga' re spyi spyod rlangs 'khor gyi 'dug gnas su gzhan dang bsdebs te 'dug skabs/ gzhan pa de tsho 'bros pa ltar 'dug stegs spor ba dang / 'dug stegs med rung langs 'dod yod pa la/rang rigs kyi skyetshobo rnams rkang brkyang lag bgrad kyis bag lhod po'i ngang bsdad de mi gzhan phud de nga rgyal gyi rnam pa 'chang rung / don gyi cha nas rang nyid la dri nag 'thug po yod stabs kyis/ gzhan pa de tsho rang dang bsdeb te 'dug snying mi bro ba yin pas/ rang nyid nga rgyal byed mi 'os shing / gzhan gyis btsog lta byas pas rang nyid gtsang sbra'i bya ba la 'jug pa'i skul 'ded thebs dgos shing / gtsang sbra snang med du bskyur ba'i ngan goms kyi bag chags dkrugs te/ phag pa lta bu'i rmongs gnyid las sad thabs byed dgos/de bzhin du da lta'i dus su chu 'go thams cad dwangs sing sing dang / gtsang shar re yod cing / chu mjug thams cad la mi gtsang ba'i btsog rdul gyis khyab nas/ chu btung mi rung zhing / chu gnas gyi srog chags bza' bya mi nyan pa'i tshad du slebs/ nam zhig na chu 'go yang de 'dra'i gnas tshul ngan pa chags na sems pham 'os pa zhig dang / yid mug pa zhig red/ma gzhi gnam bshad sa bshad stong phrag gis lha 'dre'i rtsod pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar bkra ba las/ dngos gnas nga tsho la dgos gal che ba/kha yod lag yod kyis phan thogs pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa dang / de'i don la bgro gleng byed na dga' snyam/ der brten rgan mo bsam bzang gi tshul du zhu rgyu zhig la/ nga tshos nges par du snang 'jog gal chen byed dgos pa ni/ sngon chad nga tshos ming tsam yang thos ma myong ba'i nad tshabs che ba skyi g.ya' ba dag 336

gis dpung 'jug byas te/ e shar ya dang bod khul rnams su 'byams grabs yod pas de'i skor cung zad bshad 'dod pa la/ de yang nad de'i ming la ed tsi 'gos nad zer/ de nyid sngon 'gog byed thabs skor bshad pa'i dgos pa 'dug pas cung zad bshad na/1 ed tsi 'gos nad ces pa ni ci yin nam/ed tsi 'gos nad ni ed tsi 'bu phra las byung ba'i 'gos nad tshabs chen zhig yin pa red/ ed tsi 'gos nad kyi 'bu phra de mi'i lus po nang 'dzul rjes/ mi'i lus po 'gos nad 'gog nus la gtor bshig thebs stabs/ ed tsi 'gos nad phog ba'i mi rnams la spyir btang gi mi rnams la phog dka' ba'i 'gos nad dang skran nad phog sla ba dang / rting mar sha skam pas/sa skam du gyur nas shi 'duga.ed tsi 'gos nad phog pa'i mir 'phral du nad rtags mthong mi thub cing / spyir btang du lo lnga nas bcu tsam phyin rjes gzhi nas mngon thub/nad rtags ma mngon sngon la ed tsi 'gos nad khyer mkhan zer gyi yod/2 ed tsi 'gos nad de ci 'dra 'gos pa red/ed tsi 'gos nad de gsham gyi bya ba gsum las 'gos pa ste/gcig lus 'brel byed pa las 'gos pa/ 'dzam gling yongs su lus 'brel byed pa ni ed tsi nad 'gos pa'i rgyun mthong bya ba zhig yin pa red/'bu phra de ed tsi 'gos nad yod pa'i mi las lus 'brel bya yul la 'gos pa dang / gal te lus 'brel bya yul la reg dug yod na de bas kyang ed tsi 'gos nad phog sla ba red/ gnyis/ khrag nas 'gos pa/ de ed tsi'i 'bu phra 'gos pa'i khrag rgyag pa dang khrag bzos sman rdzas 'thung nas mir 'gos pa red/ ed tsi'i 'bu phra 'gos pa'i sman khab dang de min gyis sman bcos yo byad spyad na'ang mir nad de 'gos nges yin/ sdod rtsar dug khab rgyag mkhan 337

dang sman khab yang yang spyad de dug sel yag po ma byas na ed tsi 'gos nad sngon 'gog byed thabs med pa red/gsum/ ma lus phru gu dmar 'byar la 'gos pa/ ed tsi 'gos nad phog pa'i sbrum ma las phru gu ma skye sngon dang phru gu skye ring dang phru gu skyes rjes nu ma snum pa'i skabs su ed tsi 'bu phra de phru gu dmar 'byar ram mngal chags phru gur 'gos srid pa red/2 ed tsi 'gos nad sngon 'gog byed dgos/nga tsho mi'i rigs kyis ed tsi 'gos nad thag gcod byed pa'i byed thabs da dung rnyed med pa red/ 'on kyang nga tshos nad der sngon 'gog byed thub pas de'i don la do snang byed dgos/gcig rang lus rang gces byed pa dang gang mos kyis lus 'brel ma byas na ed tsi 'gos nad sngon 'gog byed thub pa red/gnyis/ yang dag pa'i sgo nas sbrum 'gog sgro'u bed spyod byas na/ reg dug dang ed tsi 'gos nad sngon 'gog byed thub pa red/gsum/ dus thog du sman bcos byed pa dang snga tsam sgrig lam la brten nas sman 'thung rgyu de ni ed tsi 'gos nad rgya yan du mi 'gro ba'i byed thabs shig yin/bzhi/ dgos nges med pa'i khrag dang sman khab rgyag mi nyan pa dang spyod thengs gcig gi sman khab rgyag dgos/lnga/ gzhan dag dang mnyam du skra gri dang so shad mnyam spyod mi rung /drug gzhan dag dang dug khab yo byad mnyam spyod byed pa ni ed tsi 'gos nad 'gos pa'i lam bu gal chen zhig yin pas/ dug rdzas gtan 'gog byed dgos/bdun/ a ma'i mngal nas nad de 'gos nad de 'gos par g.yol 338

thabs byed dgos/4 reg dug nang nad ga re 'dus yod pa/reg dug ces pa ni gtso bor lus 'brel byas nas 'gos pa'i nad cig yin pa red/ 'gos nad des gtso bor mi'i skye 'phel dbang bo gcin lam/rmen bu bcas la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen gtong gi yod pa red/ reg dug ces pa gtso bo ni reg dug dang grang gzhi/ spen bu'i skran nad sogs nad rigs bcu tsam bsdus yod pa red/ spyir nad 'di dag ni grang gzhi'i nad yin zhing / rgyu 'dod chags kyis bskyed pa'i nad yin pas chags pa'i spyod la ma yang dag la rem rgyu gal che/5 reg dug gi gnod pa phyogs ga rer mtshon pa/reg dug des mi sger dang khyim tshang / spyi tshogs bcas la gnod 'tshe tshabs chen gtong gi yod pa dang de'i mtshon tshul gtso bo ni gsham gsal/gcig mi sger gyi lus po bde thang yong bar gnod pa dang phru gu skye mi thub pa/ ngal rtsol gyi nus pa shor ba dang tha na shi 'gro nges yin/gnyis/ khyim tshang gi bde skyid la gtor bshig thebs pa dang rang nyid kyi lus po bde thang la gnod pa/ mi rigs kyi dar rgud ci yong dang thad kar 'brel ba yod/gsum/ spyi tshogs dang khyim tshang / mi sger bcas kyi dpal 'byor khur bo je ljid dang spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bar shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs nges red/6 reg dug gi nad de gang 'dra byas nas sngon 'gog byed dgos zer na/gcig shugs chen pos 'phrod bsten dril bsgrags kyis las ka spel nas dmangs yongs su reg dug dang ed tsi 'gos nad 'gog bcos kyi shes 339

bya khyab spel btang ste/ mang tshogs rang nyid kyi 'gog bcos 'du shes mtho ru btang nas reg dug gis mi sger dang khyim tshang / spyi tshogs bcas la gnod 'tshe je nyung du 'gro bar byed dgos/gnyis/ reg dug 'gog bcos las khungs kyis nan tan gyi sgo nas do dam lam lugs dang lag rtsal spyod lugs lag len bstar nas reg dug gis mi sger dang khyim tshang / spyi tshogs bcas la gnod 'tshe je nyung du 'gro ba byed dgos/gsum/ reg dug 'gog bcos las khungs kyis nan tan gyi sgo nas do dam lam lugs dang lag rtsal spyod lugs lag len bstar te reg dug gi 'byung khungs sngon 'gog byas nas spyod thengs gcig gi sman khab yo byad khyab spel byed dgos/bzhi/ dmigs gsal las gnas kyi las sgrub mi sna dang rgyal mtshams nas 'gro 'ong byed pa'i mi sna'i lus por zhib bsher bya skabs khrims srol la gzhir bzung nas 'gro lugs sgrub dgos/lnga/ rim pa so so'i sman bcos rims 'gog dang lus khams bde srung las khungs kyis sbrum mar reg dug 'gos par mthong chen hur brtson gyis sman bcos byed dgos/7 reg dug phog na gang 'dra byed dgos sam/gcig rang nyid la reg dug phog pa'i tshor snang byung tshe/ skrag snang dang ngo tsha skye mi nyan la rang shi byed dgos bsam mi rung / sems lhod po'i sgo nas sman bcos bya rgyu'i gra sgrig gang mgyogs bya dgos/ gnyis/ nges par du bza' tshang bar lus 'brel byed mtshams 'jog dgos pa dang mi gzhan pa dang lus 'brel byed mi nyan pa dang / rang rang gis mtshan ma gtsang ma byas nas/ khyim tshang dang de min la reg dug dang 340

ed tsi 'gos nad phog tu 'jug mi rung /gsum/ 'phral du rgyal khab kyi sman khang nang sman bcos byed par 'gro nas nad gzhi 'gor 'gyangs gtong mi rung / gal te sman bcos kyi dus tshod 'gor 'gyangs byas na/ nad gzhi je ljid 'gro srid pa ma tshad lus po la gnod skyon tshabs chen thebs nges red/bzhi/ nad gzhi thag chod rjes/ nges par du sman bcos byed dgos pa dang / sman bcos rgyun 'khyongs byas na nad de 'jam thub pa red/ rang gi sman nyos nas 'thung ba dang / da dung sger btsugs sman khang rdzun ma dag gi mgo skor g.yo 'og tu tshud nges pas de rigs la gzab dgos/ nad 'jam rjes dus yun nges can nang yang bskyar zhib gsher byas na/ gzhi nas nad gzhi gtsang sel byed thub/rdo spyir btang gi spyi tshogs thog gi 'brel gtug byed par ed tsi 'gos nad 'gos sam/ed tsi 'gos nad gyi 'bu phra de mtha' rlung ngam spyi tshogs thog gi 'brel gtug byed par 'gos mi thub pa dang / ed tsi 'gos nad yod mkhan dang lag pa 'ju res byed pa dang las ka mnyam sgrub byed pa/ skad cha bshad pa/slob sbyong byed pa/ za ma za ba/ rlangs 'khor gcig tu mnyam bzhugs byed pa/ gsang spyod mnyam spyod byed pa/ chu rkyal rgyag pa sogs las ed tsi 'gos nad 'gos mi thub pa red/ der brten ed tsi 'gos nad kyi 'bu phra de mi'i khrag dang gzugs po nas bral na rang byung khor yug tu skye nus ha cang zhan pa'i mir 'gos mi thub pa red/ blo mthun rnam pa tsho/ khyed rnam pa'i lus po bde thang dang 'tsho ba skyid por yong dgos na nad 'di la do snang byed gal che/341

bcu dgu pa/ ma rtsa bed spyod thabs bshad pa/de la ma rtsa'i dngul sgor bed spyod byed thabs skor la/ ma rtsa'i dngul sgor gcig gis bcu/ bcu yis brgya sogs kha ba ril sgril byed pa bzhin je che dang je mang btang dgos pa las je nyung gtong rgyu med ces bshad/ de la mdzo mo bzhos te bed spyod pa las/ mdzo mo bsha' nas bza' mi rung ba'i dpe dang / bya ma g.yar nas bya sgang bzhag tu bcug ste ma rtsa je che btang ba las je nyung gtong mi rung ba'i tshul bshad/ ma rtsa nyung ngu yis ma rtsa chen por bsgyur thabs la/ za khang dang / mgron khang / chang khang / ja khang / tshong khang / bzo grwa bcas byas shing / gzhan yang spyi spyod rlangs 'khor che chung mang po nyos te gla rgyug byas pa sogs mdor na ci drag gang drag gi thabs shes bkol mkhan mang / 'on kyang nga tsho bod mi'i gna' rabs kyi gtam dpe la/'brog pa rgyags na chos/ rong ba rgyags na khang ba zer ba ltar/ 'brog pa'i 'byor ba chos phyogs su btang nas 'di phyi'i legs pa'i 'bras bu smin rgyu yod pa la yid ches dgos/ rong ba'i 'byor ba khang las la btang ste/ ma rtsa'i dngul sgor la 'phel bskyed med cing / ma rtsa je nyung ma song ba na stabs yag shos su brtsi dgos pa zhig tu gyur/ ma rtsa'i dngul sgor 'phel bskyed med pa'i bya ba 'di zhugs mkhan yang / lung khug ri sul la gnas pa dag ches mang /de ltar ma rtsa'i sgor mo de bed chod par byas te/ 'phel bskyed yod pa'i bya ba la 'bad 'bungs byas dgos shing / ma rtsa'i sgor mo nyal du 'jog ste/ rang so gnas pa dang / yang na je nyung phyin pa zhig byed mi nyan/ ma rtsa'i sgor mo cung zad yod tshe de gzhi chen khang chen bzos par btang ste/ nyams rdzig po 342

chags pa tsam gyis ci phan/ nga tsho la ma rtsa sgor mo yod pa des dpal 'byor gyi 'phel bskyed yod pa'i las ka la zhugs te/ spyong brdar phul phyin zhig byas tshe/de las bzang ba zhig med ces bshad chog ma rtsa des mi sna gso skyong byas/mi sna gso skyong byed pa dang / byang tshad mthor phyin te/ mi spus gtsang byung na dpal 'byor shugs kyis 'grub pa ni/ lo tog legs na so ma zhar la 'byung pa'i dpe dang / bod kyi dpe la/ rgyu spus ci 'dra myi spus zer ba ltar lags pas/ myi spus bzang na rgyu spus bzang rgyu ni tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig lags/ de ltar na nga tshos 'du shes la dkrug dkrug byed dgos/ glen pas lta sa gcig dang / dmigs sa gcig la byas te bsdad na/ rgud pa kun gyi sgo lags pas/ ngas yang du zhu rgyu dkrug dkrug bya dgos zer ba de yin/ nga tsho'i rgyal khab la bshad na yang dkrug dkrug ches mang po byas/ bcos sgyur lanagacig min pa yang yang byas pa'i mthar 'bras da lta mig mthong yod pa 'di ka lags/ nga tshos rgyun du mthong ba'i ljon shing dang skyes dngos 'di dag kyang char ba dang rlung sogs kyis dkrug dkrug dang g.yo 'gul byas nas/bskyed bsrings ba yang kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar lags/ blo mthun ting zho'o phing gis/ bcos sgyur sgo 'byed ma byas na 'gro sa shi lam zhig las med ces thag bcad pa bzhin/ nga tsho rgyal khab gcig gis las dbang de yang bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi lag mthil du 'ardzog pa red/ phyi nang gi brtan g.yo thams cad la bcos bsgyur dang / brdab gsig cig gtang na da gzod go rgyu zhig yod nges/ der brten nga tshos srol rgyun gyi lta ba ste/ phyir rdzig nyams che ba/ nang du 'phel bskyed gang yang med pa'i las ka la rin thang chen po yod snyam pa'i mkhregs bzung gi bsam blo de ring du dor te/ med pa nas yod pa yod pa nas gong spel gyi 'du shes la gtsigs su 'dzin rgyu gal che/ yang sgor mo yod rung spyod stangs ma shes pa'i gyong kha rag mkhan yang ches mang ste/343

sgor mo stong phrag gis sgor mo brgyas khug rgyu zhig las nyo ma thub pa dang / sgor mo spyod stangs shes na sgor mo brgya yis sgor mo stong phrag gi rin can nyo thub pa/'di dag ni sgor mo spyod stangs la rag las pa'i don yin no/ ngas blta na nga tshos sgor mo spyod stangs 'di gnad 'gag cig mthong gi 'dug sgor mo spyod stangs kyis phyug sprang gi lam gnyis rgyu ba yin 'dug pas/ 'di'i don la gzob pa lhur len byed rgyu gal che/ gang zag kha cig gis sgor mo g.yar nas/spyod thabs mkhas par byas pas ma rtsa je cher song ba ni/ med pa nas yod pa/yod pa nas gong 'phel song ba/ kha cig gis ma rtsa sgor mo rang la cung zad yod rung spyod thabs ma shes nas/ yod pa je nyung du gyur/ je nyung gtan med du song bzhin yod pa yang mig mthong lag zin red/nyi shu pa/ dang len gyi nus pa bshad pa/'jig rten gyi dpe la dka' mo'i las de ma bsgrub na/ sla mo'i zas mi rag ces dka' tshegs kyi bya ba la brten nas/ 'bras bu thob dgos par bshad kyi yod/ dpe cha slob pa dang / de bzhin du zhing las dang / 'brog las dang / bzo las byed pa bcas ni/ las ka dka' mo'i gral 'jog cing /de bzhin las sne grangs las 'das pa mang po zhig yod pa de dag bsgrub pa la 'tshe snang dang / dka' snang gis lag bstar byed mi thub pa'i gnas tshul yod/'on kyang nga tshos bsam blo gtong lugs gcig byas na bya ba dka' sla ni sems kyi 'khyer so red/ dper na nga tsho phal pas nam yang lag bstar byed mi thub cing / bya ba 'ga' zhig lag bstar byed rgyu phar zhog bsam mi phod pa de dag kyang / rlabs chen gyi mi sna 'gas las sla mos lag bstar byed pa yang mngon 344

sum du gyur ba 'di ka lags/ der brten bya ba bsgrub dka' sla zer ba de bya ba'i las kyi steng na med par byed po'i bsam blo'i 'dzin tshul zhig yin par shes dgos/ dper na lus srog sbyin pa gtong ba ni ches bya dka' ba'i tshod yin par bshad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' skyes bu chen po dag snying rje'i lcag gis skul shugs kyis lus srog phongs med du gtong ba la/ 'jug tshul yang bya ngang pa mtsho la 'jug pa ltar/ dga' ba dang spro bas 'jug pa lta bu/slob gso zhes bya ba chos gang gis kyang sgrim du med pa'i stobs shugs can 'dis shugs rkyen thebs na bya dka' ba'i las gang yang yod tshad mi snang /dper na a ri yi dgu gcig gcig gi don rkyen slong mkhan de dag gis/rang gi lus srog phongs med kyis gtong tshul la ltos dang go ba len bde ba 'dug rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ goms na sla ba mi 'gyur ba'i/ dngos de gang yang yod ma yin zhes pa'i gsungs de ci 'dra'i don la 'byor ba zhig red ang / 'jig rten gyi dpe la/ bzang dang 'dris na bzang / ngan dang 'dris na ngan zhes grags pa bzhin no/ deng sang sems kyi 'khyer so mi 'dra bas gang zag 'gas ni slob sbyong byed rgyu dka' khag che gras rtsis te/ ngal rtsol la zhugs rgyu ni las sla mo'i 'du shes 'dzin pa dang / yang kha cig ngal rtsol la zhugs 'dod med cing / slob sbyong la ngang gis 'jug par spro ba lta bu/bya dka' ba'i las la dang len gyi nus pa skyed byed ni/ slob gso'i stobs dang / khor yug gi stobs dang / rang bzhin gyis dga' zhen yod pa'i stobs dang / dmigs pa'i 'bras bu mngon tu 'gyur 'dod kyi stobs dang /'jigs skul gyi stobs sogs ches mang / rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ bzod dka' ba lam 'khyer byed stangs la 'di ltar gsungs te/ drin lan log 'jal lam du 'khyer tshul la/ bdag gis bu bzhin gces par bskyangs pa'i mis/ bdag la dgra bzhin lta bar byed na yang / nad kyis btab pa'i bu la 345

ma bzhin du/ lhag par brtse ba rgyal sras lag len yin zhes phar bu bzhin gces skyong byas kyang / tshur dgra bzhin lta bar byas na yang / nad na ba'i bu la mas lhag par brtse ba ltar/ khyad par can gyis gces skyong byed dgos tshul gsungs pas/ tshur gnod byed kyi dgra bo de zhe sdang khong khro'i nad na bzhin yod pa yin zhing snying rje ang snyam pa'i blo skyes dus/ ci tsam gyis gnod par byas kyang de tsam gyis gces snying 'dod pa zhig yin/ 'di 'dra'i bsam blo gtong tshe gnod pa byed mkhan de la nad na ba'i bu la mas khyad par can gyis brtse skyong byed pa ltar/ bya dka' ba 'di dag kyang dga' bzhin spro bzhin dang len byed thub/ bya ba gang la yang spro bas dang len gyi nus pa ldan na phyir mi ldog pa bya ba legs 'grub yong thub rgyu'i dge mtshan yod/ bya ba gang zhig mi 'dod bzhin du lo gcig la bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu des/ 'dod bzhin du zla ba gcig la bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu la do zla mi yong / der brten bya ba gang zhig bsgrub rung sngon 'gro spro ba bskyed pa ni shin tu gal che ba zhig yin no/nyer gcig pa/ phyug 'gyur gyi thabs bshad pa/de yang 'gro ba mi yi rigs su yin rung phyug rgyu la dga' zhing / phyug 'gyur gyi thabs la 'bad 'dod yod pa dang / de'i don la blo dang bkod pa ci drag gang drag la 'bad 'bungs byed 'dod yod pa yin na yang / thabs btsal lugs dang blo bkod phud pa'i 'go btsugs ma shes pa dang / phyug 'gyur gyi bya ba'i sne bzung ma shes nas dus tshod stong zad dang / le lo rnam g.yeng ngang du mi tshe bskyal gyi yod/ de ltar na phyug 'gyur gyi rgyu rkyen ang dang po de rang nyid kyis nus pa phyir 'don thub par bya rgyu de yin pa red/ rang 346

nyid kyi nus pa phyir 'don thabs la thog mar khyim tshang nas 'go brtsams dgos/ 'o na khyim tshang nas 'go btsugs dgos na/ thog mar sdod khang 'grig po zhig yod dgos/ sdod khang 'grig po zhig med na mi'i bsam blo la shugs med pa dang / ci byung gang byung gis chog par 'dzin pa'i blo skye zhing /snyoms las kyis nyi mar 'de nas/ gnyid la yur te sdod nges red/ sdod khang 'grig po zhig yod na gzhi zin pa yin zhing / gzhi 'dzin rgyu'i 'go tshugs rjes mi de bag yod pa dang / gzob pa lhur len can du gyur nas/ phyi yi khang tshags dang / nang gi sgrig bkod bcas par bsam gzhig shugs je che ru phyin te/ rang khar sdod snying mi bro zhing / tha na mdun du 'jog rgyu'i cog tse dang / gos bcug sa'i sgam dang / mchod khri bcas pa mi bzo rang dbang med pa dang / las ka gcig gis gcig shugs kyis ded nas yong pa zhig yin pa ni dngos po'i gnas lugs red/ dper na khang pa yod na bzhag rgyu zhig yod dgos pa/ bzhag rgyu zhig yod na de bstun gyi dngos bo 'dzoms dgos pa sogs gcig gi sne mor gcig gis mthud nas yong pa zhig yin stabs/ mi yi nus pa cha tshang phyir mngon thub pas de ni phyug 'gyur gyi thabs shes ang dang po de yin/ de ltar na thog mar sdod khang nas 'go brtsams te phyug 'gyur gyi las la 'bad na ches bzang ba'i tshul 'di ni mun nag lag snyog ma yin zhing / mngon sum tshad mas grub pa'i mngon gyur gyi chos shig red/nga tsho 'jig rten pa yin tsang 'jig rten gyi bya ba nas 'go btsugs dgos pas/'jig rten gyi bya ba ni khyim tshang nas 'go brtsams pa yin zhing / gal te 'khor bar sdod snying mi bro zhing / nges 'byung rnam dag rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag la cha mtshon na khyim nas khyim med pa rab tu byung dgos pa zhig yin/ de la rab byung ba zhes bya zhing / 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang yang bsgrub rgyu med cing /dam pa'i chos la 'bad par bya rgyu rang red/ de ltar na rab byung ba dang khyim 347

pa pa'i dbye mtshams de yang khyim gzhi yod med kyis 'byed kyi yod/ der brten gnas skabs gnas skabs rnams su mgo phud byed tsam du kha la za yas dang / lus la gon yas tsam gyi rogs skyor byed pa des rtsa ba nas thag gcod mi thub cing / 'byor med kyi mi sna la skul 'ded byed mi thub cing / da dung lta rtog de la re sgug byas te mgo 'khor srid pas/ de 'dra'i las brgya phrag spel ba las khang pa 'grig po kha shas byed na dga'/ nga tshos rang nus 'don spel byed thabs la mi yi rigs kyi sems khams la zhib 'jug dang / tshod lta mang po byas pa'i sdom tshig ni khang las nas 'go btsugs dgos pa shes so/nyer gnyis pa/ mi'i srog mi gcod pa'i khas len byed dgos pa'i skor/de yang nga tshor spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing kha grag shes pa nas ma ṇi 'don shes pa/ snying rje shugs kyis che ba/ srog chags grog sbur tshun chad la 'tshe ba mi byed cing / srog bslu la dga' ba/ lam du 'gro ba'i tshe na yang srog chags 'bu yi rigs gsod dogs kyis gzob pa lhur len byed pa/ nangs pa yar langs dus nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang / bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig ces sems bskyed bzang bos 'go btsugs nas/ nyin gang bor bsam pa bzang po gser 'dra ba zhig la gzhi bcas te bya bar byas/ khyad par du theg chen sems bskyed kyi sdom zhus mang ba dang / bung ba me tog tu 'khor ba bzhin bla mas chos gang du bshad na der nyan par 'gro mkhan ches mang zhing /kha ma ṇi dang mi 'bral/ lag phreng ba dang mi 'bral/ sems snying rje dang mi 'bral pa'i rnam pa zhig snang gi yod/ tha na rang gi 'tsho ba'i rten gyi sgo bshas 348

kyi bya ba dag la yang lag mi thebs shing / 'tshe snang byed pa/ dngos nas ya rabs kyi mi yi rigs te/ sems can spyi yi bde thabs la bsam gzhig byed pa/ mi yi rigs kho na'i ched du bde thabs tsam ma yin par srog chags grog ma tshun chad la bde thabs byed pa/ skad cha cung che tsam pa zhig bshad na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la bsam blo gtong mkhan gyi mi rigs shig yin/ khyad par srog chags mi 'dra ba ches mang po zhig srog bslu byas te/ de'i don du sgor mo 'bum phrag mang po gtong gi yod/ srog bslu 'di 'dra byed mkhan ni 'dzam gling na nga tsho mi rigs las gzhan med ces mi 'jigs gtam gyi nga ro bsgrags chog pa zhig yin/ des nas khyad par nga tsho mi rigs 'di la goms gshis ches bzang bo zhig yod pa ni/ lha bla ma'i mdun nas bya ba ngan pa rigs mi byed pa'i khas len dam bca' byed srol yod pa red/ khas len pa'i rjes su de dang 'gal mi nyan pa'i bsam 'dun shugs che la/ de dang 'gal song na ha cang tshabs che ba'i nyes pas lji ba'i 'du shes yod pa/ khas len dang 'gal ba'i mi de tha shal gyi rigs su rtsis te/ pha bzang bu ma yin pa'i gral du 'jog srol yod/ der brten khas len gyi bya ba 'di ni ya rabs dam pa'i las su snang zhing / bya ngan mi byed pa'i khas len la zhugs na de las bzang ci yod/ rgyu mtshan de dag gis bla sprul mkhan gsum gyi bslab bya dang skul 'ded 'og nas/ chang a rag gcod mkhan/ rku bcom gyi bya ba gcod mkhan/ rdzun g.yo sgyu gcod mkhan/ tha na ched du srog gcod pa'i sha mi za zhing / sha gcod mkhan yang mang bo yod/ da dung stag gzig dam dred sogs gcan gzan dang / shwa rna dgo ba sogs ri dwags bcas mi gsad rgyu'i khas len mkhan yang mang po yod pa red/ de ltar na nga tsho mi rigs la ya rabs kyi mi rgyud/ bsam bzang gi mi rgyud/ snying rje can gyi mi rgyud ces 'dzam gling na yang skad grags yod pa red/ 'on te nga tsho sems 34 9

pham 'os pa zhig la de 'dra'i snying rje che ba'i mi rigs te/ tha na lam du mthong ba'i srog chags grog ma dang sa 'bu tshun chad srog skyob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan sngags mang po mang po rna lam du bsgrags shing / srog chags de dag tshe 'dir srog skyob cing phyi mar thar ba'i lam sna zin thabs byas pa zhig yin pa la/ mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'dzing mo dang 'thab rtsod la zhugs shing / tha na tshig gsum bshad mi khom nas gri dang mtshon cha phud de/ bzod pa dang snying rje yid yul la ma byas nas/ 'dzem med kyis mi gsod pa'i las la zhugs pa 'di ches mang bas gzab dgos pa zhig tu snang / spyir mi srog bcad pa 'di sdig pa lhag par du che zhing / mi gsod pa'i sbyor ba 'di mthong ba tsam gyis 'jigs su rung ba zhig dang / skyi g.ya' ba zhig yin pa la/nga tsho sdig pa la ches 'dzem pa'i mis/ sha mi tsha ba dang / snying mi rje nas mi gsod pa la lag thebs pa 'di ches 'gal bar zhig tu snang / dngos gnas bshad na nga tsho mi rigs 'di khas len rgyu la dga' zhing / bya ngan rigs spangs nas dam pa'i las la 'bad brtson byed mkhan zhig yin pas/ mi srog mi gcod rgyu khas len 'di ha cang gnad 'gag chen po zhig red/ spyir mi lus 'di thob dka' ba/ thob na don che bas mi lus la srog chags gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rin thang yod pas mtho rim gyi srog chags zer ba dang mi lus rin po che zer ba sogs kyis ha cang mthong chen byed kyi yod pa/ khyad par du mi lus la srog chags gzhan la med pa'i gsal rig khyad par can zhig yod pas/ gsal rig khyad par gyi bkod pa la brten nas las ka ches bzang po re thon gyi yod/ nga tsho'i snying rje can gyi mi rigs 'dis de 'dra'i rin thang can gyi mi gsod mi rung ba zhig dang / gsod mi 'os pa zhig lags pas/ srog chags gzhan dag srog mi gcod rgyu de los bzang yang / mi'i srog mi gcod rgyu ni de las kyang bzang bas cis kyang khas len re byed pa'i re ba zhu ba lags/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/350

sdug bsngal thams cad khyad bsad nas/ zhe sdang la sogs dgra 'joms pa/de dag rgyal byed dpa' bo ste/ lhag ma ro la gsod pa'o/ zhes nga tshos mi de ma gsad rung nam zhig na kho rang shi nges yin pas/ nga tshos mi gsod pa de ro yang gsod byed pa dang 'dra gsungs/dper na ston pa bka' drin can gyis/ dge slong dgra bcom pa dag gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs pa mngon du gyur nas 'khor bar bzhugs 'dod med pas rang la bdog pa'i dngos po tha na chos gos dang bcas pa mi la sprad nas rang nyid gsad du 'jug pa la dmigs nas mi srog gcod pa'i sdig pa yod gsungs te/ bcas par mdzad pa lta bu/ khyad par du ston pa bka' drin can gyis dud 'gro rigs gsad pa las kyang mi gsad pa'i sdig pa tshabs che bar rtsis te/ mi gsad pa ni pham pa dngos yin gsungs nas sdom pa rtsa ba nas gtong 'gro gsungs pa 'dis don chen po zhig mtshon yod pa yin/ nga tsho mi rigs 'di lam du rgyu ba'i grog sbur zhig gi srog gcad pa la yang 'dzem zhing / snying rje che rigs su snang na'ang mi srog gcad pa la mig spu tshabs bkrab cig med pa 'di ha cang ya mtshan pa zhig red snyam ste rang blo la 'gal 'du'i dri ba mang po zhig bkod kyi 'dug de ltar na chos dang 'jig rten gang gi lugs la yang mi yi srog ni rin thang chen po'i gral du 'jog srol yod pa yin la ci nas kyang mi yi srog mi bcad pa'i khas len dang dam bca' la zhugs shing mdza' mthun dang zhi bde'i dpal la rol ba'i smon 'dun yang yang zhu'o/de ltar shes rig gi spyi rnam le tshan kha shas bkod pa 'di yang rgan mo bsam bzang gi tshul du phan re'i 'dun pa drag po zhig gis rgyud bskul te bris pa yin la da dung yang gnad che ba 'ga' zhig bshad 'dod yod rung thengs 'di dpar skrun bzo rgyu la brel bas re zhig bzhag la rjes nas mu bkod bya rtsis yod do/ /351

mjug byang /shes rig gi spyi rnam tshangs pa'i drang thig ces pa'i deb 'di don gyi cha nas tshangs pa'i drang thig 'gyur dang mi 'gyur cha ma 'tshal na yang / rang nyid kyi bsam blo thad kar brjod pa'i ngos nas tshangs pa'i drang thig la 'gyur rgyu the mi tshom zhing / deng shes rig gi bgro gleng byed stangs ni nags kyi tshal na gnas pa'i srog chags sna tshogs kyis skad 'don pa bzhin so sos bsam blo lhug por brjod chog pa'i dus skabs bzang po 'dir/ ya ga'i 'di 'dra zer 'dug ma ga'i de 'dra bshad 'dug ces ngo gnag dang tshig pa mi za nas shes rab spyan gyis dbye 'byed dang / mkhas pa'i ljags kyis bgro gleng mdzad na go rgyu zhig yod/ der brten rtsom deb 'di'i nang du yul skor ljongs rgyu'i skor dang / nang don/ tshad ma/ spyi tshogs kyi gnas tshul sogs gang mang zhig bris yod pas/ rang blo bslu med bsnyon med yin pa sus kyang khas len mi thub pas tshul mthun yin min mkhas dbang gzur gnas dag gis brtag par 'tshal/ hril gyis 'dor ba dang hril gyis len pa de mkhas pa'i las su mi 'os zhes sngar nas grags pa bzhin no/ / spyir deng sang bod kyi dpe cha la gzigs mo mdzad mkhan nyung zhing / zhib gzigs mdzad mkhan de las kyang dkon pa'i dus 'dir/ bod kyi dpe cha 'di dag la snang 'jog dang / nan lta bya rgyu'i re ba che bas/ dpe cha bem ror mi 'gyur nas sgul bskyod kyi nus pa zhig thon rgyu gal che/ da lam rtsom deb 'di'i nang du yul skor ljongs rgyu dang /bod kyi shes rig ngo sprod kyis yul skor sne shan 'dzin grwa la phan pa cung yod 352

nges kyi gdeng 'jog thob pas/ sgrol zam dge rtsa nas deb 'di'i dpar skrun la mthun 'gyur rogs ram gnang bas snying nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang /deb 'di'i zhu dag dang / yar len mar bskur sogs dka' tshegs 'o brgyal ci rigs gnang ba'i dgen 'od zer lags la yang bka' drin che zhu zhu// / /353
